articleTitle: Research on security testing of information system based on interface communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper firstly analyzes the security problems which the information systems are facing such as network attacks and attacks by use of communication protocol. Then it proposes a security testing platform basing on interface communication protocols in the light of the characteristics of the communication in information systems. It describes in detail the implementation of this platform. With this method, one can designs test cases to test the security of an information system according to its communication protocol of the hardware interfaces, which can satisfy different requirements of security testing of information systems.

articleTitle: Study on Shanghai stock market with ACD model based on MCMC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the stock exchange, the trade duration reflect the important information about market exchange. So it has great effects on the bargainer's behaviors and the liquidity of the stock market exchange. For testing the infection of the trade duration in the stock exchange, the paper chooses two stocks in Shanghai Stock Exchange to study their trade duration with ACD model based on MCMC, discusses the characteristics related to duration, and checks the extent between the ACD model and China Stock Exchange Market. The research shows that the ACD model match well with China Stock Exchange.

articleTitle: A network based semantic similarity measure for knowledge management in social tagging systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As the social tagging systems becoming prevalent, it remains a critical question that how to make explicit the semantics for tags to fully facilitate Web2.0 applications. This paper introduces a pair of customized operators for the network of semantic similarity among tags, i.e. NSST, constructs a network based measure to evaluate the semantic similarity among random pair of tags, and presents a case study using the empirical data retrieved from delicious website. Comparing to the traditional measures, our network based measure is capable of evaluating similarities between random tags even not co-occurred, can better reflect the structural influence of the network of tag co-occurrence, and is feasible for applications like intelligent search in user-centric Web2.0 environment.

articleTitle: Research on structural stability of eco-industrial system (EIS)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the promotion and popularization of EIS in the world, how to improve its structural stability is becoming an urgent problem. Based on complex network theory, this paper tries to study EIS structure with two kinds of cases - "node" (enterprise in the system) and the "edge" (material and energy flow channels in system) subjected to random disturbances and intentional interference through two kinds of indexes - the structural stability and performance trends. After comparative analyzing on actual network samples and virtual network samples by Matlab, paper found that the "node" and the "edge" of the deliberate interference with the destruction of the structure to bring the whole network should be much better than the random disturbances. Paper suggested that it is necessary to protect the key enterprise and exchange channels during the actual operation process.

articleTitle: Preparation of titanium oxides films by CVD in O2-N2 atmosphere
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The effect of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fraction of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on crystalline phases, deposition rates and microstructures of titanium oxides films deposited by laser CVD was studied. With decreasing O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fraction and increasing laser power, rutile TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, anatase TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, Ti<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sub> and Ti<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> films were obtained in turn, implying the magneli phase formed easily at high temperature and low O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fraction. The deposition rates increased with increasing O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fraction. The films cross-sectional structures became denser with increasing O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fraction.

articleTitle: Simulation study of harmonic elimination technology for multi-level inverters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Multi-level converters as a novel kind of converters more and more used in high voltage and high power application field. It can generate near sinusoidal voltages with only fundamental frequency switching._This article describes multi-level inverter SHEPWM technology based on the Walsh function model, The Walsh function is constructed using the linear algebraic equations to replace the traditional nonlinear SHEPWM equations. This method can solve the difficulties in solving nonlinear equations, and the online multi-level switching angles calculation become possible. Finally, simulation and experiment verify the feasibility and correctness.

articleTitle: Optimization design for the connection seat of A-type frame of mining dump truck
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new design mentality of the connection seat of A-frame of dump truck was purposed. The force condition of the connection plate was analyzed, and the place of hinged point was optimized in order to places the seat in the best position. Using the topology and parameter optimization method designed the connection seat, which avoided the blindness of traditional design method and achieved a great effect.

articleTitle: Design of PS2 keyboard controller IP core based on SOPC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the IP core is designed with ALT ERA NIOSII soft-core processors as the core and Cyclone II FPGA series as the digital platform, the SOPC technology is used to make the I/O interface controller soft-core such as microprocessors and PS2 keyboard on a chip of FPGA. NIOSII IDE is used to accomplish the software testing of system and the hardware test is completed by ALTERA Cyclone II EP2C35 FPGA chip experimental platform. The result shows that the functions of this IP core are correct, furthermore it can be reused conveniently in the SOPC system.

articleTitle: Analysis on vibration forming system in consideration of plastic deformation of materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Under the function of a cyclic load, material has an elasticoplastic deformation; and restoring force and displacement of a shaping mechanism-material system represents hysteretic characteristics, which can be equivalent to rigidity and damp according to elasticoplastic properties of the material. In order to study the influence on system characteristics due to vibration mass, rigidity and damp, a small indoor vibration forming mechanism specific to a special design is researched. A hysteretic model of the system with a symmetrical curve is established based on real data; and an asymptotic method is applied for solution and analysis. The analysis indicates that the displacement of a resonance curve towards the right increases as the rigidity of the material increases and the damp decreases; and the vibration mass of the material has little influence on the resonance curve.

articleTitle: A simulation study on on-ramp control for expressways in Beijing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On-ramp control is one of the most effective measures to relieve traffic congestion on urban freeway. Take Beijing Fuchengmen Bridge Expressway as an example, the geometric layout and traffic characteristics are analyzed, three on-ramp control algorithms, including fixed-time, Alinea and New-Control were separately evaluated via the microscopic transportation simulation software Vissim on Fuchengmen Bridge Expressway at a certain traffic demand level, and the parameters calibrations were also expatiated. Simulation results show that it is necessary to ramp metering control and on-ramp metering can effectively improve mainline traffic at a certain traffic demand level. By and large, both Alinea and New-Control perform better than fixed-time metering.

articleTitle: CFD detection for inner flow and presure fluctuation in a hydraulic tubine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Pressure fluctuation is a common problem in large-scale hydroturbine, which will affect the performance of hydroturbines, such as negatively affecting the efficiency, increasing the damage of components and decreasing the life span, bringing up great potential troubles to the operation safety of large-scale hydroturbines. To study the pressure fluctuation in the hydroturbine, CFD calculation was performed on the Francis hydroturbine. The model of Francis hydroturbine studied in the paper is Baihetan HEC-a1014-type. The computations were carried out in the whole runner blade passage and the boundary conditions were set as the same as the experimental conditions. The unsteady flow of the turbine was computed. The effects of turbulence were modeled with RNG κ-ε turbulence model. The inner flow field and the pressure fluctuation were obtained from the calculation using the solver of Fluent. After analyzing the results, conclusions were drawn out.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of information-oriented DEA on technology innovation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Information has great effect on technology innovation, because technology innovation begins with information acquisition, however, it finally presents itself in the materialization of information. In this thesis the DEA method is used to build an efficiency regression model. And then the information variables and the technology innovation variables are input into the model to calculate, the result shows that the four indicators, information development status, human resource information status, information infrastructure status, information resources status, have conspicuous effect on patents and new products of technology innovation, however, the effect of the information-oriented consume status and the popularization and the applications of information technique on the achievements of technology innovation is not significant.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the collection efficiency on aircraft ground icing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a numerical approach to calculate the droplet collection efficiency on airfoil was presented. Two-dimensional wind field simulations have been performed based on the Reynolds Averaged Navier-Stocks (RANS) equations. The droplet trajectories are calculated by Lagrangian method. Particular attention is paid to the study of collection efficiency of droplets with different diameters and velocities for a NACA0012 airfoil.

articleTitle: The data collection of hybrid traffic simulation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper use C language simulation a platform as the background, describes the traffic simulation system for mixed personalized data collection process and applications. Focuses on the mixed traffic simulation node data as a way to judge and provides a theoretical solution to the traffic problems. The content of the paper proposed a solution not only to specific time period can be used to traffic problems, but also for efficient allocation of resources to analysis and evaluation.

articleTitle: A study on the calculation method of dispatching intervals in the module of "One Road One Line" public transport
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For maximizing the efficiency of "One Road One Line with Straight Driving" (OROLWSD) Public Transportation System on the basis of the assumption integrated with the method of bus dispatching, we conduct a mathematical mode test of bus departure interval. Founded on the theory on mono-channel and single server system, this model take the length of bus route, the bus drivers' wages and some other influence factors into consideration, balancing the interests of passenger and the interests of public transport company. This method can lower the running cost of bus system and fits well into OROLWSD Public Transportation System. This paper focuses on the approaches and strategies structuring this method.

articleTitle: The arbitrary point of working and locating breakpoint techniques based on the FANUC 0i NC system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, applying (FANUC PMC) technology to get the locating breakpoint of numerical control system(NCS), in practice, based on the FANUC 0i MC CNC system, which designed relocating breakpoint by calling macro instructions of NCS in the working process. The key-press operation and programming instructions functions showed low techniques for operators. The design and operating methods presented in this paper have extensive use values.

articleTitle: The analysis of electronic commerce project risk with the Bayes network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper thesis comes from the definition of the risk analysis. Using bayes network from go up and down from the incredible update ability deliver results from the start node to the result node Through calculating data in the table of conditional probability in the simulation realized project risk.

articleTitle: Analyze the relationship between slowlight effect and parameters of double-parallel-microring structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Coupled Resonator Induced Transparency and Electromagnetically Induced Transparency have similar characteristic in slowlight effect. In this paper, the relationship between slowlight effect and parameters of double-parallel-microring structure with transmission matrix method is studied.

Author Keywords: microring resonator coupled resonator induced transparency(CRIT)

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Grounds Health Management for aviation gyroscope
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Prognostic and Health Management (PHM) technology plays an important role in improving the security of aviation equipment, decreasing the life cycle cost and improving the logistics efficiency. According to the technique characteristics and the requirements on logistics of certain aviation gyroscope, we put forward to setting up the Integrated Grounds Health Management (IGHM) system for Aviation equipment using the historical failure information, current status information and current environmental information on the basis of integrated logistics information system in existence. On the basis of analyzing PHM technology, the system structure and key technologies to realize IGHM system are discussed in detail. Research shows that the IGHM system is open and universal, which is easy to upgrade and to apply on other logistics systems.

articleTitle: Study for mechanical transmission proposal of peristaltic pipe robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: There are analysis and design for moving mechanism from the view of mechanics and kinematic on the thesis. It makes use of screw transmission mechanism and direct current motor to realize the peristaltic moving of the robot. It mainly studies on the double movement drive mechanism of mechanism structure, support frame of the robot which adapts to the variation of the pipe diameters, immediate stop and locked-up mechanism. It also raising one of the best driving manners which could work in both of the vertical and horizontal pipeline and realize alternating motion in limited distance.

articleTitle: Research and applications on a soak boiler with the thermal insulating layer in pulping and paper making technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In allusion to the problems of high wasted energy and heavy pollution in the traditional pulping and paper-making equipment, a new type of clean production equipment "bagasse bulping soak boiler" of 75 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> at a paper-making factory in Yunnan province was researched in this paper, and the theoretical calculation results of the thermal equilibrium were respectively worked out for the traditional thermal insulating layer failure and a new type of thermal insulating layer. The results showed that, the coal consumption of 110, 600 yuans could be saved in one year by using a new type of thermal insulating layer in the bagasse pulping soak boiler, fly ash and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission load in this new equipment could be respectively reduced 0.19t and 0.14t in one year at a conservative estimation. Therefore, this new equipment could make great progress in energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: PWM Control Design Principle for the High Voltage Invert with High Power
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The maximum voltage, which the device of PWM Control Design Principle for the High Voltage Invert with High Power can support, is the DC-bus voltage of the power unit. The Low-voltage device can be used without cascade because there is no problem in voltage-sharing of each device. The low-voltage IGBT power module is adopted in the power unit as it has simple drive circuit, mature and reliable technology. It can be superposed to a high-voltage output of different grades by changing the amounts of device cascaded into each power unit or the pressure level of each power unit.

articleTitle: A dynamic design method based on system reverse load for CDMA EV-DO RevA Qos
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: CDMA EV-DO Rev.A has greatly enhanced support for real-time business. This article provides a design target at optimizing CDMA EV-DO Rev.A QoS algorithm to ensure better network performance.

articleTitle: Research on casing wear monitoring technique based on detection of tool joints and its field test
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Casing wear monitoring is basis of scientific casing wear prevention work, and now there is no scientific and convenient casing wear monitoring techniques in current drilling engineering. Wear characteristics of the casing — drill pipe system is further analyzed, basic theory and analysis methods of casing wear monitoring based on detection of tool joints are established through reasonable assumptions, and corresponding computer software is developed to form a complete set of casing wear monitoring technique which achieves quantitative calculation of casing wear at any depth of the well. Field tests indicate that this casing wear monitoring technique based on detection of tool joints can calculate the well casing wear volume (or weight) at any depth easily, its monitoring and computation are simple and the process has no impact on drilling, so it is suitable method for field operations.

articleTitle: Compact terahertz wave beam splitter based on self-collimating photonic crystals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a compact beam splitter is proposed for terahertz (THz) systems based on the self-collimation effect in two-dimensional photonic crystals (PCs). The splitter has a very compact size of 908×908μm2. The parameters of the splitter are optimized by using the plane wave expansion (PWE) method. The equal-frequency contours (EFCs) and gap map are given to analyze the properties of the splitter. By using the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, the field distribution of the THz wave propagation in the structure is simulated and the normalized transmitted powers versus various radii of the air holes of the splitting region are calculated. The impact of incident angles on the transmitted power is also studied with the FDTD method.

articleTitle: Research on expert system model based on SWRL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The expert system model based on SWRL is proposes in the paper, which makes full use of sharing property of ontology. The relations between knowledge can be effectively said by ontology represents knowledge with SWRL rules, which is helpful for knowledge sharing and reuse.

articleTitle: Determination of gibberellin residue in vegetables and fruits by HPLC-MS/MS method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A rapid and sensitive high performance liquid chromatography — tandem mass spectrometry (HPLC-MS/MS) method for determination of gibberellin(GA3) residue in vegetables and fruits was developed. The gibberellin in samples were extracted with methanol solution, adjusted the pH value 3–4, and then extracted with ethyl acetate. After the evaporation, the organic phase was purified with solid extraction using C18 column. The purified liquid was detected using HPLC-MS/MS and quantified using external standard method. Linear range of gibberellin was between 0.01∼10.0 μg/mL, and the detection limit was 0.01 μg/mL. The recoveries for all samples with gibberellin ranging 0.02∼1.0 mg/kg were between 77.0∼100.0%. The CV value were between 3.39∼10.05 %(n=5). The results show that the method was accurate and of low detection limit, and could satisfy the request of MRL determination.

Author Keywords: High performance liquid chromatography — tandem mass spectrometry (HPLC-MS/MS)

articleTitle: Study on dynamic response of the experiment to potted crop's water consumption detection system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to detect on-line potted crop's water consumption, the water consumption detection system to potted experiment is designed. It is mainly consist of the following sections: soil pot, funnel, water tank, water consumption sensor, leakage sensor, counterweight, dynamic strain gauge and computer, etc. With inputting the pulse signal, dynamic response test on detecting is applied for system. The signals are analyzed for time and frequency domain applying software of origin, transfer functions of the system are established, and dynamic behaviors of the system are analyzed. The results of the study indicate that: the system belongs to owe damped linear system. The response speed of the system, the band width on and others performance indexes are meeting the testing requirements.

articleTitle: The wear analysis for cam mechanism of diesel fuel injection pump based on multibody dynamics theories
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The wear problems are the serious problems that influence the operating performance and life of fuel injection pump. In this paper, the wear mechanism is researched by wear analysis and the kinematics and dynamics analysis of the cam mechanism. According to the wear simulation results of the cam-roller, the location and the value of the max contact stress are gained. And these can use to optimize the structure of cam and roller.

articleTitle: The present situation and development of machinery's integration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The technology of machinery's integration is being involved with the application of the interdiscipline technology. It is an all-around new comprehensive high technology which consists of microelectronic technology, computer technology, information technology and mechanical technology unify, coming of the combination of mechanical technology and emblem electronic technology. The application of integration of machinery technology has brought the remarkable benefit for the mechanical field, enhancing the productivity, the product performance and the quality. This article has summarized the integration of machinery technology, taken a brief discussion on the present situation of domestic and foreign integration of machinery technology, and made a prediction about the trend of integration of machinery technology.

articleTitle: The application of web log in collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Collaborative filtering algorithm has been widely used in the electronic commerce recommendation system in recent years, but collaborative filtering algorithm also has some problems, such as data sparseness and lack of individuation, these problems affected the efficiency and accuracy of recommendation algorithm. According to the problems, this paper proposes the method of Web log analysis and user clustering related technology, this method transform implicit interest to explicit interest of user for commodities, it not only solves the problem sparse data also improve the recommend of accuracy.

articleTitle: A research on influences of wind and solar power generation system on the grid and the control strategies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Wind power and solar energy will play a more and more important role in enhancing our country's energy supply diversity, upgrading energy safety and improving the energy resources restructure. This article is to research into the advantages of wind and solar power generation system and possible grid problems. Present research results at home and abroad are also proposed. And then, design approaches and principles for co-ordination control of the system are to be delivered.

articleTitle: Quasi-bimolecular chain reaction model of energy in greenhouse eco-economic system and simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to prove the feature of dissipative structure in greenhouse eco-economic system in theory, a model named quasi-bimolecular chain reaction model of energy has been constructed on the method of system kinetics, and the stable or unstable conditions of the system and judgment methods of dissipative structure are analyzed. The results of simulation based on experiment of cucumber in greenhouse have showed the only knot of this system was unstable, so it has been proved to be a dissipative structure system in theory.

Author Keywords: quasi-bimolecular chain reaction model of energy

articleTitle: Analyzing system of electric signals in spot welding process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on general platform with Windows operation circumstance, high speed data acquisition card PCL1800, and industrial computer. A software for detecting and analyzing electric signals in spot welding process with high speed and multifunction has been developed by using Visual C++6.0. The system can detect current and voltage waveform of spot welding process, and extract dynamic expulsion characteristic information of spot welding process. Thus, it provides a powerful tool for developing high performance welding and optimizing parameters in spot welding process.

articleTitle: The issues of cloud computing security in high-speed railway
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Cloud computing has brought new changes and opportunities to IT industry. It is the result of the evolution of a variety of techniques. And the railway department will use the cloud computing technology to achieve the sharing of the railway information resources and to improve the capacity of information processing. But with the development of the cloud computing, it also faced with many difficulties, cloud computing security has become the leading cause of impeding its development. Cloud computing security has become a hot topic in industry and academic research. This paper will explore the status of the development of cloud computing security, analyze the data privacy, security auditing, data monitoring and other challenges that the cloud computing security faced with. We will describe the solutions which the industry and academia proposed for some key issues of cloud computing security, such as virtualization security and traffic monitoring between virtual machines and so on. And we analyzed the security of cloud computing in railway environment. We proposed a cloud computing security reference framework. The purpose of this paper is attempted to bring greater clarity landscape about cloud computing security.

articleTitle: Automative air conditioning system control — A survey
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularization of air conditioning system (A/C) in reality, A/C system control problems are focused on. This article presents a survey of different automatic control techniques that have been applied in A/C systems. Characteristics of the A/C systems are described and variables that should be controlled are discussed. A classification of the control approaches is used to explain the main features of these strategies used in A/C systems. This article clearly shows that, with the improvement of people's living standard and emergence of worldwide environmental and energy problems, there are increasing requirements of more advanced A/C control strategies. Studies of control methods presented in this paper are summarized. Development and new trends of A/C control approaches are analyzed.

articleTitle: A survey of study of FlexRay systems for automotive net
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: FlexRay, as the next generation bus for automotive industry, have the prominent features including high data rates, time/event-triggered behavior, redundancy, fault-tolerance and deterministic. It has application for safety critic domain. According to the design and analysis processes of V model, a survey of the work on scheduling analysis of FlexRay bus was given. Secondly, an error in any of these systems results, not only malfunctions, but also loss of human lives. Verification and validation methods that provide a formal proof on an abstract mathematical mode of the system reported in this paper. Finally, the software tools and hardware microcontrollers that can support the FlexRay protocol and integrate FlexRay controller with MCU were introduced.

articleTitle: Motion error analysis of modular self-reconfigurable robot M-Cubes based screw theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the process of self-Reconfigurable for modular robot, the module's assembly, connection, transmission, cantilever deformation and joint flexibility would affect the pose error of the execution module in the end, which would cause the adjacent module not to be properly connected, so the position and orientation of the end module must be calibrated. For analysis, various error factors were attributed to the error of structural parameters and movement variable of the robot. On the "L" structure of the modular reconfigurable robot M-Cubes, the forward product of exponential error calibration model was derived by the nominal coordinate system built on the link coordinate system, in which the rotation coordinate transformation and the translation coordinate transformation caused by the error factors to the nominal coordinate system was amended. The calibrated model would be applied to the "L" structure of the self-reconfigurable robot M-Cubes, which properly calibrate the pose error of the rotary joint axis and hole in the end execution module, and ensure properly connected with the adjacent joints. The foundation was laid for the self-reconfigurable robot.

articleTitle: Integration of PEM fuel cell/battery powertrain: EMI noises and power split strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: EMI (electromagnetic interference) noises and power split strategy are two important topics when integrating a PEM fuel cell/battery hybrid power-train. Principles and methods to eliminate the EMI noises are firstly introduced. Generally speaking, the EMI noises can be reduced by applying electrical grounding, designing a time-triggered communication system and using some filter technologies in electric control units. A power split strategy on the basis of a prediction algorithm is then proposed aiming at prolonging working life time of fuel cell stacks. With this strategy, the fuel cell stacks work in a quasi-steady state and the battery is kept charge-sustaining. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the strategy.

articleTitle: CODP positioning based on extension superiority evaluation model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The mass customization production consists of two stages: the initial make-to-stock phase which is driven by the forecast and the final make-to-order phase which is driven by order. Customer order decoupling point (CODP) is the point which differentiates order-driven flow and forecast-driven flow in mass customization. Reasonable positioning of CODP is difficult and also important for effective implementation mass customization. The influence factors and their mechanism to CODP is analyzed from such four aspects as: market, product, production, and resource. Both the reason and effect of CODP upstream and downstream shift are studied. Then, the extension theory is introduced, and the extension superiority evaluation model is established to select the right decoupling point. Finally, the extension superiority evaluation model is verified with an application case in one China air conditioner company.

articleTitle: Anticorona materials and structure for stator coils of high voltage generators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The high voltage capacity is enlarged constantly, which needs good anticorona materials and suitable anticorona structure. When researching and optimizing anticorona structure, it needs to have the knowledge of the development status of anticorona materials for high voltage generators. This paper covers the ways of optimization process of anticorona materials from the following aspects: the choice of raw materials, the performance of SiC powder, the influence of doped materials on anticorona performance. Once-solidification-molding anticorona and painting anticorona are respectively suitable for the resin-rich insulation system and the vacuum pressure impregnation (VPI) resin-less insulation system. The gas permeability of the prefabricated carrier tapes and the stability of the anticorona layer resistances are the important factors to influence on using the once-solidification-molding anticorona structure in VPI resin-less insulation system. The resistance dispersion of the anticorona layers and the SiC content are the important factors to influence on the anticorona effect. The anticorona structure and technology are introduced from the following aspects: additional insulation outside the anticorona layers, the covering lacquer, the influence factors of corona voltage, etc. The optimization calculations of the anticorona structures theoretically summarize the sphere of application for anticorona layer parameters.

articleTitle: The metric model of software trustworthiness based on symbiosis theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays, as more and more software are used in daily, a large number of many software defects are revealed, and conventional measurement method of software trustworthiness can not reflect the impact of mutual restrain between the various properties of software trustworthiness on software trustworthiness measuring, in order to solve this problem, a tolerance switching function is used in this paper. By introduced symbiosis theory, analyzed the vine network characteristics between the various properties of software trustworthiness, proposed necessary and sufficient conditions for software trustworthiness measuring, and given a formal proof, on the basis, proposed a tolerance switching function and software trustworthiness inclusion-symbiosis model(STISM). It is more reasonable use of this metric model with tolerance switching function because it better reflects the impact of mutual restrain between the various properties of software trustworthiness on it. It puts forward a solution for the lacking of system integrity of traditional measurement of software trustworthiness.

articleTitle: Trusted computing technology analyzing in NGSCB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the Microsoft's implementations of Trusted Computing in its Next-Generation Secure Computing Base (NGSCB), and investigates that why NGSCB can build a secure and trusted system, and shows how it is built. In addition, Windows secure ability on withstanding attacks is also presented, and some defects that brought reproach upon NGSCB are proposed. Finally, some related works are listed, compared with the NGSCB.

articleTitle: Surface shape optimization for the space membrane reflector
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Space membrane reflector is very promised for optical quality application with the merits of ultra-lightweight and flexible. In order to improve the surface precision of membrane reflectors, the formation and surface shape error of a membrane at uniform load are studied based on the henky-cambell equations of circular membrane. The ANSYS software is used to build an optimization model of membrane reflector surface shape, in which the yield strength is the state variable, the surface load on ten concentric annular regions of the mirror is the design variable, and the minimum RMS between ideal surface and mirror surface is the target function. and the theoretical and experimental result show that RMS and PV of the optimized surfaces are reduced respectively than those before optimization. In a word, this paper offers the theoretical and experimental basis of the polyimide membrane reflector.

articleTitle: Fully atomistic molecular dynamics simulations of the mechanism of the drag reduction agent
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Drag reduction mechanism of alpha olefin in crude oil had been investigated in study. Molecular dynamics simulations and quantum chemistry calculation at molecular level based on density functional theory were carried out. By investigation to molecule aggregation, and by comparison of the shear behavior adding DRA and without it, it included the influences of carbon number, shear rate and branch carbon number. It could be concluded that short-chain molecules are easier to enter into the absorbed films near the pipeline wall than long-chain molecules. The shearing speed has a less influence on the distributions of alkenes in the pipeline. While, with the branched chain increase, the number of DRA molecules entering into absorbed layer near the wall increases else. But the adsorption of crude oil on the pipeline wall is decreased. Since DRA molecules diffuse toward absorbed layers, so it can effectively reduce the drag in crude oil transport and overcome the energy lost in the pipeline.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of MDF incoming power disturbance alarm system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To solve the problems of MDF incoming power disturbance and the redundancy of management personnel in communication computer rooms, the author designed an incoming power disturbance alarm system applied to the computer rooms where nobody is on duty. The system adopts a tertiary host/slave structure of the monitoring center, monitoring unit and alarm collectors on each distributing frame. Through the system real-time monitoring can be realized, and the disturbance would be delivered timely to the surveillance center and to the maintenance staff. In this paper the overall framework of the system and specific design schemes are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Qt programming to realize teaching simulation demonstration of exploration seismology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Exploration Seismology is a basic and important specialized subject of Geophysics in college. It's too hard to remember and understand so many concepts, processes and principles for students. And for teacher, the difficulties are how to explain these profound theories vividly in simple language. Based on this actual requirement, we developed the teaching simulation and demonstration software called OpenSE with Qt. As a GUI tool, it owns a powerful graphics library and cross-platform features that make “write once, compile anywhere” come true, so Qt becomes our preferred language to develop this set of software. Through our efforts, we complete the software, which greatly facilitate the teaching and student learning.

articleTitle: Application research of data mining on reservoir characterization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Most Chinese oil-gas fields are almost approaching production tail, and an increasing number of non-traditional oil-gas reservoirs are encountered during the process of exploratory development, which leads to a urgent requirement for advanced methods in conventional methods such as cross plot and multiple linear regression, which can not precisely describe complex oil-gas reservoirs. Thus, the main purpose of this paper is to come up with method of Decision Tree as final model for identification of reservoir fluid based on the comparison of advantage and disadvantage of four methods, including Decision Tree, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Network and Bayesian Network. Moreover, nonlinear regression is performed by using Support Vector Machines to calculate reservoir parameter, which is testified to be good compared with observed data. In sum, data mining is a prospective applied method in oil geology.

articleTitle: A family of three-step eighth-order iterative methods for solving nonlinear equations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we present a family of three-step eighth-order iterative methods for solving nonlinear equations by using suitable Taylor and divided difference approximations. Per iteration the new methods require three evaluations of the function and one evaluation of its first derivative and therefore have the efficiency index equal to 1.682. Notice that Bi et al.'s method in [5] is a special case of the new family of methods. Numerical comparisons are made with several other existing methods to show the performance of the presented methods.

articleTitle: Clutter polarization estimation based on an adaptive polarization filtering approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Estimation of the clutter polarization has key significance if we use virtual polarization filtering approach to suppress the clutter and matain the target at the time. This paper proposes a new algorithm to estimate the clutter polarization. In this paper adaptive variable step size Least Mean Square Error (LMS) recursive function is set up based on double polarization receiving signal model. By choosing desired response signal properly, the receiving data can be estimated by using the proposed approach. The result of the estimation is used for Null Phase-Shift Instantaneous Polarization Filter (NPSPF) design and the target's amplitude and phase compensation. Here the tracking performance of this adaptive polarization filtering approach is discussed detailedly. The simulation results accordding with the above analysis shows that clutter suppression is effective.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of high-pressure capillary rheometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the rheological principle of high-pressure capillary rheometer, three-dimensional modeling is designed by using of 3-D software. Solid model and simulation model are established, and the motion simulation of the rheometer is processed, the working process of high-pressure capillary rheometer is simulated and analyzed. The interference checking of the components of rheometer and kinematic analysis of plunger movement are achieved. The simulation results show that the acceleration of the plunger is short and extremely close to the ideal working condition.

articleTitle: Application of power matching on optimization of three way valve controlled differential cylinder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Hydraulic components are used to drag the load movement, so there is the problem whether output characteristics of hydraulic power components match the load characteristics, i.e. load matching. It requires the load locus fairly match the power sector output characteristics. In the design of the cylinder valve, power matching principle should be followed to make the system work normally and have good dynamic performance. Especially it is more important for high-power control system. Three way valve controlled differential cylinder has been widely used in machine-hydraulic servo system. In this paper, the analytical method was used to do the research of power matching on optimization of three way valve controlled differential cylinder. First mathematical model of its load characteristic was established and load locus was painted, then the output characteristics of transforming and performing components were obtained, finally power matching principle was used for parametric and optimal design of the system. We proposed the design guideline, which has some significance on improving the performance of such systems and broadening application ranges of valve controlled asymmetric cylinder system.

articleTitle: Grey incidence analysis on China's e-commerce development
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper makes a detailed analysis on the structure and environment of China's e-commerce development by means of grey incidence analysis. The results of the analysis show that China should make more efforts to construct the network infrastructure in its central and western regions and boost the development of e-commerce in rural areas; it should further push small and medium-sized enterprises to carry out e-commerce; also, it should expedite training of talents in e-commerce and conduct more studies on mobile e-commerce, overseas purchasing agency and online group shopping.

articleTitle: Ultrasound-based measurement of relative blood volume
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This study introduces an online detection technique of relative blood volume based on ultrasound, which analyzes the correlation between changes in serum protein concentration and attenuation in sound velocity and intensity. By measuring the attenuation in sound velocity and intensity, this method is employed to calculate RBV, and then evaluate dry weight of dialysis patients. In addition, this investigation also illustrates the structure and principle of detection device and provides the calculation formula. RBV values range between 15.6%~22.9% calculated from the model equipment. This detection method possesses multiple advantages such as real time, convenient, reproducible, non-invasive, etc.

articleTitle: Chinese calligraphy system in CADAL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a novel Chinese calligraphy system is presented and implemented. It is designed as a new version of the calligraphy system in CADAL, and will be online in several months instead of the current version developed some years ago. In this system, users can browse and retrieve the calligraphy books, calligraphy works and calligraphy characters, user can generate a calligraphy tablet, a user can write one or more characters with common-used input devices and render them with the strokes of a specific calligrapher and a user can view the writing process of some calligraphy characters. Many latest technologies are integrated in the proposed system. The key technologies are shape based calligraphy character retrieval, style-consistent calligraphy character synthesis and calligraphy tablet generation, calligraphy character rendering, and calligraphy character writing process simulation. The system is well designed and all the subsystems work well in our experiments.

articleTitle: Calibration of simulated vehicle speed in military motorized mobility
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyses factors affecting military motorized mobility, calibrates norm speed under free-flow and unfree flow state, and analyses various limit condition, especially the military regular infection, finally puts forward a calibration of practice vehicle speed.

articleTitle: An unstructured P2P network search algorithm based on percolation theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The measurement of a search algorithm for unstructed P2P network are the hit rate and redundant links. Most current search algorithms are unable to guarantee the connection of the network and reduce redundant links effectively both. In this paper, a novel search algorithm is proposed in which percolation theory is employed, Experiment proves that the proposed algorithm can obtain a better result.

articleTitle: Statistics analysis and eigenvalue construction of EEG for driving fatigue by fuzzy entropy arithmetic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, electroencephalograms (EEG) of drivers driving under normal and fatigue state are collected and decomposed into 4 components, d1, d2, d3 and d4, by way of empirical mode decomposition (EMD). And Fuzzy Entropy arithmetic was used to analyze the characteristic of the components. Results show that fuzzy entropy ratio of d2 and d4 was able to distinguish the two types of EEG with a favorably agreed difference, which could decide whether or not the driver is in driving fatigue (DF).

articleTitle: Research on driving characteristics of double-articulated bus docking the bay bus station
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on theory of Dynamics of Multi-body System, a 25m double-articulated bus's multi-system model is established adopting ADAMS, which is used to research the size requirements of each part of the bay bus station when docking with different steering angles step input. The results show that length of deceleration (SI) and length of acceleration (S2) are not less than 23m, and the width of parking area is not less than 3.6m, only these can it ensure the 25m double-articulated bus to dock at the bay bus station. The existing bay bus station built according to the relevant provisions of CJJ 15–1987 and CJJ 37–1990 can not satisfy the normal docking requirements of the 25m double-articulated bus.

articleTitle: Developing the computer system in data processing of physical experiment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article introduces the function of developing the computer system cope data physical experiment with computer, analyze analyzing the error, forming the experiment report and printing the result, in order to raise experiment efficiency.

articleTitle: Moving object detection and tracking in indoor environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An approach to detect and track moving objects in indoor environment is presented in this paper. HSI model is first adjusted for better motion detection; then based on the improved HSI model, the background subtraction and the frame difference are effectively used to overcome light changing and to detect moving objects in indoor environment; finally based on Camshift and Kalman filter, the detected objects are tracked in real time. With video recorded ahead experiments are realized and the results validate that the approach presented in this paper is feasible and reliable.

articleTitle: Analysis of thermal stability of center of mass of gas-floated gyroscope
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the governing equations is introduced and the stability of center of mass under the condition of same temperature and different screw extension value is studied by using the finite element software. The effect of screw extension value on center of mass deviation along x, y and z axis is obtained respectively. Then reasonable spanner moment in the assembly process of float module is obtained.

articleTitle: Design and mechanics simulation for shell parts of fiber composites
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Characteristics of fiber composites was introduced. The forming methods of shell parts made by metal and fiber composites was compared, and the technical route and key problem of numerical simulation for fiber composites parts were given. The design difference for the shell parts of metal and fiber composites was given through the example, and the bearing condition was analyzed based on ANSYS with fiber composites instead of metal. The result showed, that technical route have general guiding significance for composites instead of metal.

articleTitle: Novel method for processing of the pressure waveform based on Wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a novel method for processing of the pressure waveform based on Wavelet analysis. Wavelet de-noising and Wavelet decomposition coefficient are introduced emphatically by MATLAB language. Results show that the new algorithm is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Effect of burying the straw deeply and plastic mulching on soil water and yield of spring-sown maize
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Areas of northern China are arid, and soil moisture content and fertility are low at the time of planting of maize. A solution was proposed to address this problem. After harvesting in the autumn, the soil is tilled to create deep furrows which are filled with straw and fertilizer, and then backfilled to form ridges that are mulched with a plastic film. In the coming spring the maize will be seeded by puncture the membranes. A field experiment was conducted to investigate the effects of field management practices on soil water and maize yield in west Liaoning province. The field management practices included traditional tillage (CK) and alternating ridges deeply buried straw and mulched with plastic film and bare furrows (DM). The DM treatment significantly increased the soil water content in the upper 40cm soil layer throughout maize growing season, compared with the CK treatment. Maize growth in DM was faster than that in CK treatments. Maize yield and some yield components were affected by burying the straw deeply. The mean yields for DM and CK treatments were 11.8 and 10.9 t ha-1, and DK treatments increased 8% of maize yield. The greater yield was associated with better yield components.

articleTitle: Temperature field reconstruction using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: BP Neural Network (BPNN), one of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm, was introduced to heat transfer in this paper, which builds a complete anti-continuous mapping to reconstruct the temperature field by training sample points of research model, without the information of boundary conditions, initial conditions and physical parameters. In addition, some optimization method like unevenly selecting sample and genetic algorithm were used to improve the reconstruction accuracy.

articleTitle: Effects of Sr on the microstructure and performance of Mg-Al alloy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Effects of micro alloying element Sr on the microstructure and mechanical performance of Mg-Al alloy were studied in this paper. X-ray diffraction (XRD), optical microscopy (OM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) were employed to analyze and observe the microstructure of the alloy. It was found that accompanying with the addition content of Sr from 0.01 to 0.1wt%, the grain size of Mg-3wt%Al alloy decreased from 120-160μm to 50-80μm, proving that the addition of Sr could refine the microstructure obviously. At the same time, the mechanical properties were measured to find that the tensile strength increased from 147.77MPa to 183.25MPa after aging treatment and the Vickers hardness increased from 85 to 102. The room-temperature fracture morphology of Mg-3wt%Al alloy with 0.1wt%Sr appeared as low ductile sockets and narrow sidesteps. The refinement and enhancement mechanisms of addition Sr were also analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: The research of software development supporting environment based on UML
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: First, this paper briefly introduces the UML and two of the popular UML supporting environment. Second, this paper mainly introduces the main principles of UML supporting environment. UML supporting environment includes: UML modeling environment, UML simulation environment, automatic code generation environment and reverse transformation environment.

articleTitle: Research of multi-modal function optimization based on multi-agent immune genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To the deficiency of conventional genetic algorithm in solving multi-modal function optimization problem, the Multi-Agent technology in combination with immune principle was presented, in this new algorithm, the immune Agent dominant operator was provided, the operator can acquire the environment information from the evolution procedure, then real-time adjust and control the evolution operating, in order to find out the global optimum value quickly and efficiently. The simulation experiments indicates that the algorithm improves the deficiency of the genetic algorithm and is better than the conventional genetic algorithm, has the well ability of global and local search as wello.

articleTitle: Low background liquid scintillation analyzer circuit design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Liquid scintillation technique was developed from the early fifties as an effective way to measure the low energy radiation. It can detect more than half of the periodic table of elements. And it is widely used in industry, agriculture, biology, chemistry, medicine, geology, hydrology, archeology, environmental protection and other fields. When measuring on low energy β-ray and low penetration α-ray with liquid scintillation analyzer, the number of its excitation photons is small. So, demand on the measuring instruments is very high. This paper analyzes the source of the liquid scintillation background counting, and it focuses on how to reduce background based on improving the sensitivity from the angle of the circuit design.

articleTitle: A study for transmission scheme of entanglement signaling of quantum mobile communication radio interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Quantum mobile communication is one of the hot-topics in the field of information, but entanglement signaling of quantum mobile communication radio interface transmission scheme is still a gap till now. Hence, this article firstly raises the concept of the Quantum Entanglement Signaling (QES) and frame structure of QES based on the conception. For the Quantum Mobile Terminal (QMT), this article studies the location registration, location update, and signaling processing and transmission scheme during the routing process. Then, the capacity between the Quantum Mobile Terminal (QMT) and the Quantum Mobile Base (QMB) in two-way communication is discussed. The results of the study indicate that quantum entanglement signaling transmission scheme and the capacity of radio interface proposed in this article can meet the needs of quantum mobile network for signaling transmission in the future.

articleTitle: Transmitting circuit design for ultrasonic transducer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Ultrasonic transducer is the ultrasonic transmitting and receiving component for ultrasonic equipment. The performance of its driving circuit plays an important role in the whole system. This paper presents a driving circuit for ultrasonic transducer based on transducer's operating principle. The circuit uses the capacitor to generate the high voltage pulse with the help of MOSFET The experimental results show that the circuit has achieved the ultrasonic transmitting. It is simple, adjustable, and easy to be modularized.

articleTitle: An indoor airship autopilot design scheme
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Current situation and development of the indoor airship autopilot system is based entirely on equipments that are applicable for many kinds of aerial vehicles. Since autopilot system is a crucial section of flight control system, it is desirable to develop special autopilot device for indoor airship, and this paper presents a design scheme of such equipment. Using ARM9 processor and sensors with high sensitivity, such as HMR3300 digital compass, the autopilot designed in this paper meets the developing trend of flight control system with high precision, small size and digital design. Its effectiveness and potential of practical use are demonstrated through application on real indoor airship.

articleTitle: Research on modeling, simulation and control of new type power split hybrid powertrain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to satisfy the growing demand of vehicle new energy and energy-saving technologies, much concepts have emerged, including electric driving, hybrid powertrain and fuel cell electric vehicle, etc. This study targets a new type of hydraulic hybrid powertrain of a series-parallel structure. The look-forward simulation method is used to establish dynamic mathematical model of the provided hybrid powertrain. Based stop-and-go duty cycle, the economy of vehicle with hybrid powertrain is studied based on the dynamic simulation model.

articleTitle: Enrichment of semantic ontology in Tibetan language by extracting concepts with hyponymy patterns
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Semantic ontology is driving the evolution of knowledge engineering on the basis of shared knowledge. The acquisition of hyponymy is a basic and vital problem in ontology building, which provides the basic supports for further enrichment. In this paper, we propose an iterative verification method of enriching ontology concepts by the representation and acquisition of hyponymy patterns in Tibetan language. The hyponymy patterns are defined in Tibetan language, which is represented as a pair of a meaning frame defining the necessary information extraction. Then we put forward a method to acquire the concepts by the hyponymy from the pattern-match sentences.

articleTitle: Topological analysis of deployment chassis of Nomad
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Deployment chassis is to solve the contradiction between the performance requirements and the volume constraints. Based on graph theory, different representation methods of mechanism such as joint codes, topological graph and matrices and so on and topological analysis process of mechanism is discussed. According to topological analysis process, deployment chassis of Nomad is analyzed in details. The topological graphs and the adjacent matrices are presented and the characteristic of basic units are analyzed. The results of this study could provide another method of conceptual design for configurations innovation.

articleTitle: Analysis of melt fracture during the process of macromolecule material's extruding moulding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Melt Fracture (MF) is a kind of unstable fluxion of extruding moulding. We have analyzed the process of MF and introduced macromolecule material solid solution's viscosity and unstable fluxion which can damage the stable fluxion. This is the main reason of MF which caused by irregular moulding and slippage. In this paper, we also have studied the mechanism of melt fracture, what we have studied is import to eliminate melt fracture.

articleTitle: Load adjusting system of independent wind power generation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to resolve the problem about small wind power generator's output voltage varying with wind rotating speed and load impedance, we have studied the optimal power load curve. And then we have discussed how to determine practical power load curve and classified load controller. We have studied the relationship between output power and wind speed, rotating speed. We also have studied the principle of classified load controller and its circuit design. Eventually, we have analyzed the relationship between load controller and wind power generation with variable speed constant frequency.

articleTitle: Virtual prototyping simulation of minitype universal docking mechanism based on ADAMS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Focusing on the On-Orbit Servicing technology, according to the design demand of mini-type universal automounous docking mechanism and using ADAMS-View software, the paper concluded the previous work in the following aspects: establishing a virtual prototype model of the mini-type universal docking organization and completing the dynamic characteristic analysis of the docking organization according to the typical stage researching the influence of the key parameter. The results has confirmed the feasibility of original design, And had provided the design basis of optimization design.

articleTitle: Identifying the mechanism of toxic action of selected compounds by artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this study, classifying and predicting the non-polar narcosis, polar narcosis and reactive toxicity mechanism for 150 selected organic compounds were investigated using Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The variables used were the logarithm of octanol-water partition coefficients (logKow) and 10 quantum chemical parameters including the descriptors of energy, charge, and volume, which calculated with Gaussian 98. The 150 selected organic compounds were divided into two sets: training set (135 compounds) and test set (15 compounds). Supervised learning with backpropagation (BP) arithmetic was used. The results showed that the training error of network was smaller than 10-13, and 100% correct classification was achieved for test set.

articleTitle: Research on the layout optimization method for ceramic core locator in investment casting die
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve turbine blade casting wax ceramic core positioning accuracy and ensure thickness accuracy of wax pattern, the paper proposed and studied the ceramic core locator optimization. Based on rigid body kinematics, the optimization model of ceramic core positioning error transfer chain was established, and the model was solved by using greedy algorithm to achieve the optimal layout of ceramic core locators. Finally, the optimal layout was verified through the Monte-Carlo method. The results show that the optimal layout ceramic core locator layout can effectively reduce the ceramic core positioning error and improve the ceramic core positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: A customized dynamic array for job scheduling queue of a large-scale server cluster
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As computing demands increase, the management and scheduling of a volume of jobs is becoming a significant challenge. This paper analyzes various data structures and algorithms used to manage job queue. Considering a fair and adjustable job scheduling, job scheduling algorithms are generally based on dynamic priorities of jobs. This paper analyzes three conventional data structures, including binary tree, Vector, linked list, and corresponding algorithms used to implement priority queue. Based on the application scenarios, we propose a customized dynamic array to manage priority queue, and design corresponding algorithm, including job queue sorting, inserting, removing and etc. A performance measurement and comparison of these algorithms are performed in varying job scale. The measurement results show time cost of sorting in the dynamic array grows slower than Vector and binary tree. Moreover, the customized dynamic array causes more economical space cost than Vector. Considering performance and actual requirement, the customized dynamic array is more competent for implementing a job scheduling queue than others.

articleTitle: Simulation of the self-sensing actuators based on multi-piezoelectric effects of piezoelectric crystal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the theory of classical piezoelectricity and the rapid development of piezoelectric material today, it has become possible to integrate structure and function of sensor with actuators into the single piezoelectric element. This paper analyzes and simulates integrated sensor-actuators using coupled-field analysis function in the finite element analysis software ANSYS for 3-D finite element model which of models is PZT-5 piece. In the beginning of positive piezoelectric effect, the results show that voltage and displacement generated by secondary converse piezoelectric effects respectively have linear relationship with the applied outside force. The simulation results are proved that the functions of sensors and actuators can be integrated in the single piezoelectric crystal.

articleTitle: Structural optimization of intake pipe based on pulsation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper studied on a 125cc single-cylinder gasoline engine. Within the range of engine economical rotational speed, optimized structure of intake pipe can arouse airflow of inertial and resonant effect. The theoretical model analysis and computer simulation provides directional guidance of improving intake system, which may reduce test cost and shorten the redesign cycle. Through the experiment of speed characteristic on dynamometer bench, test data of original and improved intake pipes were compared. Both theoretical models and experimental results show that the effective use of intake pulsation can improve the engine power performance and fuel economy.

articleTitle: Research on functional testing system of mechanical section in oil logging devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Logging devices could finish comprehensive evaluation in geologic setting, which is important for testing strata pressure, sampling formation fluid and etc. Mechanical section plays a very important role in logging devices, which could take charge of logging devices' acting and sampling. Now, it remands to monitor states of mechanical section. And an efficient testing system could be used in monitoring and maintaining mechanical section. A testing system used for monitoring mechanical couplings based on CAN bus in logging devices is explained in the paper, which could solve the problems about testing, detecting and maintaining of mechanical section better. The system has wide prospect of market application.

articleTitle: The building analysis of software basic course group in the computer specialty
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
