abstract: The characteristics of the course group's building is that it breaks the repeatability which exists in the software basic courses in the classical teaching plans of computer science and technology, emphasis the basic knowledge of the student, which can broad the range of specialty and train the self-learning ability of the student without arranging the content through the course name; In addition, the course group can save the course time on the premise of achieved the training goals in order to teach new technology and knowledge in specialty domain using saving time.

articleTitle: Analysis and research about rocket aeroelasticity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The correct static and dynamic analysis about rocket entities is an important step in engineering analysis. To choose a single method of analysis will have a certain amount. However, static analysis based on dynamic analysis will help to enhance the effectiveness of the results of the analysis. By using of powerful large-scale finite element analysis software, this paper analyzes a missile on Solid Modeling and Modal Analysis. Compared with the experimental results, it has high storage and computational efficiency, shows that this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Radio frequency controlling and transmitting based on the USB chip CY7C68013A
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Use Universal Serial Bus (USB) chip CY7C68013A and wide broadband Radio Frequency (RF) module RFL018 to design a system for transmitting wireless data, introducing the whole framework, flow chat and communication of this system.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: The application of exponential filter on optical measurement of atmospheric compositions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Database design in EPR system structure of automotive electronics company
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The qualify BOM system for all qualify activities in the process of enterprises operation is introduced in the article. Based on that system and taking the manufacture qualify BOM of the automotive electronics company for an example, the necessary process model and data model is established.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of superplastic blow forming of fine-grained magnesium alloy sheet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The process of superplastic blow forming was simulated and analyzed by the finite element software. The effect of the strain rate sensitivity index and forming pressure on the wall thickness distribution of forming parts were studied. Meanwhile the changes of strain rate during the forming process were simulated. It is shown that strain rate sensitivity index and forming pressure have a great impact on the thickness uniformity. When strain rate sensitivity index of 0.5 and forming pressure of 0.8 MPa, the thickness uniformity of forming parts is good and the highest thinning rate is 39%. The thickness gradients appear during blow forming due to the differences in the local stresses.

articleTitle: Study of hospital-bed calling information system based on motor imagery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A calling information system is designed for those who have physical disabilities with normal brain thinking in hospital, which can control the key switch by using EEG if they are imaging. When the accompanying persons are absent, the patients can control the system by their motor imagery.

articleTitle: The development of integrated static and dynamic mechanical test-bed
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new generation of integrated static & dynamic mechanical test-bed and supporting comprehensive test equipment are designed. The test-bed contains eight kinds of experimental devices, it could offer beyond twenty experimental items. The test-bed uses digital testing system with the computer, it has both static and dynamic experimental functions.

articleTitle: Research on ellipse vibration grinding finishing technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In mechanical manufacturing, it is often process for the plane finishing problem. In many applications, the surface finishment of parts will have very high demand, at the same time, keep surface edges integrity. However, in the actual, the manual polishing method is often used for finishing, which is not only high labor intensity, but also difficult to reach the surface roughness and requirements. So the ellipse vibration grinding process method is put forward. The ellipse vibration grinding mechanism is analyzed, and the plane surface finishing experiments are carried. It can be seen from the experimental results that the ellipse vibration grinding process method can get the finishing requirement and has the features of high efficiency and brief operation. The ellipse vibration grinding new process method has high practical value.

articleTitle: The design scheme analysis of energy efficiency fresh air system for residential building
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The ventilation scheme design of solar energy utilization combined with heat recovery for air changes in residential building is proposed in the paper, in this way we can lower energy consumption for the fresh air and there are simple equipment and easy operation. This is an energy-efficient ventilation system scheme for air changes in residential building with detailed methods according to the special condition of our own country. The design scheme of energy efficiency fresh air system for residential building can meet fresh air requirements, which can not only improve indoor air quality, but also give technical support to the green residences design.

articleTitle: Pressure and stress analysis for an underwater vehicle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Underwater vehicles are widely used in both military and civilian operations for more than 60 years. They are the best tools to perform dull, dangerous and dirty tasks in the water. So the distribution principles of static pressure and stress along the vehicle hull must be found out when designing hull shape and choosing the materials. The static pressure and stress on an underwater hull is simulated in this paper by using CFD commercial software ANSYS Fluent. The obtained principles are useful for future research.

articleTitle: The technology realizes the way in the construction energy conservation supervision system's function research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Realizes the way according to management by objectives theory construction energy conservation supervision system technology, uses the goal decomposition method to divide the supervision system level in turn, provided the technology for the domestic construction energy conservation supervision system's establishment and the implementation to realize the way design reference.

articleTitle: The integrity rules and constraints of database
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Database is a warehouse for storing data. The integrity of database is an important measure to guarantee the uniqueness, consistency and accuracy of the data. It is a issue that must be well researched in the development of database application system. In this paper I present some analyzing and discussion about the rules, constraints, classification and control of database integrity.

articleTitle: The research and design of oil field associated gas recovery device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The oilfield associated gas recovery device is designed in this paper according to the status of associated gas recovery in oilfield. The operational principle and working flow sheet of associated gas recovery device are expounded. Meanwhile, the relation of gas temperature and pressure in the device during the heating process is analyzed and calculated through the ideal-gas equation. The gas recovery device designed above is theoretically proved to be feasible. The oilfield associated gas can be effectively recovered by the device which has low investment and convenient field application.

articleTitle: Control system design for multi-legged robot with hand-fused foot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a distributed motion control system is designed and achieved for the modular multi-legged robot with hand-fused foot based on CANopen network. A communication network is built among modules and joints through CANopen network. Controllers and encoders are used to achieve closed-loop control for each joint. The system has completed real-time multi-jointed linkage. Moreover, experimental results have proved the reliability and validity of this control system's hardware and software.

articleTitle: Computer network security and measures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Along with the computer information network technology high-speed development and Internet extensive application, network information and data security is becoming more and more important. The problems of detailed analysis of the confidential computer information system safety protection of the main problems existing in the, Introduce the computer network in today's facing threats. The problems and in the face of such threats should take safety countermeasures. Refer to the computer information system security protection rules and principles, The problems of study the information security management system multi-layer various protection technology measures, The problems presents a comprehensive reliable information safety management system design and realization method.

articleTitle: The simulation analysis of the centroid offset effects on braking performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to study centroid offset of the vehicle affects on the braking performance and the longitudinal and horizontal offset of the centroid affects on the stability, it analyses theoretically the relation between centroid position and braking performance. And it establishes the whole vehicle's model through simulation soft ADAMS/CAR of the dynamics and analyses the relation between longitudinal offset and the rotate speed and between horizontal offset and heading angle; the same condition, it analyses that horizontal offset of the centroid affects on horizontal replacement and heading angle. The Simulation result indicates : while the centroid moves longitudinal and forward, lateral stability becomes worse and while the centroid moves backward can increase to braking stability, but it makes easily the front wheel lose the turning ability; while the centroid happens to horizontal offset and along with the offset gradually increase, horizontal replacement and heading angle increase notability. It the centroid can be controlled while the vehicle brakes may enhance security of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Synchronization algorithm of ultra wideband communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the timing synchronization is studied and proposed a synchronization acquisition algorithm based on least-squares estimation. The advantages of the poposed algorithm is that it can reach a compromise between complexity and synchronization performance and also obtain good synchronization precision under certain SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio). Takes Time-Hopping Ultra-Wideband Pulse-Amplitude-modulate signal system as an example, simulation results have demonstrated the feasibility of the proposed method and verified the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research of double servo system synchronization control base on decouple compensation control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the growing application of hydraulic technology in engineering field, due to the increase of load capacity of large equipment requires several implementation components simultaneously drive the working part, so synchronization control becomes more and more important. In this paper, study the synchronous control problems of double electro-hydraulic servo system, for mechanical couple exist in double servo systems caused by not synchronization, design decouple controller. When the double servo systems are not synchronous, according to the change of the two chambers pressure to compensate disturbance. Then achieve the purpose of synchronization. The simulation results show that the method has high synchronization accuracy.

articleTitle: Attribute reduction algorithm of rough set fused with ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper fused rough set theory and ant colony algorithm. The attribute core was determined through the correlative algorithms of rough set, which could be used as initial node of ant colony algorithm, then the time complexity and search space were reduced. The search capacity was used to get the lease combination of these nodes, which is the minimal attribute set, and the NP-hard problem in attribute reduction by using rough set was avoided. The result of experiment showed the feasibility and validity of this algorithm.

articleTitle: The prospect of using multi-sensor information fusion technology in flight data application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To meet the urgent needs of flight data application, this paper presents the idea of using multi-sensor information fusion technology to solve the bottleneck problem of flight data application. By analyzing the advantages of multi-sensor information fusion technology and the characteristics of flight data system, we make an outlook to the possible difficulties and the relevant solutions in using multi-sensor information fusion technology for flight data application.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of guiding band in one-dimensional slow wave structures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We have analyzed the transmission properties of guiding band in one-dimensional photonic crystal with periodic defect layers. Using transfer matrix method we concluded that the guiding band width would change with varying defect layer size or the distance between defect layers. The group velocities of different guiding bands were calculated and we found that the defect layer size could apparently affect the group velocity. We also discussed the properties of the defect modes resulted by another defect layer in the slow wave structure.

articleTitle: Mechanization of deep tillage and mulching to improve soil water content and spring maize yield
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Areas of northern China are arid, and soil moisture content and fertility are low at the time of planting of maize. A solution was proposed to address this problem. After harvesting in the autumn, the soil is tilled to create deep furrows which are filled with straw and fertilizer, and then backfilled to form ridges that are mulched with a plastic film. In the coming spring the maize will be seeded by puncture the membranes. A series of machines were designed and developed for this technology. Field tests were conducted and the performance of the machines were calculated and analyzed. Some shortcomings of the machines were found and the new machines were developed. Some field experiments were conducted to investigate the effects of field management practices on soil water and maize yield in west Liaoning province. The field management practices included traditional tillage (CK) and alternating ridges deeply buried straw and mulched with plastic film and bare furrows (DM). The DM treatment significantly increased the soil water content in the upper 40cm soil layer throughout maize growing season, compared with the CK treatment.

articleTitle: A visual analysis system for sewage treatment data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The treatment of sewage is essential for ensuring the effluent achieving the discharge standard of water pollutants and improving the quality of water. So each year, the national and regional governments invest heavily in establishing sewage treatment factories. In order to help governors and managers analyzing investment effects and operation conditions, a Visual Analysis System for Sewage Treatment Data (VAS-STD) was presented in this paper. VAS-STD can provide the functions of classifying sewage treatment data, analyzing the investment effect and operation condition of sewage treatment plant, discovering existing problems through data mining, and finding the future direction of investment. VAS-STD is based on B/S architecture, apply Weka as its data mining tool, and apply time series diagram and Web-GIS technology to visualize the analyzing results. A data mining algorithm based on artificial neural network for sewage treatment data is also proposed. VAS-STD has been used to analysis more than 4000 sewage treatment plants data to provide important basis for decision-makers and managers.

articleTitle: Face feature extraction based on reduced-dimension matrix of DCT and projection of block covariance matrix
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Feature extraction is the foundation of face recognition and plays a very important role in face recognition. Different method of face feature extraction has different performance and efficiency to later steps of face recognition. This paper firstly discusses how to reduce dimensions of face image matrix obtained by DCT from video. Then we can acquire covariance matrix of block face matrix which consist of low frequency factor and high frequency factor. The low frequency factor retains basic and stability features of the same individual and high frequency reflects the details of face contour, etc. Lastly the eigenvalue is acquired through calculating the covariance matrix. The obtained eigenvalue is sorted and the projection of three biggest eigenvalue is taken as the key factors which reflect face block matrix to recognize face. The experimental results demonstrate that comprehensive utilization of high frequency and low frequency factor and big eigenvalue can keep more energy of image, so it can achieve high recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of motor power assembly mounting system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Through an analysis on a decoupling theory, a motor power assembly mounting system is designed and all related parameters are computed for selection directed to excitation characteristics of a motor of a certain model. An optimized design scheme is put forward through a test and an analysis on the energy transfer efficiency of a mounting system.

articleTitle: Prediction model of grind machining of engineering ceramics based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Reasonable selection of technological parameters plays an important role on the CNC grind machining effect on engineering ceramics for the caver machine. But the relationship between technological parameters and machining effect is extremely complex and it is very difficult to build the relational model by traditional regression method. In order to solve this problem, a BP neural network prediction model of CNC grind machining of engineering ceramics is built on the basis of grind machining characteristics by using neural network theory. Simulation and experimental results prove the validity of the prediction model. The prediction model can be used to reasonably select the technological parameters for CNC grind machining of engineering ceramics and improve the machining quality and machining efficiency.

articleTitle: On computer aided design college art design thinking course
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We need extensive use computer technology in Art design teaching, which is the only way to art and design education is leap-forward development. This paper tries to start from investigate the combination of computer-aided design and art design courses, analysis the problems and countermeasures of the computer-aided design in the College Art Design curriculum, and eventually made way through the reform of educational methods achieve the progress in creation of college computer-aided design courses.

articleTitle: 3-DOF MEMS Gyroscope modeling and design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, issues related to the modeling and designs on a 3-DOF (degree-of-freedom) MEMS Gyroscope are studied. The MEMS Gyroscope employs a combination of two proof-masses and flexures to form 1-DOF resonator in the drive direction and 2-DOF oscillator in the sense direction. The 3-DOF MEMS Gyroscope has very stable responses within flat region for both gain and phase corresponding to variations in spring coefficient or quality factor. Through simulation and analyses, the gyroscope is optimized. The high operational frequency device (5.053 kHz) and bandwidth over 1 kHz is designed. In the full scale range ±5007s, the high scale factor about 0.527 mv/ (°/s) is achieved.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation using regions in natural scenes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By introducing an over-segmentation algorithm into the conditional model (CM), we propose a new region-based CM model (R-CM), and investigate its performance on semantic segmentation of images. In order to incorporate structure information of objects, we segment an image into regions by using an over-segmentation algorithm. Based on the results of CM model, we first consider assigning all pixels in one region with the same label, and then other feature potentials are included to counteract the influence of false over-segmentation. We compare our results to related work on the Olive & Torralba database and show that aside from improved accuracy of the whole database, our model obtains a perceptual improvement, with boundary of different objects correctly labeled.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of flow field of main spool in servo valve
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Servo valve is a core component of servo control system. Its characteristics would directly affect the entire performance of servo control system. In this paper, Fluent is used on the main spool internal flow simulation when its opening is fixed. The valve flow characteristic is analyzed. The simulation result is consistent with the laws of fluid flow and the theoretical. It provides a basis for optimal design of electro-hydraulic servo valve.

articleTitle: The traditional retail trade development strategy in E-Commerce environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Along with the electronic commerce rapidly development, the traditional retail trade is facing the huge challenge. This article thorough analysis has compared the electronic commerce and the traditional retail trade's characteristics, proposed measures for sustainable development of traditional retail trade.

articleTitle: Design and research for intelligent teaching platform based on RMXP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Intelligent teaching platform is a intelligent knowledge platform based on a subject, it involves many subject as Artificial Intelligence and so on. And its development and research has been a hot pot of research on computer-aided teaching instruction. This article mainly analyses design and process of intelligent teaching platform based on RMXP. The platform can combine role playing and studying. And in the platform, learners can play a unique role and adventure in a mystery learning world on a game style. In the process of adventure, learning can study knowledge and find problems constantly, in order to solve the problem of learning on a game style. And finally it can achieve the purpose of developing intelligent and training creativity.

articleTitle: The program design for the network security authentication based on the USB Key technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to make the network authentication convenient, secure and reliable, this paper presents a solution based on USB Key technology. It constructs a logical model based on USB Key, shows the process of network authentication, and gives a specific example using ASP, thus effectively solving the problem of network authentication. Practice has proved that this solution is feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of coupling onto wires enclosed in cylindrical cavity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A numerical simulation of electromagnetic pulse coupling onto wires enclosed in cylindrical cavity is described. A modulated Gaussian plane wave excitation with the frequency range from 0 GHz to 10GHz has been applied in the simulation. The main interest is to characterize the mechanism of electromagnetic pulse coupling through slot onto wires within a cylindrical cavity. Through the use of EM topology schemes, the status of wires coupling for EMI is analyzed. A coupling coefficient is defined to evaluate coupling characteristics on wires for different electromagnetic wave and geometric configurations.

articleTitle: On cooperation between enterprises with a supply chain alliance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A supply chain alliance is formed by a number of independent entities within a value chain to better cope with the contemporary competitive and cooperative market conditions. In an effort to strive for the maximum added value, each enterprise in the alliance contributes their core competencies in their areas of strength respectively. This paper applies game theory to set up a two-stage dynamic game model between aligned and non-aligned enterprises to discover the correlation between the number of member enterprises and the overall profit made, as well as the potential impacts that incurred costs exert on profitability over time. The results show that: the enterprises which take the lead in establishing the alliance enjoy a significant growth in profit, which stimulates formation of alliances amongst other enterprises in the market; although as the number of alliances formed increases and aligned enterprises cut costs thereafter and profits decline proportionately in turn as a result, nevertheless, profit figures are still at a level above those of non-aligned enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on torque measurement of revolving shaft based on capacitive grating sensing technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The difficulties in torque measurement on revolving shaft are signal transmission, limited installation space, poor stability in long-term use and signal disturbance. In order to solve the problems above, an embedded capacitive grating torque sensor and measuring system have been developed. Through installing the capacitive grating sensors on both ends of the revolving shaft, electrodes of capacitive grating can be embedded respectively into the revolving shaft and the fixed support. When the revolving shaft is touched by torque, the capacitive grating outputs the signal of cyclical change. The phase difference between outputs of two capacitive grating sensors shows the size of twist angle. The outputs through the PLL processing in measuring circuit will be signal with the steady frequency and the twist angle can be worked out by it. Then the torque will be calculated by twist angle. The embedded installation of capacitive grating sensor least affects the structure of revolving shaft. Besides, it makes the capacitive grating sensor without the need for slip ring, radio or infrared to transmit signal and power, so it overcomes the shortcomings in installation and the signal being susceptible to interference in the ways above. By means of experiment it is proved that the capacitive grating sensor is highly reliable and can be used under the harsh environmental for a long time.

articleTitle: Study of MIS for greenhouse group environment in North China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The control technology of the greenhouse environment is the important aspect of the research on modern agriculture. To achieve quality cultivation with high yield and efficiency, the manipulation aim of the greenhouse environment was realized by controlling some equipment through analyzing the monitoring data of the internal of the greenhouse environment and according to crop growth rule. Based on the summarization at home and abroad, oriented to the greenhouse group in North China, a set of greenhouse group environment and management system is exploited by utilizing modern computer technology, fuzzy control technology, communication technology. Analyzing data real-timely, processing data, retrieving information about greenhouse production and pest prevention and intellectualized control in the greenhouse which the parameters of solar greenhouse achieved the demand for the crop growth can be realized.

articleTitle: Study on isolation and identification of the Lactic acid bacteria in airing wuchang fish and production performance of strains
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Many kinds of Lactic acid bacteria were isolated in airing wuchang fish. Lactic acid bacteria is isolated and identified by the colony morphology observation, the mycelium morphology, sugar alcohol fermentation tests and various physiological and biochemical test, the result showed that the Lactic acid bacteria were respectively belonged to seven strains. In order to obtain the most suitable strains for the producing fermented meat, acidifying rate, the properties including the tolerance to sodium chloride and nitrite, optimization growth temperatures, proteolysis and lipolysis activities were studied. Finally, Lactococcus lactis sub lactis were certified to be suit to the fermented processing.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of discerption of surface PM pole on cogging torque of PM motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The cogging torque causes vibration and noise of PM motors, heavily affects the precision of torque. This paper elementary studied the effect of discerption of surface PM pole on cogging torque, based on studying classical formula of cogging torque, the analytic formula of effect of discerption of surface PM motors pole on cogging torque is deduced. By the result of FEM analysis, correctness of this analytic formula is testified.

articleTitle: Technological parameters simulation of cutting red copper by wire cut electrical discharge machining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The technology of Wire cut Electrical Discharge Machining (WEDM) is widely used in machinery manufacturing industry, but chooses the technological parameters is so difficult that it can influence the quality of processing and productivity. As a new type of neural network modeling tools, neural network is a neuron by a number of large-scale cross-link the composition of parallel distributed information processing system with self-organizing, self-learning and good fault tolerance system complexity can be used to simulate realistic input and output relations, has a strong nonlinear modeling capability. In this paper, modeling of traditional method is adopted to solve the problem at first, and then combining the characteristics of artificial neural network using WEDM process simulation model.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of a type of square baler's framework
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an design procedure of square baler, a CAD model is built in Solidworks environment. In order to prevent large deformation and stress due to resonance from breaking working parts, modal analysis is carried out with finite element method by utilizing simulation plug-in unit integrated within Solidworks, a study of preliminary model based on a type of hydraulic high-density baler shows that frequency ranges between 70Hz to 90Hz is likely cause great vibrating with mode shape of high mass participation ration in specific direction, which is observed in practical running. The design is improved by altering the dimensional size for different types of balers, and then the configuration is applied with one CAD model document. This study contributes to further optimization in square baler design by using computer aided engineering applications.

articleTitle: Computer-aided design of lead compensator of control system via MATLAB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper introduces computer aided design of lead compensation of control system via MATLAB. A number of MATLAB functions are developed that automate the compensator design procedure. With this design tool, control engineers would be able to rapidly design lead and/or lag compensators. As shown by the example, the method can improve the efficiency and reduce the cost of the compensation.

articleTitle: Implementation of dynamic change method of multi-group collaborative work
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Under the new organizational model SDOM(synchronic dynamic organizational model), a dynamic change method based on multi-group team working is proposed in this paper, process instance don't need change when changing members in one or more work nodes, only organizational model including operational staff and work flow need to be modified. In this way, requirements of dynamic change of work flow in multi-group collaborative work are better fulfilled.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of the convective coefficient on cooling water pipe embedded in concrete
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A finite element method was developed to simulate the convective coefficient of cooling water pipe in concrete, and the mean Nusselt numbers on each section in the cooling water pipe were obtained. Numerical results show that the flow field distribution was very complex with a secondary flow appeared in the bend position. The cooling water flow velocity decreased along the pipeline accompanying the secondary flow, it was not advantageous for promoting heat transfer. Nusselt number changed greatly at the joint of straight part with bend section, which decreased gradually along the pipeline with the maximum value change rate of 20%, leading to the decrease of heat transfer between the cooling water and the concrete. It suggested that the Nusselt convective coefficient should be piecewise loaded to ensure the accuracy of results, when employ an approximate method to calculate the temperature field.

articleTitle: An improved regional stabilization method for time-delay system with actuator saturation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the control synthesis problem of time-delay systems with actuator saturation is studied by the free-weighting matrix technique and the convex polytope idea. The improvement lies in introducing a scaling factor into the free-weighting matrix. Not only constant delays, but also internally time-varying delays for systems with actuator saturation can be handled by the new approaches. The conditions for estimating the domain of attraction of the origin are proposed in terms of linear matrix inequality. The numerical example is further presented to show the effectiveness and less conservative of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An approach to identify magnettizing inrush currents and its simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Power transformer is one of the main electrical equipments. It is the important for the system to run safely and economically. When the short circuit takes place between the internal coils, power transformer different protection works correctly; while the external short circuit fault and over excitation appear, it does not process trip. The distinguishing internal fault current from magnetizing inrush current of power transformer is still the key issues of differential protection of power transformer. The wavelet analysis has the characteristic of multi resolution analysis and good time and frequency domain localization, fits to extract sudden change signals in transient processes, and detects irregularity of signals very well. This paper describes a method for discrimination between internal faults and magnetizing inrush currents in power transformers using the wavelet transform. The experiment simulation shows that the proposed method is more reliable and simpler, and is suitable for different power transformer systems.

articleTitle: GrC and ANN based fault diagnosis method of distribution network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis in distribution network, this paper puts forward an intelligent hybrid diagnosis system, which combines granular computing theory with neural network theory, to make the best use of rules reduction of granular computing and fault-tolerance learning capabilities of neutral network. In this paper, the concepts of relative granularity and significance of attributes based on binary granular computing are proposed to select reasonable input variables to form the most simplified rules, and are used as the heuristic information of reduction algorithm. The most simplified rule sets are called to make modeling and parameter identification with BP neural network, and then learning training is done by training samples. Compared with the result of fault diagnosis for one distribution network, it shows that the method can reduce the learning training time, improve accuracy of diagnosis and have better fault-tolerance.

articleTitle: The achievement of Cash Management System
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the author first introduces the accounting software's system models, then introduces the achievement of Cash Management System.

articleTitle: A FPGA LED controller for SoC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: FPGA(Field Programmable Gate Array) devices and VHDL, a hardware description language, software are common in computer and electronic design. As a new light source, LEDs are used more and more. In this paper, a LED hardware controller for a reconfigurable processor is described. The design is based on FPGA. The simulation and test are taken. With the LED controller, a microprocessor in SoC will manage LED devices more easily and quickly.

articleTitle: The ESR characters of unintentionally doped 4H-SiC with Si ion implanted
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The intrinsic defects in epitaxial semi-insulating 4H-SiC that are implanted by Si ion, annealing after implanted respectively are studied by electron spin resonance (ESR). The results show that the intrinsic defects in Si ion implanted and annealing are the same as that as-grown 4H-SiC consist of carbon vacancy (Vc) and complex-compounds-related Vc, which is to say Si ion implanted and annealing treatment have a few effects on the intrinsic defects in unintentionally doped 4H-SiC prepared by low pressure chemical vapor deposition. The ESR spectrum are the same as that as-grown samples with Xe light, which are illumination time changes the relative density of intrinsic defects in 4H-SiC; the relative density of intrinsic defects reaches a maximum when the illumination time is 2.5 min, and the ratio of Vc to complex compounds is minimized simultaneously. It can be deduced that some Vsi may be transformed to the complex-compounds-related Vc because of the illumination.

articleTitle: Analysis of the regenerative brake system parameters for concrete mixing truck basded on AMESim
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article describes the concrete truck's hydraulic regenerative braking system structure, working mechanism, matching principle, and the relevant dynamic model. In order to achieve the purpose of simulating regenerative braking system, the software AMESim was used to establish physical model. By the target vehicle torque control strategy, according to the real parameters of the tuck, hydraulic parameters of secondary element and accumulator were analyzed, compared, and determined. And bench test validation was conducted. Based on those advanced works the hydraulic regenerative brake system for the truck was developed.

articleTitle: Study on the preparation, characterization and antibacterial activity of complex for gadolinium iodide with thiourea
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The complex GdI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>·2CS(NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>·10H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O was prepared with a new method and characterized on the basis of elemental analysis, X-ray powder diffraction, infrared analysis, mass spectroscopy, and thermogravimetry and differential thermal analysis. The antibacterial activity of the complex GdI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>·2CS(NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>·10H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O was better than that of corresponding coordinator.

articleTitle: Elastic vibration research of the non-sinusoidal oscillation system for the mold of continuous casting
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new type of generating device namely antiparallel four-bar linkage for non-sinusoidal oscillation of the mold in continuous casting is developed and the prototype is manufactured of a whole oscillation system with cascaded whole-leaf spring guidance mechanism driven by the new device. Further more, dynamic model of the whole system is built and the differential equation of motion is deduced, which shows this is a dynamic system with periodic time-varying parameters. And elastic vibration rules of this system are analyzed by using harmonic balance method. Then the reason of serious elastic vibration occurring is studied.

articleTitle: Design of high-precision FFT based on VHDL and analysis of code coverage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper uses structured design to implement the floating-FFT by VHDL with ISE5.3 and simulates it by ModelSim. The data pathways in this project are in the form of 32-bit single precision format which can avoid data overflow and achieve high SNR. In this project, the Radix-2 algorithm is used and the controller is modeled as a finite state machine. The simulation and code coverage analysis results show that (1) the design can achieve high accuracy; (2) the running speed is fast enough to meet the real-time signal processing requirements, and (3) the test work is very complete.

articleTitle: Analysis of voltage source control characteristics of clearance control magnetic dynamic absorber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Some problems existing in the traditional absorber can be solved better by adopting clearance control magnetic dynamic absorber to control the imbalance vibration of rotors. For the special structure of conical electromagnet, stiffness and damping equations of the electromagnetic dynamic absorber are derived when voltage source is taken as the power of the electromagnet, and the influence law of various parameters on the stiffness and damping characteristic of the clearance control magnetic dynamic absorber is obtained through numerical analysis. These researches lay theory foundation for further studies on the clearance control magnetic dynamic absorber.

articleTitle: Computer graphic design software applications in graphic design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Graphic design is a products of combination of technology and art. With the development of the times and social progress, all kinds of graphic design combined with computer graphic design software. This article started from the analysis of the concept of computer graphic design software, introduce the concept and current state of graphic design, then to analyze the use of computer graphic design software in graphic design.

articleTitle: A new method of chaotic synchronization based on numerical simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper puts forward a kind of method using change parameter, let the Non-coupling system synchronization. Controlled system dynamic evolution, will contain controlled system itself and drive system foreign double chaotic factor, thus present more complex nature Can effectively resist the attack from phase space reconstruction and parameter estimation methods, and easier to implement in technology.

articleTitle: Research of word similarity model based on HowNet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming to word similarity research based on HowNet, domestic scholars have proposed various calculation methods. But these methods have the shortcomings that word similarity is not high, and the difference of disposition relationship concepts is not obvious. This paper adopts the thought of "words similarity layer calculation" mentioned in the references, does further perfect to make the layer calculation more clear and rigorous, and brings forward an improved algorithm aiming to the shortcomings.

articleTitle: The research of dissolved oxygen detection system based on fluorescence quenching principle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Oxygen is one of the prominent parameters characterized the quality of water, how to detect the precise content of oxygen is paid much attention nowadays. Lately the method of fluorescence quenching has been the hotspot practice to detect the oxygen in the international. This paper based on the principle of fluorescence quenching has designed the DO(dissolved oxygen)detecting system. Through choosing dissolved oxygen sensing head and photoelectric receiving devices rationally and determining appropriate circuit parameters after experiment, it can realize the detecting of the DO preliminarily, laying the foundation for the instrumentation of the system.

articleTitle: Art education vocational curriculum study digital art
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In recent years, computer design software has entered the art schools and many schools have opened a variety of graphic design software, two-dimensional and the three-dimensional animation design software, graphic image rendering and processing related courses to help our art creation and art and design. By analyzing the definition of Vocational Education and Digital Art Courses in Art Educations Studying the problems of Digital Art Courses in Art Education, proposed some useful advice or suggestions on these issues. Hope this can be caused related institutions pay attention to the higher vocational colleges' digital art education curriculum, and promote art education in vocational colleges' better development.

articleTitle: Research on incremental decision tree algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For data analysis of increase rapidly customer behavior, Web log analysis, network intrusion detection systems and other online classification system, how to quickly adapt to new samples is the key to ensure proper classification and sustainable operation. This paper presents a new adaptation data incremental decision tree algorithm, which combines RAINFOREST structure. It combines with the traditional SPRINT decision tree algorithm, and uses new samples quickly train a new decision tree based on the original decision tree. The improved algorithm deal with new samples at any time to produce a decision tree related, and the tree has been optimized with real-time.

articleTitle: Net utility maximization based scheduling model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the traditional utility-based scheduling research, all the network traffics were divided into such categories as VOIP, IPTV, TCP and HTTP, applications of which were not differentiated, resulting in the loss of both fairness among applications and utility maximization of the network. In order to solve this problem, applications for each category of traffics are identified as those of charge or no charge. Hence, a net utility maximization based scheduling model is established to provide the appropriate algorithm. Finally, the validity of the algorithm is verified through simulated experiment.

articleTitle: A method for correction of multitemporal satellite imagery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes new approaches to radiometric correction of multitemporal satellite imagery using wavelet analysis and Fourier transform. The results obtained are compared with commonly used NO-change regression (NC) normalization and Histogram Matching spatial domain methods. Statistical accuracy assessment shows that proposed transform domain approaches are valid.

articleTitle: The mechanical performance analysis of grid structures with foam under the tests of quasi-static and dynamic loadings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Grid structure is a light and efficient structure. The composites have many excellent performances, such as that it can be designed excellently. This study mainly studies the grid structures with foam quadrilateral core-type. In this paper, the mechanical performance and the energy absorption properties were studied for the nine different kinds of core-type configurations, which undering quasi-static compressive test and impact test. And the optimize design of the structures could be obtained through comparing the mechanical properties and the energy absorption ability of the structures.

articleTitle: Study of macromolecular compound anstatic agent
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we have mainly studied the terylene's anti-static effect which has been processed by means of external use negative ion anstatic agent, external use positive ion anstatic agent, external use amphoteric anstatic agent, external use nonionic anstatic agent and chemical fiber anstatic agent. We also have compared with the anti-static effects in accordance with anstatic agents with different densities. At the same time, we have analyzed some anstatic agents' water-tolerant and washing experiments. At last, we have analyzed several kinds of anstatic agents' effects. We have concluded that macromolecular compound has excellent anti-static ability and water-tolerant ability.

articleTitle: Research for hybrid genetic algorithms on optimization of cutting linear stock
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The improved genetic algorithm i.e. hybrid genetic algorithm is applied to solve problem of cutting linear stock, respective corresponding determination methods and algorithms are given for genetic coding, fitness function, initial population generation and genetic operator. Elitist strategy is used in keeping the excellent individuals of population to make the genetic algorithm more effective.

articleTitle: The design of distributed robot control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the past, most robots used the centralized control mode, in which the power electronics, the motor controllers and the coordinating computer were contained in a central control box. This paper describes the design of a distributed robot control system which consists of the host computer, the controller for each joint and the communication network. The individual controllers are located physically close to the motors that they are controlling, enormously simplifying the wiring harness of the robot down to simple power and network cables. Additionally, the hardware rationale and the control software of the joint controller are elaborated in details.

articleTitle: Ship swaying data denoising via multiscale manifold representation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A method for ship swaying data(pitch, roll and heading) denosing using multiscale manifold representation is proposed. Combining the lifting scheme and computation of means on manifold, the method implements an adaptive wavelet transform which decomposes a time series on the special orthogonal group SO(3). We demonstrate through simulations with the swaying data contaminated by additive white Gaussian noise that the performance of this method surpasses that of traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on communication equipment configuration optimization of electronic information system based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As a task to effectively use radio resource, system electromagnetic compatibility control is also a combinatorial optimization problem. The paper presented regional communication equipment optimal configuration model and focus on simplified model of plane area. Based on introduction of basic steps of Genetic Algorithm (GA) and parameter settings, regional radio communication equipment optimal configuration method was used to perform simulation analysis on optimal model of plane area. Simulation results illustrate that GA shows superiority in the optimal control of communication system electromagnetic compatibility.

articleTitle: Determination of five flavonoids in honeys by HPLC-ESI-MS/MS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A quantitative and quantitative method was established for determining 5 flavonoids in honeys by high performance chromatography-tendemmass/mass(HPLC-MS/MS). The samples were dissolved by deionized water, and then extracted by hexane-ethyl acetate solution with volume ratio of l:l, and the extract were centrifuged and evaporated. The residue were dissolved by methanol. The chromatography separation was performed on a C18 column with a gradient elution programmer using the mixture of methanol and 0.1% aqueous formic acid as mobile phase. The mass spectrometry equipped with an electrospray ionization source(ESI) was operated in the negative mode using multiple reaction monitoring(MRM). The linear relationship of the method was very obvious and the 5 flavonoids limits of quantization (LOQ) were 1.5μg/kg, the average spike recoveries situated between 64%∼89%, and the relative standard deviation(RSD) were 2.2%∼8.4%. The method is outstanding due to its precision and excellent separation effect and can be used for the determination of flavonoids in honey.

articleTitle: Research on PZT multi-channel power supply and control method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The small range micro-table could realize many degrees of freedom driving by using several PZT actuators. The PZT actuator demonstrates superior characteristics of high displacement resolution, miniature size, high-frequency response, strong power, no generate heat etc. The quality of PZT power supply will impact the positioning accuracy of table directly. The development of miniaturized multi-channel high-precision PZT power supply and control methods have be introduced amply. By the application of the DLL library for data acquisition card and Timer control of VB, the real-time programmable output of control voltage was realized. According to the non-linearity of amplifier circuit, the control voltage and output voltage multinomial curves of PZT power supply were charted, and the relational expression of control voltage with output voltage was obtained by means of MATLAB. Experimental results indicate that the output voltage of eight channels shows good linearity, the nonlinear error is less than 0.023%. The research supplies further scientific ways to amend and reduce the effect of non-linearity error, and improve the positioning accuracy of the systems.

articleTitle: New frequency spectrum estimation for the Spacial Transient Optical
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on Alpha Stable Distribution, the frequency features of the optical transient signal are analyzed. The result is that the signal of Spatial Transient Optical is a random signal. Using the estimations FLOM covariation-Spectrum, this method is not applicable when the value of Alpha is below 1. A method of the estimation of FLOC is proposed, and the comparison of two spectrum estimations on results of emulator shows that the method proposed in this article presents a good capability and it can be widely applied to Alpha-stable distribution. Especially when the value of Alpha is small, the method of FLOC spectrum estimation has an incomparable advantage.

articleTitle: Position controller based on state observer for 6-DOF parallel teleoperation manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The sense system of slave side for electro-hydraulic servo control telerobot is simplification and credibility, which is needed by work environment and test signal remote transfers. The displacement of slave side is only measured signal in this research and designs state observer for restructure velocity and acceleration state variables. Consider the influence of restructure error to position control and random disturbance of slave side, apply lower order output variable to make up of a output linear feedback system, design optimal controller to accomplish master-slave position tracking control and force feedback of bilateral servo control. Simulation and Experimental results are given to demonstrate the developed controller is availability and robustness to existence of outside random disturbance.

articleTitle: A new video-based highway management information system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new video-based highway management information system is developed. The key techniques include video capture, moving picture compression, mileage calculation and processing of GPS information. The system structure is introduced first, and the algorithm for calculating mileage from GPS coordinate is described in detail. The experiment results have shown that the algorithm is effective in reducing errors. And the new system can be used in the highway management.

articleTitle: Characteristic analysis and sample modeling of cave depot target
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to correct recognition cave depot target from mountain background, we choose the shape of military cave depot as target characteristics by thinking about "character simple, easily extraction" and "character stability, easily recognizable". Then we abstract it as "line with line" or "line with arc" combination, which one conciseness, reasonable and meet the requirement of target feature extraction. Besides, adopting the software virtual modeling we build target simulation sample database from different situation like season, favorable climate, distance and angle. By taking characteristic analysis and sample modeling of cave depot target as we said in this thesis, we can shorten the time of target recognition and improve efficiency.

articleTitle: A rate control scheme for three-dimensional wavelet-based video coders
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The rate control problem for scalable wavelet video coding system based on motion compensated temporal filtering (MCTF) has been studied in this paper, we first investigate and verify the rate-distortion (RD) function for the temporal frames, and estimate the coding efficiency parameters. Optimal rate allocation among the frames in the group is then examined based on the Lagrangian optimization method, and a rate control strategy related to the variance and coding efficiency parameter of the temporal frames has been presented, the algorithm and its complexity is suitable for video applications. Experiments show that compared with the fixed rate allocation, the proposed rate control strategy can obviously improve the average PSNR.

articleTitle: Worm defense system research based on intelligent maintenance trees
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Worm defense is an important security problem that has long aroused people's attention. With an eye to improve intranet security, an intelligent maintenance tree-based worm defense strategy is put forward by analyzing intranet worm propagation characteristics. Mobile agent-based down automatic maintenance line and detection-based up alarm line constitute an intranet active defense circuit and the mathematical model of intranet worm propagation is constructed based on the strategy. The functions of worm defense strategies of intelligent maintenance tree-based worm propagation model and traditional dual-factor model are analyzed through simulation. Experiment shows that the proposed strategy plays an important part in intranet worm protection and intelligent management of the maintenance net is achieved.

articleTitle: Study of hydraulic fault diagnosis based on power switchgears
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Hydraulic failures of power switchgears were analyzed in this study. The malfunction of oil-minimum breakers, operation failure of hydraulic actuators, and overpressure of hydraulic operation actuators were also analyzed, and specific solutions also have been proposed which can ensure the normal operation of the equipments.

articleTitle: Research on fault recognition method based on variable-risk SVM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Because the tradition methods of fault pattern recognition can not distinguish the different loss by different misjudgments, the variable-risk support vector machines (SVM) is proposed in this paper. Then, the optimal classification face is redesigned and expert's experience is integrated when using an actual data to recognize the fault, which makes the result more reliable. Finally, this method has already applied in the diesel engine fault diagnosis successfully.

articleTitle: Design of autopilot steering alarm system on ship based on CAN-bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Introduces a suit of alarm system based on can-bus and ARM. Take LPC2292 Central Processing Unit and CTM1050 as its communication system key part, adopts other designs both of hardware and software, completed a suit of distributed signal detected and process system of autopilot steering. The system has the advantages of the alarm information be showed by real time and dynamic, communication fast and dependability be improved, the running effect is also satisfactory.

articleTitle: Finite element modal analysis and test modal analysis of the control cab
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to study vibration characteristic of the control cab, finite element model of the control cab was established, then vibration modal of control cab within 0-100Hz was analyzed. In order to verify the accuracy of the finite element model, the natural frequencies and mode shapes within 0-160Hz were tested. Test data was compared with simulation data, to prove that the established finite element model was correct. Reinforcing patch or damping patch could be pasted to avoid cavity acoustic resonance.

articleTitle: Study on preparing crystalline C3N4
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Plasma-detonation synthesis was developed to synthesize the superhard material C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. The method integrates the advantages of plasma and detonation in carbon nitride preparation. In the method high-tempreture plasma was supplied through high-voltage impulsing power source, TNT was detonator and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> was reactant. The samples of prepared were analyzed and characterized by the ways of SEM, EDS, XRD and FTIR. The results show that average crystalline size is 1.1μm, and most particle is hexagon. The quality ratio of carbon to nitrogen is about 1.00 : 1.77 and the products are mainly α-C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and β-C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, g-C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and a few of CNx phase. The main valence bonds are C-N and C=N.

articleTitle: Optimization model of armored equipment inventory based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the era of network centric warfare, having a scientific and rational optimization model of armored equipment inventory model to adapt to future combat styles is a key problem. On the basis of analyzing system dynamics complex relationships, combined with system dynamic theory, according to the giving specific application example, the paper builds the model of optimizing armored equipment inventory. The purpose of the paper is to find a unique method to optimize the armored equipment inventory.

articleTitle: Design of the control system for hydraulic experimental bench based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Hydraulic experimental benches are indispensable in teaching process. In order to improve the experiment effect, establish the concept of hydraulic online testing, a control system was designed, which mainly consist of computer, data acquisition card (DAQ), and several sensors. The experimental software is developed on the famous virtual instrument (VI) develop platform - LabVIEW, and provides several functions such as control, measure, data saving, data processing, result show and so on. With the experimental program customized in the system, general experiments can be done under the guide of control system by man-machine interface. The experiment control system uses dynamic sensors to measure all kinds parameters in experiment process, so it is more suitable for hydraulic dynamic characteristic tests.

articleTitle: Uniform framework for direct volume rendering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A uniform model for Direct Volume Render is described in this paper. A rendering pipeline is described by introducing intermediate rendering buffer. To construct the intermediate rendering buffer, the Contribution Number and Visibility Number of 3D volume dataset. By join with advantage of both image order and object order DVR model, the uniform model is more efficient and suitable to parallel computing.

articleTitle: Treat the problems of beggars with game theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the government to solve the problems of beggars with more practical countermeasures, we collect informations from newspapers, periodicals and journals to illustrate the current situation of beggars in our country. After that, we show the deficiencies of our exist policies and try to help the government to relieve the problems by simplified it into a two-player(government-beggar) game which exists only a mixed strategy Nash Equilibrium (p*, q*). Finally we give some advices in accordance of the results and offer some further recommendations.

articleTitle: Design of purchase, sales and inventory system on B/S mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Purchase, Sales and Inventory System as one of database technology application systems, has become an important tool for enterprise information management. In this paper, the development of the Purchase, Sales and Inventory System is taken as an example to introduce how to use ASP.NET, database technology to develop the application system.

articleTitle: A study and structural design of salt-packing machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the working principle and structural design of a simple salt-packing machine, and functions and performances of its components. This packing machine can greatly improve performance with its simple structures, low cost and high efficiency. It is worth practical and extensive using, and can be widely applied in the packing production lines of salt and other products.

articleTitle: Research on Bi-directional converter for lithium battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, based on the fact that lithium battery energy storage system needs to exchange energy with the grid frequently, a grid-connected conversion for lithium battery energy storage systems is introduced for the charge-discharge function. In order to achieve the current decoupling and high power factor, the synchronous rotating frame and the space vector pulse width modulation (PWM) are used for the AC/DC conversion. DC/DC conversion part of the controller is designed based on the average model. The output voltage control problem is converted into the control of the inductor current. Electromagnetic transient simulation results show that the system is correct and feasible.

articleTitle: Implementation of TS streams pack/unpack and transport in DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a video wireless transmission system based on DVB-T is introduced with the DM642. Based on this system, the packing-unpacking TS stream device is designed in DSP, and the method to output TS stream by means of using EDMA, GPIO and serial peripheral interface (SPI) is proposed. This method which has been proved is an effective solution to transport TS streams. It is not only reduces the cost but also reaches the industrial temperature level standards.

articleTitle: A novel method for weak multi-audio frequency signal detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Multi-audio frequency signal have been applied in vary case. In this paper, a novel method for weak multi-audio frequency signal detection have been proposed. We aim at the multi-audio frequency signal detection in very strong noise circumstance based on the chaotic oscillator. At the end of paper, we exploit our approach to a typical multi-audio signal, TVM430 railway signal system, which have been widely used in railway. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method has preferable performance.

articleTitle: Improvement and analysis of GA on finding QoS routing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
