abstract: As is well known, quality of service (QoS) routing problem plays an important role in providing quality of service in traditional IP network To find a QoS constraints route, this paper makes a model for the problem based on specific multiple parameters and then analyzes simple genetic algorithm. Besides, fitness function is modified to gain better accuracy and classify-based idea is also bring into traditional algorithm to improve its performance. And the improved algorithm is analyzed to show its superiority.

articleTitle: A system of refractive index detection based on microinterferometric backscatter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Measurement of the refractive index (RI) can be used in many applications. Rapid monitoring and detection of ultra-small-volume samples are in great demand. However, accurate RI measurements in nanolitor volumes still present a significant challenge. Here we present a measurement system consists of an optical circuit system, a temperature control system and a CCD detention system. The measurement system extracts the interference fringes based on a microinterferometric backscatter detector (MIBD) by a linear CCD. Relative changes of the fringe pattern with respect to the change in solute concentration (RI). So, we can get the information about the refractive index by probing the position of the fringes with the FFT analysis. Using this method, we have obtained the detection limits of 1.49 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> Δn, corresponding to 8.37 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> g/mL.

articleTitle: Synthesis, characterization and cataluminescence properties of three aerogels
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aerogel is popular and commonly used as a composite, an absorbent, a sensor, etc. In this work, supercritical ethanol drying was performed for the preparations of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and MgO aerogels from the sol-gel synthesis. The effects of media, temperatures and pressures in high temperature supercritical drying mode on the structures of aerogels were investigated. Furthermore, the cataluminescence properties of three aerogels were studied. Cataluminescence based on aerogels has good repeatability and fast response.

articleTitle: Root locus approach in variable eigenvalues control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposed a root locus approach for variable eigenvalues control (VEC) on the foundation of the step analysis of variable eigenvalues control. It can depict the root locus of three dimensions surface with the aid of computer aided design tools to support the design of VEC systems.

Author Keywords: root locus approch of three dimentions for VEC

articleTitle: The analysis of correlation of China and international steel market
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By cointegration analysis, we find that the prices of Chinese steel and iron ore have long-term stable relation with international prices. Granger test shows that the prices of steel and iron ore are not reinforce each other, there is only one way of China on global prices of causality. Thorough VAR model, the Chinese domestic steel market fluctuations are mainly effected by the prices of early steel and it also shows that the main cause of iron ore price fluctuations in China is on a domestic iron ore price volatility.

articleTitle: An effective segmentation method — Internal radius template method for quasi-round fruit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Graphic segmentation and positioning are the basis and key of image recognition. The present paper carried out considerable tests to the case of quasi-round fruit conglutination with an internal radius template method, proving that the internal radius template method is an effective segmentation and positioning method for quasi-round template method.

articleTitle: The study about flow velocity measurement with spatial filter principle based on the electrostatic sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The spatial filter measurement principle of flow velocity is obtained by point charge mathematical model of the electrostatic sensor, and signal cut-off frequency is acquired with "3dB" principle during real-time measuring flow velocity. Experiments prove that the spatial filter measurement velocity principle of inducement probe is feasible, and experiments separately examine the flow velocity with this measurement priciple in range of 2-7m/s.

articleTitle: Data exchange between IPTV multi-businesses operation support system and LivingRoom
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Data interface of IPTV multi-businesses operation support system in this paper can be applied to the data exchange between the system and LivingRom - TV broadcast business system. The paper tracked the course of data interface application, carried out the integrated test and analyzed the function of data interface according to the testing result.

articleTitle: Novel algorithm for frequency estimation of sinusoid signal with random length
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An algorithm of frequency estimation for sinusoidal signal with random length corrupted by additive Gaussian noise was proposed. Firstly, The frequency of truncated series was estimated through FFT and was considered a coarse reference frequency. Secondly, three DFT coefficients near the coarse frequency were calculated and the largest magnitude was determined. Interpolation on Fourier coefficients on the basis of frequency estimate corresponding to the largest magnitude was performed to get the final frequency estimate. Computer simulation results demonstrated that the performance of proposed algorithm attains to Cramer-Rao bound of sinusoid.

articleTitle: Back analysis of non-adiabatic temperature parameters of roller-compacted concrete
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The determination of the concrete boundary heat transfer process is the key point of the temperature field and stress field, and it is also the important aspects to investigate the problem - simulation of the critical temperature control of concrete structures. Relying on a project, take a test under the non-adiabatic state temperature of the concrete, and obtain the measured data. Using improved genetic algorithm as a numerical back-analysis method, calculating the measured data inversion of temperature field, and comparing the calculated with the measured values, then analyzed the reasonableness of the inversion results, at the same time we obtained the equivalent heat transfer coefficient with the engineering condition in compliance under the condition of different things cover concrete surface and different sizes cooling water pipe wall, to provide references for similar projects.

articleTitle: Volcano smoke planar ultra-wide band antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The author designs a volcano smoke planar ultra-wide band antenna, which is composed of the planar volcano smoke antenna and the resistance loop circuit. The lower cut-off frequency of the antenna bandwidth is studied. The return loss (S11) of the input port of the antenna is measured. The research finds that the lower cut-off frequency of antenna with and without resistance loop circuits is 0.5GHz and 0.8GHz, respectively. The results show the resistance loop circuit can expand the bandwidth of the antenna toward the lower frequency direction.

articleTitle: Optimal control system of coke oven collector pressure control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The nonlinear PID optimization control scheme is proposed in this paper based on the fact that coke oven gas collector pressure control is multi-variable nonlinear system. This study developed nonlinear intelligent regulator with variable bias dead zone and feed-forward functions use of a variety of advanced control strategies. Then taken DCS to realize optimal control based on the traditional feedback control. Engineering applications show that the system design is universality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Discuss the modeling technique of 3D animated characters under three-dimensional visual angle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Study of modeling technique aims to acquire a more feasible and effective method of making three-dimensional animations. The paper presents an idea about that to simplify any complex object by analyzing structural characteristics of different role models, and according to various model structures to select appropriate methods to model three-dimensional animated characters.

articleTitle: The soft reconstruction of stratifying machine based on S7–400PLC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In view of the blocking problem existing in automatic production line for certain large H-shaped steel at the stage of production, the paper will analyze the cause and put forward optimization method for the motion of stratifying machine. Under the circumstance of no increase of equipment hardware, technical transformation (soft reconstruction) will be made only for the flow procedure of S7-400PLC, which will not only improve the working efficiency, but also resolve the problem of steel blocking thoroughly.

articleTitle: Electrochemical corrosion behavior of HRB500 steel bar in Simulated Concrete Pore solutions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The electrochemical corrosion behavior of HRB500 steel bar in Simulated Concrete Pore (SCP) solutions contaminated by bicarbonate ions and (or) chloride ions was investigated by cyclic potentiodynamic polarization technique, and it was compared with that of HPB235 steel bar. The results show that the passivation and repassivation of HRB500 steel bar is remarkably in the conditions where pH is 12.5 and w(NaCl) is 0~0.1%, or pH is 11.5 and w(NaCl) is no more than 0.01%, or pH is 10.5 and w(NaCl) is less than 0.005%. These are almost similar to that of HPB235 steel bar. However, with the increase of the aggressivity of SCP solutions, the corrosion susceptibility of HRB500 to pH and chloride ions is greatly higher than that of HPB235. The threshold value of chloride ions is considerably decreased with the increase of carbonization. If the connection of HRB500 and HPB235 was exposed to the aggressive environments, HRB500 is anode which is corroded acceleratedly, and HPB235 steel bar is cathode.

articleTitle: Research on the application of green function approximation in the quantum super magnets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The quantum super magnets is researched by Green function theory in this paper, the problems in the quantum super magnets are settled by particle and spin Green function theory, especially settling the orderly magnetic of quantum. The application of Green function in the ferromagnetic and reverse magnetism and magnetic ferrous are maily studied.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo EM algorithm for two-component mixture of generalized linear random effects models with varying coefficients
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Generalized linear models have many applications in agriculture, biology, and so on. With the need of applications, it was extended from various ways for more general cases. The paper proposes an extended finite mixture of generalized linear random effects models (GLMMs) with Varying Coefficients, based on the finite mixture distribution and GLMMs with varying coefficients, then parameters are estimated via Monte Carlo EM (MCEM) algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the straightening quality of steel pipe based on the computer numerical simulation technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the computer numerical simulation, the relevant parameters' effects on the straightening quality of steel pipe was studied in this paper. The optimum process parameters were found by combining the tradition calculation method and the computer numerical simulation. The analysis results have important guiding significance to both the design of steel pipe straightening machine and the steel pipe production process.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of hotel call accounting system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to enhance the management level of hotel industries, a simple and effective hotel call accounting system is designed. Based on the analysis of the development background of hotel call accounting system, the object of the cost system is presented. According to several important principles, such as availability, reliability, advanced and realtime, the total structure of call accounting system is designed. The system can be divided into foreground communication part and background accounting part by the operation environment. The functions and their relationship of the system modules are described, and the process of accounting data settlement is designed and implemented. To improve the system security, detailed planning is established. The system can collect the accounting data of the telephone call intensively within the hotels, restaurants and so on, and it can account and settle billing automatically, accurately, efficiently and reliably. The system can increase the service quality and enterprise benefit.

articleTitle: Design of multi-channel signal acquisition module for separate storage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To achieve multi-channel acquisition of the signals with different sampling rates, the authors of this paper design a multi-channel signal acquisition module with field programmable gate array (FPGA) as the core. This module adopts FPGA chip as core controller of the system, for the purpose of controlling A/D converter, multi-channel analog switch gating, signal acquisition and compiled frame and storage of data. This design is flexible, easy to control, of high reliability, and has been validated by tests.

articleTitle: The design of hydraulic control system about bidirectional compressing refuse collector based on PLC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The control of the traditional refuse collector uses the operation of manual and remote controller. and operation, which causes the shortcomings of the low efficiency, the labor-intensive operation and mistakes in operation. An environmental sanitation company produces bidirectional compressing refuse collector, specific to which a hydraulic control system is designed based on PLC. This system is easy operating, and is real-time monitoring and the operation is easy and safe, the advantages of which avoid the shortcomings above and improve the automatic level of refuse collector.

articleTitle: Visualization of complicated objects for hydraulic engineering based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Construction and visualization of three-dimensional (3D) complicated objects has become an important task in many GIS and their applications. Main process to construct a true 3D virtual scene with the programmable visualization environment OpenGL for water conservancy works is introduced. A simulation system developed by the authors is presented for importing, filtering and visualizing of complex geographical related data. Culling, lighting, shading and antialiasing were introduced to enhance the 3D visualization effects of the objects. Aspects like presentations of data with spatial dependence, virtual roaming in the terrain and geographical frame of reference and in time, interaction techniques are presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation on agricultural relative efficiency in different areas of China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: They were the important problems needed to solve on improving use efficiency of agricultural resources and agricultural technical efficiency for developing countries at present. Technical efficiency and Scale efficiency of 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities were appraised by method of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) from 2002 to 2005 in China in the paper. The following conclusions were obtained. Agricultural technical efficiency was showed descending trend in our country. At the same time, technical efficiencies in the areas were different. Downside areas of agricultural scale efficiency were increasing. The results were showed more investments, downside use efficiency of factors and ratio unbalance between input-output in agriculture of our country.

articleTitle: A foggy image restoration algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An improved fog fuzzy image restoration method is proposed. The threshold value range is determined by the image histogram. Image threshold segmentation can separate the target threshold from the sky threshold. Then, image is expanded with the increase canvas method and processed by the histogram specification algorithm based on the mobile template. Simulation results show that the algorithm is effective, and can restore image that is blurred by the fog.

articleTitle: Signal characteristic extractio of wood defects based on wavelet packet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The wavelet packet decomposition was made for the ultrasonic testing signal of wood defects. The wavelet function of Db5 was applied to make the three-layer wavelet packet decomposition for the wood defects. Four characteristic parameters of wave form B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</inf> wave crest B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf>, energy distribution E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf> and energy percentage E were extracted in the nodes of Layer 3. The effective evaluation standard was established on the basis of characteristic information extraction. The separability of different defects in time domain eigenvector and frequency domain eigenvector was compared and analyzed respectively. The frequency domain eigenvector with better separability was served as the recognition eigenvalue of classifying defects sorts. BP neural network was used to identify the extracted frequency domain eigenvector, and the total recognition rate reached to 83.3%. Therefore, the method presented in the study is feasible in the wood defects recognition

articleTitle: The path algorithm coal mine's emergency rescue
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Coal mine accident rescue is a huge project. But how to ascertain the place where the accident happened, the scope affected by the accident and rescue route is the key of coal mine's emergency response. In this paper, using the function of GIS's space analysis, taking in the concept of half space, constructing entity of coal mine project — relation model, and designing construction of laneway database, constructing shortest path analysis model for evacuating people and transporting succor materials, simulation system is designed in Visual C++ environment for coal mine's emergency response route. That establishes necessary technology base for improvement the scientific quality and pertinence of preparing coal mine accident rescue plan.

articleTitle: Research on cutting tool paths optimization of ZrB2 CNC grinding based on parametric curve interpolator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Zirconium boride ceramics is one of the new type of bearing high temperature materials which is used in the modern aeronautics broadly, numerical control grinding technique is the main means of manufacturing it. but the component shapes which zirconium boride ceramics worked in the modern aeronautics always complicate and need the higher processing accuracy and geometric tolerance, all those raised the higher technical requirement to the project of numerical control machining, This paper will use the method of parametric curve interpolation to carry on the optimization to the numerical control processing cutting tool path.

articleTitle: Research on port cluster based logistics collaborative platform construction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper studies the port cluster based logistics collaborative platform (PCLCP) from management perspective. Its construction modes, designed functional structure and system structure are also discussed. This article is of certain theoretical and practical value for building the PCLCP. Several such platforms have been built and proved to be effective in different regions of China.

articleTitle: An automatic assignation application for faculty members
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The faculty members at the universities serve on several committees governed by the Faculty Senate. We have developed an automatic assignation tool that can help the Faculty Senate to assign faculty members to different committees. There are 5 types of algorithms and 5 sorting methods used in this tool. This software can be used for Committee on Committees for any universities that need to assign faculty members each year.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analysis of spiking neuron synapse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper researches on the sensitivity of spiking neuron synapse caused by the input perturbation. Due to the discontinuous character of the response function in real number space the discussion of the sensitivity is divided into two parts according to the different value of the neuron running time. One part is deriving a computational formula for the sensitivity which is defined as a mathematical expectation of absolute output deviation due to the input perturbation. Another part is analyzing the probability of response change caused by the perturbation. With these results it's possible to investigate the working mechanism of the spiking neuron from a special aspect.

articleTitle: A cascaded multilevel class-D power amplifier output harmonic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A novel switch-mode power amplifier based on a cascaded multicell multilevel circuit topology is introduced in the paper. By application of the concept of multicell topology being operated in a unipolar phase-shifted PWM control to switch-mode amplifier system, the effective switching of output results in 2N times the switching frequency of each full-bridge. Due to the Carrier-Based phase-shifted modulation of the individual switching cells, the output voltage ripple of the total system is considerably small. The paper analyzes the advanced characteristic of the cascaded multilevel technique. A multilevel class-D amplifier's output harmonic with vary modulation index M is analyzed and then a cascaded multilevel class-D power amplifier is built in the laboratory. The result of measurement shows an good following performance and stability.

articleTitle: Study on the design and experiment of a magnetic controlled wireless capsule endoscopy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Through theoretical analysis and experimental study, this paper discusses the key issues in the wireless capsule endoscopy MEMS system, such as the optics design, the image capturing, the transmitter, the power supply and so on. The reasonable design of lens and lens holder insures imaging of the system; An illumination device is designed according to the imaging illuminance of the image sensor in the capsule; The system circuit is controllable in the wireless way outside the body through the magnetic switch and a magnetic field array, so that the point checking can be carried out. All the parameters and configurations of the endoscope system prototype are designed with the principles of micromation and low power consumption. The images captured by the capsule in live animal experiments indicate that the miniature wireless capsule endoscopy is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on boundary extraction and fitting analysis for convective clouds based on rerouting strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The method of boundary extraction of convective clouds was theoretically studied on the basis of image processing and model fitting evaluation theory, with the help of Doppler weather radar echoes. Ellipse and convex polygon was used to fit the extracted boundary of those clouds whose areas are big enough for flights to reroute. The evaluation results show that polygon fitting method is better than ellipse. And the accuracy gradually decreases with the increasing of length-width ratio of clouds. On the contrary, the redundancy gradually increases. In ellipse fitting method, the deviation degree also increases when the length-width ratio increases, while, the value is constant in the method of polygon fitting.

articleTitle: Research about the extraction of signal feature of film instability rotor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article elaborated the lubricant film jitter rotor signal characteristic's extraction. Through experiment of the lubricant film jitter fault simulation, and used the DASP software to withdraw the signal characteristic of the lubricant film jitter. Designed and made the rotor laboratory bench, has drawn the assembly drawing and the partial detail drawings. Has achieved the anticipated goal.

articleTitle: The research of software reliability measure based on conditional value at risk
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The research on software reliability is one of the main research contents in the software engineering. At present, the research on software reliability mostly focuses on the software reliability analysis in the conventional condition, and the study on software reliability problems at extreme conditions is less. This article introduces the theory of conditional value at risk in the financial risk management to study the problems of software reliability at extreme conditions. The data simulation illustrates the application process of this theory, the conclusions show that this method has a certain application value, which can play a supplementary function for the study of software reliability.

articleTitle: Research on interactive design for network multimedia digital newspaper
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularization of the personal computer and the rise of the Internet, people have spent more and more time for attaching information through the web, and the way people acquire information has been changed. This paper will firstly examine the characteristics of traditional newspaper, and then explore the network digital newspaper's interactive way after considering its layout, text and picture interactive and voice interactive design. The definition of basic concept and the theoretical framework of interactive elements of network multimedia digital newspaper have been presented in this paper. Finally we will study the trend for network multimedia digital newspaper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Investment protection, financial imperfection and endogenous technological change
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Multi-model predictive functional control for a nonlinear system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Most of the systems in reality are nonlinear and time-varying and there are many uncertainties under the working conditions. As a result, it is difficult to obtain satisfactory results by using the traditional predictive control method based on a single model. This paper presents a new method — predictive functional control based on multiple models, in which each model set up the local controller and local controller has a weighting and composition of the object controller. The simulation results show that multi-model predictive functional control is superior to a single model control for dynamic quality control system.

articleTitle: Markers rectifying in the motion capture system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the passive optical motion capture system, occlusion caused by the hidden markers occurs between whiles. A method based on least square for detecting and estimating of such lost points is proposed in this paper. First, we give an algorithm to find the abnormal markers by detecting the extra large derivatives of the markers' trajectories. Second, two models for estimating the abnormal markers, the rigid one and the linear transformation one, are discussed. The results of the experiments shows the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Design of three-lift controller based on FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper describes the design of elevator controller based on FPGA, the FPGA chip EP1C6Q240C8 is used as the core of controller, and its functions are described in hardware description language VHDL, and its programs use Max+plus II to compile and simulate, then downloaded to the test box to verify. The results show that the elevator is in line with actual demand. Thus, it is highly practical.

articleTitle: Virtual prototyping technology in research and development of new composite piling machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new type of cement-soil composite piling machine virtual prototype model has been established. The force-situation analysis in the process of machine-work based on soil mechanics and the simulation-analysis of operating characteristics by using ADAMS under the practical engineering working condition are both given so as to provide a reliable basis for the design and manufacture of the prototype.

articleTitle: Research on pusher and ejector in seeder of cell rotary-plate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to make seeder of cell rotary-plate enter the cells successfully and drop out of them by gravitation during plate moving, radius and the height of pusher and ejector of seeder of cell rotary-plate seeds should have reasonable values. Research on pusher and ejector by the combination of theory and experiment means. When height of brush seed is 3mm and radius of brush seed is 40mm, bud seeds enter the cells successfully. Finally, performance study on pusher and ejector by test show significant performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic testing for the seed tape tensions of the rice seed tape twisting machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to test the seed tape tensions of the rice seed tape twisting machine during the process, a dynamic testing system for the seed tape tensions was designed composed by the tensions sensor, data acquisition controller and PC, etc. The dynamic performance test of the machine was done and the seed tape tensions in the different speed was test by using the virtual instrument technology. The time domain analysis of the seed tape tensions was done by applied analysis software. The results show that, the seed tape tensions in the moving could be test by using tensions sensor and the virtual instrument technology. It has the important meaning for the seed tape tensions of dynamic measurement. It provided the basis for the dynamic performance testing and parameters optimization of the rice seed tape twisting machine.

articleTitle: Application of BP neural network in welding joint data processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article gathered the welding current, welding voltage and column displacement moves parameters of the U71Mn rail welding process orthogonal test, and extracted the quality characteristic quantities of luminous time ratio, energy input, weld period and cremation quantity before accelerating preceding to input to the BP neural network forecast model to research the welding process research to the U71Mn rail. The test result indicated that the welding process parameter conformed to the railroad standard stipulation, and played certain instruction role in the project practical application.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis and physical experiment of the inverter's influence on ceramic electric spindle's vibration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Electric spindle is the core component of numerical control machine. Using ceramic material which has the advantages such as small density and light quality to make it can not only improve its own dynamic response ability but also improve the manufacturing quality of the machine tool. However, the electric spindle vibration can also influence the processability of the machine tool directly, so it's necessary to analyse the influencing factors that can cause that. There are lots of factors should be responsible for the vibration of the electric spindle, and one of them comes from the transducer which is used to control it. This's because the inverter output voltage contains a lot of harmonic composition which can cause the electromagnetic vibration. In this paper, harmonic simulation analysis of the inverter output voltage and vibration testing experiment of the ceramic electric spindle were made follow by analysing and verifying the influence of the harmonic on ceramic electric spindle's vibration through comparing the simulation result with the experimental result.

articleTitle: A new fractal stereo video coding method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the paper, a novel stereo video codec algorithm based on fast disparity and motion estimation is proposed. Firstly, this paper makes some changes to the conventional fractal video coding method. We use tree structured partition method to partition the encoding frames. Besides, domain block searching strategy and range is used in the coding processing. Based on the feature of video motion and structure of stereo video, a fast disparity and motion estimation algorithm is used to stereo video coding. Compared with the traditional fractal stereo video coding, experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm spends much less encoding time and achieves almost the same compression ratio and compression quality. At the same time, computing complexity is much smaller.

articleTitle: The investigation on the selection of measuring distance of acoustical holography
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To investigate the selection of the underwater large-scale structures measuring distance in acoustical holography, first the sound field distribution of underwater large-scale structure is analyzed, and then for the sound pressure attenuation characteristics of three different regions in the sound field, the sound field reconstruction in a different location of measuring surface is selected. Simulation data analysis results show that: In the process of measuring surface move from Fresnel zone to distance, when the measuring surface is in the transition zone, the error curve of the sound pressure reconstruction declines rapidly. So to get certain sound field reconstruction accuracy and resolution for underwater large-scale structures, measuring surface should be chosen in the transition zone of sound field.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of real-time wireless sensor network based on ATA5823/4
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The system uses the Silicon Labs company high-performance single chip microcomputer C8051F530 as systems control module, and the High-performance full-duplex RF chip ATA5823/4 produced in Atmel applies to its RF transceiver module. The sensor modules in Single-chip microcomputer control system have the corresponding functions, for example the data collections and data sending function, on one hand, the wireless transceiver module collects the data and send them to the PC, on the other hand, they accept the commands from the PC, including control instructions and analysis instructions, and then, execute these orders.

articleTitle: Control system for constant pressure metering of fluid sowing machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A control system for constant pressure metering of fluid sowing machine was developed. Fluid sowing is a new way to save water against drought, to ensure the emergence rate and growing of the seedlings of the crop. But the level of the gel and seeds mixture in the tank will lower down and the rate of gel metered will decrease with the proceeding of sowing and this will reduce the uniformity of sowing. In this study, the metering pressure in the tank was maintained to a constant value with the air blast for agitating, by adding a pressure control system of magnetic float and solenoid to the experimental machine, which solves the problems in the process of fluid sowing. The mathematic model of the air rate for stabilizing the pressure with the metering process was established which can provide basis for the parameters design of the air blowing system of metering device of fluid sowing machine. The experiments on metered gel rate with and without the pressure stabilizing control system were conducted, the results showed the control system could significantly increase the uniformity and mean gel rate metered and it can meet the requirement of agricultural production.

articleTitle: Research on virtual manufacturing models of a new type of taper ball-end milling cutter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the analysis of the difficulties in design and manufacturing and cutting edge curves of many kinds of revolving milling cutters, a design method is presented in this paper for a new type of cutting-edge. The general differential equation is given so that the cutting-edge, the three-grooves and the grinding wheel to grind can be satisfied. The actual grooves and cutting-edges of virtual manufacturing are presented. The general feeding speeds of grinding wheel used in 2-axis NC machining of the cutter were deduced. The virtual simulation of the taper ball-end cutter is carried out. It has been proved that the traditional problems in designing and manufacturing are solved successfully in this way, simultaneously the process is much simple for it can be formed only in one time elementarily.

articleTitle: An algorithm design concerning wind monitoring and alarm along the train line
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the construction of disaster prevention for passenger special line, the wind alarm processing is rather complicated. In the paper the wind speed alarm delay model and the remove wind speed alarm delay model are established, and it realizes analysis of collected wind data and processing of wind alarm. This model is based on piecewise linear interpolation theory. The current collected wind speed value is deal with one of the following three cases: alarm maintenance, alarm delay or remove alarm delay. The delay time can meet the requirement that be pre-set. At last this paper gives the error of the model, and compares with other methods. It also points out the shortcoming of the model.

articleTitle: Hybrid-based segmentation of massive three-dimensional point cloud data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Data segmentation is an important part of the reverse engineering. Point cloud data segmentation is a technique of dividing different regions of the stitched scattered point cloud into a single geometric property. The technique is a critical part of the former reverse modeling. This article draws ona segmentation method based on hybrid, and proposes a grouping method of improving three-dimensional point cloud data which based on backtracking. During the measurement process, the method avoids the sparse phenomenon of point cloud cause by object occlusion, the change of reflecting rate or unsatisfactory reduction algorithm processing and some other circumstances. Thereby, it resolves the "isolated island"question of point cloud which generated in the split process.

articleTitle: The grey relational analysis on various modes of transportation in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to rationally plan and make good use of various modes of transportation in China, we establish a scientific and rational model based on grey relational analysis method to analyze the relevance of each mode of transportation in China. We apply this model with the real data about different transportation modes in recent years in China. The results not only can indicate the relational grade between different transportation modes and passenger and freight transport in China, but also can be as the reference to the planning and construction of the comprehensive transportation network.

articleTitle: Warship brigade complex mission reliability modeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzed the feature of the warship brigade mission. A three-phased mission decomposition method based on atomic task was brought forward to decompose the warship brigade mission, and the brigade mission was described based on hierarchy, relation and attribute. IDEF3 was extended by introducing substitution and conjunct intersection and a warship brigade mission reliability modeling method based on extended IDEF3 is proposed. Finally, the example of warship brigade aerial defense mission has been illustrated to prove the validity of the modeling method.

articleTitle: Mechanical analysis of key components and machine performance for the oil regeneration project compressor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Special scroll profiles among the functional general scroll profiles were chosen to make a study on the integrative performance of the scroll compressor. Based on such profiles, it was further researched for all factors working on the integrative performance of the scroll compressor and the analysis of gas power was made on the key components influencing the integrative performance and four basic parameters including height, spindle rotation, involute angle and radius parameter of base circle. It was analyzed that the relation of axial gas power, radial gas power tangential gas power, overturning torque and rotation torque of dynamic and static vortex plate by employing the Genetic Algorithms (GA) of MATLAB to obtain the restricted parameter range, and to conclude that there is a linear relationship among four basic parameters and the overall force. Instance calculation was conducted to prove the validity of the restricted range that compression ratio and volume utilization have been increased greatly after optimization, so as to avoid the blindness of parameter selection and consequently improve the integrative performance of the scroll compressor.

articleTitle: Wear analysis of UHMWPE acetabular cup in standard gait
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The integral values of stress based on FEM to distance based on Euler angle on the UHMWPE acetabular cup for standard gait was obtained, and the Archard wear equation was applied to evaluate wear resistance of the a series points on the surface of the UHMWPE acetabular cup. The result shows that the deepest wear point depends on both the loading and the relative moving tracks. In the special condition, each point on the surface of the acetabular is acquired and the wear depth is no more than 0.3 mm after a million paces.

articleTitle: Switching transient simulation of redundant actuation system with mechanical backup
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Although the fly-by-wire flight control system is very common in contemporary aircrafts, the emergency mechanical backup is still necessary to provide basic manual flight control in case of fly-by-wire flight control failure. The transient of mode switching is uncontrollable and unexpectable, which always causes disaster if the switch failed. The transient analysis is necessary in both the design stage and ground test stage. Based on the platform of AMESim8.0b, the hydraulic parts and mechanical parts of redundant actuation system with mechanical backup could be modeled in details. In this way, the paper simulated the switching moments when the system lost power sources one by one and degraded to mechanical backup. The simulation result shows us the reverse movement when the power is lost and uncontrollable behavior when the mechanical linkage is poorly balanced, all of which could not be expected in advance. Besides, this article also provides a good example to simulate the complicated system with hydraulic and mechanical components together.

articleTitle: Study of thin-plate specimen fixture of high-frequency fatigue testing machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A three dimensional finite element model has been setup to simulate the working states of thin-plate specimen fixture on the high-frequency fatigue testing machine. Effects of different connecting structure on the integral rigidity have been studied by the results of finite element analysis. A conclusion has been obtained that the connecting structure which has circle contacting face has higher integral rigidity. Effects of screw pitch on the self-locking performance and wear resistance of screw have been studied, and how hardness affects to screw fatigue life has studied also. The fixture designed by the optimized parameter has been used in the high-frequency fatigue testing machine and good effects obtained.

articleTitle: Intelligent green production of raw materials in ceramic technology of choice
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article is designed to establish the basis of the green ceramic, mainly for traditional ceramic raw materials selected on the lack of ideas and methods, and in-depth study of modern ceramic enterprise in material selection problems. According to the basic concepts of ceramic raw materials, basic adaptation and impact factor analysis, given the general principles and selection process, and this tensor product wavelet neural network modeling and artificial intelligence methods, building material selection of ceramic green system framework. Through the ceramic material composition of the sample input to the network for training and testing, fast convergence, not only analysis of existing materials do not exist misdiagnosis, but also the emerging material composition can all properly classified and presented to environment as the main factor in the decision-making.

articleTitle: A threshold denoising based floating point representation genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA) was widely used to many engineering optimization fields. Encoding is one of difficult issues of GA research. Floating point presentation (FPR) is of the advantage of higher precision and convenience of searching in great space. Noises were generated by the FPR in genetic operation environment. The noises have influence on the performance of GA. In this paper, the properties of the noises were mostly analyzed in inherit operation. A novel floating point representation genetic algorithm was proposed based wavelet threshold denoising mutation. Many experiments were made on it. The results of the research and the experiments indicate which the method is superior to other algorithms, is reliable in theory, and is feasible in technique.

articleTitle: High-resolution Fourier lens design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This Fourier lens system is often used in optical signal processing system. Based on the design principles of Fourier lens system and the requirements of some particles observation experiment, a Fourier optical system whose working wavelength was 532nm was designed using ZEMAX. The testing experiment using the visual microscope, showed that the system's resolution was 250lp/mm. And the system was successfully used in the particles observation experiment.

articleTitle: A research on optimization algorithm for BPEL process based on synchronization and concurrency analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Business Process Execution Language(BPEL) is widely used in service composition and orchestration. However, sometimes it is time-consuming to handle several sequences executing concurrently. This paper proposes an optimization algorithm for BPEL process, which is based on synchronization and concurrency analysis. Our approach first scans and reconstructs all the synchronization structures based on a synchronization analysis, following with construction of data dependence and control dependence, representing in process dependence graph. By decreasing quantity of sequences and increasing concurrency degree, an algorithm is proposed to enhance efficiency of a given process. At the end of this paper, a BPEL process instance shows the algorithm validity.

articleTitle: Evolutionary stable strategy model in multi-application enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the evolutionary game theory, the paper builds an ESS evolutionary game model for multi-application enterprises, and analyzes dynamics process on cooperative performance. Through comparing balanced results in different profit, cost, punishment and initial group percentage parameters, this paper provided a fresh method to management multi-application enterprises reasonably.

articleTitle: Research on NC manufacturing of a new spiral bevel gear
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the Free-form NC bevel gear milling machine, the module of generated tooth surface was built, which was expressed by the functions of the rotary angle of work-piece gear, the manufacturing theory about a new spiral bevel gear was researched, and the manufacturing thoughts and ways of logarithmic spiral bevel gear were presented in the end, which lays a theoretical foundation for the processing technology of such a new spiral bevel gear.

articleTitle: Combustion performance of vehicle diesel motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we have mainly analyzed the four periods of diesel motor's combustion process, which includes the questions about ignition delay, rapid combustion period, slow combustion period and aux-combustion period. We also have studied the formation reasons about incomplete combustion, noise of ignition phenomenon, and exhaust smoke. And we have formed the resolutions.

articleTitle: Research on fatigue life of the casting crane's girder by using damnification limits design method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By using ANSYS to carry out finite element analysis, combining the results of the analysis and the theory of fracture mechanics, and making use of damnification limits design method based on the theory of fracture mechanics, the thesis gave a certain type of casting crane girder for example to analyze its fatigue life. It provided some theory basis and reference for casting crane's safe operation and fatigue lift design.

Author Keywords: crane girder fatigue life ANSYS damnification limits

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Improving accuracy of benzene detection based on optical atmospheric composition measurement technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Automatic Speech Emotion Recognition using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Automatic Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a current research topic in the field of Human Computer Interaction (HCI) with wide range of applications. The purpose of speech emotion recognition system is to automatically classify speaker's utterances into five emotional states such as disgust, boredom, sadness, neutral, and happiness. The speech samples are from Berlin emotional database and the features extracted from these utterances are energy, pitch, linear prediction cepstrum coefficients (LPCC), Mel Frequency cepstrum coefficients (MFCC), Linear Prediction coefficients and Mel cepstrum coefficients (LPCMCC). The Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used as a classifier to classify different emotional states. The system gives 66.02% classification accuracy for only using energy and pitch features, 70.7% for only using LPCMCC features, and 82.5% for using both of them.

articleTitle: Novel design of intelligent internet-of-vehicles management system based on cloud-computing and Internet-of-Things
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays explosion of car ownership has wrought gridlocked traffic. So how to improve traffic of city has become the focus of the global concern. The development of cloud computing, internet-of-things, wireless sensor networks and so forth, has opened a new horizon for solving the increasing transportation issue in cities and in highways. We present a novel intelligent internet-of-vehicles administration system, which is featured by low cost, high scalability, environment friendly, high compatibility, easy to upgrade, to replace traditional traffic management system and the proposed system can improve road traffic tremendously.

articleTitle: Effective load balancing for cloud-based multimedia system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Cloud computing, as a new concept, provides a good solution for handling multimedia applications effectively and efficiently. It can facilitate the execution of complicated multimedia tasks, as well as supports specific and stringent multimedia QoS provisioning. However, for this new idea, a key challenge is how to make each multimedia service task to obtain the required resources in the shortest time. In this paper, we propose an effective load balancing approach for cloud-based multimedia system, called CMLB. Its main advantage is fully considering the load of all servers and the network conditions, and thus achieving reasonable resource allocation and scheduling. The evaluation results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: The application of soil temperature measurement by LM35 temperature sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Consider revising medium temperature used LM35 temperature sensor, what is an economic and feasible method. This study mainly researches the applicability of LM35 temperature sensor in soil temperature testing field. Selected the sensor, and based on the theoretical equation between the sensor output voltage and Celsius temperature; introduced correction coefficient, carried through the calibration experiment of the sensor; further more, it is applied to the potted rice's soil temperature detection. The calibration results show that, each sensor correction coefficient is different from others, but these numerical are close to 1, the linear relationship was very significant between tested medium temperature and sensor output voltage. In the key trial period of rice potted, used LM35DZ type temperature sensor to measure the soil temperature. The analysis result show that, the changing trends are basically equal both soil temperature and air temperature, and the characteristics of soil temperatures are lag. The variance analysis shows that, the difference was not significant paper film covered and without covered on soil temperature.

articleTitle: A new approach to realize UART
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to connect DSP which has synchronous serial ports to the devices implementing asynchronous communications protocol, a method to implement UART communications based on programmable logic device is proposed in the paper. In the proposed method, the core function of UART is integrated in CPLD with VHDL. Firstly, UART data frame format and operational principle of UART were introduced after reviewing some methods to realize UART. The methods to implement UART transmitter, UART receiver and baudrate generator using VHDL were illustrated in detail. Then pre-simulation and synthesize of VHDL program were executed. Finally, the test with bit error rate was carried out on physical system. Experimental results indicate that 75 percent of the GLB are used by UART, and the bit error rate is less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>. The experiment was implemented utilizing the RS-422 protocol and the baudrate is 62.5kb/s. The proposed method can satisfy the system requirements of high integration, stabilization, low bit error rate, strong anti-jamming and low cost.

articleTitle: The design of smart home platform based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The smart home is a concept of the pervasive computing, and it gradually becomes significant for the people living in the high technology area. For numerous data and complex control bring about a much heavy burden on the local computers, and it is difficult for the users to obtain the information of the smart home. In this paper, we propose the smart home structure based on Cloud Computing, which helps to reduce local workload and the users obtain the real time information through Web browser directly. In addition, we build the experimental platform to validate the structure of smart home based on Cloud Computing, the experimental results show that the proposed structure of smart home is more convenient, flexible, high efficiency and low cost. Though experiment, we find that the structure based on Cloud Computing is available and has a widespread scope of applications. Furthermore, the Cloud Computing provides plentiful network resource, and guarantees the users data security.

articleTitle: A dynamic priority scheduling algorithm on service request scheduling in cloud computing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularity of cloud computing, more and more business are operated in the cloud computing. In this paper, we address the problem of service request scheduling in cloud computing systems. We consider the three-tier cloud structure, which consists of resource providers, service providers and consumers. The service request scheduling strategies in this scenario should satisfy the objectives of the service providers and consumers. We propose a new strategy dynamic priority scheduling algorithm (DPSA) to solve this problem. The algorithm is more efficient and optimal than the FCFS and SPSA.

articleTitle: The design for the controller of the linear inverted pendulum based on backstepping
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Inverted pendulum is an ideal model to verify a new control theory or methods as an absolute instability, high, variable and high coupling typical nonlinear system. There are many researches on the control methods of inverted pendulum. Using Backstepping for the controller design of the linear Inverted Pendulum is presented in detail in this paper. This method does not need linearizing the system, and can design the controller directly and recursively, meanwhile, the designed controller remains the useful nonlinear terms and can be closer to the reality with strong Robustness. The experimental platform simulation demonstrated the method has the characteristics of fast stabilization time, great anti-interference capabilities and good control effects.

articleTitle: Study on fault diagnosis of power transformer based on similarity measures between vague sets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The fault diagnosis method of power transformer based on similarity measures between vague sets is discussed. The similarity measures between Vague Sets is combined with transformer fault diagnose problem. The gas concentrations dissolved oil is used as failure symptoms, based on the knowledge sample, counted the analogical degree between the diagnosing fault swatch of Vague Set and system fault knowledge of Vague Set, so as to diagnose and arrange the faults. Through practical transformer fault diagnosis, the rationality and accuracy in the power transformer based on similarity measures between vague sets is elaborated and verified.

articleTitle: Projection onto convex sets super-resolution image reconstruction based on wavelet bi-cubic interpolation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The traditional projections onto convex sets super-resolution image reconstruction algorithm leads to the halo effect in reconstructed high resolution image, so we present a super-resolution reconstruction method based on wavelet bicubic interpolation algorithm. The new algorithm utilizes wavelet bi-cubic interpolation algorithm to obtain the initial image of POCS algorithm and introduces bilateral filter to estimate point spread function. Bilateral filtering makes non-edge pixel having minimum influence on the edge region. Algorithm also uses adaptive relaxation parameters to reduce the impact of error motion information. Compared with traditional algorithm, experiment results show that the proposed reconstruction algorithm eliminates the halo effect obviously, thus the reconstructed image can achieve a good visual effect.

articleTitle: NFC antenna research and a simple impedance matching method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Near Field Communication (NFC) technology evolved from a non-contact radio frequency identification (RFID) technology and intercommunication technology. Sensor reader, contactless card and peer to peer features integrate to a single chip. This chip could communicate with compatible devices by the identification and data exchange at a short distance. The technology was a simple merger of RFID technology and network technology at first, but it has evolved into a short-range wireless communications technology, which develops very quickly. This paper introduces the concept and characteristics of NFC technology first. Then, starting from the antenna coil used by NFC technology, this paper accomplished the theoretical analysis, Matlab simulation, HFSS and ADS2009 joint simulation respectively, and improved design an antenna impedance matching approach.

articleTitle: Application of gesture recognition based on simulated annealing BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm of gesture recognition based on simulated annealing BP neural network is presented. Firstly, this new algorithm extracts the edge outline by skin color division and recognition feature of the distance between center and edge of binary gesture image. Secondly, it combines simulated annealing with BP neural network, which has both the learning ability and robustness of the neural network and the global optimization of simulated annealing, avoids the slow convergence and prevents it from falling into local minimum. The results of experiments show that the algorithm can greatly improve efficiency and accuracy of gesture recognition.

articleTitle: The improved elliptic curve digital signature algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: ECDSA is the first successful algorithm that based on ECC. It was accepted by ANSI, IEEE, NIST and ISO as the standard signature algorithm. In this paper, ECDSA was analyzed and improved. The improved algorithms reduce the computational cost while keeping the same security as original ECDSA. They are suitable for the users who have limited compute capacity in different cases. The performance data of each algorithm was presented also.

articleTitle: State estimation and simulation of the magnetic levitation system of a high-speed Maglev train
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The magnetic levitation system of a high-speed Maglev train is simplified as a single mass system on a rigid guideway. The motion equations of the electromechanical components are derived with LAGRANGE-Function in state space notation. Because of the instability of the magnetic levitation system the vehicle must be actively controlled. The controller is designed by linear quadratic optimal control strategy. A state observer (KALMAN-Filter) is used to estimate the states which can not be measured or are influenced by noise. For the simulation of the control system the MATLAB/Simulink is used. Simulation results for the time histories of the magnet gap and the vertical acceleration are given for a gap initial condition.

articleTitle: PWM speed control system of DC motor based on AT89S51
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new approach of DC motor PWM speed control, using microcomputer as controller, after discussing conventional cascade speed control. It introduces the principle of DC motor PWM speed control and the details of the realization of the approach base on AT89S51 single-chip microcomputer. Different duty cycle quadrate waves are produced by the PI of AT89S51. Different speed grades and the direction are depended on different buttons. Experiments have proved that this system is of higher performance.

articleTitle: UAV attitude and position estimation for vision-based landing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) landing safely is key and difficult on UAV research. In order to improve the security of UAV landing on the flight strip, a vision-based method was presented for attitude and position estimation of it, based a few feature points distributed on the ground arbitrarily. Calculating the attitude and position relative to runway is the core. Firstly, the coordinates in the camera frame of the feature points was acquired with the N-point algorithm; secondly, with the orthogonalization method, the rotation matrix and the translation vector between the camera frame and the runway frame were acquired. For the imaging process of feature points is influenced by noise, the least-median-squares (LMS) algorithm was employed to diminish the influence of noise and to improve the robustness. For improving the efficiency of LMS, the data segmentation technology was used. The simulation indicated that the presented algorithms meet the precision demand of UAV landing.

articleTitle: Electric braking performance analysis of PMSM for electric vehicle applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzed the performances of plug braking and regenerative braking of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM), which is often used as the driving motor of electric vehicles. The electric braking principles are briefly explained at first. The performance analysis focuses on maximum braking torque, braking torque ripple and the feedback power of braking energy. The two main control methods for PMSM, six step commutation control and field oriented control (FOC), have been analyzed. A simulation system has also been developed in this paper and the analysis is supported by the results of simulation and preliminary experiments.

articleTitle: Research of a kind of new UAV training simulator based on equipment simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Traditional UAV training Simulator is independent of UAV System, so the UAV operator cannot accomplish both system test and training in one training process. This paper presented and realized a kind of new Training Simulator based on simulation for the equipment on UAV. The new kind of system structure and signal pipeline was introduced first, then the method and process to treat plane model equipment model into real time. At last the main function and effect of scene editor and displaying were presented. The result shows that the new training Simulator can not only meet the training requirement but also accomplish the testing for flight control system, radio data link, and ground station in the meantime. This Training Simulator has successfully applied in a certain kind of UAV system and wined prime estimate.

articleTitle: Research on security issues in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the widespread growth of applications of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), the need for reliable security mechanisms these networks has increased manifold. In this paper, we first review the desired security services from WSN perspective. The crucial problem in WSN is position estimation or Localization, due to their dynamic method of deployment, and the greatest challenge imposed is in communicating with their authenticated neighbors, their precise location in a secured manner. Against the popular belief that public key cryptographic schemes are not practical for sensors, an authentication technique which makes use of Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) along with the positioning scheme is implemented. Finally, we provide algorithms to determine their location in presence of neighbor sensors that may lie about their position.

articleTitle: A face and eye detection based feedback system for smart classroom
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a novel auto feedback system used in smart classroom based on face and eye detection technology and PTZ camera. The system is used to address the issue of students' inattentiveness occurred in learning procedure by sending them instant feedback. In this paper, we use a PTZ camera for students' images gathering, locating each student using face detection technique, detecting learning status though eye detection technique, and then sending instant feedback though Wi-Fi environment. The main contribution of our research is combining face and eye detection technology into smart classroom environment to provide an approach to remind students when they are distracted and let teacher focus on teaching.

articleTitle: Investigation on some key issues of regenerative damper with rotary motor for automobile suspension
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper mainly investigates the regenerative damper (RG damper) from three aspects. In the first part, the author introduces the structure of regenerative damper, analyses the advantages and disadvantages of three types of current regenerative suspension and proposes a novel regenerative damper structure. In the second part, it firstly reviews the control problem of RG damper and proposes a new problem, then summarizes its control characteristic. The third part is about the dynamic modeling of the regenerative damper with rotary motor. In this pat, it firstly points out the modeling problem in previous literatures and then derives its complete dynamic model for regenerative suspension.

articleTitle: The inverted-pendulum model with consideration of pendulum resistance and its LQR controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper discussed the inverted-pendulum model in detail. The pendulum resistance is considered which makes the model closer to the actual application. The simulation experiment results show that even when pendulum resistance coefficient is small, i.e. 0.005, the system performance is obvious affected. So the pendulum resistance is necessary to be considered in the model. The Linear Quadratic Regulator is designed for the inverted-pendulum system. Both pendulum angle and carriage displacement can be controlled with the regulator. We did the initial pendulum angle experiments and the disturbance experiments show that the system performance and stability are good.

articleTitle: Optimization of the control strategy for EHA-VPVM system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
