publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The deformation of brittle and hard material slender bar has great significance in contour grinding process. In this paper, the grinding deformation for Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-TiC slender bar was studied. Diamond lapping film and adhesive mounting method were applied in the experiments. The influences of grinding pressure, grinding speed and stress on deformation were discussed in detail based on the theoretical analysis and the measurement of straightness in different conditions. The bend deformation goes up with the increase of grinding pressure and speed. The internal stress will bring large deformation after grinding. Releasing the stress will improve the deformation. Experiments shown that releasing the stress two-thirds at a proper condition before final grinding can achieve the deformation below 1000 nm. Employing lapping film and adhesive mounting method in optimal condition, the Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-TiC slender bar deformation in grinding can be controlled.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An empirical research of the business cycle synchronization among the GCC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application information flow non-interference transmission model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the security field of computer application systems, how to guarantee legal transmission of information flow among different application programs is a significant problem. In this paper, firstly, non-interference theory is analyzed, and then a security model called Application Information Flow Noninterference Transmission Model (AIFNITM) is proposed. The model divides application programs into security domains and sets up rules for regular interference to prevent malicious information flow. Finally, on the basis of AIFNITM, a security enhancement system for an application server is implemented, which demonstrates that the model has strong practicality and operability.

articleTitle: A self-adapting improvement Particles Swarm Optimization algorithm and application in Multi-Criteria Group Decision-making
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to avoid the phenomenon such as earliness and convergence emerged by Particles Swarm Optimization (PSO) Algorithm during searching target solution, the paper supplies a Self-Adapting Improvement PSO (SAI-PSO) Algorithm including of its improvement methods, strategies and operational structure from the angles of evaluation characteristic generated and fitness function selected. The experimental results show that SAI-PSO uses self-adapting strategies to amend inertia weighing and particles selection mechanism, it could reduce the amount of computation for particles optimization, strength the algorithm convergence speed, obtains the better solution precision, which provides the valuable lessons and references for Multi-Criteria Group Decision-making resolution.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulates the light migration in compacted subgrade
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Transmission characteristics of photon in the subgrade tissue is the theoretical basis of using laser imaging to detect density of compacted subgrade. After explaining the basic methods of using Monte Carlo simulation theory to study the propagation of photon in the subgrade tissue, the paper selects optical properties of several subgrade tissues, simulates the propagation of photon in the subgrade tissue by using program written with C language and presents the photon density in different radius with the light source as the center. Research shows that applying Monte Carlo to study the propagation of photon in the subgrade tissue is of great help to find out the factors which will affect the detection accuracy of non-destructive testing in principle.

articleTitle: A method to judge taper-taper intersection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To judge taper-taper intersection and to calculate the position they intersect is common in many engineering applications. The traditional method to solve the inequalities of the two tapers is very complex. This article brings forward a new method which turns the taper-taper intersection problem into the sphere-sphere intersection one that makes it much easier.

articleTitle: Research of control algorithm of medical balance bed
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The system of medical balance bed is the research project of combining of the dynamics theory and the automatic control theory and technology. The control system of the balance bed is a complex, unstable, nonlinear system. To achieve balance of the bed, well-designed control system is particularly important. Presently, there are many different types of control methods, but the system of medical balance bed needs to control balance automatically and law regulating the parameters of the system in real-time, and to adapt to the impact of environmental changes, parameters change of the system itself and external interference, etc, so that the whole system can run in the best condition. Based on comparison and analysis of several typical control algorithms, this paper puts forward a neural network adaptive PID control algorithm. It can not only suppress the external disturbance, and adapt to the impact of environmental changes and parameter changes of the system itself, to some extent, but also can effectively eliminate the modeling error and other factors. This paper discusses the neural network adaptive PID control algorithm, and simulates using MATLAB to prove that the neural network adaptive PID control algorithm is better than PID control algorithm.

Author Keywords: neural network adaptive PID control algorithm

articleTitle: A novel switched reluctance motor drive system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A switched reluctance motor drive system is presented, and this system has the characteristics of simple construction and reliable performance. It is designed based on 4 phase, 8/6 pole and 5.5 KW switched reluctance motor. TMS320F240 is used as the main controlling unit. A new type of power circuit that includes at least switching components is applied in the power converter and IGBT is used as the main power switching component. A control scheme of the low-speed fixed angle current chopping and high-speed variable angle voltage chopping is applied. Experimental results are given to verify the stability and reliability of the proposed system. The performance of speed regulation is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Imperfect monitoring and impermanent reputations in infinite dynamic games
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper tried to extend Cripps, Mailath and Samuelson (2004, 2007)'s impermanent reputation results from repeated games into dynamic games so as to make it applicable to many dynamic settings. We consider the impermanent reputation in the same dynamic setting as that in Celentani and Pesendorfer (1996). By the assumptions of anonymity, our formal analysis could be on the strategic interactions of two long-run players with one's actions private while the other's public. Under imperfect monitoring, the large player's deviate from the commitment strategy would be statistically perceived by the opponent not immediately but some periods later.

articleTitle: An algorithm of multi-stroke combination in the automotive styling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of the combination of two strokes into one mixed stroke in the application of automotive styling. By the analysis of stroke patterns, three cases have been considered to match the natural ways of closure. The conditions of determining the cases have been proposed. The concept of the influence ability between two strokes has been applied to get the offset or mixed points. By the calculation of the threshold X, within its control interval to offset the points of stroke, the hybrid bilinear interpolation has been introduced to make a smooth combination for the overlapped sections. The results demonstrate that the algorithm is quite satisfied and the algorithm meets the natural ways of sketching.

articleTitle: PMSM speed control simulation based on sliding mode variable structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is a high-order, nonlinear system with strong coupling. When the system parameters vary or disturbances occur, conventional linear regulation law can not satisfy the higher requirements with the speed-adjustable system. According to the sliding mode variable structure and the vector control theory, we design the sliding mode controllers (SMC) in the speed loop and the current loop based on double closed-loop system with PMSM, which solves the problem of the parameters change and disturbances in the system. The simulation results show that the scheme for the parameter variations of the system and disturbances has good rapidity and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Research on ECS control scheme of waste incineration based power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the characteristics of waste incineration based power plant and its demand for electric monitoring, an scheme of electric control system (ECS) was designed in this paper. Through the cooperation with electrical special equipment such as ASS, AVR etc. our system has realized automatic quasi-synchronization between generator and power network, and also provides a man - machine interface between the electric monitoring system and operation staff. Experimental results indicated that, our system can meet the demands of the operator start for real-time monitoring the status of startup and operation of the whole system and related equipments.

articleTitle: Equivalent analogy correction parameter tuning method of digital control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at pulse transfer function description puzzling the parameters tuning, based on equivalent analogy correction method of digital control system having the characteristics of transforming the transfer function into the equivalent pulse transfer function in digital controller, a uniform formula of lag and lead correction is deduced. Analytic expression of typical units is listed and changing range is dedicated. Program flow chart from the equivalent analogy conversion of lag and head correction is showed, and two group parameters' relationship is defined. The results indicate that the method has the same advantages of clear concept, definite tuning step, convenient be achieved in computers. It can help scientists and engineers to design and debugging a control system quickly.

articleTitle: Geometry standardization of arbitrary multi-stroke sketching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the freehand sketching in 3D of automotive styling, this paper has investigated the geometry standardization through the identifications and fittings of the geometries drawn by arbitrary strokes. The standard geometries can be established by freehand sketching in 3D. The working process has been proposed to achieve the goal of identifying the standard geometries automatically. The standardization has been realized in three levels for arbitrary sketching. Firstly, the strokes to be combined into a single stroke are arbitrary; secondly, the strokes to form a standard geometry are arbitrary; and thirdly, the modifications of strokes are arbitrary.

articleTitle: In-material measurement technique for brittle materials subjected to shock loading
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Two kinds of magnetic gauges, including electromagnetic particle velocity (EMV) gauge and a combined gauge composed of EMV gauge and electromagnetic (EM) stress gauge, are introduced to investigate the dynamic damage of brittle materials subjected to shock loading. The former is now used for the measurements of non-magnetic materials under pressure-shear impact loading. The latter one can be used in normal plate impact, and the experimental results with this gauge could be self-proofed. The preliminarily experimental results show that these techniques are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Research on configurable strategy of spacecraft data management system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The working model for the spacecraft testing has been evolving and will continue changing as this process is going on. This evolvement has aroused challenges to the designs of the spacecraft data management system. The problems include that requirement of the evolving working model could not be satisfied by simply tailoring the functions of the old systems, and that computing resources accumulated in history fails to be effectively utilized to serve the new applications. In response to these problems, this paper proposed a configurable strategy for spacecraft data management system. It contains the following parts: encapsulates basic computing units as components, connectors and component linkage language in which data management system can be developed by manipulating components and connectors. Finally, a part of the system implementation example illustrated effectiveness of the scheme proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Integrating multi-relations and multi-domains in qualitative spatial reasoning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Spatial reasoning is an important analysis method for spatial information in Ambient Intelligence and other applications. We discuss the integration problem on spatial reasoning. The combinations of more than three relations and multi-domains relation are investigated. These reasoning problems are useful in AmI, GIS and other applications. But neither of them was studied before.

articleTitle: Dynamic resource reservation MAC mechanism for distributed wireless networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the distributed wireless networks, this paper proposes a new MAC mechanism protocol - Distributed Dynamic Frame Reservation Multiple Access (DDFRMA) which supports voice and data transmitting together. The Markov model is built to analyze the relationships between nodes and the voice packets dropping probability. Simulation results show that the protocol can support voice transmitting of distributed networks, improves the voice capacity of access mechanism, compared with the CSMA/CA mechanism.

articleTitle: Prediction and estimation to the maneuvering target in opto-electronic tracking system based on robust extend Kalman filter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the improvement of target maneuvering performance, noises statistical character changes correspondingly in the opto-electronic tracking system. To solve this problem, robust extend Kalman filter (REKF) based on the acceleration non-zero mean value time-correlation model was given in this paper. Result of the simulation shows that, comparing with extend Kalman filter, the prediction precision of REKF is almost twice as much as that of EKF. And at the same time, REKF has good robustness to overcome the effect coursed by stochastic measurement noises.

articleTitle: Analysis and design for bilinear discrete systems subject to input saturation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We study double linear discrete systems subject to actuator saturation which are made up of linear discrete systems subject to input saturation and state observer. We use differential convex to convert the part of nonlinear saturation into convert linear part. In other words, we suppose that domain of contractive of them is invariant, so a few conditions could be derived from the given contractively invariant ellipsoid. These conditions are shown to be less conservative than the existing conditions of other literature. Moreover, conditions can be expressed as the linear matrix inequalities optimal issue. LMI methods solve the state feedback matrix F and auxiliary matrix H to make double linear discrete systems asymptotic stable. We estimate the domain of the attraction of double linear discrete systems under input saturation by the state feedback matrix F and auxiliary matrix H. Numerical simulation demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The motion accuracy reliability research of hydraulic amplifier mechanism in naval ships
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the control system of the naval ships steam power plant, it's control process should be accurate, timely, concerted. With considering two factors that may influence the kinematic accuracy of amplifier mechanism, this paper quantitative analysis the output error of baffle displacement by the reliability classical model based on the mathematical model, and validate the reliability model by Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Design of automotive intelligent node based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays, the CAN bus technology has become a popular communication way in more vehicles. Each electronic control unit in the automotive control network based on CAN bus can be regarded as an intelligent node, in which ID address, bitrates, work mode, etc. are set through programming. In this paper, the hardware rationale and the control software of the intelligent node were elaborated in details. Additional, the anti-jamming measures in the automobile work circumstance were introduced.

articleTitle: Modeling analysis and simulation research for a flexible vehicle arresting system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A flexible vehicle arresting system (FVAS) is presented in this paper. The FVAS enables vehicle to stop without damages to the vehicle and vehicle-mounted personnel. The analysis completes about kinematical equations for each link both in on-and off-center arresting processes, kinematics model for the FVAS, building the simulation model of the FVAS in MATLAB/SIMULINK and making a description for systematic behaviors after running the model. Further more, this paper evaluates the correctness and validity of the ever-built model by means of comparing data from testing on real vehicle on-center hitting against the FVAS with those from simulation, and then it provides some valuable advice for further research on the FVAS.

articleTitle: The effects of fibers on the electrical contacts
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Because the electronic products are sealed up incompletely, it is easy to be influenced by the environment to cause the electrical failure. Through the micro-examination of interior of the failed mobile phones, it was discovered that the fiber was one of the main pollutants. The distributed characteristic and the size scope of fibers in the failed mobile phones were analyzed. By using simulation experiments of static and dynamic contact conditions, the failure mechanisms of electrical contacts covered by fibers were studied.

articleTitle: The research of programming on embedded uBase-III system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Taking the embedded uBase-III for example, this paper analyzes the characteristics of embedded programming from memory management, Multi-tasking programming and RPC. The method of embedded programming is thoroughly studied, and some examples are given.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of compound grinder for grinding end face and inner hole
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the structure of compound grinder for grinding end face and inner hole of tappet body, this paper established the finite element (FE) model and presented the modal analysis of the compound grinder and its components by means of three-dimensional software and FE method. The first four natural frequencies and modal shapes of the compound grinder were given. As a result, the weaknesses of the compound grinder were determined and it offered the basis for improving dynamic property of the compound grinder.

articleTitle: The system development of FMS monitoring and fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the decentralization and flexible technology development of manufacturing system, the paper constructs the status monitoring and diagnosis system of the distributed flexible manufacturing system, and designs the system model of hardware and software and the expert system architecture of fault diagnosis, the hardware system includes the management layer and the monitoring layer and the information acquisition layer and the equipment layer and other components, the function of monitoring software involves the system monitoring module and the fault diagnosis module and status monitoring module and Web service module and database management module. The paper introduces the system framework of the status monitoring and fault diagnosis based on J2EE platform, these will provide important guidance value for the status monitoring and fault diagnosis of the flexible manufacturing system study.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of PDA-based mobile inquiring system for oil well logging information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article describes the PDA-based mobile inquiring system of oil well information and show the design of the systems. PDA-based mobile monitoring system for oil wells using the TCP/IP communication mechanism, the client PDA terminal through the WIFI and GPRS switch-in the data center. As the Web-Service provides the data service, one can carry on the dynamic monitor to the oil well and realize the dynamics of safety management, which improves staff efficiency effectively. This system has applied in the oil field monitoring system, provides the effective information technology support for the oil well site dispatching decision making, and improves the rapid reaction capability and work efficiency greatly.

articleTitle: The design of 3 ∗ 3 real time VideoImage convolver on the basis of FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the feature of video image scanning every other line, this paper will design a convolver which can process real-time video signals on the basis of ALTERA's QUARTERS II software and Cyclone's FPGA. Such a convolver can make full use of the advantages of FPGA, for example the flexibility that make it possible to set the inner logical configuration based on the requirements of applications. The structure of our convolver is very simple because it only employs a 3×3 window facing the processing of video images. In addition, this paper also gives some attentions in the convolver designation. Experiment has shown that our convolver effects very well when processing video signals.

articleTitle: An improved DRM authentication approach for mobile journals publishing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we reviewed the foundation concepts and technologies of Digital Rights Management, studied the features of mobile journals. According to the research above, we found that there are some differences between mobile journals and internet-based digital journals. So we studied the application of DRM for mobile journals. According to the features of mobile journals, we found an improved DRM model based on authentication technology for mobile journals, included the technologies about encrypting, decrypting, packaging and transmitting.

articleTitle: Research on conceptual design of heavy-duty truck frame based on topology optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Topology optimization is a design method based on mathematical programming, to seek an optimum distribution of material, greatly shortened product conceptual design cycle. With the help of variable-density method, topology optimization was carried out for heavy-duty truck frame based on Hyper Works platform. The way not only satisfied with the design requirements, but also provides reference for the new product design. It provides an important technical message for conceptual design.

articleTitle: Study on making high side-mode suppression ratio fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper a new method is proposed. A high side-mode suppression ratio fiber bragg grating using ordinary system can be obtained by this method. First, let hydrogen loaded optical fiber pass the laser beam, and hold seconds, we call this pre-exposure. Second use this kind of fiber made Fiber Bragg Grating(FBG) in the original optical path. We can find that pre-exposure fiber can get FBG that has higher side-mode suppression ratio and higher performance.

articleTitle: Web caching system research and implementation of cluster
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, how to cluster technology combined with the Web cache, the number of Web cache server to build a high-performance, scalable cluster system model, to solve a single Web cache server node failure problems and improve the data parallel processing capabilities. System, each module uses superior algorithms to achieve and a good mechanism through which testing proved that under high load in the Web, the performance is more excellent.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of infrared gait detection based on immune ant colony
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The accurate infrared gait detection is a research difficulty because of the unique thermal imaging characteristics. Therefore, the coarse result of infrared human detection is obtained by using the background subtraction method based on the single Gaussian background model, and is fine segmented by applying the improved pulse coupled neural network (PCNN). At the same time, the effect of the adaptive segmentation is reached by introducing the immune ant colony algorithm to fast determine the optimal segmentation parameters of PCNN. The simulation results show that this algorithm can achieve the ideal detection effect.

articleTitle: A new estimation method of the forestry inventory parameter based on three-dimension laser scan technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Terrestrial laser scanners, as efficient tools, have opened a wide range of application fields within a rather short period of time. Beyond interactive measurement in 3D point clouds, techniques for the automatic detection of objects and the determination of geometric parameters form a high priority research issue. The quality of 3D point clouds generated by laser scanners and the automation potential make terrestrial laser scanning also an interesting tool for forest inventory and management. The paper will first review current laser scanner systems from a technological point of view and discuss different scanner technologies and system parameters regarding their suitability for forestry applications. Based on a large number of mixed forest plots, accuracy and handling of the laser scanner were tested. Furthermore a method for the automatic detection of the approximate position of trees will be presented. Co-ordinates of the approximate positions and the number of trees in the plots are a result of the first algorithm. In a second step all located trees will be separated and the breast height diameters, the profiles along the stem and their height will be determined automatically. Finally the paper presents results from several pilot studies on the application of terrestrial laser scanning in forest inventory tasks with the goal of automatically determining inventory-relevant tree parameters. The basic data sets have been provided using one terrestrial laser scanners, which based on phase measurement technology.

articleTitle: Research and realization on the control strategies of blow-down supersonic wind tunnel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As the characteristics of nonlinear, time-varying and big time delay in the ejecting blow-down supersonic wind tunnel, it will occur the interference and coupling between the total pressure control system and ejector control system in the ejection test mode. In order to meet the requirements of high control accuracy and the stable velocity of convergence of wind tunnel tests, the control strategies for the startup of wind tunnel and stability of flow field under different testing conditions are made deep study and successful application during the wind tunnel tests.

articleTitle: Comparison of two filter media for nuclear, chemical and biological filter applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this article, the performance for nuclear, chemical and biological(NBC) filter applications of two filter media, microfiber and nanofiber, are compared. High filtration efficiency is needed for protection against airborne high-toxic particulate matter such as bacteria, viruses, chemical weapon agent(CWA) liquid aerosols and radioactive fine particles. Filter media based on micro glass fibre is widely used in NBC filters. Polymer based nanofibre composites are new candidates for filter media with high or ultra-high filtration efficiency. They offer many new and useful properties, but they also have some serious limitations in performance.

articleTitle: 3D Sketching in AutoSketch
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper presents a novel method to sketch in 3D for automotive styling based on a computer-aided styling system - AutoSketch, which has been prototyped by using ThinkDesign API. Differing from the traditional CAS/CAD systems, AutoSketch uses a digital pen to draw/sketch in a natural way on digital tablet/screen to create 3D surface models. The method demonstrates how spatial curves/surfaces have been created. Planar points are converted into spatial points, planar strokes into spatial curves on working plane or surfaces through the projection and intersection, and spatial curves into surfaces in hand sketching ways.

articleTitle: Double-pass optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A double-pass noncollinear optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier has been demonstrated. The signal is double-pass amplified in a single nonlinear crystal by a nanosecond pump pulse. The first-pass optical parametric amplification is completely phase matched in the plane of the maximum effective nonlinearity, and the other pass works symmetrically near to the first-pass optical parametric amplification plane. This architecture efficiently increases the overall gain, overcomes the optical parametric fluorescence. This scheme has been used respectively in the optical parametric chirped pulse amplifiers which the signal is an Yb-doped passively mode-locked fiber laser or a Kerr lens mode-locked Ti:sapphire oscillator.

articleTitle: Zinc oxide hexagram microrods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Zinc oxide (ZnO) microrods were grown by the floating zone method, the as-grown ZnO microrods have uniform size. Scanning electron microscope image reveals that the ZnO microrods are grown with a hexagonal structure, well faceted ends and side surfaces. Most of ZnO microrods have diameters of about 20-30μm and lengths of about 1-2 mm. Polarizing microscopy image of ZnO microrods shows that they have high crystal quality. The X-Ray diffraction pattern shows that microrods have vertical orientation. The Raman spectra demonstrate that the vibrational mode of wurtzite-type ZnO clearly. The room temperature photoluminescence measurements indicate that the microrods have a relative strong ultraviolet (UV) emission and very weak green emission.

articleTitle: Design and research of simulated surgical instruments for medical training system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the purpose of helping new doctor master surgical technique, improving the successful rate of surgery, also for reducing the training cost of surgery, according to real-world surgery condition, three operative instrument simulators applied in surgery training were designed based on degree of freedom numbers of three operative instruments. Operator of those simulators can feel feedback force from simulators. Work spaces of the simulators were analyzed. The results shows that three simulators meet the design requirements and their work space were the same as that of real operative instruments. The simulators can exactly be used to simulate specific operative instruments in surgical training system.

articleTitle: Approach of aircraft configuration with complex free-form surface design based on reverse engineering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As a complex engineering technique, reverse engineering is dependent on the high precision measuring equipment. As to special aircraft configuration with complex free-form surfaces, traditional direct CAD constructing method is inefficient. By analyzing the technical characteristics of reverse engineering, a new design approach for special aircraft shape with complex free-form surface is proposed. Finally, the comparison between the traditional method and the new approach is made, and the feasibility of the new design approach is discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic identifying and tracking framework for cutters using RFID technology in digital workshop
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For effectively solving the problem of accurate tracking and control of cutters in digital workshop, this paper presents a novel RFID-based dynamic identifying and tracking framework for cutters in digital workshop (RFID-DITF-CDW). An overall architecture for RFID-DITF-CDW is established and its key enabling technologies including RFID-based realtime information collecting, dynamic misuse detecting of cutter change on CNC machines, real-time position identifying, status tracking, and service life forecasting for cutters are discussed. Finally, a prototype system of RFID-DITF-CDW is developed and applied in a real typical CNC machining workshop to demonstrate the validity of presented framework and enabling technologies.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of leaf-spring robot control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Leaf-spring manipulator is a kind of equipment used to handling and leaf the spring. In order to make the leaf-spring manipulator realize the fast movement, accurate positioning, greatly improve the production efficiency and reduce the labor intensity of the workers, the system adopts PLC centralized control mode and modularization program design, develops control system and control procedures, equipped with high-performance servomotor system and adopts high accuracy, good linear and induction sensitive sensors.

articleTitle: Analysis on relationships among variables about traffic capacity at intersections and reformation measures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The project in this essay uses methods of field investigation and statistics science to research traffic conditions at intersections. Analysing survey data, we have established a systematic mathematical model which illustrates relationships among variables about traffic capacity at intersections including bicycle traffic demand, occupied motor lane width by bicycles, bicycle traffic capacity and decrease of motor traffic capacity. The finding of the research can be used for intersection reformation to decline losses caused by interference between bicycles and motor vehicles, leading to significant improvement in traffic conditions at intersections.

Author Keywords: occupied motor lane width at intersections

articleTitle: Hydrothermal synthesis and optical properties of ZnO particles
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Through hydrothermal process, different morphology ZnO particles are prepared with zinc acetate dehydrate and ammonia used as main resources. The microstructure, morphology and photoluminescence properties of the as-prepared products are characterized by x-ray diffractometer, scanning electron microscope and photoluminescence spectrum, respectively. The results indicate that the as-prepared products are ZnO single crystalline with hexagonal wurtzite structure. The morphology change from rod-like to flower-like and PL intensity enhances when the growth temperature is increased from 120°C to 200°C. CTAB greatly improves the crystalline of ZnO crystals.

articleTitle: Scene simulation of navigation simulator based on Creator and Vega
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the study of composition and characteristics of navigation simulator visual system, this essay considered simulation development process that based on Creator and Vega. The key technology of scene simulation has been introduced; the model construction and real-time optimization have been realized, and marine meteorological and special effects are established, finally the program flowing was showed. The results of simulation experiment shows that the simulated effect of navigation simulator that based on Creator and Vega are not only realistic, but can substantially reduce source code compiling, and develop with higher efficiency.

articleTitle: A robust system of face detection and precise face organ location
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Human face detection and face organ feature location are both important steps in automatic visual interpretation and human face recognition systems. In this paper, a robust system which focuses on human face detection and face organ location is introduced. We improve the cascade-structured classifier of the human face detector, and integrate human face super-resolution algorithm into our system to help processing low-resolution faces. Template matching, feature space analysis method (PCA) combined with AdaBoost algorithm are used to get the precise location of eye feature, and the locations of other face organs are incorporated in the similar framework. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system has good performance on actual images.

articleTitle: Grey relation analysis on fuzzy fault tree of disk brake
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The fault states are fuzzy and the relationship between the primary and the secondary factor leading to the fault is uncertain in the course of the reliability analysis of disk brake. To solve these problems, the fuzzy grey relation analysis is used to improve the traditional method, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA). The triangle fuzzy number is used to represent the fuzzy probability of basic event. The fuzzy importance of basic event is calculated by adopting barycenter algorithm. The grey relation degrees between the top event and minimal cut sets are computed after getting incidence coefficients between them. This method is adopted to analyze the fault, inadequate braking moment, of hydraulic disk brake. The order of possibilities that the fault modes represented by minimal cut sets lead to the top event occurrence is determined by comparing grey relation degrees. The results can provide theoretical bases for finding out weaknesses, preventing faults, improving reliability and safety of the system.

articleTitle: Simulation of soil moisture content and its application of peanut field in low hilly area in southern China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to study the soil moisture of peanut fields in the region of low hilly area and to develop water-saving agriculture along gentle slope upland in southern China, the numerical modeling of soil moisture content was established, based on Richard movement equitation. The simulated soil moisture was in good agreement with measured data. Modeling analysis showed that the soil hydraulic parameters are more sensitive than other kind of parameters. The simulation also demonstrated that the cumulative evapotranspiration in the 150 cm soil profile at upper slope is higher than lower slope. In conclusion, it' s advantageous for tillage soil at the lower slope to keep soil moisture and resist the drought in the peanut field during dry season in southern China. The numerical modeling of soil moisture has practical significance to improve the management of water capture and retention and development of water-saving agriculture.

articleTitle: A target recognition matching method with high reliability
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Grayness correlation is a method with high reliability for target recognition. However, there is a lack of reliable guidelines for matching results. Basing on normalized correlation, this thesis uses the SURF (Speed up Robust Features) algorithm of local features of an image to verify matching results. By fully utilizing the global and local information of the image, this method ensures the reliability of the matching results. Emulation tests how that this method is hardly interfered by outside factors and can greatly save time by using parallel calculations. With a high accuracy of matching results, it is applicable for targets recognition.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of temperature field on capillary rheometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming to the features of capillary rheometer's barrel, mathematical model of the barrel is established by heat transfer theory and finite element principle. Based on the mathematical model, finite element model was built by ANSYS, and then temperature field in the barrel is calculated and analyzed. The analysis results indicate that the temperature field has more even by adopting three areas heat, and this improves the measurement accuracy of rheological properties of material.

articleTitle: Ponderomotive force of a electromechanical coupling system and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the electromechanical coupling system energy conservation equation, the ponderomotive force expression of a discrete electromechanical coupling system with approximation and quasi-stable is obtained. It is applied to RLC series circuit and micro-beam coupled system. Using Newton's law and Lagrange equation, the equations of motion of RLC series circuit and micro-beam coupled system are obtained respectively. The intrinsic link between two establishing model methods is given through the ponderomotive force.

articleTitle: Research on standardization of vehicle terminals communication protocols in intelligent public traffic system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is necessary to develop the relevant communication protocol standards to support the construction of intelligent public traffic system. This article first analyzes the status of communication standardization of intelligent public traffic system. Further it introduces the constitution of communication protocol system of intelligent public traffic system. It proposes communication protocol layered model and the protocol constitution content of vehicle terminals in intelligent public traffic system. The design of protocol layered model reference the ISO/OSI model, and provides the special short-range communication standards of DSRC. In the premise of meeting the current application in the field of our intelligent public traffic and considering the future development, design and determines the important index and parameters of the standard. Further it proposes system integration content based on vehicle terminals standardization of communication protocol. The standardization of communication protocol proposed by the article was applied in practice in the relevant engineering and achieved good results.

articleTitle: A neighborhood parameter optimization method of LLE based on topology preservation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Locally linear embedding(LLE) is a typical manifold learning algorithms. Aim to the difficulty of selecting neighborhood parameter on the algorithm, a neighborhood parameter optimization method based on topology preservation is developed in the paper. From the point of the dimension reduction mapping quality, the error function of topology preservation is constructed to keep mapping quality. The optimization of the neighborhood is obtained according to the minimum of the error function. The experimental results on IRIS validate the optimization of the neighborhood and the effectiveness of feature distribution.

articleTitle: Study on human-simulated intelligence elevator controller — Based on SCM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article take the elevator controller for research object and investigate the elevator control system based on taking the SCM as the core of the elevator controller. The control function of elevator is divided into several modules and different controller complete particular functions of each part. The author analyzes PID controller characteristics, the performance analysis of the human-simulated intelligent PID control algorithm and introduces the designing method of hardware in elevator control system. This is suitable for practical elevator research and satisfies requirements of the stability and safety in elevator control.

articleTitle: Analysis of parametric vibration of cylindrical shells considering material viscous damping
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to investigate the effect of winding angle of fiberglass on the parametric vibration of cylindrical anisotropic shells considering viscosity, the Mathieu Equation is derived from dynamic equilibrium equations while some assumption are taken. Using method of small parameter, the first unstable region of the Mathieu Equation is determined. The effect of winding angle of fiberglass on the material damping is also investigated. The results suggest that with increasing damping, the un-stable region increases. But damping can not prevent response from increasing infinitely in the un-stable region.

articleTitle: Study statistical properties of Raman Cross-talk with walkoff in fiber communication systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new model of Stimulated Raman Scattering (SRS) with workoff is presented. It is applicable in the cases of random binary modulation input power, arbitrary channel number and dispersion coefficient and arbitrary transmission distance. By the model, SRS degradation in the pulse walkoff regime and statistical properties of Raman Crosstalk for a two-channel system are studied. The probability density function (pdf) of output power in the presence of SRS and walkoff approximates to Gaussian distribution. The formulae of mean and standard deviation of output power are derived for the system. The results from the formulae are in good agreement with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and analysis of pneumatic drying on straw fuel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the mechanism of mass and heat transfer and interaction of the particles and air in drying tube, the mathematic model of Pneumatic drying process in a straight horizontal tube was established. According to the characteristics of the model, the equations were solved by Runge-Kutta integration method. Then, by the analysis of the factors influencing the drying of the straw fuel in the process, the most important one summed up in Pneumatic drying was the mass flux of hot air. This correctness of the model and factorial analysis has been proved by experiments. The analysis of the Pneumatic drying process in the method of orthogonal experiment led to the conclusion that the primary role in the process is the mass flux of hot air and then its temperature and the diameter of the drying tube.

articleTitle: Design of carving machine controller based on MCX314
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the character of carving machine motion control the motion controller with 3-axis Simultaneous-motioned is achieved. MCX314 is selected as motor driving chip of numerical control device, and ARM7 as central processing unit of controller. The working principle of hardware circuit with CPU of AT91FR40162 and its constitute are introduced. The motion control process based on special-purpose chip is analyzed. The structure of controller software is provided. The methods of typical motion control programming are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis & rearch on the design of automation system for finite element process based on HyperWorks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on HyperWorks Process Manager, Process Studio, the automation system structure for finite element process and developing process solution are given by using Tcl/TK technology, about some kind of product, finite element process developed the automation sysytem, it is provided a quick method for product design and annalysis. Finally, it is tested the the system's utility and convenience through the CAE analysis of automotive half-axle.

articleTitle: The realization of learning of perceptual model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to simulate behavior of human perception more realistic, this paper proposes the framework of perceptual model, improves the model of the perception sensor and processor, realizes of the perceptual model of learning, increases the reality and credibility of the model.

articleTitle: Electronic system design of ultraviolet ozone vertical profile probe for aerography satellite
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The design of ultraviolet ozone vertical profile probe is illustrated and the electronic system is introduced in detail. The device is a compact, high precision, ultraviolet-vacuum, ultraviolet spectral radiometer, and is used to measure atmospheric solar backscattering spectral radiance and solar spectral irradiance. Noise of the system is analyzed and Numeric accumulation and synchronous demodulation was used to decrease the noise and the zero-drift of the instrument. The solar irradiance at altitude 830 km in 160-400 nm and the backscattering solar spectral radiance in the ultraviolet ozone absorption band at 12 wavelengths from 250 nm to 340 nm are obtained. Test results on orbit show that all the requested function is met successfully and the performance is stable.

articleTitle: The design of a pot light tracking system based on MSP430
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper introduces a kind of a pot light tracking system based on MSP430. Two design schemes is firstly put forward, and then be compared with each other. Finally the design mechod of hardware and program are presented, experiments have proved that the design of the light from the tracking system have strong adaptability for response quickly with excellent flexibility.

articleTitle: A resource integration platform for manufacturing grid based on SOOA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Most of the manufacturing grid systems are built on Web services technology. Basically speaking, they lack of the ability to handle the dynamic nature of network and manufacturing resources due to the static nature of service protocol-oriented architecture (SPOA) which Web services are built on. Recently, service object-oriented architecture (SOOA) which is suitable for constructing reliable distributed systems on the unstable Internet evolves rapidly from SPOA. In this paper, a resource integration platform for manufacturing grid (RIP-MG) is designed and implemented based on SOOA. In RIP-MG, an open template model (OTM) for encapsulating manufacturing resources is proposed, by which various manufacturing resources can be encapsulated as grid services conveniently without the need of programming, and the services can be deployed and managed locally by RIP-MG in remote service hosts. RIP-MG has been applied successfully in a collaborative design platform of manufacturing grid.

articleTitle: Study on application of 3D laser scanning technology in estimation of the standing tree parameter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper will first review current laser scanner systems from a technological point of view and discuss different scanner technologies and system parameters regarding their suitability for forestry applications. In the second part of the paper, results of a pilot study on the applicability of terrestrial laser scanners in forest inventory tasks will be presented. The study concentrates on the automatic detection of standing trees and the subsequent determination of tree height and diameter at breast height. Reliability and precision of techniques for automatic point cloud processing were analysed based on scans of a test region in Harbin Experimental Forest Farm. In the pilot study, which represents an early stage of software development, more than 95% of the trees in a test region could be detected correctly. Tree heights could be determined with a precision of 80 cm, and breast height diameters could be determined with a precision of less than 1.2cm.

articleTitle: Electronic transport and photovoltaic properties of La0.4Ca0.6MnO3/Si heterojunction at high temperature
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We have investigated the electronic transport and photovoltaic properties of the La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/Si heterojunction as the temperature grows from 300 to 673 K. The rectifying behavior and the junction differential resistance change with increasing temperature, which can be explained by considering the energy-band structure evolvement at different temperatures, and thus give rise to a change of photovoltaic properties with increasing temperature. This understanding of the temperature related current-voltage behavior of oxide heterostructures above room temperature should open a route for devising future microelectronic devices working at high temperature.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of hydro-viscous winch starting performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Hydro-viscous winch is designed as a novel hoisting equipment based on original inclined mine hoisting winch and it overcomes the original winch shortcomings of low degree of automation. In order to research the starting performance of the winch, a simulation model was established in AMESim and the simulation results under the two start-up conditions, load on horizontal and load on slope, were analyzed. The results showed that the demand value of the input voltage is small if the hydro-viscous winch startup in the first condition; the practical output torque of the hydro-viscous brake initially changed following its response curve, but it had a sudden decrease at some time; it required a greater input voltage value if the winch startup in the second condition and the higher input voltage value may cause intense vibration for the system. The results of the simulation suggest that the start-up conditions greatly impact the winch starting performance. Therefore, the start-up conditions must be considerd during making the control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on CMOS operational transductance amplifiers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The survey describes CMOS circuit design techniques for several fundamental operational transductance amplifiers (OTAs). The OTAs based on the fully differential structure (FD), cross-coupled differential structure with floating voltage adjustment (CCD), and fully differential complementary structure (FDC) are mentioned. A brief analysis on these OTA implementations is offered by explaining the ways to enhance linearity. The OTAs' performances such as power consumption, transconductance value, and dynamic range are compared. A summary to illustrate the promising results that can be achieved and exceeded when designing OTAs is presented.

articleTitle: Research on mistake proofing technology for airbag flexible assembly line based on barcode and database
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As an automobile product, the reliability and accuracy of the assembly process must be ensured. In order to achieve the minimum errors in the assembly process, a new assembly control approach which combines the technology of station computer, barcode scanner and specialized assembly and detection components was proposed. Based on the existing theories of mistake proofing, the article will briefly introduce the work flow of designing and implementing a new mistake proofing algorithm. The algorithm is implemented in the environment of SQL database and Visual Basic 6.0. Furthermore, as the real applications demonstrate, due to the processing mechanism of client-server model, the system enjoys the advantages of complete mistake proofing and fast reaction, which makes it suitable to be applied in the flexible manual or automatic assembly lines that have huge variety of products and requires a lot in the quality monitoring.

articleTitle: The research on prediction model of HEV Ni-MH battery capacity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The study on discharge process is base on the principle of electrochemical analysis of Ni-MH battery. Based on mass transfer, combined with Ni-MH battery manufacturing process, measurement parameters, the model of Ni-MH battery discharge is constructed. Complete the correspondence between potential, current and time. While establish a state of lower Ni-MH battery discharge voltage versus time curve. Make time as the meeting point to meet the discharge rate and changes to adjust the voltage versus time curve. So as to calculate the AH capacity and forecast remaining capacity.

articleTitle: Maximum entropy image segmentationis based on improved QPSO algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Image segmentation techniques have great significance in image analysis and recognition, maximum entropy algorithm also has very wide range of applications in image segmentation. In this paper, it is analyzed with the traditional maximum entropy thresholding algorithm, and combined with quantum behavior of particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm, and a new image segmentation algorithm was proposed. This method is the use of maximum entropy image segmentations based on improved (QPSO) algorithm do global search, and make the maximum entropy to be the threshold to for image segmentation. The simulation results show that this method is easy to implement, fast convergence, and have good segmentation.

Author Keywords: quantum behavior of particle swarm optimization (QPSO)

articleTitle: A stochastic model checking method for the usability of clusters about distributed rendering system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to study the usability of rendering clusters, Continuous Time Markov Chains model is used in this paper. By introducing the probabilistic model checker-PRISM, formalize the whole rending cluster system, and through a series of properties about the system, to analyze and verify the usability of the system. We verify the probability of the system's usability under different situations, one-node cluster, two-node cluster and with it in different situations, talk about the usability in different situations, through comparisons, we get that our method is very correct and positive.

articleTitle: The research of the accuracy with gear measuring center based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aimed at gearing measurement center as the research object. In this paper, based on the finite element method and dynamics theory, researched the whole modeling and dynamics analysis technology of gearing measurement center, calculated the vibration frequency of system and the elastic deformation of overall mechanical structure under the comprehensive function of gravity and measurement movement. Analyzed the influence law of measurement precision, which is important to actual work.

articleTitle: Integration benefit allocation solution for reverse supply chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We firstly use Stackelberg game theory to study the reverse supply chain consisting of one manufacturer and two retailers, the income of the whole supply chain were studied in both cooperative and no cooperative situation. We use one kind of integration benefit allocation method to resolve the variance caused by different allocation methods. This method use the positive ideal value to set weight of different allocation program, so it can compromises the different results of traditional benefit allocation method into a reasonable one.

articleTitle: Non-linear compensation algorithm of LOS locating in aerial remote sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A non-linear light-of-sight(LOS) locating compensation algorithm for certain aerial remote sensor is presented in this paper. The LOS locating system is composed of two main components, which are an inertial reference frame to provide coarse LOS locating and a 2-axis Fast Steering Mirror to remove the frame's residual error. The azimuth and elevation of LOS are both affected by the FSM two-degree-of-freedom rotation, which should be dealt with to raise the accuracy of LOS location. This paper extrapolates LOS locating algorithm of FSM by coordinate transformation, and gives corresponding deviation analysis for different LOS poiting angles. It is found that the angle deviation grows rapidly with range of FSM's travel enlarging, so the deviation must be eliminated. Through the data analysis for deviation, a non-linear compensation algorithm is proved effective to reduce the error of LOS significantly. Taking LOS changing in [-3 deg, 3 deg] as an example, two analytic expressions are given, and the LOS locating accuracy rises by 34 times compared with non-linear compensation unused, and the cross coupling of LOS loating is 0.08%.

articleTitle: Research on energy saving for shift-beam oil pump motors based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the principle and method on energy saving fuzzy control for shift-beam oil pump motors are put forward. Based on studying the energy saving mechanism of the shift-beam oil pump motors, the energy saving fuzzy controller suitable for shift-beam oil pump motors is designed. The energy saving fuzzy controller can track the load of the shift-beam oil pump motors in real-time while simultaneously taking the least stator current of the motors as the control target to adjust the stator voltage of the motors according to the fuzzy control rules, which can increase the working efficiency of the motors, so the energy saving running of motors is realized. A hardware system of energy saving fuzzy controller for shift-beam oil pump motors with DSP is designed. And a two dimensional fuzzy control algorithm in which the stator current of motors and its changing as input variables and the stator voltage of the motors as output variable is presented. The simulation test of this energy saving fuzzy controller has been done in laboratory, the test result shows that the energy saving effect is notable, and it is valuable for popularizing.

articleTitle: The design of sound simulating systemin vehicle driving training simulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The sound simulating system which is mainly made up of MCU 89C51, ISD4002 and digital regulation-resistance is designed. The main function of the system is playing the sound and controlling the volume of the sound. Moreover, the anti-jamming measures are taken in order to improve the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Predicting residual stress characteristics based on BP artificial neural network in precision hard turning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The prediction models of residual stress on surface are built using BP artificial neural network in precision hard turning, which defines tool parameters and cutting parameters as input values, and the values of residual stress characteristics as output, and the models are verified by experiment. Finally, MATLAB is used to develop prediction system of the residual stress in precision hard turning with PCBN tools. The system has realized higher-accuracy prediction of surface integrity in precision hard turning.

articleTitle: Model updating applied to an missile structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The finite element (FE) model updating is an important method to accurate FE modeling for dynamic analysis of practical engineering structure. In this paper, a model updating method programmed by DMAP which is the secondary development language of the MSC. Nastran, realized the seamless connection of the updating method and the FE analysis software, and applied to a missile cabin structure based on the test data, for getting an accurate FE model. The results shows that the updated FE model is improved considerably, the analytical nature frequency is very close to the test value, and frequency response is also improved, which satisfies the engineering practical demand.

articleTitle: Entry trajectory generation based on neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A methodology for onboard generation of entry trajectory subject to all common inequality and equality constraints is developed, which makes use of the neural network as a major approach to design a complete and feasible entry trajectory instantaneously. Conventional constrained nonlinear trajectory optimization problems and control parameters generation online can be transformed into the neural network off-line training problem, given the entry initial conditions, values of constraint parameters, and final conditions. Differing with the general neural network, this approach is trained by the principles of optimal theory. The inputs of the neural network are the time-variant state variables, the outputs are the near optimal control parameters. Numerical simulations with a reusable launch vehicle model for various entry conditions are presented to demonstrate the capability and effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Design of a system for recognizing user's relationship based on GIS and mobile phone
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing usages of geographical information system and mobile phone, it is possible for us to achieve more information from the behaviors of these. We can dig up more information through GIS, mobile phones users' communicated information and classification algorithms. Based on the analysis of advantages and shortcoming of current technologies, we designed a system for recognizing the mobile phones users' relationship based on geographical information system in this paper. A* Path finding algorithm and Bayesian estimation can help us to identify mobile phone users' profession and relationship. The system can be used for mobile phone users' profession's data statistics and military survey. It can also be widely used in modern society, and the consumers will be offered ideal service and the operator can get more potential commercial value.

articleTitle: Preparation and properties of magnetic scensitive hydrogel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Magnetic sensitive hydrogel has been fabricated using physical cross-linking method. polyvinly-alcohol was selected as binder and the content was 15%, magnetic powers choosed iron oxide black and iron oxide red, The mechanical properties and swelling characteristics have been studied for different content, magnetic sensibility were tested using the vibration sample magnetometer, experiments results show that iron oxide red hydrogel has better mechanical properties, swelling percentage and loss rate of water of the polyvinly-alcohol hydrogel decrease with the increasing of the magnetic particles content, the change tendency is very like, cross-linking is increased with performance the swelling performance decreasing; PVA / Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> has good response from the SEM photo; its magnetic properties is better.

articleTitle: Comparison between two nonlinear sea-aero target detection methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is very significant to detect sea-aero targets from optic-electro images for military applications. In our previous work, two practical nonlinear artificial object detection approaches have been presented, which are cellular automata-based method and fractal image coding-based method. In this paper, we do some comparison of the two methods, and analyze their merits and defects. Experiment results show that cellular automata-based method is more stable and accurate than fractal image coding-based method, but the latter has stronger noise resisting ability and is faster than the former. Our work will be of benefit to the developing of novel artificial target detecting methods.

articleTitle: GALBF: Geodesic-Aided LBF method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new active contour model that can be used to segment images with intensity inhomogeneities. The proposed method integrates geodesic curves with LBF method. We refer to this as the Geodesic-Aided LBF method. Moreover, a novel method based on local information for variational level set is added to the level set regularization term in the energy functional. It can not only ensure accurate computation, but also avoid expensive re-initialization of the level set function. Experiments on synthetic and real images demonstrate the advantages of the proposed model over the C-V model and the LBF model in terms of efficiency.

articleTitle: A variable polarity power supply based on 80C196KC control technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Designed a kind of two-stage inverter welding power of variable polarity, main circuit used the phase-shift full-bridge soft-switching technology and push-pull inverter circuits. CPU 80C196KC control system as the core component and PI control achieve a inverter closed-loop constant-current control; By setting parameters such as output frequency, positive and negative to implement second inverter waveform control. Experimental results show that the power design is reasonable and output waveform controllable, it can completely meet the technological requirements of aluminium alloy TIG welding.

articleTitle: The fault diagnosis of aerodynamical and structural performance for icing wing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To solve the performance changing problem of icing wing of one aircraft, a test method of aerodynamic characteristics and structural characteristics based on flow field and structure field coupled analysis is proposed. The method is used to discretely analyze time-averaged N-S equation of two-dimensional steady incompressible viscous flow by finite element method, and solve droplet trajectory equation by 4-order ronggo-kuta method to determine the degree of pollution.
