In addition, temperature sensing ability of metalized encapsulation of the QFBG sensor can be improved to 24.4 pm/°C, which is 2.3 times as much as that of the QFBG sensor used adhesive encapsulation. Metalized encapsulation not only improves sensing characteristics of the QFBG sensor, and greatly expands its application scope.

articleTitle: Application of color transferring base on Reinhard algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Transferring color between images is a method that borrows one image's color characteristics from another. The classic algorithm of color transferring named Reinhard was analyzed, and some methods which set different parameters to determine the linear transformation between two images were proposed. These new methods can generate different styles of painting of images. The experiments show that the proposed methods can generate convincing results with better performance. Transferring color applies to two images which are of strong similarity, it is worth further exploration on the art style of images.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of a medical image 3-D measurement technique based on VTK
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: VTK(The Visualization Toolkits) is an object-oriented designed, powerful toolkit for the Visualization of graph and image data. For the requirement and characteristic of medical image processing, the article introduces the application of 3D measurement technique in the field of medical images. In parallelism cast shadow, the 2D coordinates that users select are converted into 3D's, and by help of "picking points" approach, the characteristic points are picked. Combining with the method, we carry it on the patient's face of skull, the results are satisfying.

articleTitle: Research on grinding spindle frequency distributed control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper described the structure and cooling issues of grinding high speed motorized spindle. The equipment run rated speed through the PLC frequency. According to the basic functions of distributed control system, the corresponding software is developed.

articleTitle: A new detection circuit design based on DDC264
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the research on new x-ray detection system, the design and development of a detection circuit based on DDC264 for x-ray detection are described in this paper. This new design combines both current-to-voltage and A/D conversion, so low-level current produced by photodiodes can be directly digitized. The main features of this new circuit include: current-to-voltage and A/D conversion finished in one single-chip, which will reduce the space of detection circuit; signal digital conversion is realized at the front-end of detection system, avoiding the long distance analog transmission of signal; making use of CPLD on detection board can realize the time sequence control for DDC chip, which will make detection circuit intelligent. The module design of circuit is able to match existing interface, besides it is easy to transplant the circuit to aerospace, aviation, casting, security inspection, medical and other fields.

articleTitle: IT talent demand forecast and research in Dongguan based on Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the arrangement of industrial structure in Dongguan City, the swift and violent development of high and new technology industries and its boost of transformation and upgrading, the quantity demand in IT talents has rised. In the basis of completion of investigating IT talent demand in this city, it has been carried on such matching and forecasting in it by using GM (1, 1) Pattern of Grey System Theory, according to the historical data of IT talent demand in Dongguan these years. And furthermore, countermeasures for talent cultivation have been picked up pointed to the demand of social development. Therefore, to catering to the new innovated situation in Dongguan, it supplies reference basis on exploration of cultivation models for advanced computing specialized talents, who are in the diploma program utility type and skilled type.

articleTitle: The influence of ozone on the property of envelop materials of near space vehicle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The ozone aging of PE-EVOH (ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer) films, which is a kind of envelop material of near space vehicle, is studied in the paper. The ozone aging test of PE-EVOH films was performed in an ozone aging environmental apparatus with 600pphm ozone concentration. The mechanical property variation of the PE-EVOH film after ozone aging was investigated by mechanical tensile test and the results show that tensile strength of the PE-EVOH films decreases as the ozone aging time increases. The aging mechanism of the PE-EVOH film was analyzed using FTIR spectra analysis and atomic force microscopy (AFM) images. The results reveal that mechanical and physical reactions were occurred between the PE-EVOH film and ozone, which leads to the decline of mechanical property of the PE-EVOH film.

articleTitle: Design and development of rolling bearing vibration signal analysis system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Taking the respective advantages of LabView and Matlab, an on-line vibration signal analysis system of rolling bearing was designed and developed. First, system scheme design was introduced. Then each module of the system was discussed. Finally, system application examples were given, which verified the convenience and effectiveness of this system.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy control in temperature control systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The article introduces in brief that with improvement of system's complexity, the traditional control gradually can't satisfy the requirement of control in the temperature control system. The requirement of control can be completed by application of fuzzy control and the prospect of fuzzy control in systems also brought up.

articleTitle: A fast spectral cluster algorithm based on bipartite graph
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Recently, spectral clustering has been applied successfully in a variety of different areas. While choosing the similarity graph and its parameters for spectral clustering is not a trivial task and its computational complexity is rather high. In this paper we proposed a fast bipartite graph spectral algorithm which uses evidence accumulation method and algebraic transformation method to avoid the above shortcoming. Experiments on real-world document sets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and wavefront sensing for the segmented spherical primary optical telescope
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On account of the tight requirement of the high-resolution, the Segmented Primary Optical Telescope (SPOT) becomes the mainstream. Obviously, the use of a strongly aspheric form creates several intractable problems in manufacturing and subsequent optical testing of aspheric off-axis segments having different forms, the task of controlling a large number of aspheric segments for on-orbit cophasing is formidable, so the prospect of assembling the primary mirror from small, low-cost identical spherical mirror segments is very attractive. This paper will discourse upon the demand of the SPOT and analyze the advantages of segmented spherical primary mirror relative to aspheric. Besides these, the author will design an optical systems under the properties (D=1200mm, MTF ≥ 0.6), the optical designs use a full steerable, quasi-Cassegrain telescope in which the primary mirror uses spherical surface, then we will demonstrate its performance and prove the practicality of Spherical Primary Optical Telescope. Ultimately, we will introduce a multistage wavefront sensing and control strategy briefly for Diffraction-limited phasing.

articleTitle: Design and realizing of the lightweight cable digital television data analysis system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to get useful information from mass data of cable digital television to support TV station's decision analysis, we present a lightweight cable digital television data analysis system. The system is based on the partition technology of SQL Server 2005 Database, and the data is collected by the set-top boxes of the digital TV. This paper elaborately discusses the architecture and the functional modules of the data analysis system, and emphasizes the storage management of the mass data and the optimization of the stored procedure. Through test, the system is proved to have a good performance on data processing and analysis, and it meets the need of the TV station.

articleTitle: Grinding engineering ceramics research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The cost of high hardness ceramic materials grinding limits its wide spread application, a basic understanding of the grinding mechanism is economic and efficient processing of ceramic technology base. This article outlines the grinding abrasive cutting ceramic workpiece material situation. Previously, research on the vast majority of ceramic grinding mechanism we use the “indentation fracture mechanics model” approximation or “cutting model” approximation. Indentation fracture mechanics model looks the ceramics of grinding and workpiece like an interaction phenomenon in the small indentation; typical machining cutting force similar to put the debris and the measurement and processing of the surface of the microscope together. These two models are similar to the grinding mechanism of ceramic material providing an important basis.

articleTitle: Traction and yaw-rate control of 4WD vehicle with drive force distribution
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper is concerned with traction and yaw-rate control strategy for 4WD vehicle by controlling drive and brake forces of all 4 wheels. A hierarchical controller, which consists of a main loop controller, drive force distribution algorithm and wheel slip controller, is conducted to improve the acceleration performance while ensuring the vehicle stability. Simulation of a cornering and accelerating on low μ case is carried out to verify the effect of the control algorithm. The simulation results indicate that handling stability and acceleration performance of the 4WD vehicle is improved by the proposed control strategy when the vehicle is cornering and accelerating on the slippery road.

articleTitle: High performance Complementary Pass transistor Logic full adder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Complementary Pass transistor Logic (CPL) is becoming increasingly important in the design of a specific class of digital integrated circuits which employ the XOR and MUX operations. In this paper, we have designed full adder circuits using CPL and CMOS logic respectively. We analyze their delay and power dissipation, and run the simulations of two full adder circuits. The theoretical analysis and simulations show that a worst-case delay and total power dissipation in the CPL design are better than the conventional CMOS logic design.

articleTitle: Fatigue life estimation of a light truck gearbox housing using multi-body dynamics and finite element method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Reliability is an important vehicle performance. It mainly depends on the fatigue life of the key auto parts. As the key component in transmission system of the truck, gearbox's efficiency and reliability are closely linked with the truck's power and safety. In the paper, by using multi-body dynamics and finite element method, the fatigue life of the gearbox housing with static method is presented.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo ballistic simulation applied to dispersion analysis of starting control points for Antitank Missile
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper provides an overview of the Antitank Missile Monte Carlo starting control points dispersion analysis conducted with the ballistic simulation. First, The disturbances that affect the flight of a missile are analyzed. Then a method of how to handle with the disturbances is presented to establish a ballistic simulation model with Monte carlo method, the steps of simulating the disturbances based on Matlab are also given. Taken account of the initial angular rates disturbance, rocket engine thrust misalignment, wind disturbance, the equation that described the dynamics of the missile mass center movement should be adjusted accordingly. In this paper, a common model is established to simulate the effect of disturbances. Results indicate that missile trajectory disturbances could be substantially reduced by lowering rocket engine thrust misalignment.

articleTitle: Simulation of automobile diesel engine under transient operating conditions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Diesel engines under transient operating conditions are much different from those under steady operating conditions. The paper based on the diesel CA6DL2-35E3 of FAW R&DC with turbocharger, intercooler, four-valve, six-cylinder and high pressure common rail, the diesel displacement is 8.6L. We had established model of the diesel with GT-power and simulated diesel engine working process under transient operating conditions which in constant speed while torque increased, and also analyzed the results. And we had analyzed transient response of burning boundary conditions and max burning pressure.

articleTitle: The influence of dynamic thermal characteristic of wall on air-conditioning load and thermal environment in building of different zoning for thermal design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at different kind of walls in five cities of different zoning for thermal design, using thermal instantaneous response factors method, the author compiles programs to calculation air conditioning cooling load temperature, thermal response factors, and periodic response factors. On the basis of the data, the author gives the net work analysis about the influence of dynamic thermal of wall on air-conditioning load and thermal environment in building of different zoning for thermal design regional, and put forward the strategy how to design thermal insulation and heat preservation wall base on dynamic thermal characteristic of wall under different zoning for thermal design regional. And then provide the theory basis and the technical references for the further study on the heat preservation with the insulation are in the service of energy saving wall design.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis and validation on aerodynamics of tunnels on high speed railways
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the increase of train speed, the issue of tunnel aerodynamics becomes more important. A simulation platform based on CFX is established to fulfill simulation calculation of tunnel aerodynamics for 300km/h high speed railways, with emphasis laid on studying the changing rules of compression wave and pressure transient on tunnel wall while the train enters tunnel as well as micro-pressure wave at tunnel portal with speed increase. The simulation results are then compared with actual measuring result. It is shown that the simulation result is basically consistent with laboratory measurement thus the finite element simulation could be applied in practice; amplitude of the initial compression wave will slightly decrease with the increase of tunnel length and the amplitude bandwidth will gradually increase. When the train speed is no more than 300km/h, the micro-pressure is basically proportional to cube of speed and when the train speed is more than 300km/h, the micro-pressure will see drastic increase and it is proportional to 6.5th power of speed.

articleTitle: First principle investigation of CrSi2 with doping V
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The geometrical structure and electronic structure of CrSi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with doping V were investigated by using first principle based on the plane wave pseudo-potential theory. The calculation of band structure result shows that the band gap decreased from 0.35eV (pure CrSi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) to 0.25eV (V doped). The valence band and conduction band near the Fermi energy is mainly composed of 3d state electron of Cr and 3p state electron of Si for pure CrSi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. After doping V atom, the Fermi energy moved into the valence band, the valence band and conduction band near the Fermi energy is mainly composed of 3d state electron of Cr and impurity atom V, the conductive type changed into p type, improve the electrical conductivity. It shows that doping plays a very important role to change conductivity of materials.

articleTitle: A rotor fault intelligence diagnosis system based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to get the rotor fault characteristic component in stator current, an advanced correlation algorithm is presented in this paper. Because of faster and multi-channel ADC subsystem, S3C2410 ARM is chosen as the core of stator current acquisition to meet the need of spectrum analysis. By programming on LabWindows/CVI — a virtual instrument development tool, the fault information can be separated from stator current signal. Then make the spectrum analysis to the residual signal, the broken bar fault can be diagnosed easily. The results of experiment indicate that a reliable and portable system can be realized to meet the purpose of testing and diagnosing the faults of induction motors in-situation, and method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Bias analysis on return signal simulator of radar altimeter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The radar altimeter prelaunch calibration was commonly carried our by return signal simulator. The principles of return signal simulator, biases such as quadratic phase bias, amplitude and phase biases, delay bias were described in detail in this paper. In the last section the overall system bias on return signal simulator was calculated.

articleTitle: Emission and combustion characteristics of different fuel in a HCCI engine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Different intake valve timings and fuel injection amount were tested in order to identify their effects on exhaust emissions and combustion characteristics using variable valve actuation (VVA) in a Homogeneous Charge Compression Ignition (HCCI) engine. HCCI engine is a promising concept for future automobile engines and stationary power plants. Two-stage ignition process in a HCCI engine creates advanced ignition and stratified combustion, this makes ignition timing and combustion rate controllable. Meanwhile, the periphery of fuel-rich zone leads to fierce burning, which results in slightly high NOx emissions. The experiments were conducted in a modified single cylinder water-cooled diesel engine. In this experiment we use diesel, bio-diesel (Jatropha) and gasoline as the fuel at different mixing ratios. HCCI has advantages in high thermal efficiency and low emissions and possibly become a promising combustion method in internal combustion engines.

articleTitle: Data base management system accounting software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the improvement of social democracy market economy and economic globalization, and the popularity of modern information technology and Network technology, computer-based accounting system in China has been popular rapidly. This not only makes accounting work have been changed greatly, but also improves accounting work efficiency and quality. On the other hand, there are still some problems have been existed in accounting software which block the deeper development of computer-based accounting in China. In this paper, we have mainly analyzed the generation, present situation and the existed problems, and we have proposed some solutions eventually.

articleTitle: Application PTS reduce PAPR OFDM system technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing is very suitable for high speed communication systems, but there are peaks higher than those problems. Partial Transmit Sequences OFDM because of its flexible and effective system to reduce peak-average power ratio has been studied extensively. Of previous research, the paper presents a search algorithm based on phase. Simulation results show that this method reduces the computational complexity of the system, and its performance has not been reduced compared to previous methods.

articleTitle: A new method for the analysis of temperature-dependent resistances and inductances of multiconductor cable
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The whole mechanical test procession, especially transmission cable is effected evidently by environment temperature fluctuation. So of particular interest in the paper is to discuss the resistance and inductance parameters of multiconductor at environment of changing temperature. A new approach with the given formulas is presented to calculate electric parameters using finite element method. And then, the temperature-dependent characteristics of resistance and inductance are obtained, which are agreed with the result obtained by energy method. The change of equivalent current density for multiconductor also highlights the parameters change when proximate effect is considered. The result is shown that the temperature-dependent parameters bring more important responses on the terminal of circuit network containing certain deviation. It is shown that. For the first time, results are shown for the lossy transmission cable with temperature-dependent parameters characteristic, which are used to quantify the main practical engineering.

articleTitle: Kinematic simulation of polishing head oscillating mechanism based on COSMOSMotion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To the phenomenon of vibration seriously in the process of grinding tiles with the polishing head, the study on the affection of oscillating mechanism was carried out in this paper. The 3-D model of the oscillating mechanism was built in SolidWorks. The motion characteristics of the mechanism was simulated and analysed in the COSMOSMotion based on the simplfied model of the 3-D model. The simulation results show that the motion law of the active oscillating rod is just opposite with the passive oscillating rod and the velocity curve of the active oscillating rod is not smooth at all with large fluctution at the maximum and minimum values. Optimization of the cam profile curve is needed to enhance the oscillating mechanism's kinematic accuracy and improve the properties of the polishing head.

articleTitle: Study of friction hot forming technology of hydraulic cylinder at both ends
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the absorbers, air springs and so on-in-one cylinder forming process, tooling technologies. Hydraulic cylinder can be sealed by itself if friction hot forming technology is adopted on hydraulic cylinder at both ends. By going through the technology, two sealing devices of hydraulic parts are saved, the leak of hydraulic parts is avoided, the rigidity of hydraulic parts is enhanced, the structure of hydraulic parts is optimized and the service life of hydraulic parts is increased.

articleTitle: Stiffness simulation analysis of rubber bush mountings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The finite element model of rubber bush mountings based on ANSYS is built up. And the value of the reduced radial stiffness is obtained directly by solving the model. The analysis of the experimental data, the theoretical calculation data and the simulation data indicates that the simulation model of the rubber bush which has been established is correct. Based on the simulation model, which has been parameterized, the radial stiffness characteristics of rubber bush are studied by analyzing the influence of the axial length and the Poisson's ratio on the reduced radial stiffness. It is shown that the influence of the axial length on the reduced radial stiffness of short rubber bush is great and the influence of the Poisson's ratio on the reduced radial stiffness of long rubber bush is great.

articleTitle: Access pricing model of telecommunication interconnection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is absent fair and reasonable access price that mainly restrict telecom interconnection of our country currently. Therefore, the key is to formulate a suitable model of access pricing. The text explains the reason of bargaining in interconnection through relative opportunities of profit and loss, establishes the model of marginal incremental revenue, analyzes how to determine reasonable access price from profits distribution and cost sharing.

articleTitle: Analysis of environmental effects of deep groundwater exploitation in east-central plains of Hebei province
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the data about deep groundwater dynamic and surface subsidence of the east-central plains, through the study on critical identification of the water-table causing environmental and geological issues such as water level dropped hopper, land subsidence and so on, find out the relationship between deep aquifer releasing water and land subsidence, predict changes of groundwater level and land subsidence, provide control measures and proposals for a series of environmental and geological effects. Providing the scientific basis for deep groundwater rational exploitation in East-central Plains of Hebei Province.

articleTitle: Reliability calculation based on sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The optimization method based the sensitivity analysis compute structural reliability is proposed. At first, we analyze sensitivity. The stress differentiates with respect to a random variable may obtain the sensitivity. According to the sensitivity analysis, designer should modify data. Second, optimization model is established. At last, optimization problem is solved to obtain safety index β. If multiple failure events occur, we also establish multiobjective optimization model and can solve it using multiobjective optimization method. An example validates the proposed method. Reliability calculation that does not analyze sensitivity is unreasonable.

articleTitle: FP-tree algorithm applied in logistics warehousing mining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As data mining is widely used in all walks of life, it also of great significance in the application of logistics management. Through the association rules mining, the reasonable storage location of commodities can be found. This paper mainly introduces using FP-tree algorithm to effectively mining logistics warehousing information. Combined with the case analysis, it's obvious to find the efficiency and scalability of the algorithm applied in logistics warehousing mining.

articleTitle: A low-power and high-gain mixer design for UWB receiver
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This letter presents a low power, low noise CMOS double-balanced direct conversion mixer for ultra-wideband systems. The mixer is a critical block to perform the frequency translation in ultra-wideband systems. The proposed mixer employs three techniques: the sub threshold operation of transistors for the radio frequency stage reduces current dissipation in the overall mixer, a local oscillation (LO) stage using an inverter lowers the required LO amplitude, and an active load improves conversion gain. The mixer was implemented using a 0.18 μm CMOS process and was operated from 3.1 to 5.7 GHz. The measured results show a high conversion gain up to 22.0 dB and a maximum noise figure of 8.0 dB. In addition and a power dissipation of 5.535 mW from a 1.8 V supply.

articleTitle: Brief analysis of how to solve data heterogeneity in the data interface of IPTV multi-services operation support system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the data heterogeneity of the data interface of IPTV multi-services operation support system, the paper analyzed the data exchange and inter system communication and determined to adopt the middle ware of the massage to solve data heterogeneity.

articleTitle: Simulation research on FLS_SVM in sensor fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The conception of fuzzy membership is introduced into the least square support vector machines (LS_SVMs), which overcomes the disadvantage that LS_SVMs are so sensitive to outliers in training samples and SVMs are time-consuming to solve quadratic programming problems. A sensor fault diagnosis system is designed by building the fuzzy least square vector machine (FLS_SVM) model. FLS_SVM is trained out of line, and used online. After being trained, FLS_SVM is used to simulate system dynamic characteristic. The simulation result is compared with actual output, and then fault error is drawn. Taking yaw angular rate sensor fault diagnosis for example has been simulated. The simulation result shows that, FLS_SVM can simulate the system more accurately, thus fault message of sensor is diagnosed in time. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An approach to scheduling of flexible manufacturing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: FMS (Flexible manufacturing system) scheduling is the center of its management owing to the dynamic nature of the system. Besides loading and discharging cutting tools and jig & fixture, the scheduling mainly deals with these optimal questions: how to choose parts; how to group parts; how to assign the system load; how to queue up the manufacturing procedures. With the mathematical model of machining parts having been established, discussions and solutions to these optimizations are presented in the paper based on grouping technology, computer science and other novel algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on micro-electric machine system and resonance beam style sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The micro-electric machine system is introduced, analyzed and researched in this paper. The relative introduction of the commercialization development process of the sensor is carried out too. The work principle of resonance beam style sensor and the superiority is discussed and deducted in detail in this paper. Through the theoretical analysis, we find that the work performance of resonance beam style sensor is more suitable than silicon piezoresistive sensor and the capacitive sensor in some aspects. At last, the temperature performance analysis of resonance beam style sensor is carried out by the means of finite element method. Through the analysis results, we find that the work performance of the resonance beam style sensor presents ideal tendency of linear variation under 240°C temperature. But, when the temperature is over the 240°C temperature, the work performance of the resonance beam style sensor presents obvious nonlinear variation characteristics. So, in the real work environment, the temperature of the resonance beam style sensor should be controlled fewer than 240°C.

articleTitle: Power distribution network reconfiguration based on fuzzy control theory and ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A versatile optimization solution combining ant colony algorithm (ACA) with fuzzy control theory (FC) was proposed for the reconfiguration problem of the distribution network in this paper. The algorithm adopted hybrid ants' behavior to produce diverse original paths, optimization of choice nodes set according to multiple constraints. At the same time, FC was added to ACA's every generation. By making use of FC's advantage of whole quick convergence, ACA's convergence speed was quickened. The feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by series of simulated results. The simulation results show that the method this paper proposed is feasible and can obtain satisfactory effect. The model of reactive power optimiz ation is established by taking the minimum network loss as the objective. Its validity is verified through arithmetic examples of 58 nodes and a practical area network.

articleTitle: Microwave frequency measurement using photonic methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Broadband, low loss and cost-effective transmission capability of optical fiber links has led to an burst of applications in every field. Instantaneous microwave frequency measurement is one of the many fields that are facilitated by the technology of optical communication. In this paper, some new optical techniques developed by the authors for microwave frequency measurement are reviewed. One is based on an optical phase modulator, one based on PM-IM (phase modulation to intensity modulation) conversion, and the last one was based on optical power monitoring using an FBG.

articleTitle: Study on output increase of cement mill by slightly accelerating revolving speed
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: There are multiple theoretically appropriate revolving speeds for grinding mill barrel of cement plant, but to choose which revolving speed is more reasonable shall be adjusted in accordance with various type of cement mill. The discussed object in this paper is a φ 1.83m × 6.4m cement mill. In the study, records are made for statistics on the course from the beginning of lessening feeding amount, and gradually increasing feeding amount to slightly exceed the output. The comparison was made between before the consumption and after the consumption by slightly accelerating the revolving speed and exceeding the output, and the profits were achieved to some extent, which proves the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Non-equant roll calender's structure design and analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of equant roll calender, we have designed non-equant isometric roll calender which applied in macromolecule material. This kind of calender can be realized by decreasing the diameter of one or two rolls properly. And a pair of non-equant roll calender can be constructed by means of one big roll and one small roll. During the process of design, we have built the corresponding mathematical model. And we have calculated the non-equant roll calender's key problems in accordance with this mathematical model. By comparing with traditional calender, non-equant roll calender has such advantages as high precision, low pressure load, low power consumption and rapid speed.

articleTitle: The design of the three-dimensional object movement simulation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Fuzzy-Proportional-Integral-Differential Controller (Fuzzy-PID) is used to design a three-dimensional movement simulation system for the simulation of the moving object. The system can move in three-dimension to simulate the object and can be controlled by manual mode or computer mode. The movement of each dimension of the system is driven by the rare earth magnetoelectric direct current servomotors, and servomotors of the system are controlled by the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) method.

articleTitle: Robust controller design for active suspension based on μ-synthesis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve stability, vibration isolation of a suspension system with parametric uncertainty for vehicle, a robust controller was designed for the system based on μ-synthesis approach. Dynamic model of an active suspension system with perturbation was analyzed. The simulation of the control system was conducted in the MATLAB/SIMULINK emulation. The result indicates that in the condition of parameter perturbation and surface irregularity disturbance, a robust μ controller made the active suspension system stable, and vibration isolation performance was improved obviously.

articleTitle: Optimization of powerplant mounting system and software development
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: 6 DOF (Degree of freedom) mechanics modal of powerplant mount system is established. Optimum design of powerplant system is made with uncoupling of energy, lateral and vertical vibration transmission rate. And based on this optimum design, software named EMUND is developed, which is used in a commercial car. The result indicates that rational set of mount parameters could greatly decrease vibration transmission from powerplant to the body in the automobile design.

articleTitle: An improved threshold cluster analysis algorithm for the energy consumption optimization of the aluminum industrial production
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The model for the energy consumption problem of the aluminum industrial production is established in this paper, and the energy consumption situation out of one ton of aluminum production is calculated. The threshold cluster analysis algorithm is a method of saving energy of the producing process. However, the choice of its distance threshold is somewhat random, so further work has been done to improve the algorithm's performance, that is calculating the distance threshold with a function of the maximum distance and the minimum distance between all of the energy consumption data. Through simulation experiments and comparative analysis, the fact that the improved algorithm performs better is shown. A better reasonable input can be found faster, and the energy saving of the aluminum industrial production is much more effective.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis on gas operated device's of internally-powered Gatling weapon
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Gas operated device structural parameter is an important factor to affect the firing rate fluctuation of the internally-powered Gatling weapon. In order to improve the movement stability of the automatic machine, Through analyzing internally-powered Gatling weapon's gas chamber structure, using gas dynamics theory, gas operated device's math model was erected. In the course of analyzing, it considered an structure effect of gas chamber's piston driving slide. This paper analyzed an effect of gas operated device's gas chamber pressure and core's and piston's rate to firing rate. This method is applicable to research the gas operated device's structural parameter design.

articleTitle: Ant algorithm in train enquiry system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Ant algorithm is a new heuristic algorithm which is applicable to solve complex combinatorial optimization problem. The idea of ant algorithm is introduced in this paper and the algorithm is applied to the train enquiry system. The enquiry results show that the shortest path can be found quickly, which illustrates the effectiveness of using the ant algorithm in train inquiry system.

articleTitle: Serial fingerprint device driver development based on EFI
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In Extensible Firmware Interface (EFI) environment, this paper describes the establishment of driver development environment, the configuration of EDK, the design of communication reliability, and the implementation of serial development protocol based on serial fingerprint device. This paper designs and implements the development of serial driver based on EFI platform, and provides guidance for the design of same serial device driver. It has a strong using value.

articleTitle: The technology of normalized digital orthogonal detection and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The method of normalized digital orthogonal detection is proposed according to the frequency of surface Magnetic Resonance Sounding (MRS) signal is much bigger than bandwidth and it has no influence on its key parameters. Constructing MRS signal with noise in accordance with its characteristics, then processing them using normalized digital orthogonal detection, the simulation results show that with the same SNR, the higher the sampling frequency, the bigger SNIR (signal noise improvement ratio). Embedding the normalized digital orthogonal detection unit in MRS instrument, and conducting laboratory test and field detection, the results show that this method is effective to extract the envelope of MRS signal, and SNR can be improved, too. At the same time, it simplifies hardware and improves the stability of orthogonal detection system.

articleTitle: The basic concepts and types of image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the development of computer technology, image processing is widely used. This paper mainly introduces the basic concepts and types of image and the format, display of Windows bitmap.

articleTitle: Low cost token maintains ring-like P2P network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of maintenance messages increased linearly with the number of neighbors in the ring-like P2P network and traditional token mechanism could not control the token number, we propose method of control speed token to maintain the ring-like P2P network. Token transmit in ring-link P2P network in the form of message, and node information could record in token in order to keep the structure of network for other nodes. P2P network use control speed parameter to reduce the number of tokens. Simulation shows that control speed parameter could effectively reduce the number of token in P2P network; with the increasing scale of the network, the average maintenance costs of node remain unchanged.

articleTitle: The research of the technology of controlling skin pass mill elongation rate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper was wrote based on the background of controlling mode of the skin pass mill elongation rate, and was wrote according to the analysis of different levels and thick incoming corresponding to the rolling force control, the connect energy of tension control and rolling force control. Then the paper put forward skin pass mill elongation strategy based on the tension fuzzy control of genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Embedded based radar image acquisition and compression
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A kind of convenient, low cost and portable marine radar image acquisition method which is based on embedded system is introduced. The system, which could automatically gather radar signal, is consist of CPLD, ARM microprocessor, ADC and amplifier. Radar echo video, heading position, bearing and trigger pulse signal are sent to the control unit through filter and acquisition circuit. For realizing remote transmission and storing, radar image is compressed based on wavelet processing method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of network-based embedded electricity management system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Using networking and embedded technology, electricity management system of ternary equipment and two-tier network, which is composed of host control computer, sale of electricity computer, locale control cabinet and power meter to form around campus network, RS-485 bus network, realized the intelligent administration of apartment with the security, economy.

articleTitle: Analysis on vibrating forming system considering slowly varying parameter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Establish symmetrical curve hysteretic forming system model containing slowly varying parameter, solve and analyze by adopting asymptotic method, and carry on experimental study by utilizing specially designed indoor small vibrating forming organization. Compare theoretical data with experimental data. The analysis indicates that in condition of relatively small forming model the influence of vibration mass of materials on the system is little; the system resonance curve may offset as change of material rigidity and damping parameter, and the vibrating frequency changes; changing vibrating amplitude and frequency of the vibration generator to further change exciting force may increase material forming efficiency.

articleTitle: Two improved sailing algorithms for the accurate track calculating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to eliminate the systemic errors in the traditional methods of track calculating, the symbolic formulae of meridian arc's forward and inverse solution are introduced, then Mercator sailing which could solve the problem of accurate track calculating is given. The calculation formula of Middle latitude is derived from its geometrical definition based on an elliptical earth, and then the precise middle latitude sailing method is available. Numerical examples show that the two methods derived by this paper could solve the problem of accurate track calculating under different reference ellipsoids in navigation.

articleTitle: Rubber paint feeling characteristic analysis and its application in product design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: “Think in raw material” is one of the principles of design. Material as design materialization form, can present design. Meanwhile, it also can provide new ideas, new visual experience and new psychological reaction. In this paper, the rubber paint's sensorial characteristic is expatiated, and the application of rubber paint's feeling characteristic is analyzed. We also summary the rubber paint's finishing effect and put forward the principle of usage. The rubber paint's alternative is also introduced briefly. The reasonable, innovative and artistical viewpoint on the feeling characteristic of molding material is meaningful to production's design and manufacture.

articleTitle: Phase rotation Maximum Transmit Diversity code
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of Maximum Transmit Diversity (MTD) code in block fading channel, phase rotation MTD code is proposed in this paper. Through phase rotation of the transmitted signals, the burst decoding error is changed into random error at the receiver, which can be corrected easily. So the system performance is enhanced. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design and application of video attemper system based on ip network in the intelligent transportation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the traffic actuality, a set of video attemper system based on IP network is designed. Capable of reliably transmitting the video, audio, record and other monitoring information, this system is described with respect to its structure and work flow. Some pivotal technologies involved in this system, such as the clipping method used to clip the input video data, the distributing strategy of the matrix, are analyzed in detail. At last, the typical applications of this system in the intelligent transportation system are analyzed. It has been proved that this system can meet the demands for the intelligent transportation system.

articleTitle: A quick target recognition technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Target recognition technology has been widely used in different areas around the world. Especially, target recognition technology developed for platforms such as satellite, unmanned reconnaissance plane, aircraft, etc. has been the focus of attention for various countries. Based on the features of image captured by reconnaissance aircraft, this thesis studies the image after-process methods and proposes a quick and effective target searching strategy.

articleTitle: A improved virtual circuit switching technology based on concurrent processing mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To improve the quality of switches for network service, as a new method of improved concurrent processing strategy, Half Step Forward Switching Technology (HSFST) is presented in this paper. By optimizing the processing of virtual circuit switching nodes and changing the phases of connect of the traditional virtual circuit switching technology, HSFST makes the received data frames directly switched to proper output ports without looking up for the information in switch table because the information are encapsulated in frames at the former switches. So the operation of looking up for the information about next hop and the other operation can be processed simultaneously. The experimental results show that this technique diminishes the switching delay and smoothes the delay jitter.

articleTitle: Study of point-based digital modeling platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Point primitives have experienced a major renaissance in recent years, and considerable research has been devoted to the aspects of efficient representation, modeling, processing, and rendering of point-sampled geometry respectively. However, the study of integrated platform based on point primitives is not as much as that of individual technologies on point primitives. The paper comes up with a point-based digital modeling platform after a brief overview of point-based computer graphics. This platform is designed according to the pipeline of point processing with various algorithms implanted as plugins.

articleTitle: Simulation of the electromagnetic waves transmission in plasma
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A plasma sheath is formed around the aircraft when it reentry into the atmosphere. The plasma sheath absorbs the electromagnetic waves and the communications between the aircraft and the ground are lost. According to this situation, the electromagnetic waves transmission in plasma is simulated and the varieties of the electromagnetic waves attenuation and transmittance along with the plasma densities, collision frequencies and electromagnetic waves frequencies are achieved in this paper.

articleTitle: Kinetic study of bacterial adhesion on biomaterials by using optical waveguide lightmode spectroscopy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The principles of bacterial identification are beginning to be understood at the kinetic level in the past few years, nevertheless, the crucial aspects to be taken into consideration are the spatial arrangements of molecules or atoms at the interacting surfaces and the profiles of the interfacial forces. In this study, the dynamics of attachment and detachment of E. coli K12 to ultra thin film biomaterials silica and zirconia surfaces with precisely coated by sol-gel method is measured by using optical waveguide lightmode spectroscopy (OWLS) are described.

articleTitle: The design of a symbol timing method in high-level modulation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A symbol timing method based on Gardner algorithm is designed in the paper. This method consists of interpolation filter, detection algorithm of Gardner timing error, loop filter and NCO etc, all part are analyzed and designed and the simulation result is given.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: New undergraduate college students common psychological problems and intervention strategies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An experimental project dedicated to pumping efficiency optimization by choosing specific cylindrical lens based on green optical-contact laser
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on analyzing the features of transverse modes of LD beam and experiment with quartz cylindrical lenses of different diameters, using certain cylindrical lenses to compress the ellipse shaped LD beam in the direction of the fast axis can result in the best pumping efficiency. The research findings can be applied to the practical production to manufacture highly efficient Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>/KTP optical-contact crystal lasers at a low cost.

articleTitle: Developed and test study on the subsoiler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the subsoiler in the developing process, based on analyzing foundation to the basic structure and operating principles of the subsoiler, the machine's 3D models and prototype have been finished. In order to validate the prototype's field adaptability and structure rationality, we carry out the field performance test and research. Test results show that various performance indexes are able to meet the design requirements, the machine has good field adaptability and reasonable dynamic matching. It provides theoretical basis for the further development and optimum design of the subsoiler.

articleTitle: Development and design of automatic log scale system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The log scale is the first process in timber trade and wood processing manufacture, and the efficiency and accuracy of log scale will directly affect the efficiency of wood production and trade fair. Real-time and online management of the information of log scale can reduce unnecessary links in the circulation of wood and improve the efficiency of timber trade. This paper proposed a novel approach of log scale based on computer vision technology and the Internet of Things technology and designed the corresponding system. Meanwhile, the overall design, working principle, work processes and function characteristics of the system are introduced at length.

articleTitle: Observation and analysis of micro pizza defects in organosilicon coatings of industrial manufacture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A transparent hard coating of Organosilicon (SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>) material can protect plastics and metals. This investigation on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> was to optimize a protective film for plastic lenses and covers of mobile phones to upscale the process to an industrial size. Hexamethyldisiloxane and oxygen has been used as precursor gas. The coating was deposited using plasma enhanced chemical vapour deposition (PECVD). Analysis of the coating by means of the optical microscope and atomic force microscope (AFM) shows that there are four kinds of micro pizza defects classed. Mechanism on defects of the organosilicon coating is discussed.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm of ontology mapping based on semantic Web
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the two existing problems in ontology matching algorithm based on semantic Web. It presents a new algorithm, which uses ontology matching based on virtual document to retrieval synset in the WordNet, and changes a single concept used by ontology searching into a concept set, so it can enlarge searching scope and obtain more background ontology. It uses dynamic ontology matching based on semantic environment to exclude wrong background ontology, so it can get more precision in ontology collecting. Experimental result shows precision and recall of matching improved effectively by using the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of the method of face image standardization based on projection and geometric transformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Standardization operation of face images is an important step in face recognition process. This thesis adopts the methods of face image standardization based on projection and geometry transform algorithm. Analyzes the vertical and horizontal projection algorithm, geometric transformation algorithm and are experimented on the ORL face library. The result proves that the algorithms of processing the face samples in this thesis have positive effect, much more pertinence and are suitable to standardized the face images.

articleTitle: Application of particle swarm optimization to the identification of thermal property parameters of porous media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An identification method of thermal property parameters of porous media by a new particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. This method improves the selection method of initial interval and fitness function, based on inheriting the global best particle, keep the diversity of population, let the calculation skip the local optimization, so that reach the goal of solving the parameters precisely. Measuring results indicate, inverse the thermal conductivity parameters and thermal diffusion coefficient of porous media like water and sand by this method and substitute the parameters into the model, the maximum relative differences of temperature are 4.83% and 2.19%. The results indicate, this method has good identification ability to thermal property parameters of porous media and it is a parameters identification method with good accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on power quality monitoring system of oil field based on ARM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the specific requirements of oil field power system parameter measurement, A monitoring system of power quality is designed based on ARM. The hardware design adopts ARM9 processor of SAMSUNG and TI's DSP processor, constructs double CPU architecture, and realizes data GPRS transmission through the SIM300 module. A regulatory center network monitoring software is designed using Borland C++ Builder 6.0 and client/server model, completing parameter display, storage and management with the Access database, and providing a friendly man-machine interface. The system can reduce the maintenance difficulty of oil field's electrical network and ensure the safety in oil field production.

articleTitle: Microstructure and magnetostrictive properties of as cast Fe83Ga17Tbx alloys
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">100−x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> (x = 15–21) Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> (x = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) alloys were prepared by non-consumable arc-melting method. The microstructure and magnetostrictive properties of Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">100−x</inf> Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> (x = 15–21) /Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> (x = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) as cast alloys was investigated at room temperature. The results indicated that the magnetostrictive properties for Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf> compared with Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf> (at%) alloy were obviously improved. Magnetostrictive coefficient could reach to 500×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> under an external magnetic field of 105.5kA·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for the Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf> as cast alloy. The enhancement of magnetostrictive coefficient in Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf> in high field was due to the [100] textured. Results of XRD and SEM show that terbium was not exist in A2 phase (matrix) of Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">83</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> alloys, but was enriched in grain boundary.

articleTitle: Soft sensor of vehicle state based on UKF and vehicle dynamics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A method of tire force state estimation is presented, which bases on Unscented Kalman Filter algorithm and a 7 degree of freedom vehicle dynamics model. Without available tire model, so it can still estimate the tire forces as well as vehicle longitudinal and lateral speed synchronously by this method. And a comparison with simulation result of CarSim is showed that the soft-sensing algorithm is effective. Therefore, it provides a new approach in the development of ESP and other advanced chassis electronic control system.

articleTitle: Study of leakage and stability in labyrinth seal using CFD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is used to model the seal and get a visualization of the pressure and velocity field. The relations between seal structure, inlet-outlet pressure and leakage can be found by a numerical simulation which can help us in the structural design of a seal and the selection of the inlet-outlet pressure. 2D labyrinth seal Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model is built which provides a basis for reducing steam flow excitation. The streamline pattern and the pressure drop characteristics for leakage of steam through a labyrinth seal was investigated. Simulation of internal flow and leakage characteristics has been performed by using CFD software and two-control volume model turbulence model.

articleTitle: On the construction of the multimedia network TCSL dictionary
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The multimedia network TCSL dictionary is a new media form, which is supported by the modern technologies, such as computer graphics, human-computer interaction technology, network transmission technology, speech input and output technology, 3D technology, panoramic simulation technology and so on. It is constituted of five main modules: search engine, vocabulary interface, thesaurus module, multimedia library and exercise bank. This dictionary has the following characteristics: fusion of multimedia elements, theme classification of vocabulary, openness of thesaurus system and powerful interactive function. Its successful experience in dictionary design and application of advanced technologies will profit the development of other types of teaching resources and ultimately promote the innovation and development of international Chinese teaching resources.

articleTitle: A parallel GA-BP neural network algorithm for solving inverse heat conduction problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Inverse heat conduction problem (IHCP) is a nonlinear, ill-posed problem of huge calculation, which is difficult to be solved properly. This paper proposes a parallel GA-BP algorithm on cluster for solving IHCP, which combine the ability of nonlinear mappings of forward back propagation (BP) neural network and the capacity of global optimization of genetic algorithm (GA). The processes of optimization algorithm and data parallelism are introduced mainly in this paper. The experimental results show that the method can achieve high speedup and improve computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Performance monitoring and acquisition system design of gasoline engines based on oxygen enriched combustion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, based on the status that in oxygen enriched combustion the dynamic performance of gasoline engines are remarkably promoted and the emission performance is also improved while NOx emission is seriously aggravated, the gasoline engine performance measurement and control system is built; the performance monitoring and acquisition system of oxygen enriched gasoline engines is designed, and its hardware structure and communication method are specified, the corresponding system software and the man-machine interface are developed to achieve the gasoline engine performance monitoring and acquisition; by controlling the flow rate of oxygen and carbon dioxide, the intake air components of the engine are adjusted to optimize the engine performance, save energy and reduce emissions.

articleTitle: Low maintenance cost small-world P2P network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to decrease the maintenance cost of structure P2P network, and increase the efficiency of the route and quire, we propose a low maintenance cost small-world P2P networks (LMCS). We describe the methods of network of the creating and maintenance. Small-world characteristic make the better efficiency of the route and quire, and we use of the clustering mechanism and extension of the COU strategy to decrease the maintenance cost. By Simulation, LMCS obviously presents the small-world characteristic. In contrast to Chord, LMCS have the lower maintenance cost and the higher query efficiency.

articleTitle: Background segmentation of corn seedling stage base on the greenness method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Background segmentation is the key step in image processing. The greenness method can satisfy the request of background segmentation of corn crops. Aiming at the different distribution of corn seedling stage in the field, segmentation operator of the greenness method is based on the ratios of R, G and B pixels in the total pixels. By researching on clear and unclear image of distribution between background and vegetation, the segmentation edge is found. By simulation, the greenness method can successfully divide image into background and vegetation.

articleTitle: Analysis of "One Road One Line with Straight Driving" Bus system based on TransCAD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The purpose to test the feasibility of “One Road One Line with Straight Driving“ Bus system based on the bus system in Yingtan, Jiangxi Province in the actual road network, is to simulate the distribution of the traffic flows in real conditions by TransCAD, traffic-simulation software. By comparing the characteristics of passenger distribution in the traditional traffic network and those in the “One Road One Line With Straight Driving” Bus system, and analyzing the pros and cons of straight driving buses together with the function of relieving traffic stress systematically, people could distribute the city's forward passengers in a better network in order to provide more reliable theoretic bases.

Author Keywords: “One Road One Line with Straight Driving”

articleTitle: Research on energy characteristics of aerospace relay mirror system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aerospace Relay Mirror System (ARMS) as a new concept weapon used in reflection of High Energy Laser (HEL) in space is studied. It extends the attacking range of Ground Based Laser (GBL) weapons enormously. Relevant researches have been carried out for many years. The structures and operating theory of the entire system consists of ground-based high energy laser weapon and space-based relay mirror. The main work of this study is focused on the analysis of relay mirror energy characteristics to deduce the relationship among the attacking range of weapon and diameter of ARMS and target irradiance. Calculation examples are also given. The results proved the strong points and feasibility of ARMS theoretically further. It is summarized that more importance should be attached to ARMS development. The results given in this paper can be reference of an actual ARMS system to some extends.

articleTitle: Non-stationary elastohydrodynamic lubrication analysis of an involute spur gear
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Non-stationary elastohydrodynamic lubrication (EHL) of an involute spur gear is a very complex problem. A full transient EHL solution of an involute spur gear is obtained by utilizing the multigrid method, which takes the variation of equivalent curvature, entrainment velocity and load on time along the line of action into consideration. The lubricant thermal and rheological effects are ignored and the gear teeth are assumed to be rigid in the model. The influences of load spectrum and impact on the EHL are analyzed in the paper. The load is carried by one pair of teeth and two pairs repeatedly and the impact when the teeth come into action is taken into consideration. The results show that the transient effect have strongly influence on the maximum pressure and minimum film thickness. The load spectrum plays an important role in the EHL of gear.

articleTitle: The comparison of algorithms for sloving the inverse problem of line source
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, in order to better apply the algorithms to the engineering, three algorithms for numerical solution of the inverse problem for a class of line source are compared. First of all, mathematical mode of a class of line source will be briefly introduced, and according to characteristics of the inverse problem, the objective function of inverse problem is constructed; then three algorithms which are designed to solve the inverse problem are given, According to the two cases of unknown parameters interval estimation, three algorithms are analyzed based on the simulated data, then the measured data is used to verify the solution efficiency of three algorithms. Through the data inversion, the principles of algorithms selecting are concluded on the practical engineering application, and the efficient of the algorithms application can be promoted by the comparison of three algorithms.

articleTitle: Effect of thermohydrogen treatment on machinability of TC21 alloy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The effect of thermohydrogen treatment on machinability of TC21 alloy has been studied by turning a group of TC21 alloy testing workpieces with different hydrogen content, measuring cutting force and surface roughness as well as observing chip morphology.
