Results of this experiment reveal that machinability of TC21 alloy improves with increasing hydrogen content, and there is an optimal range of hydrogen content, in excess of the range, with the hydrogen content increasing, machinability of TC21 alloy is reduced.

articleTitle: Service-oriented pricing and resource allocation in Grid computing environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Resource allocation is a crucial issue for end-users. Considering the validity and low latency in economics, the resource allocation is not only constrained within hardware and software services. It may treat different business objectives from a service science perspective. In this paper, we proposed an intelligent tool model, including a service-oriented pricing model and the resource allocation algorithm. We define an algorithm for a resource provider to allocate an arrived job, to make the cost payments and settlements based on the services received. The computer loads are efficiently distributed by varying prices.

articleTitle: The development of virtual experimental platform of industrial control based on configuration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The core mission of industrial automation laboratory teaching is to cultivate the students' ability solving practical engineering problems. Because of its limitation in traditional physical experimental teaching model and which is difficult to develop creativity and learning initiative of students. This paper introduces an innovation in experiment teaching model of industrial control, and fully makes use of modern technology, and constructs a practice platform based on virtual experimental technique. By this way, this paper makes the students to) realize all design of industrial control according to their thoughts, and enable them to apply their knowledge.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis and experimental varification on valve-less piezoelectric pump with zigzag chamber bottom
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A novel valve-less piezoelectric pump with zigzag chamber bottom (ZCB) is presented. The chamber bottom of the pump is designed as a waves shape. The ZCB and the opposite piezoelectric vibrator constitute a series of zigzag ducts in the chamber. Different flow resistances are produced between the suction stroke and the discharge stroke of the pump. The different flow resistances will generate net flow when the pump works. The presented pump is successful to minimize the valve-less piezoelectric pump by eliminating the regular diffuse/nozzle elements outside the chamber. The theory on the pump working is analyzed. The flow field in chamber is simulated for an intuition. Finally, to verify the theory, a group of tests are performed, in which one angle is fixed at the valve of 90 degree, and another angle varies from 20 degree to 60 degree. The errors between tests and theoretical calculations are no more than 14.8%.

articleTitle: The research on the influences of relative factors for factual depletion layer characteristics in MOSFETs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper is about the characteristics of the factual depletion layer in MOSFETs. The aim is to analyze the influences of the relative factors for depletion layer. The results indicate that the relative factors, such as, the thickness of gate dioxide, the bias voltage, the doping concentration, are related to the depletion layer thickness in MOSFETs. The conclusions show that the depletion layer insulativity is exponential decrease with the impurities concentration in substrate when the concentration is less than about 1.0e16cm-3, and approximately increase by exponential relationship. So we should consider the relative factors influences for the characteristics of depletion region when we will acquire a more precise conclusions in MOSFETs.

articleTitle: Conflict detection mechanism supporting simultaneous multi-group collaborative workflow
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In workflow management system of multi-group collaborative work, scheduling conflict is common, which hinder smooth operation of workflow engine. In this regard, the author proposes a new conflict detection mechanism which support simultaneous multi-group collaborative workflow, in which conflict detection algorithm runs before simultaneous collaborative work to examine whether there is scheduling conflict, to ensure smooth operation of multi-group collaborative workflow.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study of the influence mechanism of entrepreneurial social capital based on the theory of structural holes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Establishment of seabed soft sediments pressure-sinkage model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The pressure-sinkage model of seabed soft sediments is very important to design the track of the seabed nodule collector and improve its traction performance The 400 mesh bentonite is selected as the preparation material of the seabed soft sediments according to the physical mechanics characters of the seabed soft sediments and simulated the seabed soft sediments in the lab with demixion preparation method. The pressure-sinkage test with six rectangle plates is completed in the soil bin. The test result shows that the bearing pressure of the simulated increases in "S"curve with the settlement in the whole test depth of 0 to 30 cm. The founded exponent pressure-sinkage model of the sediments at the depth of 0 to 17.5 cm is based on its physical mechanics characters and the dimension constant of the plates. In the exponent model, the mechanics characters and the dimension constant can be obtained by pressure-sinkage test with at least two rectangle plates.

articleTitle: Yield criterion and unified strength theory of Zr-based bulk metallic glass
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Zr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">41.2</sub>Ti<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13.8</sub>Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12.5</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>Be<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22.5</sub> bulk metallic glass (BMG) alloy obeys different yield criterions under different stress states. In order to accurately describe yield behavior of BMG alloy and clarify the effect of middle principal stress on material yield and fracture, Unified Strength Theory is introduced to study plastic yield behavior of BMG alloy. The unified expression of yield function and its corresponding yield locus on π plane of Zr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">41.2</sub>Ti<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13.8</sub>Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12.5</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>Be<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22.5</sub> BMG alloy are obtained.

articleTitle: EEG signal decomposition using wavelet packet on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the author describes the wavelet packet decompostion(WPD) algorithm of EEG signal on digital signal processing (DSP) chip. The analyse of DSP hardware features and wavelet packet principle illustrate the relationship between them and then demonstrate the feasibility and celerity of the algorithm. Furthermore EEG signal is divided into equal frequency band through the CCS and then classified between left and right hand motor imagery with the way of power spectrum. Results indicate that the method is correct.

articleTitle: Stability of neutral type singular systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper discusses some new sufficient conditions for the stability of neutral type singular system with mixed delay. The work is done using LMI analysis and Lyapunov approach. By analyzing the stability of the new operator D and the relative system characteristics, we gain the main results of this paper. Furthermore, the stabilizing controller for the neutral type descriptor system are also obtained. The effectiveness of our result can be checked by Matlab LMI toolbox.

articleTitle: A qualification system for high temperature sterilization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is very necessary to verify the efficiency of the high temperature sterilization which is a very important process in the production of medicament especially for injections. This paper describes a system named QT-3000 which is a qualification system for the high temperature sterilization. During a qualification, the sensor readings, interval calculations, statistical calculations, the instantaneous and accumulate lethality results are displayed on the touch screen and uploaded to a host computer for further analysis.

articleTitle: Process control system for scion and rootstock feeding of vegetable grafting machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A vegetable grafting machine was designed which employed the method of splice grafting. The feeding of scion and rootstock in certain sequence is the key part of the machine and the structure, motion and accuracy of the feeding system decide the grafting productivity and quality. The operation process was determined in this study and the scion and rootstock feeding system was designed. A pneumatic system was utilized as the power of opening and closing of feeding manipulator, and a step motor was used to drive the feeding system to turn intermittently. An 89C51 Single Chip Microprocessor (SCM) was employed and programmed to realize the process control for the scion and rootstock feeding and the operation of the related cutting, conveying system, etc. The test showed that the grafting machine can realize the programmed function. The productivity is 450 grafted plants per hour.

articleTitle: High temperature oxidation resistance behavior of a FeCrAISi coating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The high temperature oxidation resistance behavior of a AISI430 ferritic stainless steel with a FeCrAISi coating was investigated at 900°C in air by the continuous measurement of the weight gain. The micro-structural characterization was performed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and the composition was determined by energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS). The FeCrAISi coating was found to possess good resistant to oxidation at 900°C in air. The results confirmed that the good oxidation resistance of the FeCrAISi coating was attributed to formation the thin a-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phases on the coatings' surface and at the substrate/coating interface.

articleTitle: Research of RBAC access control model based on LDAP tree storage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper first researched on role-based access control model, and then analyzed the fundamental principle and application mode of LDAP directory services. On this basis, proposed a combinative method of LDAP directory services and role-based access control model, this method has features of flexibility, convenience and safety, it is accorded with the real demand and easy to understand, reduced the complexity of the safety management.

articleTitle: The simulation of harmonic vibration response based on the rigid and flexible boom system of the ttruck-mounted concrete pump
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Use PRO-E to establish the three-dimensional solid model of a concrete pump boom system under level conditions, and combine with ANSYS and ADAMS to constitute the rigid and flexible boom model of the truck-mounted concrete pump. Analyze the harmonic response by ADAMS/Vibration module to get the intrinsic frequency distribution and activity condition; analyze displacement and acceleration curves of all test points. Compared with the traditional method of ANSYS model analysis, the paper reflects the vibration performance of the boom system more accurately and specifically, which provides a more practical analytic approach for vibration analysis of concrete pump boom system.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional digital process typesetting and printing system based on DELMIA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Though more and more enterprise is using DELMIA in China, but application level in DELMIA still focusing on process verifying and simulation. Directly we can not use DELMIA to output process card in manufacturing, because ability of DELMIA in two-dimension process card custom, typesetting and printing function is too young for actual use. The paper develop a three-dimension process typesetting and printing aided system based on DELMIA and CATIA for solving engineering application problem. The system has key function include process card custom, process file typesetting, two-dimension graph corresponding three-dimension model. Furthermore the system is applied in enterprise using DELMIA to realize dynamic expanding by extending and adopting ability of system.

articleTitle: Optimization and analysis on unmanned electric light armored reconnaissance vehicle gearbox
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is the basic requirements to reduce the weight and size of the gearbox of unmanned electric light armored reconnaissance vehicle. In order obtain the features of small, light and fast, we take the minimum volume of gearbox as the objective, and the modulus, number of teeth and the center distance as variables in this paper. On the basis of performance and transmission function, the optimization and analysis work are done. The optimization results show that it can provide a theoretical basis to improve the structural design of gearbox. Meanwhile, the design results provide the references to other similar gearboxes design.

articleTitle: Optimal control of two-level quantum systems based on the geometrical parametrization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an approach based on constructing control Hamiltonians to steer qubit states. When three tunable control Hamiltonians are available, we can adjust the controls to transform two-level quantum systems from an arbitrary initial pure state to another arbitrary target pure state along the unique geodesic curve on Block sphere. In terms of a kind of time-energy performance J = ∫<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">tf</sup> [λ + (1 - λ)E(u(t))]dt, we discuss how to design control magnitude to minimize this performance. An example indicates the feasibility and efficiency of this approach on optimal control of two-level quantum systems.

articleTitle: Research of differenced driving behavior modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays differenced driving behavior has realized by adding noise dada in the driver model which can not embody the essential difference between drivers. This paper analyzes the reasons of differenced driving behavior, uses the exploratory method to analyze the effects of driver's personality, intelligence and physiology on driving behavior and cooperates the affecting parameters in the driver model. It validates the improvement of enhanced model by simulation which provides the foundation for driving behavior modeling and simulation with high fidelity.

articleTitle: Research on an improved proposal of 3G security
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In 3G mobile communications, network security is mainly ensured by the AKA protocol and the complexity of encryption algorithms. After successful operation of AKA protocol, the serving network VLR could corroborate the identity of the user and the user could definite the validity of HLR. If authentication is successful, the corresponding cipher key CK and integrity key IK in the authentication vector shall be taken in use to encrypt data in both the RNC and the ME. This paper described the 3G AKA protocol process and its security features, and made an analysis of the potential security vulnerabilities and possible attacks. To solve these vulnerabilities, the author finally put forward a reliable and effective improved proposal. Finally, an analysis of the improved protocol has been made.

articleTitle: The finite element analysis on the main load bearing member of high-pressure grouting machine used for daily ceramics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The finite element static analysis on main load bearing members of a certain type of high-pressure grouting machine used for daily ceramics is discussed in this paper for researching its stress and transfiguration. The result can provide reference for design, and the discussion has some generality and practical value engineering.

articleTitle: Mellin transform solution for the model of European option
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: European options can be divided into the call option and the put option. In this paper, the models of call option and put option are studied by using Mellin Transform Solution. Then generalize the model of European option and also use Mellin Transform to analyze the solution. It fully reflects the Mellin transform using for economic model.

articleTitle: Admissibility of estimators for exponential distribution based on progressively Type-II censored sample
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Bayesian and Empirical Bayesian estimatiors of the parameter of exponential distribution are obtained under weighted square error loss function based on progressively Type-II censored samples. The admissibility and inadmissibility of estimatrors with linear form are also discussed.

articleTitle: Electrohydraulic servo control of vehicle yaw rate angular velocity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper we develop a Simulink model for a hydraulic servomechanism controlled by a pulse width modulated (PWM) solenoid. The control system used yaw rate as feedback is researched theoretically. It can represent a motion control system in an industrial or manufacturing setting, or a subsystem that controls the position of a valve in an automotive application.

articleTitle: Wavelet neural network based intelligent assessment of ceramic green technology research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This is to achieve a modern green manufacturing process of ceramic production, the use of second generation wavelet theory, combined with improved neural network, it set up an improved non-tensor product wavelet neural network, and thus created a ceramic green technology research source model. This paper has a preliminary study of ceramic production enterprise for how the evaluation model to assess whether the production process of ceramic green engineering criteria for the selection of sensor data collection and research, presents preliminary data by using the second generation wavelet neural network processing solutions. Finally, some random corporate on-site simulation training is given under the conditions of test methods and environmental factors to obtain the target detection data.

articleTitle: Design of reduced-order H∞ controller for uncertain discrete system based on observer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A reduced-order H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller was studied for a discrete system based on LMI. Firstly, the existent condition of a state feedback H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller was proposed for the uncertain discrete system. And a reduced-order observer was designed to make the error between the output of the controller and the output of the state feedback controller to zero based on Sylvester equations, which controls the system to satisfy the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance by linear matrix inequality. The approach is easy to deal with the limit of Sylvester equations in designing reduce-order controller. And a numerical example shows the feasibility of the proposed design approach.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulations of API000 nuclear main pump rotor system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Radial fluid exciting force model and its dynamic characteristics is derived through the flow field simulation of AP-1000 nuclear main pump. The result indicates that complicated harmonics frequency vibrations is existed under the operating of nuclear main pump, and the coupling resonance of blades and vanes should be taken into serious consideration under the designing of nuclear main pump.

articleTitle: Error compensation algorithm and performance evaluation for phase-shifting interferometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Phase retrieval algorithms with a small number of grabbed buckets are very helpful to the phase-shifting interferometer (PSI) required real-time processing, so the algorithms within five buckets are very practical and are given more attention. In the paper, new 4 and 5-bucket algorithms are developed to compensate phase-shift deviation and detector nonlinearity. Numerical simulations and experiments performed on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer are carried out and verify that these two compensation algorithms hold a high degree of tolerance for two dominate error sources.

articleTitle: Inter-cluster route algorithm based on the gateway for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As an active branch of routing technology, Cluster-based rounting protocols have a number of advantages such as topology management with convenient, energy efficient, etc. In this paper, it advanced a new inter-cluster routing algorithm (IRCG) based on gateway. Consider the node transmitting power can not adjustable, the Routing algorithm uses a single hop to intra-cluster comunication, and for inter-cluster communication, it takes multi-hop way to communicate with the sink node through the cluster head and the gateway points elected to build the reverse aggregation tree. Simulation results show that the protocol achieves better results in enhancing system lifetime than LEACH.

articleTitle: Emission reduction measures in ceramics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The traditional ceramic production consumes plenty of resource and energy with serious environmental pollution characteristics. Now, the traditional ceramic industry in China still consumes plenty of resource and energy, which greatly restricts the further development of ceramic industry. To reduce energy consumption and to improve energy efficiency and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> recovery and recycling efforts is the main way to reduce CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions in China's ceramics industry. In addition, the full use of the "Kyoto Protocol " in the proposed clean development mechanism, is also an effective way to reduce CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission, which also helps to improve China's energy structure.

articleTitle: Research on mine laneway 3D modeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Laneway is the artery of mine production, so establishing a true three-dimensional laneway model is important for guiding the mining design plans, project construction and security assistance and so on. This paper details the three-dimensional modeling process of laneway body, proposes the basic framework of building three-dimensional model as the laneway's center line, according to the geometric spatial characteristics of laneway, and gives several control parameters of expressing the geometric shape on laneway. Meanwhile, taking the straight-line laneway as an example, through calculating the three-dimensional coordinates of laneway feature points, using space point, line and plane as the basic primitives, establishes the laneway's three-dimensional surface model.)

articleTitle: Attack and defense information systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Information system security is a problem solved, it relates to national security and the survival and development, this article from information systems vulnerable to attack mode and means of defense present, two aspects are discussed in order to promote security of information systems people involved in the understanding of the technology.

articleTitle: An adaptive image enhancement algorithm based on human visual properties
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An adaptive of image enhancement algorithm proposed for the sensitivity to noise of Deng algorithm. It not only keep the original advantages of Deng algorithm such as easy realization, quick calculation but also play a ceratin part in restrainting noise by the use of basic principle of Deng algorithm and adaptively automatic parameters of method according to the property of people's vision. By comparing the result of adaptive image enhancement of algorithm and that of other image enhancement algorithms, the adaptive image enhancement algorithm can get automatic parameters of method. Besides the original Deng algorithm of easy realization, it also can improve the performance in restraining noise.

articleTitle: Development of nanometer wave-absorbing materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, on the base of the mechanism of nanometer absorbing materials, summarize the advantages, disadvantages and current development of nanometer materials, including metal, ferrite, ceramic, and conductive polymer etc. The gap between our nation and advanced level is indicated, point out modifying and compositing of nano materials should be further studied.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective location-routing problem (MLRP) with random analysis for regional distribution
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The location of the distribution facilities and the vehicles from these facilities are interdependent in many distribution systems. Such a concept recognizes the interdependence; attempts to integrate these two decisions have been limited. Multi-objective location-routing problem (MLRP) is combined the facility location and the vehicle routing decision and satisfied the different objectives. Due to the problem complexity, simultaneous solution methods are limited, which exits in different objectives with conflicts in functions satisfied. Two kinds of optimal mathematical models are proposed for the solution of MLRP. The three methods have been emphatically developed for MLRP. Multi-objective genetic algorithm (MGA) is introduced to solving MLRP based on Pareto. MGA architecture makes it possible to search the solution space efficiently, which provides a path for searching the solution with two-objective LRP. At Last the practical prove is given by random analysis for regional distribution with nine cities.

articleTitle: Research on road model based on steady speed of road section
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the effect of road characteristic on vehicle speed, the article introduces the concept of road unit, establishes road unit base, and discusses theory, procedure and method of constructing the road model, then validate the road model through examples and finally reaches a rational and feasible conclusion.

articleTitle: Transient optimization of drive control strategy for pure electric passenger car
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Use a pure electric passenger car as a research object, design drive control strategy in three modes for different driving conditions and provide motor target torque. To solve the affect of the change of SOC in actual motor output torque, use a penalty function to instantaneously optimize the target torque. Vehicle controller can get the target torque and the correct torque at different motor speed, different accelerator pedal opening and different SOC in look-up way. Create vehicle models and do simulations, then do road tests for the pure electric passenger car. It can be proved that the drive control strategy is practical and effective.

articleTitle: The method for matching the PMSM's base parameters of the Hybrid Electric Vehicle based on drive cycle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper propose a method for matching the base parameters of the permanent magnetic synchronous motor (PMSM) of the Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) based on the drive cycle, using the drive cycle datum of the HEV and the Probability and Statistics to determine the base power and the base speed of the drive motor, Taking the BESTURN HEV model and UDDS drive cycle in the ADVISOR for example, The simulation shows that the motor matching the drive cycle can better the fuel economy.

articleTitle: Synthetically improved genetic algorithm on the traveling salesman problem in material transportation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The research of traveling salesman problem is important in logistics distribution. There are many stochastic disturbance factors affecting logistics distribution in real life. So the result objectivity based on distribution and recovery theory and rotation algorithm to traveling salesman problem is not good. In consideration of stochastic factors affecting on logistics distribution, using stochastic programming theory and putting forward stochastic disturbance recovery theory and synthetically improved genetic algorithm with rotation algorithm we can solve the traveling salesman problem effectively. This way can avoid the higher difference between theoretical results and the ideal ones in order to promote the manipulation of the optimal plan. Last, we take the vehicle dispatch and route choice of material transportation in Hebei province as an example, and make the simulation test to verify the affectivity of the algorithm in the meantime. The result indicates that applying the synthetically improved genetic algorithm we can improve the material transportation efficiency, and achieve high-speed mathematical operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic modelling of wheeled planetary rovers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A dynamic model for wheeled planetary rovers based on the pseudo-coordinates approach is presented. The model allows any number of wheels and different types of suspensions to be considered and can used for rovers steered by steering wheels or by slip steering. As an example, the dynamics of a large 8-wheels pressurized rover for lunar exploration is studied.

articleTitle: The laser-beam welding of ferritic stainless steel for the motor vehicle exhaust 409L
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Adopts wolfram extremely argon arc welding (TIG) preheating add CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser welding in pipe production line for 1.5 mm thick 409L ferritic stainless steel welding, and welded pipe welding joint microstructure analysis. The results show that laser welding ferritic stainless steel pipe with joints heat affected zone is narrow, the grain growth degree small, and cold forming good performance advantages, can well satisfy motor vehicle exhaust pipe production factory in subsequent all cold technological requirement.

articleTitle: Design of active disturbance rejection controller for the velocity loop of optical tracking servo system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the optical tracking servo system with characteristics of large inertia and the non-linear friction, the improved ADRC (active disturbance rejection controller) method is designed to improve the velocity response of the servo system. This paper establishes a mathematical model of servo system and introduces the ADRC's working principle, then based on the step of the ADRC method, the parameters are given by simulation analysis, finally, the compared experiments are finished on the actual optical tracking servo system between the traditional PID controller and ADRC method. The actual results show that the ADRC method can not only achieve high speed fast step response without overshoot, and improve low-speed stability, its performance is better than traditional PID controller. Besides, the ADRC method can also improve the optical servo system speed performance by inhibiting the saturation and other nonlinear factors.

articleTitle: A novel identity-based signature with message recovery from RSA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Several identity-based signature schemes with message recovery have already been proposed so far, and most of the existing schemes are constructed from the bilinear pairings. Although the bilinear pairings are quite useful in the study of cryptography, it is hard to implement and computationally expensive. In this paper, we describe a novel identity-based signature scheme with message recovery from RSA, which does not need to employ the bilinear pairings. Under the hardness of RSA problem, our scheme satisfies existential unforgeable against adaptive chosen identity and message attacks in the random oracle model. Furthermore, we extend our scheme for partial message recovery, such that it can deal with the messages of arbitrary length.

articleTitle: Research on construction of smart medical system based on the social security card
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, many patients who live in the regions of which medical resources are relatively scarce, choose to go to big cities for the medical treatment, particularly when they meet some serious medical diseases which are need to prevent and cure through more advanced medical technology. In addition, the staff of relocation and the staff suffering from disease in travel also have needs of the remote medical treatment. Over the past, these off-site staffs which accepted the remote medical treatment need to achieve these things of self-pay, own Loaning, and returning to the location of insurance for the reimbursement. Now the number of off-site medical personnel is increasing very quickly, patients have to seek more convenient and quality services of health. By building the platform of smart medical system based on the social security card, we can effectively meet the individual remote medical treatment of patients. Through the real-time network and smart information systems, we will remove the off-site medical reimbursement Regulations, simplify the process of remote medical treatment, and improve the quality of medical and insurance services.

articleTitle: Parameters estimation of LFM signal based on fractional order cross spectrum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To attain fast and accurate parameters estimation of LFM signal with low SNR, a novel estimation method is presented. In this method, LFM is received with dual channel preamplifier so that noises in LFM signals are uncorrelated, parameters are estimated by using modulus of received LFM signals fractional order cross spectrum and cubic splines interpolation. Numerical simulation shows that the presented method is with good noise immunity, high precision of parameters estimation.

articleTitle: An empirical study on Differential Evolution algorithm and its several variants
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Differential Evolution (DE) is a simple and efficient global optimization algorithm. However, DE has indicated its weaknesses, such as the convergence rate. This fact has inspired many computer scientists to improve upon DE by proposing modifications to the original algorithm. This paper presents a survey on DE and its several variants. In this paper, we design two sets of function optimization experiments. One is about the five different mutation strategy of the Conventional Differential Evolution (CDE), and the other is the comparison several variants of Differential Evolution algorithm with a new improved DE algorithm (GPBXDE). To evaluate the performance of the algorithm, we selected twelve widely used benchmark functions. The results of the experiment prove that the strategy CDE/rand/1/bin and CDE/rand-to-best/1/bin are better and the GPBXDE algorithm performs outstanding.

articleTitle: A novel way for fire detection in the video using Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Computer vision and pattern recognition techniques have been recently applied to the fire detection. Unfortunately the complex environmental condition in some scenarios presents a unique challenge to the existing algorithms. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical framework for a more efficient fire detection. Firstly, we follow some classic algorithms to find the "Candidate Area" (CA) on each original video frame. Then, a group of "Confident Points" (CPs) are arranged around the boundary of a CA, after which a modified Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is used to describe the fire's flickering characteristic. Final experiments demonstrate that our proposed algorithms can well keep the robustness and stand the complexity imposed by varied outdoor circumstances, compared with previous algorithms.

articleTitle: Discriminative locality preserving dimensionality reduction based on must-link constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Locality preserving manifold learning algorithms are seeking intrinsic manifold based on overlapping local geometry structure. Locality Preserving Projections (LPP) and Neighborhood Preserving Embedding (NPE) are two representative linear locality preserving manifold learning algorithms, which not only defined on training samples, but also can generalize to test samples. But they just take the local structure into consideration, ignoring some available prior information. Pairwise constraints are easier obtained supervised information compared with labels. In this paper, we proposed two discriminative locality preserving manifold learning algorithms, by incorporating must-link constraints into LPP and NPE to improve their discriminative ability. Experiments results on Yale and ORL face databases verified the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study on torque ripple reduction of direct torque control system based on DSVM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the limitation of number of the voltage vectors in Voltage Source Inverter, the reasonable switching table of the traditional direct torque control is not able to be established and the torque ripple is large. A new method based on discrete space vector modulation is proposed to improve this problem in this paper, in which the number of voltage vectors is increased, the value and phase of voltage vectors are more continuous. Also, the different switching tables are established according to the different speed so that the large torque ripple is avoided. The experimental results show this method reduces the torque ripple and current ripple significantly.

articleTitle: Analysis of failure mechanism and stress influence on cylinder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Cylinder, which converts pressure of compressed gas into mechanical energy, is one of main pneumatic actuators in electromechanical products. With application of cylinder becoming broader and broader, the demand on high reliability of cylinder gets more and more urgent. In order to improve the reliability of cylinder, it must be made clear the failure mechanism of it beforehand. This paper first shows detailed structure of the tested A series of cylinder, then gives deep insight into the failure mechanism of this kind of cylinder with experimental phenomena gained from a large number of accelerated lifetime tests, such as wear of piston edge, accumulated debris in the lid of piston rod, noticeable ground traces on the piston rod and damage of the piston sealing ring. This paper also presents a microscopic explanation to the wear process of cylinder's moving parts with theory of cumulative damage, which demonstrates cylinder's micro failure process. At last it analyzes failure data obtained in the accelerated lifetime tests using lifetime data analysis software, mainly including the influence each stress (temperature, actuating frequency, pressure and speed) has on the lifetime of cylinder and why this happens, which further validates the failure mechanism of this kind of cylinder is wear of moving parts.

articleTitle: Research on sound intensity probe whose frequency band can be adjusted
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The distance of microphones in sound intensity probe have great relations with effective sound frequency band measured during measuring sound intensity,. To adapt different measured frequencies, the position of every microphone in sound intensity probe should be adjusted. On the basis of discussing the theory of measuring sound intensity with four microphones from three dimensions, using the theory about keeping place of brace framework and parallelogram, we designed a new 3D sound intensity probe including four microphones. Because space among different microphones in sound intensity probe can be adjusted, it can choose appropriate measurement bandwidth according to the range of sound frequencies measured actually. 3D sound intensity probe with four microphones, whose measurement frequency can de adjusted, retained original advantages of 3D sound intensity probe, and overcome the shortcomings of measuring fixed bandwidth.

articleTitle: An exchange rate forecasting method based on probabilistic neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Foreign exchange market is a complex market, with a high degree of volatility characteristics. Exchange rate formation mechanism and the factors affecting exchange rate volatility is also very complex, is a nonlinear system, it is difficult to accurately forecast, probabilistic neural network is applied to the frontiers of forecast, and aimed at the characteristics of probabilistic neural network to pretreatment the exchange of data and forecast the tendency. And by changing the vector dimensionality experiment obtain the best entry to embed dimensionality, tested and improved the precise prediction and valuable.

articleTitle: IED modeling based on IEC61850 standard
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on object-oriented technology, analyzes the basic information model and summarizes the method and procedure of intelligent electronic devices (IED) modeling, which is explained by a protective device, concludes the problems which have come up in the process of IEC61850 Application in China. The standard named IEC61850 relay protection engineering application model which offers some effective and feasible measures is used to solve these problems in electric power system.

Author Keywords: IEC61850 relay protection engineering application model

articleTitle: An efficient algorithm for detecting isomorphism of deployable truss structures using incident degree
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Deployable truss structure can be represented by weighted graph. The detecting of deployable truss structures is thereby transformed into the detecting isomorphism of graph. This paper introduces an approach based on incident degree to deal with the identification of deployable truss structures. When two or more vertexes with equal ID appear, amount of calculation using incident degree will increase exponentially. The detecting isomorphism needs an algorithm which can reduce amount of calculation. In this work, adjacency matrix is divided into several areas according to exchange properties of each area which are summarized in section 3. And then a more efficient detecting algorithm is presented.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of embedded secure web server for ARM platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The article describes design and implementation of an embedded secure web server base on Secure Socket Layer (SSL) protocol for ARM platform. The main content includes porting method of openssl to ARM platform, structure analysis and implementation of the secure web server, installation and running of it on ARM machine, and an application example of it on the mini 2440 developing board.

articleTitle: Research on RFID-based monitoring platform for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A RFID tag based wireless sensor test platform is proposed in this paper, the system build a real-time monitoring of sensor network platform by using RFID tag and WSN technology. By the combination of the wireless sensor nodes, and RFID technology, and other basic technology of things, the building of an intelligent wireless sensor monitoring platform is proposed, which can not only expand the wireless sensor network are aware of the depth and breadth of information, but also the real-time monitoring and positioning quality of the items can be achieved. In this paper, the overall design of the system is proposed and the system routing and positioning protocol is analyzed, the core technologies in design are discussed, and the system is a overall solution for comprehensive RFID-based wireless sensor network to monitor.

articleTitle: Blind equalization algorithm based on least squares support vector regressor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Support vector machine was an effective tool for solving limited learning samples. In the paper, one new blind equalization algorithm based on least squares support vector regressor (LSSVR) was developed. In this method, an iterative reweighed quadratic programming procedure for attaining the solutions has been used in this paper and the simulation results show that it has the good generalization characteristics. The solving steps are also given and it can be generalized to nonlinear blind equalization using kernel functions. The algorithm equalizes the received base-band signals with serious inter-symbol interference. By the algorithm, this method realizes error-free transmission in typical telephone channel. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has better convergence performances than the constant modulus algorithm. Especially in small sample cases, the algorithm has lower computational complexity and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: Research of rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on wavelet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Faults such as without cooling when processing, chuck could not clamp work pieces and turret without rotation were presented in CNC machine tools in this paper. Make use of PLC status display information diagnosis machine tool fault can get rid of fault rapidly and effectively. Practice has proved that it is an effective method to use PLC diagnosed fault.

articleTitle: Composition of L-shaped grounded reflector with planar monopole array to explore fan-beam antenna characteristics for DECT, 3G and 4G wireless applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this contribution, a fan-beam antenna employing a non-parasitic reflector in a grounded manner is introduced. A fan-beam antenna is achieved by 13 elements conventional planar monopole array antenna. This concept is performed by combining planar monopole antenna as an array and non-parasitic L-shaped reflector. This array element has an Omnidirectional pattern and these characteristics are allowed to control the antenna H-plane 3 dB beam-widths for the desired angle by grounded reflector shape. The antenna input impedance matching bandwidth is approximately 1550-2550 MHz when simulated. The antenna has broad band input impedance band width, good radiation patterns and proper peak gains in DECT, 3G and 4G bands. This type of antenna can be constructed easily, cheaply as well as being light weight for installation.

articleTitle: Bouyancy compensation analysis of an autonomous underwater glider
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The autonomous underwater glider is propelled by changing its net buoyancy. The value of the net buoyancy is essential to the glider's movement. In this paper, a finite element method combined with theoretical calculation is utilized to calculate the deformation of the vehicle's pressure hull. According to the force analysis of the glider, the deformation of the glider is derived. Meanwhile, based on the density change with the water depth, the net buoyancy of the glider can be obtained and a new guidance can therefore be provided for design of the buoyancy system of the underwater glider.

articleTitle: The digital filter method designing of angular rate of the servo control system in low speed
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The speed signal acquirement for the servo control system is a very important part. For the problem that in a low-speed movement, the differential signal of the position sensor cannot reflect the speed value of the servo control system, the paper proposes the digital filtering method of removing pulse moving average filtering to get rid of the measurement noise, based on the analysis and comparison about the analog filtering and the digital filtering. This method can not only successfully avoid the servo control system falling to lots of real-time online operation, but also is easy to turning in field, so it has the high theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Gait identification method based on closed area feature of lower limbs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper mainly researches on the identification issue through lower limbs. A new gait identification method is proposed by using the closed area of lower limbs as basic feature extraction. Firstly, skeleton is applied to obtain body skeleton, and through connecting lowest points of left and right foot, a closed area is formed as the gait feature. Then wavelet transform is used to analyze the feature datum. Finally, identification and classification of feature datum is realized by the mature BP neural network. The proposed method has been applied to the 0°camera angle of CASIA data-base, and the test results show the method's efficiency to improve the gait identification rate.

articleTitle: Using concurrent engineering technology to design a satellite assembly
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the design of satellite assembly, it is a new task that a full-scale digital mockup is generated using full concurrent engineering environment based on network. In this paper, the top-down technical basis, method of defining satellite model, the progress of satellite design are introduced to implement the application of concurrent engineering environment. Finally, the application of using 3D cooperative and digital technology to design a satellite is introduced.

articleTitle: Exploring the methods of using the Chinese traditional folk-custom color cultural representations on the industrial design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Introducing the traditional folk-custom color cultural expressions to the industrial design, both solves the issue of the traditional culture always lacked in the domestic universities design-education contents, and explores to solve the problem of the national culture elements been lacked when we creates the national brands on the social innovative designs. The article firstly summarizes the forms of the Chinese traditional folk-custom color culture expressions. Second, elaborates the subsystem of the traditional folk-custom color culture expressions, under the traditional Chinese culture, to carry on its knowledge management. Finally, discuss the problems of the practical application of traditional folk-custom color cultural representations in the university design-education and social innovative designs.

articleTitle: Research of General Aviation flight data analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: FDA provide a effective tool for the proactive identification of hazards for General Aviation. Firstly, this paper introduced the concept of FDA and its benefit to general aviation, then the basic procedure of FDA is presented. Lastly, through an aircraft engine monitoring case illustrate the significance of FDA to General Aviation.

articleTitle: Adaptive friction identification and compensation based on RBF neural network for the linear inverted pendulum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Generally, researches on inverted pendulum system only considered the viscous friction, the system with controllers designed based on this model was stable in simulations. However, when the controller was implemented in experimental system, small oscillation resulted. To eliminate the small oscillation, friction identification along with compensation scheme based on radial basis function neural network (RBF network) is proposed in this paper. The LQR controller is employed to stabilize the inverted pendulum in the upright position. Finally, simulation results are given to prove the validity of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Study on the preparation of crosslinked chitosan-based resin
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With chitosan as the raw material, a new type of resin material is synthesized through epichlorohydrin crosslinking. The effects of the reactant ratio, the reaction temperature, the reaction time, the stirring rate and the system pH on the cross-linking rate are studied in detail. The resin material is then characterized by means of IR. The experimental results show that the reaction occurs mainly on the amino and the hydroxyl of chitosan. The chitosan-based resin material with good acidresistivity and high degree of cross-linked can be prepared under the optimal experimental conditions: the system temperature is 50°C, reaction time is 9h, stirring speed is 400r/min, pH value is 12 and the mass ratio of chitosan and epichlorohydrin is 1:6.

articleTitle: Design of thermostat system based on Proteus simulation software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of precise temperature control, the thermoelectric cooler (TEC) principle widely used is analyzed for the design of the whole control process and selection of control parameters, and then accurate simulation model of the TEC is established in Proteus simulation software. Moreover, combined with the traditional circuit simulation model, the temperature control loop is designed, and the response characteristics of the system are tested using an input signal similar to the unit-step function to achieve the precise temperature control. Simulation results show that the proposed control circuits can precisely convert error signal to output voltage sent to TEC model, and TEC model behaves approximately like a two-pole system. The first pole starts at 20mHz and a second pole at 1Hz.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on cavity type influence of multiple oil pad hydrostatic guide fluid state
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Hydrostatic guide oil cavity of heavy CNC vertical lathe have many type, familiar oil cavity type have rectangle, sector, ellipse, I-shaped. Aim at research the influence of difference oil cavity type for hydrostatic guide fluid state, which established the 3-D entity model of rectangle and sector and ellipse and I-shaped hydrostatic guide interstitial fluid. The cavity type influence law of the guide fluid state is revealed via compute the four oil cavity type fluid state of hydrostatic guide based on numerical simulation. The result showed that the velocity of interstitial fluid gradually increase along the guide radial from inner to outer, and to reach the most in the outer edge. The result testified that the linear velocity of touch fluid for rotary wall surface directly proportional to guide radius. Based on an overall consideration of various factors, the interstitial fluid velocity field distribution of sector cavity hydrostatic guide is the most uniformity, next is ellipse, rectangle, and I-shaped, and the velocity vector graph of interstitial fluid testified that the oil cavity inner have reflux phenomena. The numerical result sincerity showed the interior fluid state of bearing. And the simulation result for project that oil cavity optimum structure design supplied theory proof.

articleTitle: A frequency prediction method based on estimation of the ionospheric characteristics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To grasp Complex characteristics of shortwave (HF) channel is the key and difficulty to research HF communication. On the premise of comprehending the ionosphere prediction method in the Asia Oceania region, HF frequency prediction method recommended by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is improved in this paper, and the engineering calculation method of predicting HF frequency in the Asia Oceania region is concluded and summarized. Comparing with the ITS (the Institute for Telecommunication Science) software's predicting result, the method is improved to some extent in time availability and SNR in the receiving point.

articleTitle: Research on the key technique of continuous rotary electro-hydraulic servo motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The low speed performance is the most important indicators of the continuous rotary electro-hydraulic servo motor. The factors which influence the low speed performance consist of nonlinear characteristics such as structural pulsation, friction and leakage characteristic, oil distributing technique, pressure pulsation, servo valve's distinguish ability and so on. In order to improve the low speed performance, the key technique of servo motor was studied. It is analyzed that velocity pulsation and torque pulsation was eliminated in the structure, the structure of blade and oil distributing plate was optimized for improving leakage and oil distributing characteristic, and friction torque was compensated in order to reducing the pulsation. These results can resolve the basic technique problem of the low speed performance and lay foundation for studying electro-hydraulic servo motor.

articleTitle: Design of networked monitoring system of PV grid-connected power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Requirement of PV station and differences between modern and traditional monitoring systems are analyzed. Based on embedded PV grid-connected controller and Ethernet technology, monitoring system of PV Grid-Connected Power Plant is designed roundly. Definite design of the hardware and software are achieved with the Principle of hardware selection and communication protocols standardization of PV grid-connected controller. With less cubage and lower cost, the system runs well, which has great significance on current projects.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm for corner detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Since detection result is not good enough when detecting real image using line search mechanism corner detection algorithm, a feature selection criterion based on priority and adaptive non-maximal suppression (ANMS) is proposed in this paper to control the number and density of features in the image. Experimental results show that the algorithm can detect corner more reasonable, and can be used in image mosaics well.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of wireless power monitoring system for public buildings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper represents the system design and implementation of a wireless power monitoring system for public buildings, which aims to help the country to save energy and electric power supply service providers to determine effective and efficient energy supply in urban area. Public building energy waste has been a big problem in cities and towns in China for several decades. The main reason for this is that people may forget to turn the electrical power off when leaving as the bill is not paid by them. In our monitoring system, a real time electrical power meter is used to track the operation situation, and the sensed data will be sent to the central control device through gateway. The controller will respond to the abnormal usage of electrical power due to this information. The schematic design and working procedure of each component has also been presented in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Rsearch of development in wireless sensor network routing protocols based on NS2
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As an open source, architecture reasonable network simulation tool, NS2 has been widely used in wireless and wired network research. NS2 is fairly easy to use once you get to know the simulator, it is quite difficult for a first time user, because there are few user-friendly manuals. Even though there is a lot of documentation written by the developers which has in depth explanation of the simulator, it is written with the depth of a skilled NS user. Meanwhile, NS2 runs on Linux operating system and the difficulty of development, many beginners can do not know how to use it. The purpose of this paper is to give a new user some basic idea of how the simultor works, how to setup simulation networks. The paper introduced the principle, procedure, process and tool of NS2 through the example of develop the routing protocol of wireless sensor network. The difficulty and importance of routing protocol development are detailed.

articleTitle: The correlation between social tie and reciprocity in social media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In many online social media systems, like other social network, because of social influence, ideas, modes of behavior and new technologies can diffuse through the network like a epidemic. However, different social tie strength between users will cause different speed and different extension of information diffusion. Users with strong social ties exhibit information diffuse more easily than those with weak ties. Therefore, researchers are very interested in identifying social ties in information diffusion. Generally it is difficult to identify the social ties, because it is latent. But there are some factors can induce it. In this paper, we presented a technique to measure the correlation between social ties and reciprocity, and applied it to real-world dataset on Sina Microblog. Results showed that there was a significant correlation and strong tie existed in reciprocal links in this system. Then we can predict the social ties easily by reciprocity.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for calculating the radiological path in CT image reconstruction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper an algorithm is presented for calculating the radiological path in CT image reconstruction. Based on the coordinate component of the intersections the lengths of the voxels intersected with this ray are rapidly calculated. Meanwhile, after determining the index of the first voxel intersected with the ray, the indices of the remaining voxels intersected with this ray can be successively determined in terms of the incremental of the coordinate component between the adjacent intersections. By so doing shortens the time consumed in calculating the radiological path. The simulation results show that this algorithm is feasible and effective. Compared with the Siddon algorithm, it results in an about 4 times speedup in the calculation of the radiological path.

articleTitle: Extracting subtle feature of target signal based on double tree complex wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Double tree after wavelet transform has good direction selectivity and invariant parallel movement. Based on analysing histogram of modulus sub-band corresponding to six high frequency sub-band after double tree wavelet decomposition, we put forward a new kind of subtle character, namely combination character of Lognormal distribution parameters and Gamma distribution parameter. Using the character to segment signal feature, and using edge smooth technology in the process of segmentation and using k-means clustering to realize unsupervised segmentation. Experiments show that the method of feature extraction is new, and edge accuracy of segmentation results and regional consistency has antinoise character, and it is a kind of effective subtle segmentation method.

articleTitle: Application of modeling technology in driving simulator system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to achieve more realistic visual effects for the driver, a high degree of simulation of 3D solid geometrical models (virtual scene) need to be created for driving simulator. The traditional methods used in the past occupy a larger memory space for building the virtual scene and the calculated quantities are also increased while the virtual scene of training ground is driven. This will result in spending a large of computer system resources, thus affecting the software running in real time. In the system of both requiring for authenticity and real-time, texture mapping modeling technology which is used to build humanities logo models of virtual scene as training ground, training subjects and trees can not only meet the requirements of system simulation, but also reduce the consumption of resources and enhance the operation performance of the system. Finally, the results show that it can obtain realistic rendering effects in real-time by using the method in driving simulator.

articleTitle: Effect of parallel compensation on series compensation in long distance distribution line
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Some network 66kV distribution system has some problems such as the levels of voltage along the loads are low and the loss along the line is big due to the long distance and the huge reactance, aiming at the problems, compensation effects of series compensation, parallel compensation and both of them are compared in the paper, basing on the principle of improving line voltage using capacitor compensation. Through the theoretical analysis and simulation, corresponding conclusions are get. The effect of series compensation is ideal, that of parallel is not obvious, when the two are used simultaneously, parallel compensation can offset series compensation partly.

articleTitle: A kind of license plate location based on mathematical morphology and edge detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the license location is adopted by using mathematical morphology and edge detection. Using the erosion operation with the horizontal structure element and the subtraction operation, we cope with the gray image turned into by the inputted color license image in order to obtained the gray image with the prominent license plate characters. Then detect the edge of the gray image by using the sobel operator. Eliminate the noise in the obtained binary image by using the erosion operation with horizontal structure element and then by using the close operation of the mathematical morphology. Some connecting areas are formed. Take two thresholds filter the connecting areas so that the connecting area with the license plate is confirmed. Achieve the accurate location of the license plate by the area preparations and the scanning row and column. The algorithm is carried with 76 color license plate pictures. The results show that the positioning accuracy rate of this algorithm comes up to 96%, and it can meet certain real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Fault Management System based on intelligent mobile terminal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Integrated Fault Management System for telecommunication level networks plays a key role to make sure the equipments of telecommunication level network safety and reliability. However, the terminal of traditional Integrated Fault Management System is a computer and it needs a wired or wireless access network environment; this greatly limits the freedom and real-time degree of work. Staffs are unable to access to real-time alerts or update the fault information anytime. In this paper, a new Integrated Fault Management System will be proposed, which is based on intelligent mobile terminal. Next the architecture of this system will be introduced. Furthermore, more details about the system, such as the real-time monitor module, query module and operation module etc., will be further discussed. This new system has been put into practice in current Integrated Fault Management system. It will bring some positive influences to the development of the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of image denoising based on stationary wavelet multi-scale adaptive threshold
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to denoise while preserve image details better leading to a satisfactory result, so that it can be analyzed and applied subsequently, in view of advantages of well time-frequency characteristic, multi-resolution and decorrelation of stationary wavelet transform, this paper proposed a new algorithm of image denoising based on multi-scale and adaptive thresholding. In this algorithm: Firstly, use stationary wavelet to transform image. Then determine adaptive threshold of every decomposition progression according to the ratio of noise variance and wavelet coefficient variance. Secondly, process the wavelet coefficient matrice with threshold neighborhood sliding window and adaptively optimization wavelet coefficient processing window. Lastly, obtain resumed image through inverse transform. The experimental results show that, the algorithm can not only obtain clearer image edges but also denoise effectively compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Experiment and simulation research of engine cooling fan in dump truck
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As an important component in engine cooling system, the cooling fan has a potent effect on the reliability and economy of the engine. To ensure that the performance of the cooling fan is satisfied with the practical working requirements, the following work is done. Firstly, the experiment of the cooling fan is carried out to get its performance data; Secondly, the performance distribution in actual working condition is simulated with the help of FLUENT; finally, the experiment result which has been fitted by MATLAB is compare with the simulation result. The relative error of the result between the experiment and the simulation is within the pale of 5%, which shows clearly that the performance data from experiments could meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of FPC under bending stress
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, finite element analysis method is applied for modeling and simulation of FPC to analyze its mechanical performance under the constant stress.
