In the simulation process, the bending method used in this research is to fix the middle of the FPC and to impose load on both sides. The results of Von Mises stress distribution between the layers of FPC are presented and analyzed with the knowledge of material mechanics. In addition, the length and the thickness of layers of FPC are taken as optimization variables. With the variables change, there are many different cases. This paper presents the stress comparison with different lengths and thickness of layers of FPC model. The simulation results show that there are different stresses between the layers of FPC model. The disbonding failure may occur between the layers of FPC under high-cycle load and the stress between layers will be reduced by changing the length of model. With ANSYS, the fatigue life of FPC is calculated approximately. The analysis result may provide some help on FPC design and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Detection system of meter pointer based on computer vision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aimed at problem of Auto meter pointer detection precision, the paper gives a solving plan based on computer vision technology. According to the input parameters provided by Manufacturers, the system can output signal that all kinds of meters need, and detects meter pointers automatically, then outputs result. The system is already applied in detection of CAN BUS digital instrument designed by ourselves. The final test result indicates that the system runs stable, and the function performed is satisfactory.

articleTitle: A research on flexible business process management system based on knowledge base and semantic web services
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Accompanied with the great changes of information technology and marketing globalization, business processes of enterprise must be dynamically adjusted and optimized, which leads to strict requirement on Business Process Management System. Based on comprehensive study and analysis of existing business process management model, this paper proposes FBPMS (flexible business process management system), which combines knowledge base and semantic web services, to provide support for a variety of dynamic business process and its continual improvement.

articleTitle: Combination forecasting on software reliability based on entropy weight
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Software reliability is a hot issue of software engineering research. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of software reliability's failure data, the researchers introduced the entropy weight to build the combination forecast model on the basis of establishing single forecasting methods. Data simulation results indicate that this method has higher precision of prediction than that of the single forecasting methods, and thus is applicable in certain fields.

articleTitle: The research on dynamic performance of 200 km/h CRH2 EMU vehicle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The 200km / h CRH2 EMU vehicle dynamic model was put up with NUCARS software and studied on its dynamic performance. The calculation results showed that the critical speed of stable operation of the vehicle is much higher than the maximum speed and maximum test speed. The experiment proved that the curve had a better safety performance. The running security and stability is sufficient.

articleTitle: Application and study of 3D alignment technology for the inspection of automobile punching parts
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As for quality problems of automobile punching parts, an inspection method based on Geomagic reversing engineering software is established; basic principle thereof is scanning an automobile punching part by means of a photographic 3D scanner so as to acquire point cloud data and comparing processed point cloud data with standard digitalized samples by means of 3D alignment technology so as to acquire a processing error of the punching part.

articleTitle: Design of indoor swimming pool water temperature control system based on fuzzy controller and Smith predictor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: All modern indoor swimming pools have a large volume, the water temperature control system is the serious delay and serious inertia nonlinear system. The traditional PLC control system based on PID controller can not meet the control requirements. This paper presents an integrated control system composed of a fuzzy automatic optimization algorithm and the Smith predictor compensator to adjust the temperature of pool water. Experiments and applications show that the proposed control scheme to solve the serious delay and serious inertia system can achieve good control effect.

articleTitle: Resarch of image magnifying algorithm based on cubic spline interpolation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Image magnification is an important topic in the field of digital image processing. The realization of a varty of interpolation algorithm is now a hotspot for research. The paper first useing the interpolation algorithm of cubic spline curve to realize image magnification, then using interpolation algorithm of cubic convolution for image edge serrated on post-processing, thus make objective image with higher resolution and good smoothness. On the image edge, the serrated phenomenon is solved and a good visual effect is achieved.

articleTitle: The design and simulation of array multiplier improved with pipeline techniques
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the time complexity of two's complement Array Multiplier has been analyzed. Based on the analysis, a method for improving the performance of Array Multiplier with pipeline has been discussed, and the modeling of it has been built with VHDL. Furthermore, the conclusion of Simulation and function verification has been given.

articleTitle: Network electric energy meter design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we have introduced the design about Network electric energy meter which based upon Ethernet. The microprocessor in electric energy meter not only be used to process the gathered data which comes from measuring circuit, but also realize some parts of TCP/IP protocols. Depending on the control chip of Ethernet, the processed data can be transmitted on Internet. The whole system is very reliable, especially for remote meter reading.

articleTitle: Optimization design of ADRC for oxygen content in flue gas based on chaos particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: ADRC control system is applied to the oxygen content in flue gas of chain boiler combustion. The chaos particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed for the control system to deal with the difficulty in the parameter regulation of the ADRC. The optimal ADRC parameters can be searched automatically. The proposed Chaos Particle Swarm Optimization approach has fine computational efficiency and could be easily implemented. This control strategy enables the system to have the advantages of adaptability, rapidity and high control precision. A simulation verification of the optimization approach has been conducted by using a chain boiler combustion model. The simulation results show that the optimal design method is viable.

articleTitle: Research on lightweight outer baffle for coaxial space camera
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Stray light is non-imaging light that reach the optical system imaging plane. The non-imaging light can be received by detector if it is not effectively controlled, and stray light which directly irradiates on the detector has great influence on the imaging quality. Stray light can be effectively inhibited, if the outer baffle of space camera is designed optimally. Carbon fiber composite material is chosen as main material to meet requirements of a coaxial space optical system. The outer baffle should have advantages, such as lightweight, high stiffness and dimensional stability, etc. Using optimization design tools, the lightweight outer baffle is designed. And finite element method is used to check the structure. Development and test results show that the outer baffle with a diameter of 620mm and a total length of 1200mm only weighs 7.3kg. And the baffle's natural frequency reaches 88Hz, and it can satisfy the requirements of the space camera.

articleTitle: Algorithm designed for image inpainting based on decomposition and fractal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An image inpainting algorithm based on fractal and image decomposition is proposed in this paper. The image is decomposition into two element structure and texture, which are processed respectively according to their characteristic, structure element is inpainted by CDD (Curvature-Drive Diffusions) algorithm. And texture element is filled by fractal parametexperiment results show that the proposed algorithm provides a better visual effect, especially for large block.

articleTitle: Algorithm analysis for a rover simulation platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In recent years, the rover-based planetary exploration missions have put forward some new challenges to the simulation platforms for rovers. This paper introduces a simulation platform, ROSTDyn (ROver Simulation based on Terramechanics and Dynamics), for planetary rovers developed with C++ programming language on the basis of Vortex software. In this paper, the structure of ROSTDyn is introduced briefly. Key algorithms for developing ROSTDyn are presented in detail, including the computation of the contact-area parameters, the transformation of velocity and force, the balance of the forces, and the integration of the algorithms and the modules. The simulation results verify that the algorithms are right, the integration is effective and the simulation runs stable.

articleTitle: An optimization control method of waste incinerator for power generation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the grate-type waste incinerator, an optimization control method of waste incinerator for power generation is proposed in this paper. We first designed the control systems of incinerator for the main steam pressure, the temperature and the fuel. Then, a control scheme of waste incinerator based on the DCS is introduced. The practical application of our method in a few waste incinerator based power plants indicated, that our proposed method is effective and has achieved a certain economic benefits.

articleTitle: Technology study of new industry data collection and monitoring system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the shortcomings of poor flexibility and versatility of traditional industrial data acquisition monitoring system, the paper design a new type of industrial data acquisition monitoring system based on single chip computer (SCM) of ATmega16 and the Labview software platform for virtual experiments. The system collects long-distance data of industrial field to the industrial PC for data acquisition and control through the RS485 serial communication, and users can set the parameters of collecting data for setting and adjustment, at the same time can be conveniently to being sampled data for storage and playback. The experiments show that the data collection and monitoring system has some features of being low cost, easy to use and a wide range of application, and has a very important application for collection and monitoring data in industrial areas and laboratory.

articleTitle: Modeling and compensation analysis of ball-end milling cutter wear
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the influence on processing error caused by tool wear in virtual NC process, ball-end milling tool is taken as research object, all the cutting factors, which affect tool wear mechanism when complex curved surface parts are processed, are fully considered, and the ball-end milling tool wear mathematical model is established, thus the processing error compensation method caused by tool wear is put forward, the tool wear coefficient is determined by measuring the axial and the and radial wears, to predict the tool wear quantity in milling process, the experiment results demonstrate that the established model is valid and reasonable, it provides theoretical basis for complex curved surface processing error research and curved surface processing precision improvement.

articleTitle: Fast and robust skew detection for scanned documents
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A fast and robust skew detection for scanned document images based on the improved piecewise covering by parallelograms is proposed in this papper. Comparison with the original PCP algorithm, the skew detection of the proposed algorithm is more applicable on vertical textlines documents, and is not sensitive to the noise. The experiment results show that the computation time is short, while the detection accuracy is higher. The enhanced skew detection approach is efficient for horizontal and vertical textlines documents, and the complex documents with forms, tables and pictures.

articleTitle: Virtual desgin and test of manual gear shifting bench
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper studies on a real time model of a virtual gear shifting test bench in terms of virtual development of manual gear shifting. This test bench gives engineers the real time feeling of how much influencing to the comfort of gear shifting while changing the design. This real time model is a complete transmission system consisting of gear shifting connecting rods and detail gear box model. How the main design parameters will influence the comfort of gear shifting will be simulated in this real time simulation environment. This model is a simplified one to reduce the calculation cycle time in order to fit the operational cycle time in the DSPACE real time platform.

articleTitle: A pressure sensor of the industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A pressure sensor structure of the industry is adopted in this paper. The reliability and stability of the sensor are analyzed understand the high pressure situation. Detailed introduction and study are carried out for the particular sensor chip and 10MPa high work pressure is loaded on the sensor chip for performance analysis. Through the analysis, we find that the stress on the middle is negative and that of the edge is positive of the chip. The Wheatstone bridge is composed and the output of circuit can be maximal. And we study its ability of overload resistance too. Through the analysis, we find that the sensor designed here has a high ability of overload resistant, high sensitivity, good linearity and fast dynamic response and so on. And the sensor is especially applied to oil industry.

articleTitle: An efficient algorithm for Chinese license plate location
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an efficient and robust method of Chinese license plate location. In this method, firstly, 2-D wavelet transform is implemented to a digital car image to detect the high frequency information which is the basis to the next approaches. Secondly, mathematic morphology is used to get connected regions which contain the candidate plate regions with appropriate size. In order to pick out the real plate region, a BP neural network is trained by the samples chosen from plate images under different illumination conditions. Then certain of pixels in candidate regions are identified by the network based of color elements, which help determining the real plate location. Experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: A DRM system for mobile digital journals based on OMA DRM model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we introduced some concepts, technologies and applications of digital rights management first. According to the concepts, we got a kind of DRM solution for mobile digital journals publishing based on OMA DRM 2.0 and mobile devices' characteristics. Especially, we focused on the security mechanism in the new digital rights management system, such as encrypting, decrypting and keys transmission technologies.

articleTitle: Data structuring and effective retrieval in the mining of web sequential characteristic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Web data mining based on sequential characteristics is a mining technology focusing on text data on Web pages and link structure and combing sequential characteristics on the basis of the mining of Web structure and Web contents. A huge number of data information is carried on Web, and it is increased at a geometric speed every day. As time goes by, the effectiveness of a great number of data is continuously reduced, and they even become completely useless. How to clean these useless data, find out hidden regular contents among a great number of data, and solve the quality problem of data application has become the research hotspot in the Web data mining technology at present. All the information objects on Web can be generally divided into two categories: Structured data and semi-structured data. Those that can be expressed in database structure are called structured data; those expressed in various forms with text as representative are called semi-structured data. The greatest feature of Web data is semi-structuring. Such kind of semi-structured data are relevant to time sequence, meanwhile, time effect of data is also related to time sequence. In the article, discussion is made about how to use the sequential characteristic in the course of Web data mining to carry out structural transfer of semi-structured data based on time effect of data, that is the structuring of Web data, and solve the problem about effectiveness in retrieval accordingly.

articleTitle: The thinking of promotion and using green building materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of the construction industry, the human living condition has been greatly improved. As a kind of high resource consumption and heavy pollution industrial product, building materials improve human living condition, but also greatly polluted the human environment at the same time. Therefore, to reduce building materials pollution, promote and use green building materials, is really the key to improve the human living environment, and it is necessary for the healthy development of human society.

articleTitle: Coordinate measuring of the variable ratio noncircular bevel gear
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A coordinate measuring method was presented for the variable ratio noncircular bevel gear used in sliding-limiting differential in this paper. The path of the coordinate measuring was planned according to the feathers of the variable ratio noncircular bevel gear. And then generation and simulation of the measuring path was analyzed by software-Powermill. At last, the variable ratio noncircular bevel gear was measured by a coordinate measuring machine and the data was in good preparation for the later calculation and processing.

articleTitle: The onset of convection in a viscoelastic nanofluid layer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a linear stability analysis for natural convection in a horizontal layer of viscoelastic nanofluid whose rheological behavior is described by an Oldroyd B model. The effects of Brownian motion and thermophoresis on the motion of nanoparticles are considered. The onset criterion for stationary and oscillatory convection is derived analytically. Results indicate that oscillatory instability is possible in both bottom-heavy and top-heavy nanoparticle distributions. Regimes of stationary and oscillatory convection for various parameters are derived and discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Access control method based on multi-level security tag for distributed database system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An access control method for distributed database system is discussed in this paper. The method is based on multi-level security tag and mandatory access control policy. This paper designs Multi-level security system structure and defines the security tags of subjects and objects. It also presents definition rule of security tag and security tag table. Mandatory access control is achieved by modifying the user's query statement and using security tag table in distributed database system.

articleTitle: Design of VME bus interface board based on FPGA for converter control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The VME bus is a widely used industrial bus, which is applied in military, industrial, aerospace, communication and control applications. This paper describes the general characteristics of the VME bus, presents a VME bus control system for back-to-back neutral point clamped converter. Focus is on the VME interface board consists of DSP and FPGA. The design of the interface is discussed in detail. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of new suspension for four-wheeled independent steering electric automobile
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new suspension using double-wishbone and torsion bar spring type structure is designed for four-wheeled independent steering and driving electric automobile. Firstly, the simplified geometric model is built, and the ADAMS is used to set parametric model. The design takes wheel alignment parameters and vehicle roll center as the evaluation objective and optimizes the suspension guide mechanism. By doing this, a prototype model is manufactured to the design requirement.

articleTitle: Study on medical polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) / polyvinyl pyrrolidone (PVP) hydrogel burns dressing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)/polyvinyl pyrrolidone (PVP) hydrogel burns dressing has been prepared using freezing-thawing method. PVA content was chosen as 15%, the basic properties were tested, such as water content, the rate of water absorption and pH value, the mechanical properties and water transmissivities of hydrogels were analyzed when the PVP contents were difference. Experiments results show that the hydrogels diaphaneity is better, the biggest value of water contents are close to 90 percent; water transmissivity of hydrogels are over 120 percent; the pH value closes to the level of human body, the highest pH value reaches to 6.8; the tensile strength of hydrogel is 0.85 MPa when PVP content is 6 percent, reaches to the largest value; all water transmissivities is over 700 g·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> ·24h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, PVA/PVP hydrogels property is better.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of automotive antilock brake systems through PI and neural network arithmetic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The control logic of automotive Antilock Brake Systems (ABS) is introduced in this paper, which integrates PI controller and Neural Network arithmetic. A novelty of this paper is the ability to achieve superior performance through self-tuning controller which can realize robust control. Vehicle system and controller modeling and simulation are executed on software in the loop simulation platform with Matlab/Simulink. Some typical cases are simulated to verify the effect of the control algorithm. Results show that the self-tuning controller can improve the vehicle performance dramatically than traditional PI controller.

articleTitle: Study of a pneumatic constant force tracking system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a control method to pneumatic constant force tracking system. The proposed method comprise of two parts, the inner sliding position controller and the constant force controller. With this control method, as proved by the simulation results, the pneumatic force tracking system performs well from free space to contact space, and the speediness of the system is improved as well.

articleTitle: Compensation of variable pitch roller chains for the polygon effect
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper carries out a detailed research on the application performance and the polygon effect of chain transmission. This paper mainly adopts the following methods to realize the compensation of polygon effect: by use of variable pitch roller chains, the chain centerline is kept at the minimum intercross position with the sprocket pitch circle. Thus, the polygon effect of chain transmission under constraints is effectively improved, and the transverse vibration of the chain centerline during the transmission process has been weakened and eased.

articleTitle: Experimental study of surface roughness on abrasive belt grinding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article applies the abrasive belt grinding technology on the conventional lathe. According to the principle and characteristic of abrasive belt grinding, a device is designed using abrasive belt grinding technique. The affects on work piece surface roughness brought by performance of abrasive belt, work piece rotate speed, grinding depth and feed, hardness of contact wheel and so on are studied in experiments. The results indicate that using the abrasive belt grinding installment on the lathe to carry on the cylindrical precision grinding, can reduce the surface roughness of work pieces effectively and increase the machining precision. An effective way to reform the ordinary lathe as a grinding machine is provided.

articleTitle: Structure design and optimization of high-g piezoresistive accelerometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of the acceleration measurement of high impact, a high-g acceleration sensors of the piezoresistive beam - island structure at four-terminal all fixed supported was designed. The experimental results show that the structure existed the impact failure. To solve this problem, the structure processed the optimization design from improving inherent frequency of device and enhancing resistance overload ability of device. The structure parameters of the ultra-high overload acceleration sensor were made the corresponding adjustment. Through the comparison, it can be seen that the optimized structure can be more effectively prevent structure resonance. In full range load, the maximum stress of the structure can protect better the structure. Resistance overload ability also improved, the sensor can can guarantee normal work under 200, 000 g overload.

articleTitle: Parameter design and manufacture for the 4RRR parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to overcome the drawbacks of 3RRR non-redundant parallel manipulators, a redundantly actuated 4RRR parallel manipulator is designed and manufactured. In this paper, the relationship of mechanism parameters, workspace and dexterity is examined. A procedure to design a 4RRR parallel manipulator is presented in detail and a prototype of the machine is manufactured, preparing for the further studies on kinematic and dynamic performance of 4RRR parallel manipulator.

articleTitle: Designing of single phase electricity meter based on ADE 7755
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a main designing structure of electronic electricity meter (EEM) which based on the ADE7755. The design adopts the pulse signal which is in proportion to load active power and it produced by the dedicated electricity measurement chip ADE7755. The pulse is measured and displayed by STC89C54RD and (micro controller union) MCU respectively. Non-isolated Power save time is 83ms. At the same time the basic designing of electricity measurement module, clock module and displaying module are successfully implemented in the software platform. The results of testing show that this single-phase electricity meter has the accuracy of 99.5%, high reliable of power safeguard and low cost.

articleTitle: Mechanism configuration design of multi-legged walking robots based on hand-foot-integrated function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, most of multi-legged walking robots are still facing problems such as single function and maintainability. Walking robots are usually as a simple mobile platform. In order to expanding the application of the robot, the modular multi-legged walking robot based on hand-foot-integrated function is described in this paper. The robot not only can complete the walk but also can grasp the object by taking advantage of the leg's griping function. In this paper, the design concept and structure of such robot are introduced in details. The amount, the shape and the DOF of finesse, the selection of drive mode and transmission mechanism are discussed. Two typical hand-foot-integrated structures which can finish this function are introduced, it contains clamp structures robot and underactuated articulated structures robot. Design issues of two typical structures are discussed.

articleTitle: Coupled dynamic response of two-stage helical gear driving system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A coupled lateral-torsional-axial-pendulant vibration dynamic model of two-stage helical gear driving system is established, in which time-varying stiffness, deviation and backlash are considered. The differential Equations of this dynamic model are deduced. A fifth order changing step length and self-adapting Runge-Kutta numerical integration routine of the Matlab is introduced to solve the differential equations. The dynamic response of the gear driving system is analyzed by the numerical simulation method.

articleTitle: Kinematic analysis of a novel spatial uncoupled parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A novel spatial parallel manipulator with two-translational and one-rotational degrees of freedom is represented in this paper. The mobility of the mechanism is analyzed and computed by use of the screw theory. The direct and the inverse analytical position solutions are derived and the veloctiy analysis are addressed. Since the Jacobian matrix, mapping the input velocity vector of the actutated joints to the output vector of the moving platform, is a diagonal matrix, the manipulator is an uncoupled one. There exists one-to-one corresponding controlling relationship between one of the input velocities and one of the output velocities. Therefore, the path planning and controlling design of the manipulator will be very sinple. In addition, the singularities of the manipulator are discussed based on the Jacobian matrix method.

articleTitle: Preparation and properties of PVB/nano-LaB6 composite films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: PVB/nano-LaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> composite films with different content of LaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> were successfully synthesized through the method of solution blending. FESEM was used to observe the distributing condition of LaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> nanoparticles in PVB matrix. UV-VIS-NIR transmittance spectrogram of the films showed the effect of added LaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> on PVB optical property. Bending test of composite films proved that as LaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> added in, the strength of the composite films somewhat enhanced.

articleTitle: Study on the packet transmission method of audio and video
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we develop a test system for audio and video packet transmission. Using this test system, the decoding efficiency of different codec standards for video and audio are got. Having been applied in broadband network situation, 3GPP TS26.234 protocols have been added to the streaming media terminals in the test system in order to make them applicable in mobile network. Besides, a simulation platform is used in this test system in order to test the decoding performance of different audio and video packet transmission in real network environment. The same video or audio test sequences are encoded with different codec standards used in the test system (Video codec standards are H264, H263 and MPEG4-Video. Audio codec standards are AMR and MPEG4-Audio.). The experiment results show that packet performance and decoding efficiency of H264 and MPEG4-Video are better than H263 but packet performance and decoding efficiency of MPEG4-Audio and ARM are almost the same in the network condition with the same loss rate.

articleTitle: Study on forest fires recognition and moving target tracking in video surveillance system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The forest fires are caused by extremely complex natural factors and human factors. How to convert from passive prevention taxed a lot of manpower and material resources into the active management model with automatic monitoring and alarming, it has been a technical problem for forest fires department. In digital video surveillance system, we used image recognition technology to track suspicious moving target and alarm in period of forest fire prevention, to recognize forest fire and alarm in period of forest fire monitoring. We selected two places and do some test in Laoshan forest fire video surveillance system for testing, the result of test is satisfied. It can be generally used in the analogous system for preventing disaster.

articleTitle: Research on SID-IIs rib characteristic based on DOE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The 5th female dummy (SID-IIs) added in the new FMVSS214 regulation is different from the ES-2 in structure and performance of biologic mechanics. Based on DOE method, the response surface methodology is adopted to model the thorax rib characteristic of SID-IIs. This paper focuses on analysis of the different factors related to the rib displacement.

articleTitle: The realization of polynomial fit between EMF and temperature changes based on least squares fit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: K thermocouple which acts as energy converters is widely used in the process of industrial control and data acquisition. It can achieve the conversion between temperature signals and output voltages. The static characteristics of calibration should be carried out and analyzed based on the nonlinear relations between sensor's input and output. According to the principle of least squares fit, the system adopts a straight-line approach to linear. This paper introduces a polynomial fitting design scheme which can achieve dynamic connection of the electromotive force and temperature variation. This design makes use of n-polynomial approximation to nonlinear curve, whose coefficients are determined by the least squares polynomial equation, and conveys the corresponding algorithm value to the function of polynomial fit. his electronic document is a “live” template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: The research on multi-target matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the simulation training of intelligence processing system, multi-target theoretical tracks should be matched to the actual multi-target tracks generated by referring to the targets' route parameters. Research on multi-target matching is conducted through an example in this paper. The importance of selecting matching variables is proved by adopting two different methods. With the multi-target matching treated as the assignment problem, the Hungarian algorithm is applied to multi-target matching to get the optimal solution. The simulation results show that the Hungarian algorithm is an effective method for solving multi-target matching problem.

articleTitle: Kinematics modeling and step climbing study of an all-terrain wheeled mobile robot on uneven terrains
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a study of an all-terrain wheeled mobile robot which is a complex multi-body mechanism is presented. An effective approach for kinematics modeling of the robot traversing uneven terrain has been proposed. Denavit-Hartenberg algorithms and differential kinematics are derived for the individual wheel motions in contact with the terrain. The resulting equations of the individual wheel motions are then combined to form the composite equation for the rover motion. The motion study of the rover for step climbing is also presented. Simulation and experimental results have been employed to verify the rover mobility.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the LED management system based on PHP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As one of the most popular server-side scripting technology for creating dynamic web pages, PHP is popular for its opening, simple, easy transplantation, stability and high running speed. This paper introduces a LED management system which is based on an engineering project and the Windows XP Operating System. The system is based on Apache server, PHP and MySQL database.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of the property of oil film of the slipper in axial piston pump
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based upon analyzing the oil film thickness and pressure of chamber under the slipper in the axial piston pump, variation laws of the film thickness with angle of swash, revolution speed, pressure of chamber under the slipper and pressing force were obtained. It was found that in the range of general working conditions, rotational speed and swashplate angle of piston pump will not exceed bearing capacity of oil film, but it will have influence on hydrostatic bearing of slipper if exceed certain range, especially rapid change of inertia force because of increasing rotate speed.

articleTitle: Miniaturization design on magnetic induction sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This document reviews three types of electromagnetic detecting sensors: magnetic induction coil sensors, magnetic superconducting sensors and magnetic saturating sensors. Because of its energy free, low threshold and noise value, high stability and sensitivity, the magnetic induction sensor is widely used. But its disadvantages are big size and heavy weight. So it is necessary to analysis the equivalent circuit of magenetic sensor, and to give out the formulas of optimization values of ferromagnetic core coil's basic parameters(N, μc and A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>), finally put forward solutions to the miniaturization design on magnetic induction sensors.

articleTitle: The torque measurement method and characteristics analysis based on magneto-elasticity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper the process to build the torque measurement system on the basis of magneto-elasticity is elaborated; the principle that "the relationship between torque and magnetic flux density is linearly proportional" is summarized; a new method for torque measurement based on the linearly proportional relationship between torque and magnetic flux density is raised, in which the teslameter with GMR effect is applied to measure the magnetic flux density, and then the torque can be calculated; the SPSS software is used for data analysis, and both the repeatability of experiment data and the linearity of torque measurement are less than 0.1%, so the system requirement on the measurement error is met, and the new method is verified to be feasible; and finally the key technical indexes of the torque measurement system are summarized: the measuring range is 0∼100 N-m, and the error index of linearity and repeatability is respectively 0.1%.

articleTitle: Research on thermal deformation field of heavy hydrostatic thrust bearing rotation-workbench at different auxiliary-hole position
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the structure of heavy hydrostatic bearing rotation-workbench which is applied in heavy equipment, thermal deformation equations of the structure are deduced and boundary conditions for numerical simulation are established based on thermal elasticity theory. Thermal deformation of hydrostatic bearing rotation-workbench is calculated at different auxiliary-hole position. The results indicate that: auxiliary-hole position impacts a noticeable influence on thermal deformation of hydrostatic bearing rotation-workbench. Auxiliary-hole should be set at approximate 3/10 between maximum and minimum distance which is between the center and outer side of workbench. Meanwhile, that also should avoid setting auxiliary-hole near circumstance stiffened plate. The conclusions from thermal deformation calculation could provide theoretical basis for structure design of hydrostatic bearing and ravel out the thermal deformation problem.

articleTitle: Optimization of motion estimation and integer transform and quantization in H.264
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: H.264 is a new international video coding standard based on motion estimation, transform, quantization and entropy coding framework. H.264 adopts plentiful new technologies, which greatly improve coding efficiency but hugely adding complexity. This paper studies the H.264 which is the most popularly coding technology current in-depth, and analyzes the key technology of H.264. And then select the motion estimation and integer transform and quantization as the breakthrough point to improve and optimized the speed of encoding. Finally, through the data of experiment, under the premise of a satisfactory video quality, algorithm achieves the purpose of speed up the video encoding.

articleTitle: Analysis of GEO intersatellite laser time transfer and link performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The laser time synchronization is one of the developing field of future intersatellite time synchronization. This paper studied the GEO intersatellite laser time synchronization method of Compass I and gave two modes of GEO intersatellite laser time synchronization. According to the GEO satellite parameters of Compass I and in the condition of a given transmission system, link parameters and transmission loss and other conditions, this paper analyzed the relationship between satellite transmit power, antenna diameter and intersatellite transmission rate of GEO intersatellite laser link. The result provided a reference for GEO intersatellite laser time synchronization.

articleTitle: Research on method choosing parting line in die NC machining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is especially important to choose a parting line. Correct selection of a parting line may direct influence appearance on product and die machining degree of difficulty before machining a die part. However, in really machining a die part, choosing a reasonable parting line to simplify machining of a moving and fixing part sometimes needs a certain machining experience and skill. This article makes a comparison to different choices of parting line, analyses influence on a machining die part, and brings forward reasonable suggestions.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and fuzzy control of water strider robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To make water strider robot (WSR) walk on the water, the robot's dynamics modeling and control algorithms are discussed in the paper. The dynamics equations of WSR and dynamics equations concerning the actuator (motor) are established. Considering the motion's non-holonomic feature of the WSR, and inaccurate equations themselves, a fuzzy control method is applied in the paper. After calibration of the sensor, on the basis of fitting motor voltage and rotation speed, a fuzzy controller is developed to allow the robot approaching the light source target and tracking the trajectory of the target. Finally Matlab/Simulink is used to simulate autonomous motion of water strider robot. Simulation results show the effectiveness and accuracy of the approach.

articleTitle: Design of province-level information system of the development and reform commission based on portal websites
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper begins with an introduction to government portal websites, then design a framework of province-level information system of the development and reform commission. Some related technologies are discussed. Several application systems may be integrated into the framework, form an intelligent local government information system and decision support system.

articleTitle: 3D Model retrieval technology based on 3D reconstruction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that the low efficiency of current 2D target object recognition system and the process of target object recognition based 3D reconstruction is complex. The paper proposes a 3D model retrieval technology based on 3D reconstruction. The system use a new automatically select 2D feature points technology based Horn-Schunck flow algorithm and canny operator; then use 3D cloud points reconstruction technology based on Expectation-Maximization algorithm (EM) and Structure From Motion algorithm (SFM) reconstruct 3D cloud points of target object; then use a new technology rapid extract Extended Gaussian Image (EGI) based on Crust algorithm to complete matching and retrieving target object, at last prove the system is efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Factors analysis of the sound field for audio directional systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to analyze the complex influential factors on the sound field of audio directional systems, investigate the mechanism of the associated basic acoustic theories, and study how the system performance vary with the change of parameters. Then integrate these theories and analyze their combined effects on the sound field. The accurate numerical model of the sound field including multi-parameters is built, and the sound field distribution and its mechanism are simulated by MATLAB software. The results of comparative analysis presented in this work will facilitate the design of audio directional system.

articleTitle: Creative design of multimedia educational software based on technical support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper is mainly about the design strategies of educational software, and proposes the new idea of design integration. In this paper, the structure of the design of educational software is analyzed in five aspects: creative design, technical design, functional design, aesthetic design, and visual communication. By analyzing all the design stages of the development process of educational software, this paper gaped the missing of design ideas, and is can be referenced for future design and development of educational software.

articleTitle: Study on the meticulous management mode in shaanxi local construction enterprises based on ERP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation of Shaanxi local construction enterprises and also the domestic and economic forms at home and abroad. It shows that these enterprises must transform from extensive management to meticulous management. They can only grow big and powerful by efficient management. And Shaanxi local construction enterprises must adopt ERP system to realize meticulous management. For successful implementation of ERP, they must undergo the following four phases: network infrastructure-building, professional management and administration of informatization, system integration & e-commerce system construction.

articleTitle: Study on the critical cathode-mesh electric field for designing a streak image tube
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The influences of cathode-mesh electric field on a streak image tube were studied in this paper. The results show that a critical field value following the pulse current density exists. The temporal resolution of the image tube can significantly be improved by increasing the electric field when the field strength less than the critical value, but if the field is greater, it lacks influence on the temporal resolution. Under the conditions of current density 20A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the critical electric field is 10kV/mm. It is significance for designing the streak image tube.

articleTitle: Application of quality statistics tools in quality improvement of the spiral bevel gears
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the quality problems in a gear enterprise, quality statistics tools are used to improve the quality of the spiral bevel gear, and the quality data is analyzed by using Minitab software. Firstly, the technological process of the spiral bevel gear is introduced, and the quality tool is used to define the main quality problem and improvement goals. Then, as for these existing problems, the orthogonal experiment is done and the improved effect is analyzed. Through the successful implementation of quality statistical tools, the spiral bevel gear unqualifiedly is reduced, the quality of products is improved, and the competitiveness of the enterprises and customer satisfaction are enhanced.

articleTitle: The research on multipath routing algorithm of wireless mesh network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of wireless mesh network, this paper presents a dynamic toplogy algorithm based on the multipath adaptive flow distribution. This algorithm dynamically distributes data flow ratio to each path according to the weights of quality path. The simulation results show that this algorithm guarantees the stability of packet transmission and improves the delivery rate.

articleTitle: Speech quality testing method of Cockpit Voice Recorder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The procedure to quantify the speech intelligibility of Cockpit Voice Recorder is complex and not easy to implement. This paper analyzed the method to estimate the speech quality, and proposed a simple approach for the speech test of Cockpit Voice Recorder.

articleTitle: TM wave of finite-difference time-domain analyses
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Be based on the PML absorbing boundary conditions of wave propagation of TM finite-difference time-domain analyses, and given the two-dimensional situation, take absorbing boundary conditions PML FDTD center differential fraction to where net deduces finally to free space for example. Waves that TM Using FDTD program were written in C language, and the results are analyzed in details.

articleTitle: Economic production quantity model research based on facility layout planning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we introduce facility layout design problem into economic production quantity model and address economic quantity model and facility layout design problem simultaneously. With the aim of minimum total cost including set-up cost, holding cost, material handling cost and facility allocation cost, we present the optimal mathematic model based on economic production quantity model and classical quadratic assignment model. Genetic algorithm is applied to solve facility layout cost per part and derive the production quantity formulation with derivate. Simulation example is provided to illustrate the theory, and get results with production quantity and facility location.

articleTitle: A novel method for packing unequal circles into a rectangular container
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We propose a novel method for the problem of packing unequal circles into a rectangular container. Random search algorithm and Greedy algorithm are applied. In this article the algorithms are described in detail. Appropriate software has been devised and computational results are also provided and discussed.

articleTitle: On the intelligent detection of insects in stored grain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The detection of insects is always investigated for stored grain; the correct insect species identification and density ascertain provides the necessary basis for insects' prevention and control. This paper has carried on the brief narration and analysis to the stored grain pests in domestic and foreign research results. The intelligent detection of insects in stored grain based on DSP (Digital Signal Processing) and multi-information fusion is suggested at last.

articleTitle: Multi-node data acquisition and analysis system for the development of AT electronic control unit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a multi-node data acquisition and analysis system for the development of AT ECU (electronic control unit)is designed. The system acquires data from each node on the bus and sends the data to PC through CAN card, while designing data display, storage and analysis system on PC through LabVIEW8.6 platform in order to monitor control signals and state parameters of the automatic transmission in real-time. This system can improve the efficiency of data processing and shorten the development cycle for ECU by analyzing the data acquired.

articleTitle: Analysis of software automation test protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Software testing is an important means to ensure software quality and to improve software reliability. With the volume and complexity of software applications continue to increase, people's requirements on software quality are also rising; the function of software testing in the process of software development has become more and more important, while software testing effort also appears to be increasingly difficult. This paper analyzes software automation testing, and the definition, characteristics and functions and other aspects of automated are introduced. In addition, improvements to the overall process of software automation testing were proposed, providing assistance to the future work of software automation testing development.

articleTitle: The theatrical calculating formulas of BFT type flexible driving with multichannel engaging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The theatrical formulas of BFT Type Driving on practical engineering application are unbalanced because of some reasons as the restriction of structure conditions. So far, some papers only discussed the static calculation formulas of BFT type under the last stage two points meshing transfer with unbalanced load. The theatrical formulas are discussed under all unbalanced load status according to previous deficiency in this paper. This is an accurate theatrical formulas with universal significance base on the transmission. The calculation formulas are given under different degree well balanced load. The calculating example verified the correctness of these formulas.

articleTitle: Study on rotary impeller refinement of 4004 Al alloy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The effects of gas flow, rotational speed, refining time and still time on rotary impeller refinement of 4004 Al alloy have been studied. The results show that the rotational speed effect of rotary impeller refinement is superior to that of gas flow, refining time and still time. The optimum purification parameters are obtained by orthogonal analysis: rotor speed of 500 r/min, inert gas flow of 0.4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, refining time of 15 min, and still time of 6 min, and degassing rate can be 68%. Tensile results show that tensile strength and elongation of the alloy are slightly improved with increasing gas flow, rotational speed, and refining time. But the tensile strength and elongation will first increase and then decrease when the tensile strength and elongation are improved to a maximum value.

articleTitle: Instrument reach for peeping at the bore of deep pipe
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the CCD imaging device, a video system is presented to detect the inner wall of deep pipe. By LED irradiation, the information of inner wall is detected by CCD camera, which is small view field and large focal length. Then, CCD camera conveys the inner wall information to the computer, by image processing, distinct image is got. At the defects analysis on the inner wall of deep pipe, threshold is found out by adaptive segmentation method, After image segmentation, clear image about the inner wall can be got, finally, the imperfection on the inner wall is quickly located and precision measuring.

articleTitle: Improved neural network and its application in dynamic optimal design of RV reducer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve the performance of optimal problem based on BP neural-network, a improved wavelet neural network is used in the optimal problem instead of the BP neural-network. The mapping relation between the design variables and the dynamic parameters of a RV reducer is established by using the nonlinear mapping ability of improved wavelet neural network based on improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO), This method combines the global optimization searching performance of the improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and the time-frequency localization of the wavelet neural network which solves the difficult problem of establishing target function in dynamic optimal design So a complicated dynamic optimal problem converts into a simple optimal problem. This provides a new way to obtain a design scheme with good dynamic behavior in design stage.

articleTitle: Research and design of an emergency command system based on mobile devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of man-made and natural disasters, building complete emergency response mechanism becomes imperative. On the other hand, wireless communication technology is developing rapidly. The speed and reliability of data communication has improved obviously. This paper puts forwards an emergency command system based on mobile devices; it can process text message as well as multimedia information, and transport the situation on the spot to the emergency command department accurately to assist decision makers in responding emergency. The emergency command system has been realized on the Android, Windows Mobile, J2ME and Brew platform, and is already in service in the emergency response command department of the government.

articleTitle: Multi-path with probable performance for congestion control in DHT networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In structured P2P networks, the skewness in query pattern and the greedy routing strategy could result in query congestion in some hot spots. Bearing both aforementioned factors in mind, we propose a congestion control mechanism named Multi-Path with Probable Performance (MPPP) in this paper. The basic idea behind MPPP mechanism is to disperse the routing load via multi-path to more nodes to exploit the free capacity and to ameliorate the degree of congestion in the network. We also provide a theoretical analysis to prove that the performance of MPPP is bounded with probability. Additionally, simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of MPPP mechanism.

articleTitle: Research of transparent object by means of LED-based digital holography
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new interferometer is proposed and employed to investigate transparent object by means of LED(light emitting diode)-based digital holography. The interferometer combines the advantages of Mach-Zehder interferometer and Michelson interferometer, it enable us to adjust the optical path difference of the two beams interference on a Mach-Zehder interferometer. Thus the interference fringe patterns of LED could be observed quickly and conveniently. First the principle of the new interferometer is stated and then it is compared with other interferometers. Secondly, LED-based phase-shifting digital holography is carried out to investigate transparent object. Both theory and experiment results are presented.

articleTitle: Research on bearing capacity of inclined pile under vertical load
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Inclination of piles may occur due to different reasons. How to determine the bearing capacity of inclined piles is a tough problem in practice. Field load tests on inclined piles, the required characteristics of soil for FEM analysis were obtained to conduct numerical analysis. The bearing capacities of piles with different degrees of inclination under different soil conditions were studied. It was shown that the settlement of piles was obviously influenced by the soil conditions, and that under the same vertical load the settlement of piles with the degree of inclination no more than 5 percent was even smaller, but the settlement of piles with the degree of inclination more than 5 percent increase obviously. With the inclination increases its bearing capacity is decreased obviously, thus the degree of inclination is the main factor of which control the vertical bearing capacity of inclined piles.

articleTitle: Abstract interpretation-based formal description of data obfuscation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an abstract interpretation-based formal description of data obfuscation, which makes it possible to formally analyze and certify not only the correctness but also the potency of data obfuscating transformations. First, a semantic data obfuscating transformation is given, which is expressed as an abstract interpretation of program semantics with a variable obfuscation function and a corresponding variable deobfuscation function. Then, the syntactic data obfuscating transformation is systematically derived by composition of source-to-semantics, semantics-to-data obfuscating transformed semantics and semantics-to-source abstractions applied to fix-point trace semantics.

articleTitle: Analysis of chemical constituents of volatile oil of scrophularia ningpoensis hemsl GC-MS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Objective: Scrophularia ningpoensis hemsl is a kind of traditional Chinese medicinal materials with high medicinal purposes value and wide application. It had important meanding to analyze its volatile oil consitituents on expanding its utilization and increasing the added value. Methods: The volatile compounds of scrophularia ningpoensis hemsl were isolated with steam distillation and identified by capillary GC/MS and the relative contents of the constitons were detemined by area normalization method. Results: 64 volatile components were identified and determined, accounting for 96.89% of the total area of the peaks. Conclusion: The main volatile compounds are: furfural, 5-methyl-2-furan carboxaldehyde, Z-5-methyl-6-heneicosen-ll-one, palmitic acid, furfuryl alcohol, acetylfuran, terpineol, m-Cresol, 2-Acetylpyrrole, o-Guaiacol, phenylethyl alcohol, (2Z)-2, 4-pentadien-1-ol, 3-ethyl, isovaleric acid, Spiro[2.4]heptan-4-one, phenylethyl alcohol, 4-ethyl-2-methoxy-phenol, 4-Vinylguaiacol and sobutyric acid.

articleTitle: The computer application in the route measurement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This design aimed at measuring the route curve by wire polar coordinating method is researched and established the corresponding graphics in the industry and data processing system. The design is proposed a complete set of implementation proposal mainly about the establishing method and procedure of this system so as to realize the modernization of the modern route engineering measurement in the internal industry. According to the modern route measurement knowledge, process the data in the route measurement by computer and draw the mapping can combine the internal and external industry together, which is enable to greatly shorten the working hours and improve the accuracy. With the modern computer knowledge, map can be drawn in the field to reduce the manpower and material. As the mainly treatment method of processing the corresponding data in the industry and drawing the map in the computer, the field data will be automatically drawn the map by the computer after processed. And the powerful graphics editing functions provided by drawing software can help us find out the optimal design proposal which is the perfect combination of human's intelligence, experience, creative thinking and the computer advantages of high-speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: The third superharmonic resonance of inclined beam subjected to harmonic excitation in temperature field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on nonlinear vibration equation of inclined beam subjected to harmonic excitation in temperature field, the first approximate solution of the 3 superharmonic resonance of the nonlinear vibration system is obtained by means of the method of multiple scales for nonlinear oscillations. The jumping and hysteresis phenomena of amplitude frequency response curves of 3 superharmonic are obvious. Numerical analysis on the influence of temperature, excitation, dumping, and geometric parameter on amplitude frequency response curve are as follow. With the increasing of Elastic modulus, cross-sectional area, damping, and high, the amplitude and resonant region of the 3 superharmonic resonance decrease. With the increasing of Excitation amplitude, length, initial temperature and temperature coefficient, the amplitude and resonant region of the 3 Superharmonic resonance increase.

articleTitle: Bionic design of building structure based on digital technology — The design of the structural morphology of Muping Sports Center
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Taking Muping Sports Center as an example, this paper advocates the application of parametric digital technology to the bionic design of building structure. From the perspectives of morphology and structural engineering, it has also elaborated the key elements in practicing the structural bionic morphology based on digital technology in practice.

articleTitle: Optimum design of planet gear mechanism based on VB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper establishes the mathematical model according to the planet transmission design theory and compiles the corresponding VB procedure by certain algorithm, which realizes the optimization of planet gear mechanism.

articleTitle: Effect of vibration frequency on friction and wear properties of Sic Ceramics/ 45 Steel friction pair
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The friction and wear properties of Sic Ceramics/ 45 Steel under the condition of alternating vibration load are researched on the friction and wear tester by ring-block means of contact, which is compared at the same friction power under the condition of static load. And The friction and wear properties is compared at different frequency. The results of test show: the friction coefficient, wear quantity is larger than the wear rate at static load; with frequency increasing the friction coefficient and wear volume increase too, but the extent of wear quantity increasing is smaller; at the lower frequency, the wear is mainly abrasive wear with less fatigue loss and micro-crack; at the higher frequency the wear turns to be dominated by fatigue flaking with less cracks and furrows.

articleTitle: An introduction of multisensor optimal information fusion based on Kalman filter method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A comprehensive introduction of multisensor optimal information fusion based on Kalman filter, the state fusion methods are summarized in this paper, and they are implemented with Matlab. Practice proves that Kalman filter has a good application prospect in multisensor optimal information fusion.

articleTitle: Ageing condition inspection system for electrical contact based on micro-current contact resistance trend tracker
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An equipment which was used to inspect the ageing condition of electrical contact by track the trend of contact resistance under micro-current was developed. Compared with existing technology, the equipment can not only measures the contact resistance under micro-current(100 μ A) which is propitious to evaluating the ageing condition of a contact, but also grasp the trend that contact resistance follows the changed current (range of 100 μ A to 1A) which is help to estimate where a contact should be used and which type of contact should be used in specific situation. The scanning electron microscopy and Energy Dispersive Analysis System of X-ray were used to verify the ageing condition.

Author Keywords: energy dispersive analysis system of X-ray

articleTitle: 4-axis micro ED-milling of micro 3D structures on cylindrical workpiece based on CAD/CAM commercial software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a correlation of the commercial CAD/CAM software into the micro 4-axis electrical discharge milling (ED-milling) process. By applying the commercial CAD/CAM software, the model can be designed and the NC code can be generated. According to the NC code, the 4-axis ED-milling process can be carried out successfully by the micro 4-axis machine tool on the cylindrical workpiece. The milling process was presented and the tool electrode wear was shown in the diagram. The on-line CCD and SEM pictures of the 3D micro structure on the cylindrical workpiece were shown in the paper at last.

articleTitle: A method for fault diagnosis in chemical reactor with hybrid neural network and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Rapid and accurate fault diagnosis remains a problem in the case of multiple fault for the large and complex chemical system. A novel evolutionary neural network for fault diagnosis is suggested. Which adopts three-layer feed — forward neural network with dual genetic algorithm (GA)loops embedded in its training. The dual GA loops are designed for optimizing both topology and connection weights of the neural network and establishing global optimal neural network for fault diagnosis. Computer simulation results in a chemical reactor indicate that the proposed evolutionary neural network fault diagnosis system works effectively and is superior to the conventional back propagation(BP)neural network.

articleTitle: Negative refraction effect in two dimensional square and hexagonal photonic crystal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
