abstract: This paper demonstrates that light propagation in two dimensional square and hexagonal lattices photonic crystal (PhCs) behaves negative refraction effect in the vicinity of the photonic bandgaps. Plane wave expansion method was used to solve complex eigenvalue problems, as well as to plot dispersion curves and Equi-frequency surfaces (EFS). Theoretical simulating results have been presented, and all-angle negative refraction and superlensing effect have been versified.

articleTitle: An improved ant routing algorithm for HAP networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper explains the potential role of HAP network for providing air traffic control(ATC) and air passenger communication services(APC) in aeronautical communication. An improved ant routing algorithm based on delay of node is presented, which is used to find the shortest path from source to destination and satisfy the QoS metrics. Simulations have been performed to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the proposed algorithm could significantly reduce call blocking probability in aeronautical communication.

articleTitle: Application of moment invariants in checking the overall dimension of the head cover
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Casting auto transmission head cover, because of its structure complex, form special, it is difficult to check the overall dimensions before it is cool, which greatly increase the time of the product, reduce the factory efficiency. In this paper, for the just completed casting products, the moment invariant is used to check the overall dimensions to determine quality, without human testing, which can reduce the time, increase efficiency, improved real-time and ensure the safety of workers to avoid injured.

articleTitle: Data acquisition technology of link layer filtering under Linux environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article first describes the architecture of Linux network stack, the principles of link layer's filtering acquisition, and then analyze the network card drivers, lastly, gives the building Scheme of data acquisition environment and the implementation strategies of link layer filtering acquisition. Using the data acquisition system to which the filter policy is added, reduces the packet loss rate, saved the system resources, and enhanced the processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of credal network on evaluating emergency capacity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By analyzing existing evaluation method of emergency capacity, the paper pointed out the inadequacy of existing methods and gave an evaluating model on emergency capacity based on Credal Network. It better expressed the uncertainty and complexity of the system by interval probability, and taked inference and diagnosis on the system. In the end, it gave inference algorithm process by example and showed the model is valid.

articleTitle: Output feedback control of switched systems: Instrumental matrix method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new and simple approach to design output feedback controllers for switched systems is proposed in this paper. The bilinear inequality including Lyapunov matrix and output feedback gain matrix is decoupled by introducing additional instrumental matrix variable. Combined with multiple Lyapunov function method, the bilinear inequality is transformed into linear matrix inequality (LMI). The sufficient conditions of, under designed switching signal, asymptotical stability of closed-loop switched system via static and dynamic output feedback are presented, respectively. The proposed conditions do not require the decomposition of Lyapunov matrix and its inverse matrix and fix the structure of Lyapunov matrix. The theoretical results are verified by means of an example.

articleTitle: Friction torque of rotating hydraulic cylinder with fleet circular groove oil film face seal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Power chuck is an important component for machine tool. In order to solve the existing problem of oil-allocating for rotating hydraulic cylinder of power chuck, a new kind of rotating hydraulic cylinder based on hydraulic slipring is suggested. The fleet circular groove oil film face seal technology is applied in the hydraulic slipring for oil transmission. Taking account of the vary of viscosity, the frictional torque of the seal face is simulated in detail. The experiment data prove the preciseness of the theoretical analysis. These theories provide reference for the practical application of the rotating hydraulic cylinder.

articleTitle: Reasearch of Wood Plastic Composites application based on Fused Deposition Modeling technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Wood Plastic Composites (WPC) was mainly made into regular section for application. The cooling shaped regular section WPC became into production by machining, which cost much energy and time. By Fused Deposition Modeling (FMD) of Rapid Prototyping (RP) technology, WPC productions could be made by this increasing materials technology, which decreased energy, process period and materials cost. Analyzing defection type and strength, WPC can be applied in middle strength required big FMD parts.

articleTitle: The analysis on the singularity of a 3-UPS Parallel Machine Tool
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper takes a 3-UPS Parallel Machine Tool (PMT) as the object to study, and it mainly analyzed the singularity of machine in the workspace. Firstly the kinematics of this machine is analyzed on the basis of introducing the structure of PMT, the kinematics equation of PMT is established, and further the Jacobian matrix of PMT is obtained. Then the workspace of PMT is carried on the solution and the analysis. Finally the degree of operability is taken as the measure index to analyze the singularity of PMT within the workspace, and the results show that this PMT does not have singular position. The analysis results of this paper have laid the theoretical foundation for the position control of this PMT.

articleTitle: A chip temperature-controlled technology based on the integrated-circuit CA3046
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By using a SCM as the core control system, and the IC CA3046 for the temperature-controlled chip, we design a technology to control the temperature of the transistor fast and precisely and this is based on the PWM comparator of the analog temperature-controlled circuit. The technology integrates electrical heating system, temperature sensor and transistor for detection in one semiconductor chip, and the SCM controls the chip's temperature which aims at achieving the adjustment, control, measurement and display of the transistor's temperature in the chip, also making chip work at a more stable temperature.

articleTitle: Application of 3G technology in mariculture dynamic monitoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, many shortcomings still exist in mariculture dynamic monitoring of our country. Given the current extensive applications of 3G technology and its advantages, this paper applies 3G technology to mariculture dynamic monitoring and puts forward a dynamic monitoring system based on 3G technology of mariculture. Parameters such as the salinity, potential of hydrogen (PH) value, temperature are as monitoring indexes in this paper. And the scheme of the system structure is put forward, it includes data acquisition module, data communication module, database module and user terminal module. The system provides many conveniences such as data collection, transmission, processing, storage and feedback control for users. So the users can get real-time data and monitor the mariculture effectively. It is in favor of the development of China ocean economy.

articleTitle: Design of hollow-core photonic band-gap fibers for CH4 and C2H2 optical fiber sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber for optical fiber sensors is designed. According to the calculation, we get the parameters of the photonic band-gap fiber as d=0.94*2.60μm, R=Λ=2.60μm for C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and d=0.94*2.41μm, R=Λ=2.41μm for CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. Around the wavelength of λ(C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) = 1.53μm and λ(CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) = 1.66 μm, 98% of the energy is propagated in the core, the fiber is suitable to be used to detect the gas such as CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Effect of content on dielectric performance of polyimide / TiO2 hybrid films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In situ polymerized polyimide/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> composite films with good electrical performance are studied. These nanocomposite films are also characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). SEM analyses show that the spherical shaped titania particles and the ceramic particles distribute uniformly in the matrix of hybrid film. Dielectric properties of the films are measured in the frequency range of 102Hz-105 Hz by an impedance analyzer at room temperature. The dielectric constant varies with the sweeping frequency and filler content and it decreases with sweeping frequency. It is demonstrated that the breakdown strength reaches its maximum value when the content of filled TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is 0.5 wt.%, and then decreases with the increase of the concentration of the filler.

articleTitle: The higher order asymptotic fields for anti-plane oblique crack with physical weak-discontinuity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An Oblique anti-plane crack is studied with its tip at the physical weak-discontinuous line of the structure which is made up of homogeneous material and functionally graded materials (FGMs). The analytic solution of the higher order crack tip fields (similar to the Williams' solution of homogenous material) is obtained by applying the asymptotic series expansion. When non-homogeneous material parameters are degenerated, the solutions become the same as the asymptotic crack tip fields of the homogeneous material. Therefore, the solutions are the basic results of non-homogeneous fracture mechanics, and provide a theoretical basis for solving the fracture problems of one common structure with physical weak-discontinuity.

articleTitle: Research and design on power converter for switched reluctance drive
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new design on power converter for switched reluctance drive (SRD) is proposed. Firstly, several commonly used main circuit topologies in SRD power converter are described, its working principle and characteristic are analysised and compared comprehensively. Secondly, circuit design of SRD power converter with 5.5kW is completed. Finally, components that is needed by main circuit are selected and calculated. Experimental results are given to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the design.

articleTitle: Signal extraction algorithm of high-tension and low-tension based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper has achieved stimulate a signal extraction algorithm of high-tension and low-tension through analyzing eyes and brain which identify infrared remote control waveforms and interference signal waveforms, judging effective infrared remote control signal or interference signal. The algorithm has made high-tension and low-tension, multi-source signal into public mode by typing-ordering, and processing, secondly filter signal, thus achieving multi-source coupling of infrared remote control. Based on the algorithm of remote control signal identified it has completed infrared remote control switch IC which has got good application in the design of an energy saving lamp.

articleTitle: Application of equipment maintenance vehicles based on entropy multi-objective decision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Vehicles equipment in the battlefield tactical value higher, blow, destroy the enemy target, transportation needs higher rates battle damage. This paper focus on future information-based war vehicles equipment safeguard demand, Combined with examples from multi-objective decision analysis Angle, using the entropy weight method is used to determine the weights of evaluation indexes, get the high reliability coefficient of the sort of the equipment maintenance plan vehicle, so as to improve the regeneration efficiency vehicle outfitting.

articleTitle: Base on research of un-calibrated visual servo in crawling object with dexterous hand
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper describes an un-calibrated control method for dexterous hand crawl an object with eye-in-hand camera. This method is based on boundary tracking method for object contours. This method does not compute moore-Penrose inverse of image Jacobian, avoiding the image the singularity of image Jacobian.

articleTitle: Improved parameterization method and its application on solving optimal control problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The mathematics fundamentals of solving optimal control(OC) problem by parameterization method is easy to be understood, but a nonlinear programming(NLP) problem is usually hard to be solved because the dimension derived from parameterization method are too high. The characteristics of improved method is that only parameterizes the control variables. The dimensions of a NLP problem will be reduced greatly if the improved parameterization method is employed, then the problem will become easy to solve. The improved method has been successfully applied to solve a problem of an aircraft optimal landing trajectory in penetrating wind shear.

articleTitle: Quadrature formula for some classes of analytic functions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We study numerical integration on some periodic analytic functions from the class A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r, b</sup>. We determine the optimal convergence rate of the rectangular formula on this class.

articleTitle: Generalized elementary transformation and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper recommends the concept of generalized elementary transformation. Then the paper illustrates the applications of generalized elementary transformation in determinant calculation, rank of matrix, inverse of block matrix and eigenvalues of matrix.

articleTitle: Topological optimization of pedestal based on variable density method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Being based on variable density method and taking minimum weight as the optimization target, depending on joint style of structural elements, if there is hole in structure, topological forms such as number and position of holes, etc., made the structure transferring external load to the pedestal under the state that constraint conditions relating to balance, stress, displacement, etc. are satisfied. Taking the displacement as constraint condition, performed topological optimization to the pedestal by applying optimization software OptiStruct of Altair, and design of pedestal, performed stress and deformation analysis to pedestal under static load, to achieve the optimization target of minimum mass under the condition that requirements of load and space dimensions are satisfied.

articleTitle: Measuring the performance of knowledge sharing in regional innovation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on panel data collected for seven years (2003-2009) of 30 provinces, the efficiency of knowledge sharing in regional innovation in China was evaluated by DEA Malmquist indexes model. The result indicated that knowledge sharing efficiency of six regions was improved respectively. As the same time, technical efficiency of knowledge sharing process in West China grew fast because of the advantage of backwardness so that it can acquire and absorb knowledge more quickly. As being lack of satisfactory performance in the technical efficiency, cross-organization excitation mechanism that support cross-sector collaboration and knowledge transfer between institutions and locally industries were more or less unsatisfactory.

articleTitle: The control system design of methanol reforming hydrogen based on kingview and PLC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We designed the methanol reforming the computer control system of hydrogen combining process characteristics. The combination by SIEMENS S7-200 and "kingview" software not only have better met the control demands of the hydrogen production units with carbinol method and PSA hydrogen purification processes, but also reduce the cost and improve the operability, making the technology is more and more widely used in industrial production.

Author Keywords: Hydrogen production units with carbinol method

articleTitle: Study and design of fine marking and accurate positing for expressway network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The expressway user's locating problems confront the customer service center of expressway while rescued in the traffic accidents and emergencies are presented. The deficiencies of the current road network's naming and coding rules were analyzed when used in the accurate posting on the driving direction, ramp, interchange and overpass etc. Based on the unified national rules for road network' naming and coding, a set of accurate road network's locating signs were put forward including four major elements which are road code, hectometer number, driving direction and transmission verification. The coding regulationes, methods about making and installing were also provided in detail, thus would help the managements get user's position fast and accurately, and guide the rescuers reach the scene as fast as possible.

articleTitle: Research and development on mechanical products rapid design system oriented to individual requirements
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Under the environment of mass customization how discrete manufacturing enterprises rapidly meet customer personalized and diversified demands, based on orders clustering, concurrent engineering thought is used and production scheduling is moved to the product design process. The product family establishment and update, personalized product configuration and production scheduling method are studied, and rapid product design system is established which contains customer demands, product family model, product configuration and production scheduling. Taking reducer for example the system is verified. The results show that the system can rapidly design the customers' personalized products, and effectively reduce costs.

articleTitle: Relation discovery in medicine through Semantic Graph Routing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The kernel concept of semantic web is that the data on the web can be abstracted as different graphs with nodes and links distributed among a multitude of web agents. In this environment, latent relationship discovery can be reduced into Semantic Graph Routing, which aims at searching possible paths under reasonable hypotheses within a set of autonomously-maintained and interlinked semantic graphs. Based on our previous work on semantic association discovery, here we establish a useful real life environment where it is proved that our multi-agent approach can be effectively applied. The experimental simulation results show that semantic-aware mechanisms provide notable path searching capability.

articleTitle: In-situ high temperature XRD studies and crystallization behavior of a Ti-rich Ti-Ni-Cu ribbon
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Structure evolution and crystallization behavior of initially amorphous Ti52Ni23Cu25 alloy ribbon were investigated by means of in-situ high temperature X-ray diffraction and DSC. The structure of crystallization products and the texture of B2 phase vary with annealing temperature increasing from 350 to 650°C. B2 crystalline phase was formed initially at 400 °C from the amorphous ribbon, while a Ti2(Ni+Cu) type of precipitates were developed at the temperature above 550 °C. The texture of B2 phase has a transition from B2-(200) to B2-(011), and then keeps stable as the annealing temperature increases. Continuous DSC measurements with different heating rates were performed to determine crystallization activation energy and Avrami exponent for the alloy ribbon. The activation energy determined by Kissinger's equation was 372kJ/mol. The Avrami exponent values (n=2) obtained from the basis analysis of Johnson-Mehl-Avrami equation are consistent with diffusion controlled crystallization processes with decreasing nucleation rate.

articleTitle: Development of automatic control system for supplying cold water based on PLC and configuration software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to supply cold water for engine laboratory PLC, configuration software, HMI, and inverter are adopted to construct an automatic control system in this paper. The control system is a distributed control system, which has higher dependability and maintainability. The reading and writing network instructions are utilized to solve the communication among multi-master problem. The remote monitoring software is developed with configuration software. By measuring temperature and pressure of entrance and exit pipes, refrigeration equipments and water pumps are adjusted real-time to guarantee to supply stable temperature and pressure cold water. Therefore the quality of water is improved and power is saved. Practice proves that the system designed meets user's requirement. The system has a good reliability and high degree of automation.

articleTitle: Study on the integrity detection and evaluation method of damaged pipeline
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To detect the integrity of damaged pipeline and accurately evaluate its damaged condition, a CCD image data guided digital automatic ultrasonic testing system was designed to realize the dynamic measurement of a pipeline damaged surface, and extract the characteristic parameter of damaged pipeline. Based on the three-dimensional discrete point set which gathered to describe the integrity of damaged pipeline, we establish a damaged pipeline entity model which is closer to the actual condition, analyze and simulate mechanical properties under the actual load by using the numerical simulation software (ABAQUS), to get the most dangerous region and the trend of stress and displacement. This method provides more reliable reference for integral safety analysis and evaluation of damaged pipeline.

articleTitle: An image retrieval method based on personalized image semantic model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article introduced in the content-based image retrieval principle of image similarity measure, as well as visual feature extraction methods on the basis of the focus on the images and analysis of the semantic concept model, the typical extraction methods and algorithms. PISM (Personalized image semantic model), the use of user queries related to the image of feedback mechanism, dynamic image adjustment semantic similarity of the distribution, and fuzzy clustering analysis, PISM training model to make it more accurate expression of semantic image to meet the different needs of the user's query. And the limitations of image-based semantic memory of learning algorithm, the initial experimental system developed by a number of user feedback to participate in relevant training, which analyzes the performance of the algorithm, the experiments show that the algorithm is a viable theory, with a value of the application.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A new kind of effective of algorithms for solving the option pricing model with transaction costs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The simulation and experimental analysis for pneumatic drying of biomass stalk
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Through the analysis of the characteristics of the drying process of biomass fuel particles, a numerical model was developed to describe the heat and mass transfer process in pneumatic drying of biomass fuel particles in horizontal tube based on two-phase flow theory. This model is solved by numerical method. The experiment result shows that the model can reflect the actual drying process precisely. The whole drying process can be divided into two parts: fast drying section and the moderate drying section. Experiments were conducted under the conditions of different initial moisture content, air temperature and quality flow of material, with the effects of various factors analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of frame structure and MAC protocol for real-time EPON
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Problem of real-time performance is a mostly obstacle on Ethernet used to industrial control. In this paper, proposed a RT-EPON concept, combines real-time performance of real-time Ethernet and efficiency of EPON, and design the frame structure and protocol of RT-EPON MAC. In a building test system, the designed frame and Mac protocol have tested, it shows that the RT-EEPON system is stable and reliable, and the BER (Bit Error Rate) is 10-10 below on the physical layer of fiber link.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of intelligent ozonizer based on Atmega8
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The design of intelligent ozonizer based on Atmega8 MCU is introduced in this paper. The full bridge inverter circuit is adopted both in the power of ozonizer and the module of fan. Two-way PWM of singlechip control the high voltage power and the output of pan, which make the ozonizer have the feature of intelligent control and high output of ozone.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis of anisotropic circular cylindrical shells with varying winding angle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to obtain approximate analytical solution of natural frequencies for the free vibration of anisotropic circular cylindrical shells made of GFRP (glass fiber-reinforced plastic) with simply supported boundary conditions, Love's theory and Energy method are used. Computation results show that the fundamental frequency comes from different vibration modes while the winding angle varies, the effect of number of axial half waves is stronger than number of circumferential waves on natural frequency of free vibration of anisotropic circular cylindrical shell. The effect of shell's geometrical parameters is also investigated on natural frequencies.

articleTitle: Theoretical research on bending deflection of ram in DVT250 numerical control double-column lathe
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For DVT250 numerical control double-column lathe ram appears the problem of precision over standard in the precision inspection of item G6, according to mechanical theory to analyze actual structure and force, and research the bending deflection when ram runs in different locations by using classical mechanical theory, to require torsion deformation of ram under the action of cylinder thrust and guide screw pre-tightening force, and verify the accuracy of theoretical analysis through on-site detection, which not only provide a theoretical basis for engineering actual optimization design and performance prediction of ram, but also propose improving measures for reducing the bending deflection.

articleTitle: Virtual link-lengths approximating method for forward kinematics of multiple motion-coupled linkage mechanism
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The forward kinematics of one kind of multiple motion-coupled linkages mechanisms were investigated, which were applied to the finger of one kind of under-actuated hand, when the finger was not touching any objects. By setting virtual link-lengths for multiple motion-coupled linkages, a numerical approximating method to solve the linkages forward kinematics was advanced. The objective was to improve the iterative speed slowed by the motion-couple of multiple linkages. In this method, these virtual link-lengths were used as several new variables in Newton Iteration to reduce the amount of derivation and computation for each differential iterative step and then the entire computing time. The operating speed had an obviously improvement in a numerical example.

articleTitle: The finite element analysis of the coach body frontal crash and structure improvement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The crash passive safety, especially the frontal crash safety is an important aspect to reflect the safety of the automobile. According to the 90° frontal crash requirement specified in China's frontal crash regulation CMVDR, this research analyzes the finite element analysis of a coach body crashing into the rigid wall at the speed of 48km/h and improves the result of analysis in order to make the coach crash safety meet the requirement in the regulation.

articleTitle: Study and experiment on key component of vegetables transplanter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For the development of Chinese vegetable planting, a vegetable transplanter was designed with functions of trenching, sending seedlings into the ditch, righting, backfilling, compaction and other processes by replacement parts of the paddy field transplanter in the meantime. Key component transplanting mechanism mainly uses a crank-rocker mechanism and pushing seedling cam mechanism. Geometric locus and attitude of transplanting were optimized by studying the crank-rocker mechanism and the cam motion characteristics to meet the agronomic requirements of transplanting vegetables. The field experiment and measurement showed that that it was consistent with the industry standard of dry planting with stable performance, and the reliability is 95%. Study and application of this technology have important practical significance and long-term strategic meaning.

articleTitle: The application research of parametric design in de-airing pug press
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper illuminates the application of parametric design methods of de-airing pug press. It introduces the principle and the process of de-airing pug press design with the help of Pro/Engineer secondary development tool - Pro/TOOLKIT and development software - Visual Studio 2005.

articleTitle: Coal mine reconfigurable monitoring model based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we present the model of reconfigurable monitoring based on Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), which merges the technology of reconfigurable virtual instrument and WSN. A set of multi-function monitoring instrument platform with WSN characteristic was developed by using Visual Studio software. This instrument can not only visually display the present topological graph of monitor area, but also enhance module reuse. Finally, a monitoring instrument, facing the equipment of hoist room in coal mine, was designed and constructed. The result shows the platform realizes reconfigurable function of the instrument module online and dynamically.

articleTitle: The construction of educational software development platform based on Flash
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To solve the problem of resource reusability in education software development and make the development less difficult, the paper, facing learning objects, puts forward a new idea of development, "level integral-style". The practice proves that development efficiency of educational software and the resource reusability can be greatly improved by the following measures. That is, the teacher, in the guidance of learning object theory, analyzes educational software's objects, finds the types of learning objects, then constructs the databases of learning objects after using Flash's hierarchical disposal, and eventually manages different levels of learning objects by a player program.

articleTitle: The modeling method of curved surface based on ACIS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the method of modeling based on ACIS. At first, it describes the way of raveling the blending function of B-Spline out. Then it finds the B-Spline surface using rectangle matrix. At last, a model of complex bending-face is found based on ACIS modeling theory.

articleTitle: A Feasible Process For Mining Corpus From Web
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Mining bilingual parallel sentence pair from Web data is the most effective way to get large-scale of bilingual corpus. In this paper, we put forward both the set of method and the series of process for extracting parallel sentence pair from nonspecific web date source. considering 1.1 billion page as the web data input, with a sequence of steps we get several sentences pair which has 81% recall and 85% precision, on this basis we bring up a parameter for measure quality of sentence pair. After filter sentence pair by this parameter, we get 850 thousand unique sentence pairs. On filtering by this parameter, the precision increase to 95%, meanwhile the recall only decrease by 1%.

articleTitle: Differential clonal selection algorithm for solving constrained optimization problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a differential clonal selection algorithm (DCSA) combined with an adaptive penalty function method is proposed for solving constrained optimization problems. In order to improve the diversity of the solution, a minority part of the antibodies located in sparse region are selected to do proportional cloning according to their minimum neighbor distance values. Comparison is made to four state-of-the-art algorithms in solving eleven well-known standard test problems. Simulation results show that DCSA performs better or similarly than the four approaches.

articleTitle: Operation characteristics of organic semiconductor copper phthalocyanine bipolar mode thin film transistor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The organic bipolar mode thin film transistors (OBTFTs) are fabricated by the method of evaporation in vacuum with copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) dye, and has five layered structure of Au / CuPc / Al / CuPc / Au. The experiment reveals that OBTFTs has obtained low driving voltage, high current density and high switch speed such as I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub>=1.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>A/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the degree of 1000Hz. The OBTFTs has excellent operation characteristics of like bipolar static induction transistors.

articleTitle: Research on structural design of robot leg based on Pro/e
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Apply Pro/e to 3D modeling of all robot parts, the virtual assembly and motion simulation of all robot parts such as gear, axis and pedestal and so on in Pro/e assembly module were presented in details. The relationship between the structural design of robot parts was examined according to the assembly effect, and then whether there is interference phenomenon existed should be observed. Finally, whether the structural design of robot is reasonable should be further observed by means of motion simulation of robot.

articleTitle: Research on tool swept volume in NC simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper researches on the swept volume in the numerical control (NC) simulation system and proposes the new method of swept volume generation in three-axis machining and in five-axis machining. Based on general tool model and swept volume theory, swept volume generation methods are presented for different tool trajectory and motion mode. The test has proved that the proposed methods are feasible and effective. Material removal process in NC machining simulation can be accurately displayed with fast computation and less memory consumption.

articleTitle: Heat flux analysis of space camera with thermal door
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Thermal stability is an important parameter which can affect the optical ability of large aperture space camera. Most of space cameras with large aperture and high resolution need high thermal stability, which means the temperature gradient should be no more than 2°C. This situation causes that the thermal control system should increase the design criteria to meet the challenge. Space heat flux including vertical incident solar rays, infrared radiation from earth and solar rays reflected by earth are the major factors which affect the temperature flied of the camera. The space heat flux of some agility remote sensing satellite changes within a wide-range. In this paper comparison of using thermal door or not in such camera is introduced. The heat flux of the space camera is analyzed and the effect of thermal control system is described.

articleTitle: Technology innovation and practice of long span traditional pure stone structure: Case from pure stone archway in Baoji new executive square
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Solidity is a fundamental of architectures, as well as guarantee for users' safety. Advanced structure technology constitutes dominant force promoting construction to development fast. The stone component section stress distribution, state and nature are changed by prestressed technique, and made to satisfy safety standard. In addition, the stone cold brittle has been given some elastic-plastic improvement, and its application range has been widen. The puzzle that stone could not be used as building materials in large span bearing component is solved by combining prestressed technique with traditional tenon technology. Consequently, it provides theory basis for such project implementation.

articleTitle: Total meshing area changing disciplinarian of work meshing pair of oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear is of an advanced drive wheel suitable for large power and high transmission ratio system. It has a broad prospect of application. The paper introduces transmission types of oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear, and analyses different transmission types of oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear's meshing process, summarizes evolution of total meshing area of oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear's work meshing pair. This research provides a theoretical basis for further discussion to bearing capacity of oscillating-teeth end-face harmonic gear's work meshing pair.

articleTitle: Wavefront aberration correction using circulation feedback control based on image boundary definition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In wavefront correction the pixels position error will affect wavefront corrector precision. To solve this problem a circulation feedback control method based on image boundary definition was proposed and an experiment is done on wavefront correcting based on liquid crystal spatial light modulator (LC SLM). The measured wavefront aberration is transformed a gray image to search edge pixels and centroid coordinates by boundary detection method of the digital image processing. On this basis the wavefront aberration is corrected by circulation feedback control. The experimental results show that the PV value of the static wavefront aberration is 0.66λ, the RMS is 0.13λ and the Strehl ratio is 0.54 before correcting and the PV is 0.17λ, the RMS is 0.02λ and the Strehl ratio is 0.98 after correcting. The PV value is less than λ/4 and the Strehl ratio is near diffraction limit, which proves that the above method is effective.

articleTitle: A universal model for ruled surface's linear cutting with four-axis linkage machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the ruled surface's multi-axis manufacture is a hot research direction, but its universal mathematic model as key theory problem hasn't been established so far. To solve the problem of ruled surface's manufacture with four-axis linkage machine, we worked out the intersection line between the lateral surface and the horizontal plane of upper-lower guiding device through geometry method, and then established the universal mathematical model to manufacture the lateral surface of the work pieces under the condition that the lower guide is fixed. To verify the exactness of the model, we took the four-edge frustum and triangle-circle frustum as example. The model has universal use value in guiding practical manufacturing.

articleTitle: Network database application in military academy assistant courses arrangement system based on XML
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Considering the current situation that setting courses arrangement and publishing curriculum schedule is not more efficient, the author designs a new assistant courses arrangement system, within which uses the algorithm of courses arrangement and builds network database make use of XML technology, and then achieves of courses arrangement inquiring from campus network. Practices results demonstrate that the new system with characteristic of data standardization, better commonality and alternateness increases of efficiency of issuing information.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of cutting process based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the majorities factories depend on the experience or the reference cutting specifications handbook in the production choose the cutting specifications, this often cannot achieve the cutting parameter optimal. Using the modern cutting theory, mathematics modeling and the model analysis method seek the cutting parameter the most superior combination, is cuts the parameter choice an important direction. Taken an example of optimization design for parameter of lathe cutting process, illustrated the application of optimization toolbox of MATLAB in mechanical optimization design. The math model of parameter of lathe cutting process was established according to the design request and the character and optimized for the least process cost. The optimal results show that by using the MAT LAB optimization toolbox to solve the question, the mechanical design efficiency can be improved because not only the arithmetic is reliable, but also the program designed is simple.

articleTitle: Study on virtual soldier's behavior modeling in urban battlefield simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Modeling the behavior of the virtual soldiers, the modeling technology in the field of military simulation, is very important to study the virtual soldiers in the urban battlefield, for the reason of the needs of military simulation technology and the field of national defense. Based on the definition the virtual soldiers and behavior modeling, this article also describes the requirement of modeling behavior of the virtual soldier, and then presents a model framework for the virtual soldiers.

articleTitle: Research of paper machine electromagnetic dryer based on intelligence control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Electromagnetic dryer is a new kind of paper machine dryer which bases on the electromagnetic induction technique. This paper adopts PIC18F8680 MCU with fuzzy control technology to design electromagnetic dryer control system, and its hardware and the software design has been completed. The simulation experiment shows that the intelligent control system for electromagnetic dryer is reliable with good real-time and high precision.

articleTitle: 3G/4G mobile communications propagation loss NPL model and network optimization scheme under shelter of vegetation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To problem of mobile communications signals attenuation caused by high density street trees, we firstly split street trees into four categories based on the trees' heights and ages, and then bring up models of 3G/4G mobile communications electromagnetic wave attenuation based on shelters from respective category of street trees (NPL model) and network optimum scheme. Finally through practical tests and theoretical analysis, we conclude the NPL model and optimum scheme can not only decrease handover failure and solve the problem of motion video interruption caused by the absorption of street trees on electromagnetic wave, but also can satisfy current 3G and future 4G needs for mobile communications network and optimization.

Author Keywords: street trees' absorption to electromagnetic wave

articleTitle: Intake port development flow of 4-valve diesel engines based on RE/CFD/CAM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the author summarizes the development and research on diesel intake port, and brings forward the target and the meaning of researching on the reverse design process of the intake port in 4-valve diesel engine; builds up the three dimensional geometric model of the intake port of a 4-valve diesel engine via reverse engineering; simulates the flow status in double ports (helical port and directional port)-valve-cylinder by using the CFD software FIRE; produces the cavity block of intake port core by the method of Numerical Controlling Machining; verifies the CFD calculation result and the steady flow test result of the core box and cylinder head, and draws a conclusion that the three show good agreement with each other, which shows the feasibility of the RE/CFD/CAM design process for intake port.

articleTitle: Study on performance evaluation and frequency characteristic for real-time image stabilization system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In image stabilization systems based on motion detection and real-time compensation, the time of image acquisition, and motion estimation, etc. resulted in delay of compensation signal in relation to actual vibration, and the influence gradually became more significant with the increase in vibration frequency. We presented a concept of compensation degree to quantitatively evaluate and analyze the influence and used Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LS-SVM) to predict the motion, so the signal delay was effectively correction. The experiment results showed that the LS-SVM had high prediction accuracy, fast calculation speed and good stability so it was in favor of improving the frequency characteristic of image stabilization systems.

articleTitle: Synthesis of ZnO nanocrystals with different morphologies by hydrothermal method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: ZnO nanocrystals with different morphologies have been synthesized by hydrothermal method employing zinc acetate dihydrate [Zn(CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>COO)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>·2H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O] and sodium hydroxide (NaOH) as the starting reactants and characterized by means of X-ray diffraction (XRD) and field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM). The results show that the as-synthesized products are hexagonal wurtzite structure of ZnO and exhibit flake-like, flower-like and rod-like structure, respectively. Their growth mechanisms are also tentatively elucidated.

articleTitle: The effect of spinning missile on the position calculating of the reticle infrared detecting system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The spinning reticle seeker is the significant part of the infrared (IR) detecting system. The track of the light spot is no longer a circle because its movement is disturbed by the spinning of the missile. In this paper, we analyze the effect of the missile's spinning on target position calculation, and obtain three important conclusions for the detecting system to improve its competence. Firstly, the calculated target position swings around the actual value. Secondly, the maximum error rate decreases along with the polar radius of the target position. Thirdly, the period of the swinging value is the lowest common multiple of the scanning and the spinning frequencies. These conclusions are well proved by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A novel method of network traffic anomaly detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to propose a new algorithm which is based on combining the linear model and the method about smooth exponential. It is used to simulate the AR model of the Single sliding window sequence of observations and gets the average value of the square of slide window observed values' residual noise and achieve the previous statistics on the latter statistic forecast with exponential smoothing method so as to decide whether the network traffic is normal or not. This algorithm is more efficiently comparing with GLR method and more reliable comparing with smooth exponential method, and has been proved is effectively in the detection for network traffic anomalies.

articleTitle: The video and audio transmission system design and implementation for a helicopter by satellite-based communication channel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to achieve two-way real-time audio and video transmission in low bandwidth satellite communication channel between the helicopter and the ground station, we propose a real-time audio and video transmission design and implementation to control transmission delay and bit error rate in a reasonable range. This particular method really ensures the full use of the satellite channel and transmission quality of audio and video, at the same time, reduces the transmission delay and smooth video shows, etc. By simulation experiments, some satisfactory results in transmitting have been achieved.

articleTitle: Applied research on stock forcasting model based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Making use of the function approximation and self-learning of BP neural network, we analyze the historical data in Shanghai Stock between June 2006 and November 2009, construct a stock forecasting model based on BP neural network, and verify the model through some test samples. Finally, we can use the Robust model to forcast the short-term stock. Matlab simulation experiments indicate that the model is feasible and effective in short-term stock forcasting.

articleTitle: 3G Technology in the engineering disciplines of higher vocational education
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the continuous development of modern communication technology, a substantial increase in data transfer speed, video and massive data transmission has become a reality. With the demands of practicalness and realtime property in modern vocational education, 3G technology is used in the practice of on-site dynamic teaching and can be visually displayed in the teaching aspect. So it saves a lot of manpower and material resources. Meanwhile it provides a new way to improve the practical teaching method.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation about the double-circular-arc modified cycloid epicyclical gear train based on UG
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Owing to manufacture difficulty, cycloid gears are not widely used in the practical application. The purpose of this paper is to make double-circular-arc modified cycloid epicyclical gear train apply to power transmission system which has the high contact strength and the high lifetime. Double-circular-arc modified cycloid gear epicyclical train is studied in this paper, whose transmission characteristics are analyzed. Based on UG/NX operating platform, 3D parameterization models of gear train are established. The simulation analysis of contact stress is carried on in the circumstance of UG/NASTRAN. Finally, the simulation result is compared with theoretical calculation, so the validity of simulation is verified. Based on the CAD/CAE integration feature of the UG, the parameterization model of the train is built and analysis of contact stress is carried on, which will be used for the optimum design of the gear train. And the theoretical basis is provided for improving the design efficiency, transmission performance and product quality in practical gears manufacturing.

Author Keywords: Double-circular-arc modified Cycloid Gear Epicyclical Train

articleTitle: Design and simulation of CMOS star sensor lens with large relative aperture and wide field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A 50mm focal length, F/1.25, Gaussian type optical system is designed in this paper, which has 20°field of view. Actual star image adding optical cross-talk effect of CMOS(Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor), detector is simulated by non-sequential ray tracing in ZEMAX<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> optical design and analysis software to evaluate its performance. The distortion relative to image spot centriod is introduced and calculated by simulated star images, which is less than 0.03% of lens in this paper. Thermal adaptability is discussed by opt-mechanic thermal analysis, which shows the RMS spot radius of marginal filed changes less than 0.7μm under 10°C temperature gradient, and changes less than 1μm during homogeneous temperature changing from -40°C to +40°C. The results of analyses and simulations show the design of this lens can achieve the requirement of high precision CMOS star sensor well.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis on a vehicle's speed control systems stabilty based on fuzz rules and PID method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A vehicle's speed stability performance is important index for the advanced vehicle. Therefore, we are interested in the vehicle's speed control module. And then we also study on the control algorithm based on fuzz control rules and PID theory, and by comparation we discovers in terms of fuzz control method designed the control system better performance then PID. The simulation result shows the better robust.

articleTitle: Preparation of modified chitosan by salicylaldehyde
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The salicylaldehyde was used as monomer to modify chitosan. The resin material is characterized by means of IR. In ethanol solvent, Schiff base reaction between chitosan and salicylaldehyde was carried out, the salicylicaldehyde grafted chitosan (S-CTS) was generated. The effects of the reaction temperature, the reaction time, the reactant ratio, the system pH and the stirring rate on the graft reaction rate are studied in detail. The rersults show that the best reaction conditions are as follows: the temperature is 60°C, the reaction time is 8h, the ratio of chitosan and salicylaldehyde is 1:4, the pH is 5 and the stirring rate is 440r/min, the grafting rate can achieve 37.5%.

articleTitle: Analysis of mirror-tilting and sampling errors in Fourier transform spectrometry and design of error analysis Graphical User Interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The Michelson interferometer is the optical core of the Fourier Transform Spectrometer. In order to obtain the spectrum, one needs to sample the interferogram and then conduct Fourier transform on it. Tilting of the moving mirror during a scan will have a bad effect on the interferogram and the spectrum. If the sampling positions are not accurate, there are sampling errors that will affect the measurement of the spectrum. The causes and categories of the tilting and sampling errors are analyzed in this paper. The sinusoidal and static tilting errors and the sinusoidal and random sampling errors are taken as examples. The mathematical model is given, and the effects of the two types of errors on the interferogram and spectrum are analyzed and simulated numerically by MATLAB. By making the Graphical User Interface (GUI), it will be convenient to observe the influences of these two types of errors on the spectrum.

articleTitle: Research on energy consumption analysis of beer brewing process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Because there are many coterminous workshop sections in beer brewing process and the reaction mechanism is very complex, it is difficult to analyze the energy consumption. Aiming at the problem, the analysis method of energy consumption is proposed based on the production data. First, energy consumption of beer brewing process is analyzed using the data envelopment analysis (DEA). The relative efficient productive batches are obtained. Secondly, the less dimensional production data are obtained using the principal component analysis (PCA) which depresses the correlation among the variables. Finally, the energy consumption of brewing process is modeled using radial basis function neural network (RBFNN), and the energy consumption model with the minimum error is also built by adjusting the width of the radial basis function. The simulation result shows that the model can be used to analyze and predict the energy consumption of the beer brewing process effectively.

articleTitle: Optimization for information visualization based on visual thinking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Information visualization (InfoVis) is a tool that assists people to strengthen their cognitive capacity rather than an invention that results from technology development. The main purpose of this paper is to demonstrate the key role that visual thinking plays in optimizing the cognitive resource arrangement, and then seek solutions to improve information visualization based on visual thinking process.

articleTitle: Energy saving mechanism based on double-way polling DBA algorithm and ONU sleep mode for EPON
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In recent years, power saving in broadband access network has become an important issue. Ethernet over passive optical network (EPON), a new optical access technology which is the optimized combination of Ethernet technology and passive optical network (PON) technology, has become one of the best choices of PON technologies. In this paper, we propose a energy saving mechanism for EPON. The mechanism bases on double-way polling dynamic bandwidth assignment (Double-way Polling DBA) algorithm and optical network units (ONU) sleep mode.

articleTitle: Parametric design of straight spur gears based on Pro/E
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The variety of gears is various, and the gears' structures and sizes needed in different situations are unlike, so the conventional development couldn't satisfy the marketable requirement already. According to the analysis of straight spur gear's structure, parametric 3D modeling and secondary development based on Pro/e are carried through, and then realized the gear's parametric 3D design. Thus, improved design efficiency of the gear, reduced designer's duplicate work and the cost.

articleTitle: Design of high-speed sampling circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As high-speed signal sampling is not easy to achieve and sampled high-speed data is not easy to accept or control, two methods of high-speed sampling clock generation and clock distribution are given relating to practical application. Two ways of high-speed data deceleration are introduced, namely the hardware multiplexer transition method and the software programming control method by large scale integrated circuit. The sampling circuit can handle the data at the highest sampling rate of 3GHz. The systems have the quality of high integration, low power consumption, simple structure and excellent performance. All the programs have been proven feasible and achieving good results.

articleTitle: Experiment study and control strategy simulation on powertrain for an electric bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of parameters matching for powertrain of an electric bus and its key components experiment verification, powertrain control system was focused designed and studied. The control strategy of driving torque and motor overload protection were developed, the method of battery power management was confirmed, in accordance with vehicle brake system, a combined strategy of mechanical and electrical regenerative braking was determined. Application of Matlab/simulink and ADVSIOR software, vehicle modeling and performance simulation analysis were carried out and the control strategy was verified. The simulation results show that the developed control strategy for the electric bus is applicable for vehicle drive control and energy management, the proposed regenerative braking control algorithm can increase vehicle drive range effectively in different driving conditions.

articleTitle: An improved fair subcarrier allocation algorithm for multiuser OFDM system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: An improved subcarrier allocation algorithm for multiuser OFDM system was performed, In order to improve the proportional fairness of channel resource allocation. A parameter a was introduced into the new algorithm. The subcarrier allocation algorithm was divided into two steps: aN subcarrier allocation algorithm and residual subcarrier allocation. By simulation experiment with the proposed algorithm, D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> algorithm and Shen algorithm, the proposed algorithm has a good performance in the spectral efficiency, normalized capacity, sum capacity and fairness.

articleTitle: Unified format definition for bulk data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the industry, there are various special formats of bulk data, that are non-structural data. Lacking of normal method to describe the structure of non-structural data, it is difficult to query and manage non-structural data as same as structural data. A architecture is put forward to describe the logical structure of bulk data, that is composite of three levels: the bulk data format definition language, special format definition, physical data file. Analyzed the components of bulk data file, the formal definition and the corresponding XML description are presented to define the logical structure of bulk data file. Considering the logical structure is dependent on the detailed data in bulk data file, an format definition language is defined in XML schema, that can define difference kinds of bulk data format. To access data by logical structure for bulk data file, the approach of mapping from logical structure to physical file is presented. Above method has been applied to manage seismic data in petroleum domain.

articleTitle: RMS and power measurements based on Wavelet packet decomposition using special IIR filter bank
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Wavelet packet decomposition (WPD), has been applied to meter the root mean square(RMS) and power. when using the method based on WPD for RMS and power measurement, the computational complexity of this algorithm is high, operation speed is low and unsuitable for the hardware realization. As results, the algorithm is not used popularly in practical application. Considering the problems above, This paper proposes the use of all-pass implemented special half-band elliptic infinite-impulse-response filters in the Wavelet packet decomposition of power measurements, The study of this paper reveals the proposed implementation reduces the computational complexity to levels comparable to FFT. the computer simulation experiment and Actual test results confirm the validity and accurate performance of the proposed method for power measurement.

articleTitle: Design of tester of porcelain insulator ultrasonic detection based on embedded technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For protecting Electronic device, the tester of porcelain insulator ultrasonic detection based on embedded technology was designed, which function included: test data gathering, demonstration, storaging and intellectualization. The design result showed: the device take on stable performance, high data processing speed and measuring accuracy.

articleTitle: The algorithm research of penetration distance based on normalization processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to get the real-time penetrating distance of the projectile and make it detonate in the predetermined depth, this article puts forward the algorithm of penetration distance based on normalization processing, using ANSYS/LS-DYNA software to simulate the process of projectile penetrating vertically into concrete targets through which the projectile penetration acceleration signal can be reached, reading the signal by utilizing the penetration distance detonation control module, and verifying the algorithm. The result indicates that the relative error of this algorithm is small, and it can also reduce the processing time of the microprocessor, which states that this algorithm is well-designed.

articleTitle: Design of cab monitoring image transmission system based on ZigBee protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Cab monitoring image transmission system can realize real time monitoring of the carriage, to prevent the crime, accidents and investigate afterwards. It is an important part of the construction of rail security system. This thesis propose a cab monitoring image transmission system based on a wireless network transmission protocol - ZigBee. Install several cameras inside the carriage to collect high definition monitoring image and then transmit the image to the cab control center through wireless network real-timely. In the cab control center, the conductor can have a good grip of the condition inside the carriage in order to command and dispatch the cab running.

articleTitle: Research and development of intelligent decision system for highway maintenance based on GIS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of modern highway development, and establish reasonable and effective technology platform for allocating maintenance funds, an intelligent decision system for highway maintenance based on geographic information system(GIS) was developed. In the system, the database technology was combined with GIS spatial management technology to realize the treatment and display of spatial data and attribute data, after treating the road index data into the required type of localized HDM4 model, analyze and predict the major, medium and mini repair schemes and the allocation of the maintenance funds. The system provides a relatively practical guidance for the application of GIS applied to highway maintenance intelligent decision system and decision basis for the administrators of highway construction.

articleTitle: Reserch on the valuation model of technical enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Since the assets and operation of technical enterprises have distinctive characteristics, it is difficult to evaluate the value of those technical enterprises reasonably. Based on the characteristics of science and technology, to use the model of real options to evaluate their intangible assets, and to use the binary growth model to evaluate their future growth, the purpose is to explore a more reasonable valuation method of technical enterprises.

articleTitle: ADR algorithm applied in electro-hydraulic servo system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Electro-hydraulic servo system due to its unique characteristics of fast response, wide range of speed, big load stiffness, strong resistance to electro-magnetic interference, large power output, light weight, etc. is applied in various industries. It is hard to build its accurate models due to nonlinear effects in order that conventional algorithms based on accurate models are ineffective to compensate disturbance. Hence, ADR (Active Disturbance Rejection) algorithm is adopted to further improve control precision of electro-hydraulic servo system, in which comprehensive disturbance instead of nonlinear effects was observed and compensated in real-time. Through simulation research by building system models with disturbance and comparing different simulation results, the parameters of ADR algorithm were tuned. Experiments with well tuned parameters of ADR algorithm were carried out to verify the validity of the algorithm on tri-axial electro-hydraulic compound flight simulator table middle-axis driven by electro-hydraulic servo system. Experimental results show that a high dynamic tracking performance is achieved based on ADR algorithm and robustness of ADR algorithm is strong. Thus, ADR algorithm can be used in practical control system.

articleTitle: Research of non-servo valve electro-hydraulic servo system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new non-servo valve electro-hydraulic servo system was researched. To control load, the system uses bidirectional fixed displacement hydraulic pump that is driven by AC PMSM directly drives servo-hydraulic cylinder. The hydraulic actuating unit was designed base on one design parameter and performance target. Initiative oil supply issue of closed circuit was solved by a set of screw-in cartridge check valves and closure oil tank contained PAF breather filter were used in the system. Achieving position control of the system by using compound control scheme of feedback-plus-feedforward and pressure closed-loop. The result of the simulation analysis and experimental research showed that the new type system could replace traditional Electro-Hydraulic servo system by achieving the function of controlling the main engine. Because of its closed circuit construction, the system has some new advantages, such as saving space and cost, saving energy sources and environmental protection, all these advantages make it accord with the direction of the future hydraulic technology.

articleTitle: Selection and processing of surface roughness for mechanical parts
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
