abstract: The basic principle of digital synchro converter (DSC) is introduced, analyzing how to use Micro Processor LPC2292 as its key part and other linear circuit to generate two sine and cosine to achieve the transforming method of from digital signal to synchro signal, completed a suit of the digital signal drives synchro interface system of autopilot steering, its accuracy and other performances can all meet the requirements and the running effect is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of dynamic virtual network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Facing up complex and various Hacker's attacking, a new approach of constructing the dynamic and adaptive virtual network based on virtual honeypot and network scanning is presented in this paper to puzzle adversaries, delay and divert attacks from their real targets, exhaust attacker resources, and collect the attacking information. Firstly the elementary concepts of honeypot and Honeyd is examined, then the techniques of network scanning used in the virtual network system are analyzed especially the active TCP/IP stack fingerprinting, and then this dynamic and adaptive system is designed and implemented, furthermore the virtual network is comprehensively tested, the experimental results prove this design can simulate the real network environment successfully.

articleTitle: The modified reliability-based iterative majority-logic decoding algorithm for structured LDPC codes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we present a modified reliability-based iterative majority-logic decoding (MRBI-MLGD) algorithm for structured LDPC codes. The MRBI-MLGD algorithm uses the initial rather than the last updated message value in the iteration procedure, which works resembling a turbo decoder. Furthermore, the MRBI-MLGD algorithm is an integer message passing algorithm and mainly requires logical and integer operations. Simulation results show that, compared to the original one, the MIRB-MLGD algorithm can achieve better performance with slightly increased computational complexity.

articleTitle: Effect of annealing on the structure and magnetocaloric properties of Gd5Ge2(Sl2−xAlx) compounds
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: All the samples of Gd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>(x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5) were produced by arc melting under argon atmosphere. The crystal structures of all samples crystallized in the orthorhombic structure are studied by X-ray powder diffraction (XRD). The crystal symmetry is preserved while the content of Al changes. By Lakeshore VSM, we have measured M-T curves and M-H curves of the samples at different temperatures. The result shows that the magnetocaloric effect of Gd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>) is the largest one in all samples at their Curie temperatures, which is 1.4J Kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> · K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> where x=0.2. The magnetic-entropy changes are small before and after annealing, which indicated that the uniform magnetocaloric effect phase had been formed before annealing.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiment study of dynamic performance for a hydraulic mount using AMESim
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Dynamic stiffness and loss angle are important dynamic performance for hydraulic mount and it's significant to predict them accurately. The structure of a hydraulic mount is introduced and the ideal dynamic performance is illustrated. Based on the mechanical model and the mathematic equation of the hydraulic mount, a simulation model is built using AMESim software. The dynamic stiffness and loss angle of the hydraulic mount is calculated and a test is carried out to validate the simulation. It shows that the result of simulation is correct and the model built with AMESim is useful to predict the dynamic performance of the hydraulic mount.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the static interference fit for the spindle and chuck of high speed horizontal lathe
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Spindle and chuck are critical units of the the high speed horizontal lathe, while the interference fit between the chuck and spindle is one of most important factors influencing the performance of the high speed horizontal lathe. To simple structure of geometry form regulation, the static and dynamic formulas are derived for the calculation of interference fit and analysis of the stress by the theories of theoretical mechanics, materials mechanics and elastic mechanics. But to the complicated structure spindle and chuck, the fault having no way to calculate a precise is had a surplus of measuring the analytical solution. In order to solve this problem, Finite element method is adopted to study them according to contacting theory. Finally, the interference fit between the the chuck and spindle of the high speed horizontal lathe made in Qiqihar Heavy CNC Equipment Corp. Ltd is determined. Result is indicated that simulating value and the experiment fits fairly good, and this method is a dood way to solve the interference fit between the chuck and spindle, and it realizes to forecast the performance of interference fit between the chuck and spindle of the high speed horizontal lathe.

articleTitle: Research on the three-dimensional modeling of roadway for coalmine based on GIS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The roadway is the coalmine vector of tunnel transport, ventilation, drainage and other systems. To build a coal virtual reality system, the key is to create three-dimensional model of tunnel. Based on the section data model, this paper established roadway model, and carry on realistic simulation of the roadway based on GIS technology and 3d visualization technology.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle air suspension system dynamic simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper has calculated and designed the vertical stiffness and frequency on the basis of mathematical model of air spring suspension system. This paper has SIMULINK computed and analyzed the response character according to road excitation spectrum as input.

articleTitle: A digital design method of geometric model for centrifugal fan impeller based on SolidWorks and VB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on an analysis of design and model in the aerofoil blade, carrying out second development by using the Solidworks and Visual Basic 6.0, a digital design method of geometric model for the impeller of aerofoil blades is provided by the silhouettes of the blade section zoomed which are gained by calling functions of Solidworks API in VB program, according to the existing silhouettes of the standard aerofoil blade section. Taking impellers of the G4-68 serial centrifugal fans as applying objects, the superiority in application of VB and Solidworks is embodied on the geometric model of aerofoil blade for impellers.

articleTitle: Research of top-down automatic assembling design method based on linkage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Facing the research and development of product rapid design system and practical application of rapid design technologies, top-down automatic assembling design method based on Linkage is given out. The mechanisms of product top-down automatic assembling design as dimension driven linkage, geometric driven linkage, logic driven linkage, assembling matches driven linkage, master model driven linkage etc is researched, the method of how to develop assembling template base of product is probed, each design step of rapid design process in product rapid design system based on product assembling template base are analyzed and described, and the method of how to develop automatic assembling design template is studied.

articleTitle: Self-configuration model of service on large-scale server cluster system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Service capacity based self-configuration model has been proposed to relieve the complexity of installing and configuring applications on a server cluster. The model is an acyclic directed graph. It details the generating algorithm of the model. Based on the algorithm and the knowledge set of cluster system, the self-configuring method is presented to automatically provide resources to meet the service requests.

articleTitle: Design and realization of traffic information collection and detection system based on linear CCD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new traffic information collection and detection system based on linear CCD is designed and realized. The system extracts traffic parameters such as license plates, vehicle existing, vehicle speed, vehicle type, traffic occupancy, flow rate and so on, using linear images of vehicles passing the detection section collected by linear scan CCD camera. And it can transmit required data to the monitoring center using TCP/IP protocols. Compared with traditional video detection systems, the system has the advantages of high real-time, accurate detection and abundant functions. And it achieves a good performance in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Effects of oxygen stoichiometry on the photovoltaic properties of La0.4Ca0.6MnO3-δ epitaxial films grown on miscut MgO substrates
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: We report the effects of lattice constants variation induced by oxygen stoichiometry on the photoresponse properties of La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-δ</sub> epitaxial films grown on miscut MgO substrates. The oxygen content was changed by annealing the sample in oxygen and vacuum. With the decreases of oxygen deficiencies, the electrical conductivity and the diffraction peak [101] of the film increase. It is found that the photovoltage and photocurrent decrease monotonously as the oxygen contents decrease.

articleTitle: Air ground radio equipments centralized remote control based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Air ground radio equipments are the necessary equipments to actualize the flight control by the control tower at an airfield. In order to ensure the command transmitting unobstructed, the air ground communication equipments usually include a series of radios, and they work respectively at the different frequencies. However, in the flight control, because every radio has a corresponding remote control terminal, the commander must to face multi sets remote control terminals. For the convenient and reliable operation, the air ground radio equipments centralized remote control scheme based on CAN bus is provided. By the centralized remote control mode, the control operation of radio equipments is integrated. The commander can expediently achieve the air ground audio command using one set of changeless remote control terminal through anyone of many radio equipments in the ground control tower. The audio command information of commander also can be cluster transmitted through multi sets of radio equipments at the same time. Thus, whichever channel is using, the audio communication link can be established timely and credible between pilots and ground commander. The flexibility and reliability of air ground audio command communication is improved.

articleTitle: The study of the fixation for femoral neck fracture based on finite element method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Femoral neck fracture is a kind of common bone damage. The stability of injured joint is often influenced by the fixed angle of screw, the number of screws and the combination of screws when the internal fixation method is brought into operation. In this study, by means of medical image processing and finite element analysis, we do a research of simulation which will reflect the relationship between the fixed angle of screw and the stability of postoperative joint. The fixed angle that we discussed is in the situation of single-screw internal fixation. The material properties model of bone that we used in research can make bone show the performance of non-homogeneous and anisotropic. Then we simulate the physiological loading conditions to load the finite element model. These two methods bring high accuracy to three-dimensional finite element model, and also reliable theoretical basis which comes from the simulation results to evaluate the development of the femoral neck fracture surgery program and its effect of treatment.

articleTitle: The crack-tip higher order field of functionally graded circular plates based on Reissner's plate theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: For homogeneous material and non-homogeneous material plates, the crack-tip field plays an important role in the research of fracture mechanics. In this paper, the governing equations are derived. Then, the series expansion is applied to find the crack-tip field of circular plates of functionally graded materials (FGMs) with Reissner's effect. Finally, the higher order crack-tip field is obtained and becomes the solution of the corresponding homogeneous plate as non-homogeneous material parameter is degenerated, i.e. β→0.

articleTitle: The judge of modified oblique plane double enveloping worm gear tooth contact line style
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The second bounded function of the modified oblique plane double enveloping worm gear pairs was discussed and solved, which based on spatial meshing theory. The contact line style was analyzed and the worm gear contact tooth was drawn to use the second bounded function.

articleTitle: Design of VxWorks-based software architecture for space optical remote sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to satisfy requirements of real time and parallel control for the space optical remote sensor and implement the high integration of software, a kind of VxWorks-based multitask software architecture was put forward. Firstly, the technological requirements of optical remote sensor were analyzed in detail and functions and performances of the optical remote sensor were fixed. Task that was based on each function of optical remote sensor was compartmentalized. Then, software architecture of optical remote sensor was designed. Finally, experiments were carried out and results verified the accuracy and feasibility of the software architecture. Test results showed that the software architecture satisfied the requirements of real time and parallel control for the space optical remote sensor, its functions and performances met the system design target perfectly, and the software architecture was applicable to the engineering application of space instrument.

articleTitle: A circular bend mode piezoelectric micro-droplet ejection generator for spatial lubrication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper reaches into a circular bend mode piezoelectric micro-droplet ejection generator, and a complete relation model from the voltage pulse applied on the piezoelectric transducer to ejection parameters of high viscosity aerospace lubricant droplet was established. Based on the Finite Element Analysis (FEM), transient response analysis of FEM modal was carried out, and the vibration equation of circular piezoelectric transducer was obtained by means of curve fitting. Multi-phase computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software was involved, and the gas liquid two-phase flow near the nozzle was established. To solve the interface movements with continuing topology changes, volume-of-fluid method (VOF) along with the piecewise linear interface construction (PLIC) techniques were implemented to describe the interfacial movements. A computational approach based on VOF method was applied to analyze the ejection process of lubricant droplet. And the effects of internal factors consist of dynamic viscosity and surface tension on the ejection parameters were investigated emphatically.

articleTitle: Distinction non-stationary pulse wave signals with HHT method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to distinguish the difference of non-stationary pulse wave signals, the novel time-frequency analysis approach, i.e. Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT), is applied in this paper. First Hilbert-Huang transform is briefly introduced. Secondly, two differently non-stationary pulse wave signals are described in Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD). With these results, the two pulse wave signals that looked apparently similar in time waves are distinctly different from each other. It is proved that HHT is effective for the purpose of distinction of non-stationary analysis.

articleTitle: Real-time reconstruction of orange tree model based on obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Based on obstacle avoidance of orange fruit harvesting robot, the real-time fruit tree model reconstruction is studied. Modular modeling method is adopted for the reconstruction, which extracts a standard module from the orange fruit tree by configuration study and then gets the fruit tree model after combining the module. Through the comparison between truncated cone module and cylinder module, step cylinder section is chose as the standard module. In order to supply the tree model in time, polygonal approximation is used in the standard module construction for the data reduction. The experiment for middle complexity tree model proved, that this method can realize real-time reconstruction of orange tree model, and the model is precise enough for obstacle avoidance.

articleTitle: Design of autogenous tumbling mill hydrostatic bearing monitor and control system based on WinCC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Autogenous tumbling mill hydrostatic bearing monitor and control System is making use of information age characteristics, sensor, measuring instrument and Siemens PLC fully to monitor and control it's important parts running status. WinCC system can realize visualization and get the bearing running information on line. It provides convenient to bearing's running safely, maintenance and repairing.

articleTitle: Dynamic control for low cost auxiliary power unit of electric bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A lower cost Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) of series hybrid bus based on diesel engine, permanent magnet synchronous motor and uncontrolled rectifier is presented in this paper. On the basis of a built system model, and according to static data, an APU power closed-loop controller which is consisted of forward-control circuit and PID feedback-control structure is developed. The simulation results show that, better dynamic characteristics of power output for the lower cost auxiliary power unit of hybrid bus is realized, with the forward and PID control method, and to a certain extent, meanwhile the stability of engine speed is guaranteed.

articleTitle: A combined interference cancellation multiuser detector design for STBC-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to restrain the interference of co-channel users in uplink STBC-OFDM system, the combined linear MMSE multiuser detection with interference cancellation is proposed in this paper. Theory analysis and simulation results reveal that the proposed schemes have a substantial performance improvement compared to the traditional detection scheme.

articleTitle: Preparation of titanium nanopowder by induction plasma technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The spherical titanium nanopowder is prepared by induction plasma technology, according to scanning electron microscope, oxygen-azote mensuration equipment and inductive coupled plasma emission spectrometer, the morphology and chemical constitution of titanium nanopowder are characterized. With the processing parameters of the induction plasma technology are chosen, the average diameter of nanopowder is 25.4 nm, and spheroidization degree is almost 100%. Meanwhile, the result of chemical constitution shows that the induction plasma technology has no obvious influence on the content of impurity element such as C, Fe, Ni, Cr and Al but reduce the oxygen content of Ta nanopowder.

articleTitle: Research on floating-gate ISFET biosensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: By the analysis of the sensing mechanism of ISFET, A HSPICE behavioral model of a floating-gate ISFET is built based on the site-binding model. Its static input-output characteristics are simulated and the relationship between the membrane resistance, membrane capacitance, interconnection line parasitic capacitance and the dynamic characteristics of the response delay and hysteresis is investigated. The results provide theoretical references for the design of the chips in an ISFET/ REFET differential integrated sensor.

articleTitle: Prediction of performance and exhaust emission of a marine electronic control diesel engine based on modeling of BP neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The aim of this study is to predict the marine diesel engine performance and exhaust emission values building a new approach based on ANNs. In this study, two stages were carried out: First, the experimental data was obtained by testing performance and exhaust emission of marine diesel on the bed. Second, ANN modeling was successfully trained by experimental data, and then the model was used to predict engine emission values. The result showed that the values produced by ANNs were parallel to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Structural design and damping characteristics modeling of new recycling vibrational energy hydraulic vibration damper
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A vibrational energy-recycling vibration damper is introduced which can recycle some vibrational energy by exporting pressurized oil from rebound cavity to energy accumulator. Pressurized oil can be used for hydraulic power steering, hydraulic power braking and so on to save energy. Nonlinear parameterized model of damping characteristics is constructed by fluid mechanics theory, and simulated under MATLAB. The results show that damping characteristics of the vibration damper is better than conventional dampers.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of X-cor sandwich's compressive modulus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Through the analysis of X-cor sandwich's microscopic characteristics a finite element model of X-cor sandwich's compressive modulus was proposed. The finite element software ANSYS was used in the computation of compressive modulus. The effects of changing angle, diameter and density on the X-cor sandwich's compressive modulus were analyzed. The numerical analysis results indicate that as the Z-pin's angle increases the X-cor sandwich's compressive modulus decreases, and as the Z-pin's diameter and density increase its compressive modulus increases. Via the analysis of finite model the influencing trends of X-cor sandwich's parameters to its compressive modulus are achieved, the rationality of the proposed finite element model is verified and the finite element model can be used to forecast its compressive modulus.

articleTitle: Software development for vehicle braking system integration and match
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Braking safety performance is one of the most important capabilities in vehicle. Thus, a method for braking system matching development efficiently and conveniently is urgently needed by engineers. This paper, based on the needs of braking system matching development, established a braking pedal model which could reflect the braking system characteristic, a vacuum booster model, a master cylinder model, a hydraulic circuit model and a simplified vehicle model. Also, this paper developed the braking system simulation software which could realize system parameters setting, simulation and post processing by using MATLAB/GUI. Finally, as an example of this methodology, a particular vehicle braking system matching development is presented to verify the accuracy of the models achieved, which could validate the reliability of the software by comparing the simulation results and tests data.

articleTitle: Study for speed management technology of national road
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: More and more attentions are paid to limit speed for national road in recent years; it has become a social hot issue in China. Reasonable speed management technology has been demonstrated to enhance the overall safety and efficiency of the road system. The purpose of the paper is to produce a speed management program for national road by investigation the status of speed, harmonizing mutual interests of drivers and governors, resolving social conflicts, which can not only improve traffic efficiency and capacity of national highway, but also promote service level to ensure people's safe and convenient travel.

articleTitle: Calculations of amounts of joint reserve of talents in human resources systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The calculation formulas of amounts of reserve of talents of systems in “personnel training” model and in “introduction of talents” model are provided in this paper. At the same time, ideas of joint reserve of talents have been proposed, and the validity has been checked through the weibull distribution. This method of joint reserve of talents in human resources systems has certain referring value in practical life.

articleTitle: An on-line thickness measurement system based on TMS32DF2812
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new program including design and application of a high-accuracy system is proposed, aiming to improve the condition that waterproofing membrance production line is lack of effective thickness measurement and controlling technology. TMS320F8212 digital signal processor is used as the control chip. Sensor with high resolution and A/D sampling chip AD976 with high accuracy are used as the functional module. This system could collect and process data with high speed and accuracy. The terminal operating system and display interface are also designed to make better improvement for the review of data after processing. Moreover, more convenient settings will be made for relevant parameters.

articleTitle: Passenger recognition system based on body pressure distribution information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Passenger recognition system is subsystem of car airbag system. It would auxiliary control airbag work. Airbag won't burst out when automobile is colliding if passenger is child or short man. The passenger recognition is distinguished based on body pressure distribution data collected from body pressure sensor signal. Passenger recognition system consists of test bed, collecting subsystem of body pressure data, data analysis subsystem, neural network recognition subsystem and airbag controlled subsystem, etc. Test results show the system can be effective to control airbag work.

articleTitle: The detection filter choice of the OSL dating instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the dating principle of the optically stimulated luminescence is introduced, the construction of the optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating system, the composition of the detection filters, and the select method of the OSL dating instrument detection filters. The experiment result showed that, the first detection filters had a great influence on the background, and the second detection filters has a little influence on the background, so the second detection filters were suitable filter to the optical luminescence dating instrument.

articleTitle: Influencing factors on re-tracking accuracies of SAR altimeter ocean power waveforms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Using the along track processing and delay correction, a Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) altimeter has better retrieved accuracies of the geophysical ocean parameters than conventional radar altimeters (CRAs). The retrieved accuracies of a SAR altimeter are relevant to the shape of ocean echo wave and the number or averaged pulses and the effective number of looks. In order to get the high precisions, the errors that influence the waveform should be eliminated. This paper analyses the influencing factors and give the results that how these factors influence the precision. How to correct these factors is also given in the paper.

articleTitle: An efficient method of 3D road automatic generating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article raised an efficient method of 3D road automatic generation. The generation will adopt Cubic Hermite interpolation algorithm and improved Bilateral algorithm to create road grid when road curves are done by the method. After sticking road grid to terrain and doing the LOD optimization, it can produce 3D road. This method can make designing and achieve virtual city scene conveniently, raise the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Nonlinear perturbation solution of Duffing equation and the application in control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the solutions of Duffing equation were discussed with perturbation method when the system resonance occurs. We calculated vibration solutions about linear equations by harmonic compelling force. We also discussed resonance solution by perturbation method for Duffing equation with damping and without damping force. We use the methods to discuss the inverted pendulum in the control system.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization design of mining truck wheel reducer based on analysis of fatigue life
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The structure of wheel reducer will be damaged easily after being used a period of time if not consider the fatigue life of gears during the design. Nowadays minimum volume is the objective to most wheel reducer optimization design which ignores the influence of the fatigue life. The fatigue life of gears was studied and ROMAX which has the function of gears fatigue life analysis was used to the optimization design of wheel reducer to solve the problem in this paper, taking 60T electric wheels articulated truck wheel reducer as an example.

articleTitle: Study on supper resolution reconstruction based on staggered arrays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The image resolution can be improved without increasing the requirement to optical imaging systems' parameters and decreasing the size of CCD pixel by staggered arrays technology, which arranges several CCDs in a specific mode. In this paper, an image super resolution method of improving the image resolution for 1.5 times both in two directions by 4 linear arrays staggered based on this technology is presented, which avoids the large computation in a single time by use of circulation method. This method is proved effective by the digital simulation, and a simulated experiment platform is constructed to test its feasibility. The image resolution is improved for 1.42 times of the unreconstructed image according to the imaging experiment of resolution chart, which is closed to 1.5 times in ideal case. And also, the reconstructed and unreconstructed images are evaluated by the image information entropy, which proves that the reconstructed image contains more information.

articleTitle: Research of network storage system based on erasure code
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Data availability is one of the most important properties of the network storage system. Data redundancy is the basic method to improve data availability. Thus some systems use replication to protect against data loss. This paper designs a network storage system based on erasure code, researches data place strategy and data read write operation flow, analyzes data availability and storage overhead of the erasure code strategy and the replication strategy, draws the conclusion that erasure code strategy can greatly improve data availability.

articleTitle: Research on the pressure field of hydrostatic center rest
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Pressure distribution of heavy type hydrostatic center rest used in the heavy CNC equipment is hard to be measured directly because the oil film is very thin in the practical engineering. In order to solve this problem, a simulation research concerning the pressure field of hydrostatic center rest is described. The Finite Volume Method is used to compute the three-dimensional pressure field of gap fluid between the work piece and hydrostatic center rest according to computational fluid dynamics and lubricating theory. The pressure distribution law is revealed and the theoretical basis is provided for the optimal design of hydrostatic center rest.

articleTitle: The design of airborne equipment environmental test system based on C#
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the environmental analysis system of airborne equipment and its design process based on Visual Studio 2005. Through reference the design of environment experiments in GJB150 and GJB150A, to analyze the environmental factor of the missiles life period and to design the environments testing conditions. It makes a complete analysis of the environmental factors of the airborne equipment lifetime, and gives related tailor to environment test. In addition, it designs test order and test conditions. Finally, it generates the reports of environmental analysis systemof airborne equipment and environmental test conditions of airborne equipment. This study is useful for engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on the digitized models of automobile hubs based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Along with the rapid socio-economic and technological development, vehicles are widely used in China, especially in recent years, the rapid growing of automobile manufacturing industry which makes the automobile industry become a crucial pillar industry. A car wheel-hub is set as the research target according to the computer simulation theory, use the digital modeling software - Rhino as a platform, and then digitally analyze the wheel hubs. What's more, using the characteristic of the digital curve to study of curve and surface, and using the generative principle of line and plane to establish the mathematics model of wheel hub, eventually concluded that can be applied in automobile hub of 3D digitizing model establishment method, which laid a foundation for digital research of other transportation hub.

articleTitle: Optimum design and research on the involute gear tooth profile
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Traditional involute gears transmission problems are discussed in this paper, optimum design of the tooth profile is elicited, and then the involute-circular arc gear is introduced. The parametric model of the involute-circular arc gear is built based on the UG/NX. Bending stresses of involute-circular arc gears and traditional involute spur gears are theoretically analyzed, and explain why the bending fatigue life of involute-circular arc gear is improved. Assembly models of involute spur gears and involute-circular arc gears are built in UG/NX, then which are imported to the ADAMS to carry out the kinematics simulation, subsequently correlative graphs are extracted to analyze and verify that the transmission performance of involute-circular arc gears is better than traditional involute spur gears', and theoretical guidance for optimum design and practical manufacture of involute-circular arc gears is provided.

articleTitle: A SCM experiment of engine assembly by WITNESS simulating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the complexity in operations and the big existing number of auto parts and components, it is more than necessary to be successful in the supply chain management (SCM), mainly regarding to logistics cost reduction and integration of all links that constitutes the chain. For this purpose, an applied research in the engine company was carried out, and both the Milk-run system and the direct line haul system are used in the case of the engine assembly. By analyzing and comparing the features of the both, the paper summarizes the applied results of the latest Milk-run mode based on WITNESS simulating. The result shows the method utilized reducing costs with transport, warehousing and stocks maintenance activities, maximizing the vehicle utilization and minimizing the time expended, besides it reduces the stocks in all chain links and optimizing the establishment lasting relationships of trust between the all chain components.

articleTitle: Collision detection for 6-DOF parallel-link CMM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Generally, the parallel-link Coordinate Measuring Machine(CMM) has higher measuring accuracy and more flexible probe posture than the serial-link CMM. Therefore, theoretical and experimental research for the parallel-link CMM has become a hot topic for both industry and academia. In this paper, the virtual prototype of the 6-DOF parallel-link CMM was designed using the graphics functions in the OpenGL library. On the basis of above, a bounding box algorithm was developed to detect collision in the movement process, the detail method of the detection and the programming are also presented. This method improves not only the detection efficiency but also the reality of virtual prototype system.

articleTitle: Heat error modeling methods of NC machine tool machining holes or slots of door hardware based on genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to special accuracy require of holes or grooves of door hardware, the principle of NC machining of machining holes or grooves of door hardware was put forward. Heat Error is an important factor of machining accuracy of machine tool. The way of improving machine tool accuracy by using thermal deformation compensation is a necessary intelligent module of high quality NC machine tool. The heat error modeling principle and methods based on genetic algorithms for machining holes or grooves of door hardware on the NC machine tool were raised, which are the key for compensating heat error. The most optimized heat error can be obtained by error modeling based on genetic algorithms, which can compensating the heat error of machine tool for machining holes or grooves of door hardware.

Author Keywords: NC machining of holes or grooves of door hardware

articleTitle: Research on credibility evaluation method for satellite network simulation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: To resolve the problem of the credibility evaluation in the existing satellite network simulation system, it introduces the current status of the satellite network simulation system and the necessity of credibility evaluation; based on the definition of credibility, it summarizes the prevalent method of the credibility evaluation in detail, and analyses the characteristics of the credibility evaluation for the existing simulation system. Then the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) is used to perform the evaluation work. Experiment validates the feasibility and rationality of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Research on groove optimization for milling insert based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article takes the waved-edge milling insert (the rake face is curve plane) developed by Harbin University of Science and Technology as an example, based on the force density function and heat density function, we have the finite element analysis (FEA) on the stress fields and temperature fields of different cutting parameters, and have fuzzy synthetical judgement on them with fuzzy mathematic theory. We build the quantitative function relation between the fuzzy synthetical judgement results and cutting parameters, so to have groove optimization design and provide the groove optimization process. All these studies provide the theoretic basis for the groove exploitation and the cutter disrepair which is the key problem in the automatiz ation production.

articleTitle: New rapid prototyping manufacturing technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In the field of plastic Compression processing and manufacturing technology, A new idea of volumetric liquid plastic molding manufacturing's technology is proposed. The technology is using the transmission of liquid force which is advantage of the fine mechanical properties, and synthetic rubber has a good property against oil, pressure, flexible features, sheet metal parts can be processed with plastic deformation, to achieve the shape and size what we need. What described in this article is the most advanced aircraft manufacturing technology, some technology is not mature, not yet been fully applied to production. But it represents the current direction of development.

articleTitle: Simulation research on the aircraft orbit transferring based on dragging force using STK
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the combination of dragging force and little driving force, it is the most energy saving method for the spacecraft to transfer. For the initial design of this kind transferring problem, in this paper, is it proposed the designing of based on dragging force and little driving force about the spacecraft transferring in orbits. The method matches the necessary impetus and direction of the spacecraft entering its orbit with the dragging force, and mainly using the dragging force, to reduce the energy consumption in the process of spacecraft orbit transferring, therefore, the spacecraft can access to the specified target orbit and finish the tasks. This paper uses the data provided by the STK analysis module, makes the simulation design of spacecraft orbit transferring, and provides data to support the further research realization of the mobile platform applications of space capabilities.

articleTitle: Structure dynamics analysis of multistage submarine missile shell
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: As submarine-launched missile moving under water, the complex force can cause severe impact and vibration to it. The mechanical characteristics analysis of a missile shell was considering it as a simple structure for cylindrical shells structure mostly. In this paper, the shell is considered as two stages with a contact section. The structure dynamics was analyzed under axial and radial loading respectively, and the results were compared with a single-stage shell model.

articleTitle: Research on health assessment based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The health assessment is an important part of Prognostic and Health Management. Since the early fault signals are difficult to detect, we argue to convert them into the information that easily observed by using Hidden Markov Model (HMM), evaluate current state that deviation from the normal state and estimate the health status for the maintenance decision of Condition Based Maintenance. In this paper, we describe the basic theory, discuss the implementation methods of HMM in detail, and give an example for validation. Experimental results show that the method can effectively assess the health status of equipment.

articleTitle: The manufacturing method of diamond dressing gears for the dressing of gear grinding worms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The gear grinding process is a widely used process for gear finishing after heat-treated. The continuous profile grinding and the continuous generating grinding are the most common used gear grinding methods which have high productivity. The grinding worms can be dressing by diamond dressing gears, which have the profile of the workpieces to be machined and bonded a single layer of diamond particles. The paper has inroduced the traditional manufacturing methods of diamond dressing gears, positive electroplating and negative electroplating. Then put forward a new manufacturing method, Electroless nickel coating. Composition and condition of electroless composite plating solution, process steps are given. Several diamond dressing gears are made by this new method. Grinding experiment testified that it is an applied method and has many advantages.

articleTitle: Smart antenna receiver implemented in base-band and its performance evaluation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A usable smart antenna receiver (DIRAKE) for TD-SCDMA with beam-forming by amplitude-weight of base-band signal would be given in the paper. Moreover, its performance is also studied when multi-path interference and multi-access interference exist. According to the results of performance simulation, it could be found that DIRAKE receiver has higher gain than classic RAKR receiver, and is easier to be realized. When the beam is formed in base-band, that gain of DIRAKE receiver is influenced by the change of MS's position, which will induce some instability to the system.

articleTitle: Study on the simulation of troops' motorization march
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the characteristics of the motorization march, this article builds a motorization model of marching, analyzes its components and significance, select the developing platform, and design a general structure, and make some analysis on the basic functions of the realization of the marching simulation.

articleTitle: Fabrication of vanadium oxide for uncooled FPAs using dual magnetron AC sputtering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a novel equipment with an improved structure of the magnetron sputtering for thin film fabrication. By using this equipment, a vanadium oxide thin film with a better TCR and uniformity can be fabricated. In this equipment, two magnets are aligned with the wafer table eccentrically so that the coupling effect is rendered. This changes the distribution of magnetic field lines for each single sputtering target; as a result, a magnetic field gradient in the z-directionis generated, which acts on Ar together with the alternating current (AC) electric field. Consequently, the goal of using relatively small sputtering target material to generate large uniform film on the substrate is achieved. Besides, there being no sedimentary insulation on the anode as the traditional structure, it can avoid the periodical purification for the equipment to ensure the continuous work.

articleTitle: Research of the nonlinear torsional vibration of the marine diesel generator shaft system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: There is a nonlinear restoring force in the flexible rubber coupling fixed on the diesel generator driving shaft, to establish the multi-degree-of-freedom lumped-parameter mechanical model about the nonlinear torsional vibration of the shaft system, and by reference to the Lagrange equation, to get the vibration differential equations of the shaft system, In the numerical computation method to obtain the results. Through the comparison with the computed results of the linear system equations and the actual testing datum of the working machine, to analyze and study the nonlinear vibration characteristics of the diesel generator shaft system.

articleTitle: Imaging characteristics of 90-deg geometry volume holographic imaging system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Diffraction imaging characteristics of a 90-deg geometry volume holographic imaging system is investigated in this paper. A volume holographic grating, used as a volume holographic imaging lens in the imaging system, is recorded via illuminating the recording medium with a spherical signal beam and a plane reference beam. According to Bragg selectivity of a volume holographic grating, the Bragg mismatch of diffraction imaging in the different position can cause the significant decrease of diffraction efficiency. The point spread function (PSF) of the volume holographic imaging system is employed to analyze diffraction imaging characteristics and to estimate the depth resolution. The results show that the observed diffracted field obviously changes with the displacement in the z direction.

articleTitle: Measuring system for mobile robot based on multiple sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A distance measuring system based ultrasonic sensors and infrared sensors was presented. It can real-time handle sensor information. And through date fusion, the obstacles in the environment can be detected. This can be used to model the environment for mobile robot's path planning and other tasks. Experiment was shown that the system can be complementary in function of multi-sensor, while providing more accurate distance information.

articleTitle: Study of a scenic spot monitoring system based on RFID and multi-sensor information fusion technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a scenic spot monitoring system, to which the RFID and multi-sensor information fusion technology are applied. In this system, e-tickets are used to get tourist' information instead of existing paper tickets, in order to analyze the traffic, forecast and draft the diversion program to protect the area. The online multi-sensor information fusion is used to monitor the crisis situation, and make early warning. And also, the RFID is used to monitor the relic. With this system, the online monitoring can be completed. It provides a visual management tools to managers, a scientific basis for planning and daily management.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese drivers' shifting quality evaluation based on simulative traffic environments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In China, most of drivers drive manual transmission vehicles, and the high number of road accidents was caused due to unreasonable driving behaviors, such as wrong, or prentice, unpracticed acceleration shifting operations. Based on the existing domestic and international research results about driving behaviors, general theory and methods of driving behavior characteristics were analyzed, correlation methods were highlighted. Driving behavior tests under simulative traffic environment scenes were carried out on the fixed driving simulator and driving behavior simulation experiment platform developed by the State Key Laboratory of Automobile Dynamic Simulation of Jilin University. Actual tests combined with impact factors were analyzed. Adaptive Neuron-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS model) was set up by Matlab Fuzzy Inference Systems Toolbox, appropriate membership functions and mixed-learning algorithm was selected. Finally, the driver ANFIS model applied to acceleration shifting operation was obtained.

articleTitle: An approach of near infrared image accurate orientation and recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes an edge extraction algorithm of near infrared image based on 2-spline wavelet transform. Through Hough transform of edge image, object image's circle structure can be detected, and object image also has an accurate orientation. So we can extract special figure features of object image. Then near infrared images are classified by statistical template matching. All algorithms which are simple and efficient are compiled in VC++ 6.0. The experimental results show that exact digital image processing method can be applied in the field of differentiating paper currency instead of manual judging. This paper is about a new field of infrared image application and a new direction in differentiating the true and the counterfeit.

articleTitle: Design of test and diagnosis system for FPGA circuit board based on functional modeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Circuit boards composed of the boundary scan and non-boundary scan devices exist widely, and the fault detection and isolation of these non-boundary scan circuit boards is a puzzle for board-level maintenance and testing. Test methods based on boundary scan and digital I/O can not fulfill functional testing of entire circuit board. An automatic test system is constructed and a functional modeling method is put forward for FPGA circuit board testing. First, VITAL model is generated in FPGA development environment, achieving its functional modeling; then VITAL format configuration files and data are imported into LASAR, realizing circuit board simulation and fault simulation, and generating postprocessing documents; finally, postprocessing documents are input into ATE, and the automated testing and fault diagnosis of FPGA circuit board is implemented.

articleTitle: Based on the Internet to strengthen information acquisition and knowledge study
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It's very necessary to study advanced culture and knowledge all over the world by using the Internet. So this essay briefly discusses the significance and function of information consciousness and ability, the meanings of information technology, search and obtain the necessary information to improve life education by using the information technology. In brief, the purpose of this essay is to adovoate developing information resources, positively enjoying network resources, learning related knowledge, enhancing cultural quality, improving the theory and technology level for the sake of creating favorable conditions for further study and work, continuously improving quality of life and work. so as to promote the informationization development and social progress.

articleTitle: Design of digital correlator in the FPIR system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper first presents the concept of the full polarization interferometric radiometer (FPIR). FPIR is to implement high resolution polarimetric radiometry without system complexity. The basic composition of FPIR is introduced. An example or schematic of all four elements of the FPIR is demonstrated, especially focusing on the design of the digital correlator. In the end, the image of FPIR is presented.

articleTitle: An independent motion controlling method towards virtual 3D scene
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In view of the 3D virtual scene for the current self-motion method in the general lack of high-efficiency issues, an independent motion controlling method towards virtual 3D scene is proposed. In motion control, under the guidance of path from path search, combining with the 3D model are Delta skeletal animation to generate a moving process with smooth and vivid action. Compared with the traditional methods, this method does not depend on the motion control template, realizes motion control general computing mechanism completely based on virtual 3D scene analysis. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: APF implementation methods of inverter output constant voltage control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Selective harmonic elimination optimal pulse width modulation techniques are described in this paper. APF implementation methods of inverter output constant voltage control is designed. The experimental result shows that these methods can regulate power conditioner continuously, quickly and flexibly.

Author Keywords: IGBT (insulated gate bipolar transistor) voltage source inverter(VSI)

articleTitle: Low power design based on seed circulation Supervisory Hand-held device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Food safety becomes more and more important nowadays. Agricultural materials safety such as seed is an important prerequisite for food safety. The seed circulation Supervisory Hand-held device is designed to deal with the problems like market outlets dispersing, manual operation and lack in information etc. Low power design technology brings us smaller size and longer operating time of handheld device. This paper presents a low power hardware design using LTC3577 and LTC2941, and a software power management. The results show that the system power consumption would be greatly reduced by the strategy this paper use.

articleTitle: Development of CPU module test device based on the virtual instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The current method for test CPU module is to load the Built-in-Test program in IDE 386 software, which is used to test all the performance of CPU module, and must run under Windows 98 operation system. But now because the most computers install the windows XP operation system, if the above method is used, so it's needed to install two operation systems on test computers. In order to realize the automatic test, CPU Module Test Device (CMTD) is designed and developed, which is used to test CPU module with various types and buses automatically. The virtual instrument PXI architecture is used to design the CMTD and simulate CPU bus signals, designed adapter is used to connect CPU signals with PXI bus module. Test-Item configuration file is used to describe the Test-Flow, and the Intel command is sent to CPU through RS-232 interface, the open-circuit and short-circuit test of all the CPU signals is realized using the propose of matrix switch and multimeter. Test software is designed under the graphical LabVIEW platform, and which realized the functions of system self-test, system calibration, Built-in-Test, covering test, test result query and report generation. Now the device is in use on CPU module production line, which improves the detection efficiency of CPU modules.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of influence of grinding parameters on grinding force
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, based on the three-dimensional finite element model of surface grinding, the finite element analysis was employed to analyze the influence of grinding parameters on grinding force during the machining of SiCp/Al composites using diamond grinding wheel. The results indicate that model can reflect tendency of grinding force. Simulated results are consistent with experimental results. The results will provide a theoretical guidance to optimize for cutting process.

articleTitle: Templated electrodeposition of single-crystal ZnO nanorods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: It is demonstrated that by electrochemically controlling the local pH within a membrane zinc oxide nanorods may be fabricated. Single-crystal ZnO nanorods were obtained when growth was performed at 90 °C using the reduction of nitrate as the electrochemical source of hydroxide.

articleTitle: Instantaneous feature extraction of non-stationary signal based on complex Morlet wavelet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Put forward the method of Instantaneous feature extraction of non-stationary signal based on complex wavelet Morlet. Aiming at the characteristics of non-stationary signal signal, we construct two groups of combination information suitable for feature extraction combining amplitude and phase information which complex wavelet transform provide. The example of linear frequency-modulated signals and application examples of bearing vibration signal show that the model and the method have better antinoise ability, and have higher precision to the Instantaneous feature of non-stationary signal, and it can extract Instantaneous feature of non-stationary signal This method can realize its fast algorithm by Fourier transform, and has the simple and fast characteristics of algorithm, and realize the real-time analysis of the instantaneous characteristics of non-stationary signal.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on effect of water depth to the hydrodynamic characteristics of the cylinder out of the tube
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The influence of different water depths to the hydrodynamic properties of the cylinder in the process of vertical flyout of the tube was investigated by numerical simulation. The finite volume method based on the multiphase model, continuity equation, transport equations of liquid mass fraction, a dynamic mesh technique and a standard κ-ε turbulent model are adopted to solve the RANS equation in conjunction. The fluid-solid coupling problem in both of the movement boundary of the cylinder and the multiphase flow field was solved by using the numerical method. Under the influence of the gravity, the flow field affected the hydrodynamic characteristics of the cylinder was derived by using the numerical simulation. Simulation results show that different water depths affect on the trajectory of the underwater cylinder and hydrodynamic. The fluctuation reasons of different pressure drag coefficient, viscous drag resistance coefficient and toll resistance coefficient were studied by analyzing simulation results.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulating of facility layout based on manufacturing costs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Facility layout is widely used in manufacturing system. It has a very important effect on the performance of manufacturing system. The three types of facility layout, including linear, U-shape, and semi-circular layout are introduced firstly. Based on the lower selling price of customers' demand, the components of manufacturing cost are analyzed secondly. Then the relationship between the manufacturing cost and objectives of facility layout are described. Meanwhile, the mathematical and simulation models related to several parts of manufacturing cost of facility layout are set up respectively. Finally, the simulation of these models for three types of facility layout is running in QUEST. After analyzing the simulation results, conclusions are obtained: (1) material handling cost of loop layout is lowest among the three types of facility layout; (2) area utilization rate of loop layout is higher than the others; (3) equipment and labor utilization of U-shape layout is the higher than others in the same moment. This research results will provide the references in selecting the type of facility layout based on manufacturing cost.

articleTitle: Power system simulation platform based on CORBA technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing power system and new electrical devices continue to emerge, the power system operation and control became more and more complex. At the same time power system simulation software is also put forward higher requirements. In order to adapt the whole process and large-scale trends of power system simulation, a power system simulation program interoperability and integration issues are proposed. In this paper, a CORBA-based power system simulation platform is proposed to solve interoperability and integration issues. The platform adopts IEC61970 standard object-oriented modeling of power system and has good maintainability, scalability and flexibility. It provides a new way of thinking for the whole process dynamic simulation of power system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of intelligent algorithms for Multidisciplinary Design Optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: There have no criteria for comparison of intelligent algorithms at present. Characteristics of several intelligent algorithms concerned with Multidisciplinary Design Optimization are summarized, and on the basis, several criteria such as time, precision, numbers of problems solved are put forward. It is the first time to use the precision as criterion of comparison. This article originally introduces short-time optimizing capacity to aim at engineering problems. A series of instructional conclusions are received by running the cases selected. The bearing seat example validates correctness of these conclusions.

articleTitle: The application of PID controller optimized by genetic algorithm in valve-controlling asymmetrical cylinder system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article focuses on the application of PID controller with generation algorithm optimized in the valve-controlling hydraulic system with vertical load. Considering that PID control can not fulfill the demand, it is necessary to use other advanced methods for compensation. The effectiveness of PID controller with genetic algorithm optimized in controlling the system is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A modified nonlocal-means for adaptive image denoising
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Image denoising is an important problem and widely studied in image processing. Denoising is a crucial step to increase image conspicuity and to improve the performances of all the processing needed for quantitative imaging analysis. This work presents a modified nonlocal-mean denoising method based on the texture collection and edge information. At last, experiments result illustrate that the technique can be successfully used to the classical case of additive Gaussian noise. The proposed algorithm seems to improve on the state of the art performance.

articleTitle: Development of automatic control system for finishing of precise flat steel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional finishing machines, such as low automation degree, bad reliability and more failures, the automatic control system for finishing of precise flat steel is developed based on PLC, touch screen and invert in this paper. The producing flow and control requirements of finishing precise flat steel are introduced. The control system is used to adjust the speed of equipment for finishing precise flat steel. Application of touch screen offers a better HML By adopting semi-closed control strategy response time is reduced and control accuracy is improved. The system has good effect in practice.

articleTitle: Design of industrial robot controller based on system on programmable chip
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The paper studies a kind of open robot controller, combining powerful functions and remarkable advantages, which realizes programmable controller on chip of industrial robot using ALTERA FPGA and an embedded soft core processor of NIOS II, and designs the structures of software and hardware of the controller. The experiment is carried out. The results indicate that the robot controller is reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of SPF/DB process for ZK60 magnesium alloy corrugated part
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Superplastic forming and diffusion boding (SPF/DB) technology has been considered as one of the advanced manufacturing methods. In this paper, SPF/DB process of magnesium alloy corrugated part was analyzed by FEM software (MARC) with three-dimensional finite element model. Penalty function method was applied to analyze the contact problem. The distribution of the wall-thickness and the deformation characteristic during the forming process were analyzed, and also, the location of the risky point was predicted by tracing the wall thickness and analyzing the friction between the die and the part. A ZK60 magnesium alloy corrugated part was produced successfully by SPF/DB, and the results of FEM simulation were in good agreement with that of the experiment. Meanwhile, it is observed that the cavities are growing with the increasing of the deformation amount, and the cavity size and percentage get maximum values (9μm and 7.7% respectively) at the corner region of the part, in which the wall-thickness decreases sharply and thereby leading to the fracture of the part.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis of a wind turbine using maximum likelihood detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Bearings are the most frequently used components in a wind turbine. As such, bearing Fault Detection is an imperative part of preventive maintenance procedures of a wind turbine. This paper presents a Maximum likelihood method to implement bearing fault diagnosis. This set extracts the amplitude and frequency modulations of the vibration signals measure from a wind turbine system. As the amplitude demodulation is inherent in this set, the fault frequency can be detected from the spectrum of the transformed signal. The effectiveness of this method has been validated by using simulated signal and experimental data.

articleTitle: The advantages research about the SSHDWR+AJax design pattern in software developmen
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the framework distributed applications with its good characteristics of high cohesion, low coupling, high elastic, and easy maintenance obtained the people's extensive concern, it based on the layers of software development, especially Struts, Spring, and Hibernate framework. The integrated SSHDWR + AJax composite frame is Designed, the design is givened that the presentation layer, the business logic and the data persistence layer. It provides a design pattern with the loose coupling, the high reliability, the easy expansion, the low development cost, the short development cycle for the development of software system.

articleTitle: Design of distributed simulation experiment's control & management system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper addresses the needs of the distributed simulation experiment (DSE) by carefully analyzing and designing the four aspects of simulation experiment control and management system: the major functions, the modular interface, the man-machine interface (MMI), and operation procedures. The realization methodology is also presented. The application of this system proves its great significance in raising DSE's efficiency and simplifying operation procedures.

articleTitle: A mechatronics educational laboratory platform for manufacturing automation based on Googol FMS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A new style engineering education curriculum for mechatronics and manufacturing automation, innovative and practice training course is proposed. This curriculum is centered on advanced laboratory platform from Googol Technology and responsible for accomodating all the junior and senior students of our university for more than ten colleges. Project based learning and individual oriented teaching mode is adopted. Three types of projects are designed as knowledge deepen and extension oriented, science research oriented, and induatrial immersion and perception oriented projects to guarantee the teaching quality and objective implementation. Advantage and deficiencies have been obtained since the course's three year execution, and this new style course reveals great potential in engineering education.
