It can greatly reduce the temperature of the oil in hydraulic motor pump and make the oil in the hydraulic motor pump at a low level. In addition it also helps reducing the temperature gradient. In conclusion, this paper demonstrates the feasibility and efficiency of heat pipe technology for heat dissipation of hydraulic motor pump.

articleTitle: The analyzing of a cascaded multilevel class-D power amplifier with the carrier-based phase-shifted modulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a switch-mode power amplifier based on a cascaded multicell multilevel circuit topology. Amplifiers based on the single-phase inverter topology or H-bridge is most easily accomplished by the direct series, or parallel, connection of multiple H-bridge power-stages. Operating these with the phase-shifted PWM control gives higher output power and produces an improved output voltage spectrum and significantly lowers output current-ripple. Two carrier-based PWM schemes, phase-shifted and level-shifted modulations, are analyzed and their performance is compared. A multilevel class-D amplifier's mathematic model is analyzed. The results of measurements taken from a laboratory setup are presented which prove the proposed amplifier improves the dynamic system behavior and have wide bandwidth.

articleTitle: Mobile beacon node path scheme in arbitrary region for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Localization with mobile beacons is one of the most efficient ways to deploy sensor nodes and locate them. However, most of the current mobile beacon-assisted localization algorithms only discuss the application in rectangular sensor region. In order to achieve the localization in arbitrary sensor region, a novel mobile beacon-assisted localization algorithm based on virtual force and ant colony algorithm for wireless sensor networks is presented. Experimental results show that the proposed localization can achieve a proper balance between localization accuracy and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Embedded forest fire monitoring and positioning system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: According to the bulky, high cost and interfered seriously of present forest fire monitoring system, the embedded forest fire monitoring and positioning system is designed based on machine vision. The system consists of four parts: embedded forest fire detection, 3G wireless communication, positioning system and held terminal. Forest fire recognition and positioning algorithm are studied based on FPGA and DSP, and 3G wireless communication is achieved. The results show that the system can overcome a variety of interference and has low false alarm rate, high real time, low power consumption. This system has good operation effect through the test in Inner Mongolia and the positioning error is less than ten meters.

articleTitle: Electrical vehicle crash test technique research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: With the implement of national electrical vehicle project, the development of new energy vehicle like the electrical vehicle, hybrid vehicle and fuel battery vehicle is strengthened gradually. However, an important feature of electrical vehicle is the high voltage surge power circuit installed in it. Compare to the crash safety test method of classical vehicle, this paper put more attention on the electrical safety problem of electrical vehicle. First of all, this paper analyze the electrical vehicle crash test standards in domestic and abroad, research on the crash test method, and combine the real vehicle crash test data analyze the concerned problems of electrical vehicle.

articleTitle: Vibration characteristic analysis of spot-welding robot based on ADAMS/Vibration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming to improving the performance of high-power, heavy-load, high-speed and high-precision robots, this paper proposes a simulation method for vibration analysis based on virtual prototyping technology. In ADAMS/Vibration, we first establish the rigid-flexible coupling vibration system of a spot-welding robot, then solve the natural frequencies and modal shapes of the system, and finally calculate the frequency response under certain forced vibration. In order to build vibration system, the principle and simulation process of vibration analysis are given by inputting sine sweep signal on end effector. With the help of the getting frequency response, we can avoid the failure of damage due to the resonance vibration of the system and create the conditions for the optimal design and reliability research of a spot-welding robot.

articleTitle: Research and application of algorithm for mining positive and negative association rules
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, an effective algorithm is presented to discover positive and negative association rules. Especially, it analyzes the definition of the positive and negative association rules, computational methods of support and confidence level in affairs. It also talks about the conflicted rules problems which are in the positive and negative association rules mining. It gets the solutions of the conflicted rules problems with the related rules.

articleTitle: Blackboard mechanism based genetic algorithm for dynamic deployment of mobile sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A novel bionic swarm intelligence algorithm, called genetic algorithm based on a blackboard mechanism, is proposed to solve the autonomy and dynamic deployment of mobile sensor networks effectively. A blackboard mechanism is introduced into the system for path planning and completing the algorithm. Each path, which can be seen as a chromosome, will be the optimization scheme after several generations of evolution. The optimal path will be broadcasted by wireless to every node in the WSN. We test the algorithm in a dynamic environment. The results indicate that the algorithm can reduce the power consumption by 10% averagely, enhance the efficiency of path planning and deployment of mobile WSN by 13% averagely.

articleTitle: An improved best bin first algorithm for fast image registration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Image registration is the significant part in some image processing applications. The scale invariant feature transform (SIFT) is the most commonly used as feature-based image registration algorithm. This algorithm will produce high dimensional feature descriptors. The best bin first (BBF) is a very efficient algorithm to find the nearest neighbor from a large number of high dimensional feature descriptors. But this algorithm has a shortage: it may not obtain the correct matching feature points when large scale exits among images. In this paper, we overcome the shortage through improving best bin first search algorithm; this approach is named improved BBF. The paper improves BBF from two aspects. First, we add a flag in data structure of k-d tree node, which represents whether the specified feature descriptor need search. This improving makes up the shortage effectively. Second, we build the k-d tree by selecting the most feature descriptors. This improving further improves the searching speed. Through large experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved BBF search algorithm and the execution speed will increase above 10%.

articleTitle: Rail pressure control of common rail diesel engine based on RBF neural network adaptive PID controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The model of high pressure common rail system is designed and studied. In this paper, we propose a PID controller based on RBF neural network, and the corresponding control program is carried out under Matlab environment. When compared with traditional PID controller, RBF based PID controller shows its superiority having better dynamic response.

articleTitle: A color image fusion method using discrete wavelet frames
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Multisensor image fusion is becoming a focus in the area of image processing because of its wide applications. But most of the existing approaches are developed for intensity images, not for color images. In this paper, based on discrete wavelet frame transform and HSI model, a novel method for color image fusion is proposed. The experimental results show that the method is satisfying.

articleTitle: Study on an active voltage equalization charge system of a series battery pack
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Because of the advantages of fully sealed, without leakage, without pollution and without maintained in its used period, valve regulated sealed lead-acid battery can ensure the safety of human body and all sorts of electrical equipments. Now valve regulated sealed lead-acid battery has widely used as stand-by power in power industry, communication industry and other industries which need stand-by power. The voltage of single battery is limited, its range usually only has 2V to 2.2V, So battery packs are usually used in a lot of stand-by power systems. Battery pack is composed of many single battery which is in series. Because of the differences of battery's manufacturing techniques, chemical compositions, used environment and operated history, the characteristics of each battery which is in series battery pack has unconsistency. With the battery pack's cyclic charged and discharged, unconsistency of single battery in the same battery pack will be expanded. This will cause differences of final discharge voltage of each single battery in one battery pack, although they are run in the same condition of charged or discharged. This kind of unconsistency will also cause Domino's chain reactions among single batteries in the same battery pack. In such a way, the actual service life of one battery pack will be shorten greatly. For a battery pack, if it is not managed and maintained in time, the capacity, service life, and performance of the entire battery pack are affacted, at the same time, the system's reliability whose stand-by power is such a battery pack will be reduced greatly. In order to prolong the service life, the same depth of discharge of each single battery must be kept consistency. This problem can be solved by active equalization charge to a battery pack. In this paper, a practical method of active equalization charge to a battery pack is put forward. Tested and verified by practical application in worksite, the voltage of each single battery tends to consistency basically in the same one battery pack, the effect of active equalization charge to a battery pack is satisfied.

articleTitle: Numerical study of francis turbine flow field under small opening condition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In order to study the cause of Francis turbine abnormal oscillation under small opening condition, CFD method was adopted to analyze the flow filed and its impact on turbine stability. Numerical simulation was performed on the commercial CFD code FLUENT 6.2, using RNG κ-ε model. Through an effective validation of the computation result and detailed flow analysis, the paper showed vortices existed in runner and draft tube flow field, abnormal pressure distribution on blades and vanes, and reverse flow in guide vanes under reverse pump condition. The result shows that the unstable flow under small opening condition leads to an increase of turbine instability, and is one possible reason of the abnormal oscillation.

articleTitle: Thermal error modeling of machine tool based on fuzzy c-means cluster analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Thermal errors of the machine tools have a significant effect on the machining precision. In this paper, temperature variables selection based on the fuzzy c-means cluster analysis is studied, robust regression theory is utilized to establish the relationship between the thermal errors and the temperature variables, and large residuals are given small weights and leave the residuals associated with extreme points. Pt thermal resistances are used to measure the temperature change and the eddy current sensors are used to monitor the thermal shifts of the spindle, the test results show that robust regression method can predict the thermal errors of the machine accurately. The coupling among the variables is also solved, which can be used for the error compensation of the machine tool so as to meet the accuracy demands of the precision machining.

articleTitle: Review on integrated health management for aerospace plane
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The references at home and abroad are summarized in this paper. This paper introduces the basic concept and the application significance of aerospace plane, the main differences between the aerospace plane and general aircraft, integrated health management system and its compositions of aerospace plane, the development status of health management for aerospace plane in domestic and foreign countries. Especially it recommends special technical experiments in America, Japan and Italy, and analyzes the health management approaches of them. Finally, it also describes the main fault diagnosis methods. Integrated health management of aerospace plane generally involves a series of activities, including signal processing, monitoring, health assessment, failure prediction, decision support, human-computer interaction, restoring, and so on. In addition, this paper predicts development direction of health management for the aerospace plane.

articleTitle: Traction control algorithm based on fuzzy PID and PWM modulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a traction control algorithm based on fuzzy PID and modulation of pump based on PWM is proposed. The target brake pressure needed to be exerted on the driving wheel is determined by a fuzzy PID controller from the difference between the target wheel speeds and actual wheel speeds and is fulfilled by PWM control of hydraulic pump of the hydraulic control unit. The control algorithm is validated based on a hardware Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test bench which is based on the xPC Target™ product of MATLAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>, and the test results of show that the algorithm can control the spin of driven wheels effectively.

articleTitle: Application of an artificial neural network on railway passenger flow prediction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This paper applies the theory of data warehouse and data mining and its derived technology to deal with the huge amount of data of the Ticket Selling and Reserving System of Chinese Railway (TRS). We use effective data mining in passenger flow analysis to establish a logical forecasting and analysis model. Our model can provide accurate decision-making information and an advanced way of forecast for the railway transit authority to make a optimal planning for passenger transport, scientific organization of the railway system and high efficiency of transport energy.

articleTitle: Kinetic study of a novel trans-scale precision positioning stage based on stick-slip effect
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the stick-slip effect was introduced and a prototype of trans-scale precision positioning stage based on the stick-slip effect was designed. The electro-mechanical conversion model of PZT actuator was built by the capacitance charge-discharge formula and the step model of PZT actuator. According to the structure of the prototype, the second-order oscillation model of inertial mass was also deduced and simulate in Matlab-Simulink software. Base on kinetic experiment, the simulation results of second-order oscillation model of inertial mass was validated by the experiment results. The oscillation model of inertial mass well reflects the oscillation phenomenon in each step of stick-slip driving and improves the accuracy of the input displacement signal in the modeling of stick-slip driving compared with only using the step model of PZT actuator.

articleTitle: Design of automotive CAN network management based on OSEK standard
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Combined with the study of OSEK network management, the design of CAN network management was mainly introduced in the paper. The design include message, correspondence between message and can frame, Ring message algorithm, Alive algorithm and LimpHome algorithm. The network management strategy designed was simulated and test in CANoe, The final result indicates that CAN network management designed runs well, and the function and algorithm specified by OSEK NM can be performed well.

articleTitle: Multi-motor control system design based on Can bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a multi-motor control circuit based on controller area network (CAN) bus is presented. The 89C51 microcontroller is the foundation and the circuit which is based on the usage of DAC0832 digital-to-analog converter, in order to achieve the breakdown of motor control. In the subdivision control, subdivision steps are set by software. Article details the overall structure of the system of hardware design, software design process, and CAN bus controller structure. Compared with the traditional centralized control, the multi-motor control system has higher reliability. Experimental result shows that the system and the intelligent control module is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: A new method of the image pattern recognition based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: A large number of computations are involved in images pattern recognition. In the process not only the speed is not quick, but also the accuracy is not high enough. To solve this problem, a new image pattern recognition method which the pixel points as the neurons to be trained is proposed and the Pattern recognition is constructed based on the neural network. A neural network system with pattern recognition function is designed in the identification processing. When an image is inputted to be identified, the source image will be given after the computed. The simulation test is done and the results show that the source image is recognized at high-speed and high accuracy. It can be used in the fast pattern recognition system.

articleTitle: Study on space station design elements for intra-vehicular navigation: A survey
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Space station intra-vehicular navigation elements design is a new research focus arising in the field of space station ergonomics, to improve astronauts' navigation ability in multi-module Space Station. The research progress of space station intra-vehicular navigation elements design was summarized and analyzed in this paper from three aspects: 3D interior configuration, interior design, and navigational aids. The derivation of space station intra-vehicular navigation elements design was introduced. After the method for navigation ability evaluation was discussed, research achievements on the effect of space station 3D interior configuration on human navigation ability were summarized, and research production and deficiency of space station interior design and navigational aids design for improvement of navigation ability were studied comprehensively. At last, the research directions in future were pointed out.

articleTitle: Memristor-based cell design and digital logical operations implementation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Memristor-based cell is proposed in this paper. Digital logical operations in the proposed memrsitor cell can be performed with a voltage-controlled current (VCC) source input or a current-controlled voltage (CCV) source input. The important application of the proposed memristor cell is to build memristor-based sersors, memristor cellular automaton, and memristive cellular neural networks.

articleTitle: Precision forming technology and application for high-precision sandwich reflector panels
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the precision forming manufacturing issues of high-precision, wide-range, undevelopable hyperbolic reflector panels, this paper further developed high-precision reflector panels forming technology based on "discrete nail die, vacuuming pressure, honeycomb sandwich, stress release and spring back", built a mechanical model for hyperbolic sandwich forming, determined the simulation algorithm of the forming process and summarized the main influence factors reflected panel precision. The shape precision of panels was increased by slotting stress release and spring back compensation, while the edge precision was assured by accessing developed panel by iterative strain energy releasing method. The precision-forming CAE system, environmental control and laser tracker measurement were used as the panel quality control methods. The shape precision and edge precision of panels manufactured by this technology totally met the design requirements. The technology can be successfully applied in large compact antenna test range (CATR) and the manufacture of millimeter wave antenna.

articleTitle: Effect of content on dielectric performance of Barium titanate/polyimide films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Polymer-matrix insulating materials are widely used in electrical and electron engineering because of their excellent mechanical properties, thermal and dielectric properties. Barium titanate/polyimide (BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/PI) nanocomposites have been prepared by an in-situ polymerization process at room temperature. The BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> phase was observed by scanning electron microscope (SEM), it shows that the BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> phase was well dispersed in the polymer matrix. The composite with 70 wt% BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> appears a high dielectric constant of about 15 in the frequency of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> Hz to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> Hz and a high breakdown strength of more than 50KV/mm under alternating current (AC) field at room temperature. Meanwhile, the loss tangent of all the simples measured was under 0.015. The volume resistivity of the composite decreased with the increase of the concentration of BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, but it was still greater than 1.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> ohm-m.

articleTitle: State feedback control of saturated switched systems and its application to turntable
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: State feedback control problem for a class of switched linear systems and its application are studied. Based on switched Lyapunov function and some basic lemmas, the purpose is to design a switched state-feedback controller with a switching scheme guaranteeing the local asymptotic stability of the resulting closed-loop system. And analyze the domain of attraction by using a convex optimization problem subject to linear matrix inequalities(LMI) constraints. Finally, the method is applied to a high precision test turn-table and the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Spatial improved fuzzy c-means clustering for image segmentation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The generalized fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm with improved fuzzy partition (GFCM) is a new modified version of the fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm (FCM). GFCM under appropriate parameters can converge more rapidly than FCM. However, GFCM, similar to FCM, is sensitive to noise in normal gray-level images. In order to overcome this problem, a novel fuzzy segmentation algorithm called spatial improved fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm (IFCM_S) is proposed in this paper. In IFCM_S, a spatial constraint term is introduced into the objective function of GFCM, and the center and membership function update equations are also presented. Experiments on synthetic and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images, show that the proposed method behaves well in segmentation performance and speed.

articleTitle: Application of SAGE algorithm to estimate thin layer material's thickness in ultrasonic NDE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Accurate thickness measurement of thin layer material is usually difficult in ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation (NDE), because the reflected ultrasonic echoes often overlapped which makes it difficult to separate these echoes and get the arrival times accurately. This paper used improved space alternating generalized expectation maximization (SAGE) algorithm to separate the reflected echoes and estimate the echoes' parameters for the purpose of acquiring the accurate arrival time of the echoes. With the accurate arrival time estimated, the thin layer material's thickness can be evaluated. Two experiments were carried out on a thin steel sheet with 20 MHz and 5MHz transducers using the improved SAGE algorithm, and the results validate the method's accuracy.

articleTitle: Current status of grafting robot for vegetable
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: Vegetable grafting is one of the most effective means to resist soil-born diseases and to improve yield. Manual grafting has the problems of low production and poor grafting quality, so grafting robot is significant for the development of vegetable grafting production. Based on the grafting principles, the development and current status of domestic and foreign automatic grafting machine was analyzed. Some problems restricting the advancement of grafting machine are found out.

articleTitle: The dynamic modelling and simulation of planar linkage containing translational joint based on vector bond graph
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronic & Mechanical Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: The procedure of modeling planar linkage containing translational joint by vector bond graphs is described. The constraint force vectors at joints can be considered as unknown effort source vectors and added to the corresponding 0-junctions of the system vector bond graph model, most of the differential causalities in system vector bond graph model can be eliminated. Based on this, the unified formulae of system state space equations and constraint forces at joints are derived, which are easily derived on a computer. As a result, the algebraic difficulty brought up by nonlinear junction structure and differential causality in automatic modelling and simulation can be solved. This procedure is very suitable for the modeling and simulation of the systems containing multi-energy domains in a unified manner, its validity is illustrated by a practical example.
